patterns.trigger: “the ground colour”“the dis…cal and postdiscal areas”“a lighter pattern”“an opening in the region”
patterns.context: 技术或说明性文字中，描述部件、区域、形态或位置；片段间未见稳定的共同触发词。
patterns.domain: 维基百科自然史描述、专利

patterns.name: 专利结构与部件说明
patterns.trigger: “liquid-pervious topsheet”“liquid-impervious backsheet”“liquid-absorbent core”“penis insertion mouth”；“formed on”“bonding pad”“glass coat”
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术说明中列举器件材料、层、部件及其空间关系。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的材料、形态与组成
patterns.context: 论文中报告纳米颗粒性质，或说明结石矿物组成及结构。
patterns.domain: 药剂学、生物医学与矿物组成研究

patterns.name: 叙事中的人物与注意力描述
patterns.trigger: “Anna is certain her parents were killed in the fire”“spends the least amount of time focusing on searching”
patterns.context: 叙事性文字中描述人物对事件的判断及行为倾向。

patterns.name: 文学评论中的传记性抗议叙述
patterns.trigger: “Grace Paley Reader”“writing from behind the bars”“spent six days for protesting”
patterns.context: 评论或随笔中引用作家作品，并提及其抗议经历。

en.description: Activations span several types of text: Let/Suppose introducing symbols, functions, and equations in math problems is prominent. Other examples include biological morphology, patent components, climate narratives, and experimental methods; the non-mathematical passages cover unrelated topics.

patterns.name: The mathematical prompt word Let
patterns.context: Introduces variables, functions, or equations in math problems, especially Let/Suppose followed by a symbol, definition, or equality. Activation sometimes falls on the introductory word or the immediately following variable.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and expressions
patterns.context: Variables, functions, arithmetic expressions, and equations occur densely, often adjacent to problem instructions or definitions; this co-occurs with the Let pattern but can also occur independently.

patterns.name: Regional terms in wing-vein/wing-surface descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the size, color, and wing-surface regions of insect wings.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biological taxonomy or morphology descriptions

patterns.name: Absorbent product components and structure in patents
patterns.context: Patent-style structural language describes a bag, layers, and their uses or openings.

patterns.name: Climate and rainy-season narratives
patterns.context: Describes high temperatures, humidity, rainfall, and the duration of the rainy season by month, then shifts to government and political headings.

patterns.name: Unit-digit questions in math problems
patterns.context: Asks for the units digit of an expression, followed by a Let definition for a new problem.

patterns.name: Shape, surface, and protrusion descriptions of biological morphology
patterns.context: Describes biological morphology in terms of length, body shape, dorsal surface, ridges, and protrusions.

patterns.name: Experimental methods and behavioral procedure headings
patterns.context: Reports animal control groups, dosing schedules, and the rationale for doses, followed by a behavioral procedure subsection heading.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central experimental paper methods sections

9_321.concept: 结构化定义与描述文本
9_321.description: 激活覆盖多类文本：突出数学题中 Let/Suppose 引入符号、函数和方程；另见生物形态描述、专利部件、气候叙述及实验方法等，非数学段落彼此主题各异。

patterns.name: 数学题引导词 Let
patterns.context: 数学题中引入变量、函数或方程；尤其是 Let/Suppose 后接符号、定义或等式。激活有时落在引导词或紧随的变量上。

patterns.name: 数学符号与表达式
patterns.context: 变量、函数、算术表达式及方程密集出现，常与题目指令或定义相邻；与 Let 模式共现，但也可能独立出现。

patterns.name: 翅脉／翅面描述中的区域术语
patterns.context: 描述昆虫翅膀的尺寸、颜色和翅面区域。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 生物分类或形态描述

patterns.name: 专利中的吸收用品部件与结构
patterns.context: 以专利式结构语言说明袋体、片层及其用途或开口。

patterns.name: 气候与降雨季节叙述
patterns.context: 按月份叙述高温、湿度、降雨及雨季延续时间，随后转入政府与政治标题。

patterns.name: 数学题中的单位数字提问
patterns.context: 询问表达式的个位数字，后接新题的 Let 定义。

patterns.name: 生物形态的外形、表面与突起描述
patterns.trigger: “Body elongate-elliptical”、“ends equally rounded”、“finely reticulated ridges”及“distinct knobs”
patterns.context: 按长度、体形、背部表面及脊和突起描述生物形态。

patterns.name: 实验方法与行为程序标题
patterns.context: 交代动物对照组、给药安排和剂量依据，之后出现行为程序小节标题。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 实验论文方法部分

en.description: Activations occur on sentence-final punctuation, paragraph breaks and section headings, articles and subword fragments, as well as formulas, math problems, patent geometry descriptions, social hierarchies, insect morphology, and educational terminology. No consistent semantic or lexical condition emerges.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: At the end of methods or technical explanations, punctuation is often preceded by an abbreviation, parentheses, or units; however, punctuation activations are not consistently marked in the given text.

patterns.name: Line breaks before section headings
patterns.context: A blank line appears after a paragraph or methods description, followed by a new section heading; the opening word or heading itself is also marked.

patterns.name: Letter sequences in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls within a tokenized word or on a local fragment; word classes and meanings are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial definite articles and local collocations
patterns.context: Ordinary noun phrases or sentence beginnings; sometimes near sections, descriptive nouns, or proper names, but with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Values, formulas, and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Function definitions and equations in math problems, tire geometry descriptions in patents, or measurement formulas in papers; these passages have no single shared trigger symbol.

patterns.name: Highlighted relative-position word
patterns.context: Describes the ordering of social ranks, with a group occupying the highest level.

patterns.name: Taxonomic terms in biological descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the color and regions of insect wings; activation occurs within a morphological orientation term.

patterns.name: Emphasis words in multiword entries or headings
patterns.context: Phrases and section headings in educational project introductions or experimental papers receive activations; no stable shared collocation is apparent.

9_321.description: 激活分布在句末标点、段落换行与章节标题、冠词和词内片段，也见于公式、数学题、专利几何描述、社会层级、昆虫形态及教育术语；未形成一致语义或词法条件。

patterns.name: 句末标点
patterns.context: 方法或技术说明的句末，标点前常有缩写、括号或单位；不过标点的激活标记在给定文本中并不统一。

patterns.name: 章节标题前的换行
patterns.context: 段落或方法说明结束后出现空行，随后开始新章节标题；标题起始词或标题本身也被标记。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母组合
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词拆开的词内部或其局部片段，词类和语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 句首定冠词及局部搭配
patterns.context: 普通名词短语或新句开头；有时邻近章节、描述性名词或专名，但没有一致的语义条件。

patterns.name: 数值、公式与数学符号
patterns.context: 数学题中的函数定义与方程、专利中的轮胎几何说明，或论文中的测量公式；这些片段没有共同的单一触发符号。

patterns.name: 高亮的相对位置词
patterns.context: 描述社会等级次序时，表示某群体处于最高层级。

patterns.name: 生物学描述中的分类术语
patterns.context: 描述昆虫翅膀的颜色和区域，激活出现在形态学方位术语内部。

patterns.name: 多词条目或标题中的强调词
patterns.context: 教育项目介绍或实验论文中，短语及章节标题获得激活；未见稳定的共同搭配。

en.description: The most consistent response is to specific noun phrases containing the, especially those involving parts, components, and their locations in expository text. Other examples include color and appearance, patent structures, and quantitative scientific statements. Some sporadic high-activation words are difficult to explain independently.

patterns.name: The in definite articles and noun phrases
patterns.context: Introduces a specific anatomical part, object component, body region, or other identified object in expository prose; the is especially strongly activated in several passages.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, patents, medical abstracts, and scientific papers

patterns.name: Positional and component-localization expressions
patterns.context: Describes an object’s position on, inside, at the end of, or in a specific region; common in structural, morphological, and measurement descriptions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic explanations, patent structural descriptions, medical and scientific writing

patterns.name: Anatomical or structural nouns
patterns.context: Nouns refer to body parts or components of an object, often paired with the, at, in, and other localization expressions.
patterns.domain: Biology and medicine, architectural descriptions, patents

patterns.name: Color and appearance features
patterns.context: Describes the colors, spots, stripes, and patterns of animals, body regions, or surfaces; mostly encyclopedic or natural-history-style appearance descriptions.

patterns.name: Patent components and geometric structures
patterns.context: Describes the structure of devices or products using component names, directions, ends, and spatial relations.

patterns.name: Quantitative scientific reports
patterns.context: Reports values such as experimental time, body measurements, weight, field strength, or concentration, usually embedded in technical statements.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, encyclopedia data, ArXiv, and environmental science abstracts

patterns.name: High-activation words with no apparent pattern
patterns.context: These sporadic tokens do not show a consistent, independent semantic trigger in their local sentences; they may be influenced by neighboring structure or tokenization.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; not attributable to a specific style

9_321.concept: 具体对象的说明性定位
9_321.description: 最稳定的反应是说明性文本中带 the 的具体名词短语，尤其涉及部位、部件及其方位；另见颜色外观、专利结构和定量科学陈述。部分零散高激活词难以独立解释。

patterns.name: 定冠词与名词短语中的 the
patterns.trigger: «the»，以及相邻的名词短语，如 «the» «throat»、«the» «east end»、«the» «injection site»
patterns.context: 在说明性散文中引出具体解剖部位、物体部件、身体区域或其他已指明对象；多个片段中 the 的激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、专利、医学摘要及科学论文

patterns.name: 方位和部件定位表述
patterns.context: 描述对象上、内、端部或特定区域的位置；常见于结构、形态与测量描述。
patterns.domain: 百科说明、专利结构描述、医学和科学文体

patterns.name: 解剖或结构性名词
patterns.context: 名词指向生物体部位或物体的组成部分，常与 the、at、in 等定位表达搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物与医学、建筑描述、专利

patterns.name: 颜色与外观特征
patterns.context: 描述动物、身体区域或表面颜色、斑点、条纹和图案；多为百科或自然史式外观描写。

patterns.name: 专利部件与几何结构
patterns.context: 以部件名称、方向、端部和空间关系描述装置或制品的结构。

patterns.name: 定量科学报告
patterns.context: 报告实验时间、体尺、重量、场强或浓度等数值，通常嵌在技术性陈述中。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、百科数据、ArXiv 与环境科学摘要

patterns.name: 模式不明显的高激活词
patterns.context: 这些零散 token 在局部句子中没有显示出一致、独立的语义触发条件；可能受邻近结构或 token 切分影响。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，无法单独归为特定文体

en.description: Activations concentrate in technical expository writing: components, shapes, and uses in patents; species morphology and texture; and biomedical results or measurement equipment. Their shared feature is concrete, objective, specialized description rather than a clear single topic word.

patterns.name: Structures and components in patent claims or invention descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the shape, composition, position, and dimensions of devices, materials, or components, often in patent background and invention-description syntax; also includes specific structural designs.

patterns.name: Body morphology and surface texture descriptions
patterns.context: Uses objective, dense morphological vocabulary to describe the body shape, color, surface structure, and texture of animals or plants.

patterns.name: Experimental biomedical results and changes
patterns.context: Reports experimental treatments, sample responses, or measured biomedical changes, including comparisons, results, and quantitative metrics.

patterns.name: Medical instruments and measurement procedures
patterns.context: Explains how medical measurement systems measure blood flow and describes related instrument components; adjacent to the experimental-results pattern but focused on equipment and methods.

patterns.name: Patent product descriptions of specific uses or insertion sites
patterns.context: Patent text describes the opening of a pouch-like product and its specific use or insertion site; although still a patent structural description, the content is distinct.

9_321.description: 激活集中于技术性说明文：专利中的构件、形状、用途，物种形态与纹理，以及生物医学结果或测量设备；共同特点是具体、客观的专业描述，而非明显的单一主题词。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求或发明描述中的结构与部件
patterns.trigger: “a metal tube of irregular shape”“at least two inner diameters”“a nebulizing device”“at least two nebulizing elements”“the width of the sipe”
patterns.context: 描述装置、材料或构件的形状、组成、位置和尺寸，常见专利背景与发明说明的句式；也包括具体结构设计。

patterns.name: 身体形态及表面纹理描述
patterns.trigger: “wingspan”“ground colour”“forewings”“Body elongate-elliptical”“finely reticulated ridges”“smooth and glossy”“leathery in texture”
patterns.context: 以客观、密集的形态学词汇描述动物或植物的体型、颜色、表面结构及质地。

patterns.name: 实验性生物医学结果与变化
patterns.trigger: “vitamin A deficiency”“altered the small intestine”“biochemical and the morphological levels”“decrease of MAO-A”“maximum decreases”
patterns.context: 报告实验处理、样本反应或测得的生物医学变化，含比较、结果和定量指标。

patterns.name: 医学仪器与测量流程
patterns.trigger: “continuous wave velocimeter”“measure the spatial mean velocity”“output calculator”“oesophageal catheter”“ultrasonic transducers”
patterns.context: 说明医疗测量系统如何测量血流及相关仪器部件；与实验结果模式相邻但侧重设备和方法。

patterns.name: 具体用途或插入部位的专利产品描述
patterns.context: 专利文本描述袋状产品的开口及其特定用途或插入部位；虽同属专利结构说明，但内容独特。

en.concept: neut word beginnings and sporadic terms
en.description: The strongest activations cluster at the beginning of neut: they occur in both neutropenia (an adverse medical reaction or symptom) and neutrons (nuclear physics). A few other scattered triggers include The in a password example, option in code, published in a license, and defined in a technical answer. No shared semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: neutropenia term
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the initial neut in neutropenia; the suffix is split inconsistently. It often appears in sentences listing hematological adverse reactions or disease manifestations.
patterns.domain: Medicine, clinical research, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: neutron term
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the initial neut in neutrons; the context concerns nuclear reaction cross sections or nuclide decay.

patterns.name: Definite article in a password example
patterns.context: The trigger is The at the beginning of or locally within a description of a ZIP password example; the password is stated immediately afterward.

patterns.name: option in a C++ API
patterns.context: option appears before a C++ type name or template expression and is followed by parentheses; the context is not medical.

patterns.name: published in GPL license text
patterns.context: Fixed software-license wording describing publication by a foundation.
patterns.domain: Github source comments and license text

patterns.name: Form of defined
patterns.context: In a StackExchange technical answer, defined appears in parentheses to indicate that an operation or behavior is defined.

9_433.description: 最强激活集中在 neut 词首：既命中 neutropenia（医学不良反应或症状），也命中 neutrons（核物理）。另有少量分散触发，分别是密码例句中的 The、代码中的 option、许可证中的 published、技术答复中的 defined，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: neutropenia 词项
patterns.context: 触发点落在 neutropenia 的词首 neut 上，后缀拆分方式不固定；多见于列举血液学不良反应或疾病表现的句子。
patterns.domain: 医学、临床研究与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 中子词项
patterns.context: 触发点落在 neutrons 的词首 neut；上下文谈核反应截面或核素衰变。

patterns.name: 密码示例中的定冠词
patterns.context: 触发点是描述 ZIP 密码示例时句首或局部的 The，后文直接说明密码。

patterns.name: C++ API 中的 option
patterns.context: option 出现在 C++ 类型名或模板表达式之前，后接括号；不是医学语境。

patterns.name: GPL 许可文本中的 published
patterns.context: 软件许可证固定措辞中，描述许可证由基金会发布。
patterns.domain: Github 源码注释、许可证文本

patterns.name: 定义的词形
patterns.context: StackExchange 技术回答中，括号内用 defined 表示某操作或行为有定义。

en.concept: English subword fragments and heterogeneous text triggers
en.description: Activations are most apparent in wanted (2 segments) and neut-related neutron/neutrophil fragments (3 segments), with other scattered instances in Latin word forms, legal publication notices and suspected OCR fragments, an email about an unexpected situation, and Something. Overall, there is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Past-tense form wanted of English want
patterns.context: wanted occurs within a sentence to mean wanting, having wanted to learn about something, or wanting to do something; it may be followed by a to-infinitive
patterns.domain: General English prose or website copy

patterns.name: Neutron-related term fragment
patterns.context: neut is the initial substring of neutron(s) or neutropenia and occurs in scientific text

patterns.name: Latin word-form fragment subs
patterns.context: The word is split into subword fragments; it occurs in the Latin form Idaea subsaturata

patterns.name: Publication restriction notice in a legal document
patterns.context: All-caps notice, near “NOT DESIGNATED FOR PUBLICATION” and a case number

patterns.name: Anomalously split characters or OCR text
patterns.context: Letters, symbols, and spaces are scattered across incoherent lines, with no clear ordinary semantic structure
patterns.domain: Suspected scanning, typesetting, or OCR fragments in legal documents

patterns.name: Name and unexpected situation at the start of an email
patterns.context: An email begins with a possibly truncated name or salutation, followed by a report of unexpected difficulties

patterns.name: Label-like string Something There
patterns.context: At the beginning of a short quotation or text fragment; followed by Herriman title text whose meaning cannot be determined from the excerpt
patterns.domain: Web or bibliographic text; specific genre unclear

9_433.concept: 英语词片段与异质文本触发
9_433.description: 激活最明显地出现在 wanted（2段）、neut- 中子/中性粒细胞相关词片段（3段），另分散于拉丁词形、法律出版声明与疑似 OCR 残片、邮件意外情况及 Something 等文本。整体没有单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 英文 want 的过去式形式 wanted
patterns.context: wanted 位于句中，表示想要、曾想了解或做某事；附近可接 to 不定式
patterns.domain: 普通英文叙述或网页文案

patterns.name: 中子相关术语片段
patterns.context: neut 是 neutron(s) 或 neutropenia 的词首子串，出现在科学文本中

patterns.name: 拉丁词形片段 subs
patterns.context: 词被拆成子词片段；出现在拉丁语词形 Idaea subsaturata 中

patterns.name: 法律文件的出版限制声明
patterns.context: 全大写版式声明，附近有“NOT DESIGNATED FOR PUBLICATION”及案件编号

patterns.name: 异常拆分的字符或 OCR 文本
patterns.context: 字母、符号及空格分散在不连贯行中，未见清楚的普通语义结构
patterns.domain: 法律文件中的疑似扫描、排版或 OCR 残片

patterns.name: 邮件开头的人名及意外状况
patterns.context: 邮件中先出现可能被截断的人名或称呼，随后报告遇到意外困难

patterns.name: 标注性字符串 Something There
patterns.context: 短引文或文本片段开头；后接无法从片段确定语义的 Herriman 标题文字
patterns.domain: 网页或书目类文本，具体文体不明

en.description: The most stable signal is the comma, especially within sentences or as a separator between code parameters or fields. There are also sporadic activations on titles, dates, code, proper names, and words from various domains, without a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: The word or line following the comma varies; the marker appears across sentence types and domains.
patterns.domain: Medical titles, technical Q&A, dates, email, news, and patent text

patterns.name: Comma separating code parameters
patterns.context: A comma in code or configuration snippets, often separating parameters or fields; it may overlap with the general comma pattern.

patterns.name: A at the start of a title or phrase
patterns.context: Capitalized A appears in a title or at the beginning of a sentence; the two examples are followed by “Paradigm” and “mitava,” respectively.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: A word is split into multiple tokens, with activation on an internal fragment of a proper name or word; there is no stable semantic or contextual commonality.

patterns.name: Revealed in a title
patterns.context: A title contains “Revealed by”, followed by a research method or source of discovery.

patterns.name: Edge-curvature terminology in natural language
patterns.context: Discusses the curvature of a graphic edge and how to alter or restore its degree of curvature.

patterns.name: Code function and parameters
patterns.context: At the start of a function definition, with a function name and comma-separated parameter list.

patterns.name: Description of curcumin and its compounds
patterns.context: Begins with Curcumin, followed by a description of it as a yellow polyphenolic compound.

patterns.name: Date format
patterns.context: An English month or abbreviation, day, comma, and year form a date, which may be followed by body text.

patterns.name: Exclamatory tone in a quotation
patterns.context: A short sentence inside quotation marks, consisting of an interjection and an exclamatory particle, followed by game-related commentary.

patterns.name: Name and greeting in an email
patterns.context: An email opens with a recipient salutation, then proposes finding time to talk.

patterns.name: Configuration fields and values
patterns.context: Consists of multiple lines of field names, values, and edits in parentheses; commas separate fields or operations.

patterns.name: Substrate processing phrase in a patent
patterns.context: A patent background section discusses patterned semiconductor substrates and substrates of rejected products.

9_433.description: 最稳定信号是逗号，尤其出现在句中或代码参数、字段分隔处；另有标题、日期、代码、专名及多种领域词语的零散激活，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 逗号后面紧接的词或换行内容可以不同；该标记出现在多种句式和领域中。
patterns.domain: 医学标题、技术问答、日期、邮件、新闻及专利文本

patterns.name: 代码参数分隔逗号
patterns.context: 代码或配置片段中的逗号，常用于分隔参数或字段；可能与一般逗号模式重合。

patterns.name: 标题或短语开头的 A
patterns.context: 大写 A 出现在标题或句首；两个例子后续分别是 “Paradigm” 和 “mitava”。

patterns.name: 专名内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 词被切分为多个 token，激活落在专名或词语的内部片段上；没有稳定的词义或上下文共性。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Revealed
patterns.context: 标题中出现 “Revealed by”，后接研究方法或揭示来源。

patterns.name: 自然语言中的边缘曲率术语
patterns.context: 讨论图形边缘的曲率，以及如何改变或恢复边缘的弯曲程度。

patterns.name: 代码函数与参数
patterns.context: 函数定义开头，包含函数名和逗号分隔的参数列表。

patterns.name: 姜黄素及其化合物描述
patterns.context: 以 Curcumin 开头，后接其作为黄色多酚化合物的说明。

patterns.name: 日期格式
patterns.context: 英文月份或月份缩写、日、逗号、年份组成的日期，后续可接正文。

patterns.name: 引语中的感叹语气
patterns.context: 引号内以感叹词和语气词组成的短句，后接游戏相关评论。

patterns.name: 邮件中的名字及寒暄
patterns.context: 邮件开头出现收件人称呼，随后提出找时间讨论。

patterns.name: 配置字段与数值
patterns.context: 以多行字段名、数值和括号中的修改项构成；逗号分隔字段或操作。

patterns.name: 专利中的基底处置短语
patterns.context: 专利背景段落谈及图案化半导体基底及不合格产品基底。

en.description: Activations span code, papers, patents, and medical text. Punctuation and structural boundaries are common, alongside the relational word “same” and terminology and identifiers from various domains. The segments are difficult to reduce to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Symbols, punctuation, and structural delimiters
patterns.context: Punctuation or delimiters occur at sentence, code-line, or text-structure boundaries, often activating with neighboring tokens; commonality across contexts is weak.
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: Q&A, code, papers, and patents

patterns.name: Expressions of sameness or identity
patterns.context: Indicates that entities, threads, or properties are the same; occurs in both graphics descriptions and code explanations.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and type declarations
patterns.context: Occurs near source code, comments, or field declarations, often as part of an identifier or type name.

patterns.name: Medical drug names
patterns.context: Drug names are listed consecutively in an unfinished abstract sentence.

patterns.name: Golf preventive exercises and body parts
patterns.context: Title-like phrase listing a sport and body parts.

patterns.name: Drug metabolism research terminology
patterns.context: Describes drug disposition processes in a study and is followed by a radiolabel symbol.

patterns.name: Message fields and duplicate data
patterns.context: Repeated message fields and their numbers or value descriptions in code or protocol files.

patterns.name: Binary data and audio/video tags
patterns.context: Audio-related tags and values occur in a byte array or resource data.

patterns.name: Semiconductor substrate processing
patterns.context: Discusses the challenges posed by patterned products that fail wafer acceptance criteria and by monitor substrates.

patterns.name: Geometric distortion parameters
patterns.context: Code comments define shape direction, distortion, and tilt parameters, with geometric shapes used as examples.

patterns.name: Schrödinger equation abstract
patterns.context: The abstract begins by stating two equations involving a time variable and a potential function.

9_433.description: 激活分布跨越代码、论文、专利及医学文本；标点和结构边界较常见，另有“same”关系词与多类领域术语、标识符。各段难以归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 符号、标点及结构分隔符
patterns.context: 标点或分隔符出现在句子、代码行或文本结构边界处，常与邻近 token 一起激活；不同语境中共同点较弱。
patterns.domain: 混合语料：问答、代码、论文及专利

patterns.name: 同一/相同关系表达
patterns.context: 表示实体、线程或性质相同；在图形描述和代码说明中均出现。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与类型声明
patterns.context: 出现在源码、注释或字段声明附近，常是标识符或类型名的一部分。

patterns.name: 医学药物名称
patterns.context: 药物名连续列举，摘要句未完。

patterns.name: 高尔夫预防性练习及身体部位
patterns.trigger: “Preventative exercises in golf: arm, leg, and back.”
patterns.context: 标题式短语列出运动项目和身体部位。

patterns.name: 药物代谢研究术语
patterns.context: 并列描述研究中的药物处置过程，后接放射性标记符号。

patterns.name: 消息字段与重复数据
patterns.context: 代码或协议文件中重复消息字段及其编号、取值说明。

patterns.name: 二进制数据与音视频标签
patterns.context: 字节数组或资源数据中出现音频相关标签及数值。

patterns.name: 半导体基板处置
patterns.context: 讨论不符合晶圆验收标准的图案化产品及监控基板所带来的挑战。

patterns.name: 几何畸变参数
patterns.context: 代码注释定义形状方向、畸变和倾斜参数，并用几何形状解释。

patterns.name: 薛定谔方程摘要
patterns.context: 摘要开头陈述两个含时间变量和势函数的方程。

en.description: Activations are scattered across quoted x strings in code, local fragments of proper names and terms, and legal citation titles. These triggers share no stable semantic or contextual rule.

patterns.name: x string and subsequent numeric comparison
patterns.context: `x` appears at the beginning of a quoted string or as the beginning of an identifier/value; subsequent content varies across examples

patterns.name: Local token activations in proper names or terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of various unrelated proper names, common words, or variable names, with no consistent semantic or grammatical condition
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, patents, code Q&A, academic papers

patterns.name: Citation/title format in legal text
patterns.context: Occurs in citations, titles, and bibliographic information in legal commentary or case materials; activations are scattered across title words

9_433.description: 激活分散于代码中带引号的 x 字符串、专名及术语的局部片段，以及法律引文标题；这些触发之间缺少稳定的共同语义或上下文规则。

patterns.name: x 字符串及其后的数字比较
patterns.context: `x` 出现在带引号的字符串开头，或作为标识符/值的开头；不同示例中后续内容不同

patterns.name: 专名或术语中的局部 token 激活
patterns.context: 激活落在多种不相关的专名、普通词或变量名的子词片段上，没有一致的语义或语法条件
patterns.domain: 百科、专利、代码问答、学术论文

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引文/标题格式
patterns.trigger: `Shoplifting — An Analysis of Legal Controls`、`Legislation — Survey and Analysis` 等标题片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律评论或判例材料的引文、标题和书目信息中；激活分散在标题词语中

en.description: Activations cover Markdown markers for scanned-page images, inline CSS styles, a LaTeX derivative formula, an NIH project abstract, and frontend import statements inside JSON. Their commonality is structured documents or code fragments, but the specific trigger patterns differ.

patterns.name: Scanned-page image markers
patterns.context: TIFF scanned-page images are inserted consecutively in a document, followed by page numbers or citation numbers; activations are distributed across markers, filenames, extensions, and numbers

patterns.name: CSS style declarations
patterns.context: CSS properties and values in HTML tags or style objects, especially semicolon-separated inline styles

patterns.name: Mathematical derivative formula
patterns.context: A formula takes the radial derivative of angular velocity, adjacent to descriptions of a boundary layer, Keplerian motion, and related topics

patterns.name: Grant projects and core facilities
patterns.context: Grant application text describing a project, core facilities, and their support

patterns.name: Frontend import statements in JSON
patterns.context: JavaScript/component-library import code stored as a string in a JSON field, including escaped quotation marks and package paths

9_433.description: 激活覆盖扫描页图像的 Markdown 标记、CSS 行内样式、LaTeX 导数公式、NIH 项目摘要，以及 JSON 内前端导入语句；共同点是结构化文档或代码片段，但具体触发模式各异。

patterns.name: 扫描页图像标记
patterns.context: 文档中连续插入 TIFF 扫描页图像，后接页码或引用编号；激活分布在标记、文件名、扩展名和数字上
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的论文/扫描文档 Markdown

patterns.name: CSS 样式声明
patterns.context: HTML 标签或样式对象中的 CSS 属性和值，尤其是分号分隔的行内样式
patterns.domain: Github 上的 HTML/CSS 代码

patterns.name: 数学导数公式
patterns.context: 公式中对角速度作径向导数，并与边界层、Keplerian motion 等描述相邻
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学/物理论文 LaTeX

patterns.name: 基金申请项目与核心设施
patterns.trigger: `This PPG's three Projects`、`Cores`、`Administrative & Biostatistical Support`、`Animal Health and Sample…`
patterns.context: 描述项目、核心设施及其支持内容的资助申请文本

patterns.name: JSON 中的前端导入语句
patterns.context: JSON 字段内以字符串形式保存的 JavaScript/组件库导入代码，含转义引号与包路径

en.description: Primarily sensitive to numbers and nearby punctuation: decimals, percentages, ranges, thousands separators, dates and times, measurements, status codes, strain numbers, and numbers in legal citations all occur, often in structured or technical text.

patterns.name: Decimal points and percentage values
patterns.context: A decimal point occurs in a number, often in a percentage, ratio, or measurement; adjacent numbers may have thousands separators or units.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia statistics, personal finance Q&A, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Numbers and dates with punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers are adjacent to commas, hyphens, or colons, forming election vote counts, dates, currency amounts, or times.

patterns.name: Numeric legal citations
patterns.context: In legal opinions or statutory citations, numbers are mixed with volume numbers, page numbers, paragraph symbols, and abbreviations.

patterns.name: Numeric status codes in configuration files
patterns.context: In server configuration snippets, numbers appear near HTTP error status codes and file paths.

patterns.name: Numeric medical measurements
patterns.context: Medical abstracts report surgical or clinical measurements using numbers, error ranges, decimals, and units.

patterns.name: Numbered biological names
patterns.context: A strain number follows a bacterial name; the number is embedded in a proper name or experimental subject identifier.

patterns.name: Numeric ranges and ratios
patterns.context: Numbers express percentages, ranges, or relative changes within statistical or experimental descriptions.

patterns.name: Other numbers and punctuation adjacent to numbers
patterns.context: Scattered numbers occur in local contexts such as times, statutes, strains, or years; it is unclear whether they correspond to distinct trigger patterns.

9_433.description: 主要对数字及其邻近标点敏感：小数、百分比、范围、千位分隔、日期时间、测量值、状态码、菌株编号和法律引证中的数字均出现；常见于结构化或技术文本。

patterns.name: 小数点与百分比数值
patterns.context: 小数点出现在数字中，常用于百分比、比率或测量值；相邻数字可能带千位分隔符或单位。
patterns.domain: 百科统计、个人理财问答、医学摘要

patterns.name: 带标点的数字与日期
patterns.context: 数字与逗号、连字符或冒号相邻，组成选举票数、日期、货币数额或时间。

patterns.name: 数字化法律引证
patterns.context: 法律判决或法条引证中，数字与卷号、页码、段落符号及缩写混排。

patterns.name: 配置文件中的数字状态码
patterns.context: 服务器配置片段中，数字出现在 HTTP 错误状态码及文件路径附近。

patterns.name: 数字化医学测量
patterns.context: 医学摘要以数字、误差范围、小数和单位报告手术或临床测量。

patterns.name: 编号化生物学名称
patterns.context: 细菌名称后接菌株编号，数字嵌在专名或实验对象标识中。

patterns.name: 数值范围与比例
patterns.context: 数字表达百分比、范围或相对变化，嵌在统计或实验叙述中。
patterns.domain: 百科统计、生命科学研究

patterns.name: 其他数字与数字相邻标点
patterns.context: 零散数字出现在时间、法条、菌株或年份等局部语境中；无法确定它们是否各自对应独立触发模式。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、法律、生物医学、问答

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in quantitative reporting: metrics and their ratios, percentages, decimals, confidence intervals, and OR statistics. They also occur in configuration and code identifiers and in real-estate price comparisons.

patterns.name: Statistical ratios and decimal values
patterns.context: Activations occur near metric names, values, and statistical significance information in quantitative metrics or comparisons; no particular value or fixed syntax is required.
patterns.domain: Medical paper results, population and housing statistics

patterns.name: Numeric and statistical reporting formats
patterns.context: Formats for statistical results, confidence intervals, odds ratios, or group comparisons involving numbers, punctuation, and statistical abbreviations.

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and delimiters
patterns.context: Near protocol names, underscore-separated configuration keys, colons, and numeric values in code or configuration text; activations involve combinations of technical strings and punctuation.

patterns.name: Width and container identifiers in code
patterns.context: Activations occur around identifiers for container maximum width, media queries, and related items in CSS/Sass code comments and mixin definitions.

patterns.name: Real-estate prices per unit
patterns.context: When discussing luxury homes, compares regional prices per square foot or gives housing prices.

patterns.name: Delivery mode and clinical association
patterns.context: Reports an association between clinical factors and outcomes, quantified using adjusted OR and significance values.

9_433.concept: 数字指标与结构化数值
9_433.description: 激活主要集中于数字化定量报告：指标及其比率、百分数、小数、置信区间和OR等统计格式；另见配置与代码标识符，以及房地产单价比较。

patterns.name: 统计比率与小数数值
patterns.trigger: «rate»、«ratio»、«coverage»、«mortality»、«survival»、«vacancy»，以及紧邻的百分比或小数数值，如«5.»«26»%、«1.»«25»、«0.»«29»%
patterns.context: 定量指标或比较结果的表述中，常在指标名、数值及统计显著性信息附近激活；不要求特定数值或固定句法。
patterns.domain: 医学论文结果、人口住房统计

patterns.name: 数值与统计报告格式
patterns.context: 统计结果、置信区间、比值比或组间比较的格式中，涉及数字、标点和统计缩写。
patterns.domain: 医学论文摘要与研究结果

patterns.name: 技术标识符与分隔符
patterns.context: 代码或配置文本中，协议名、下划线连接的配置键、冒号及数字值附近；呈现出对技术字符串和标点组合的激活。

patterns.name: 代码中的宽度与容器标识符
patterns.context: CSS/Sass代码注释与混入定义中，围绕容器最大宽度、媒体查询等标识符激活。

patterns.name: 按单位呈现的房地产价格
patterns.context: 谈论豪宅价格时，以每平方英尺为单位比较地区价格，或给出房价数值。
patterns.domain: 房地产新闻或市场报道

patterns.name: 交付方式与临床关联
patterns.context: 报告临床因素与结局的关联，并以调整后OR及显著性数值量化。

en.description: Primarily responds to statistical values and their formats, especially decimals, ratios, percentages, amounts, and rankings. It occurs in writing about cricket data, medical statistics, employment data, and election vote counts, as well as at sentence-initial thousands.

patterns.name: Decimal or statistical values
patterns.context: Numeric expressions with decimals, percentages, ratios, or amounts; numbers are often split into multiple tokens. Triggers tend to fall on the value or an immediately adjacent token.
patterns.domain: Statistical text, economics and medical papers, Q&A discussions

patterns.name: Ranking numbers
patterns.context: An entry about a person describes their career-high ranking, often with a date; activations favor the ranking value and nearby expressions.

patterns.name: Cricket performance statistics
patterns.context: A cricket narrative includes a player's bowling or batting statistics; there are also words related to averages that are not marked.

patterns.name: Election scores and votes
patterns.context: Competition or election results are tabulated by polling district, listing candidates' total scores or votes.

patterns.name: Isolated sentence-initial number
patterns.context: A number appears at the start of a sentence, followed by a thousands-separated number; the topic is inflation and yield, but the marker is concentrated on the numeric token.

9_433.description: 主要响应统计数值及其格式，尤其是小数、比率、百分比、金额和排名；在板球数据、医疗统计、就业数据、选举票数等文体中均出现，另有句首千位数。

patterns.name: 小数或统计数值
patterns.context: 带小数、百分比、比率或金额的数值表达，常见数字被拆成多个 token；触发位置多在数值或其紧邻 token。
patterns.domain: 统计文本、经济与医学论文、问答讨论

patterns.name: 排名数字
patterns.context: 人物条目中描述职业生涯最高排名，常带日期；激活偏向排名数值及其邻接表达。

patterns.name: 板球表现统计
patterns.context: 板球叙述中出现球员的投球或击球数据；也有未标记的平均值相关词。

patterns.name: 选举得分与票数
patterns.context: 竞赛或选举结果按投票区汇总，并列出候选人的总分或票数。
patterns.domain: 欧洲歌唱大赛结果类百科条目

patterns.name: 孤立的句首数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在句首，后接逗号分隔的千位数；此处虽谈通胀与收益率，但标记集中在数字 token。

en.description: All segments contain quantitative information, with activations especially near numbers and numeric expressions such as decimals and percentages. Domains include sports, economics, law, finance, and biomedicine. Sports statistics vocabulary may be an accompanying feature of numeric contexts rather than an independent trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers before decimal points and subsequent decimals
patterns.context: Numbers or values such as percentages appear in decimal notation in the text, often near the decimal point; sometimes the decimal point itself is unmarked. The marker is not limited to one type of value
patterns.domain: Explanatory text on statistics, sports results, economics, law, finance, biomedicine, and other topics

patterns.name: Sports results and pitching terminology
patterns.context: Cricket or baseball player, season, and team statistics; occurs alongside numeric-format patterns

patterns.name: Percentages and election/economic statistics
patterns.context: Percentages or growth rates are expressed numerically for social or economic indicators

patterns.name: Quantitative biomedical results
patterns.context: Significance thresholds, concentrations, or range values in research results

patterns.name: Financial returns
patterns.context: Historical investment returns are stated as percentages and averages

patterns.name: Real-estate valuation and unit prices
patterns.context: An estimate of land-sale value in a legal case, with a currency symbol and area unit

patterns.name: Ordinary numeric punctuation and statistical numbers
patterns.context: Commas or decimal notation within values, or numbers adjacent to units; co-occurs with the segment's main statistical information

patterns.name: Qualifiers in medical numeric comparisons
patterns.context: Quantitative results are introduced by medians, ranges, or significance tests

9_433.description: 所有段落都含有定量信息，激活尤其落在数字及小数、百分数等数值表达附近；领域涵盖体育、经济、法律、金融及生物医学。体育统计等词汇可能是数值语境的伴随特征，而非独立触发因素。

patterns.name: 小数点前的数字及后续小数
patterns.trigger: 如“average of 10 26”“8 12”“11 2”“1 176”“$8 per square foot”“median 0 117”；标记多出现在数值中的小数点前后数字
patterns.context: 数字或百分比等数值按文本中的小数写法出现，常见于小数点附近；有时小数点本身未标记。标记并非只针对某一种数值类型
patterns.domain: 统计数据、体育成绩、经济、法律、金融、生物医学等说明性文本

patterns.name: 体育成绩与投球术语
patterns.trigger: “wickets”“bowling average”“earned run average”“pitching staff”等；数值常接在“average of”之后
patterns.context: 板球或棒球的球员、赛季及球队统计；与数值格式模式同时出现

patterns.name: 百分比与选举、经济统计
patterns.context: 百分比或增长率在社会、经济指标中以数字表示

patterns.name: 生物医学定量结果
patterns.context: 研究结果中的显著性阈值、浓度或范围数值

patterns.name: 金融回报率
patterns.context: 历史投资回报以百分比和平均值陈述

patterns.name: 地产估值与单位价格
patterns.context: 法律案件中对土地出售价值的估算，数值带货币符号及面积单位

patterns.name: 普通数字标点及统计数字
patterns.context: 数值中的逗号、小数写法或数字与单位相连；与该段主要统计信息并存

patterns.name: 医学数值比较中的限定词
patterns.context: 定量结果由中位数、范围或显著性检验引出

en.description: Primarily sensitive to expressions related to statistical and measurement values, often near quantities, ratios, amounts, predictions, or experimental measurements; also shows weak activation on numeric punctuation tokenization and the cricketer’s name Ridgway, the latter possibly incidental.

patterns.name: Numeric tokens in percentages or decimal values
patterns.context: Across various numeric expressions, activation occurs near subsequent digits or numeric boundaries; sometimes preceded by words introducing values, such as of, rate, reach, roughly, or resolution.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain statistical, economic, medical, and scientific texts

patterns.name: General quantity or scale descriptions
patterns.context: Describes survey samples, numbers of users or devices, totals, averages, and similar quantities; percentages, ratios, or measurements may also appear in the same context.
patterns.domain: Demographic surveys, technology forecasts, economics, and medical research

patterns.name: Punctuation and tokenization boundaries near numbers
patterns.context: When numbers are split by punctuation, spaces, or subword fragments, activation may also occur on adjacent tokens; these examples alone do not establish that punctuation itself is a trigger.

patterns.name: way in a path-related name
patterns.context: The name Ridgway contains the substring way, in a surrounding account of a cricket career; activation is weak and may be incidental or related to the word form.

patterns.name: Measurement and experimental observation values
patterns.context: Specialized measurement contexts such as medical viral loads and astronomical image resolution, with values followed by units or measurement terminology.

patterns.name: Sports narratives not assigned to a clear pattern
patterns.context: Although average appears, the main content concerns a player’s debut and wickets; its connection to the statistical-value pattern in other passages is uncertain.

9_433.description: 主要对统计与测量数值相关表达敏感，常见于数量、比例、金额、预测值或实验测量附近；也有数字标点分词及板球人名 Ridgway 的弱激活，后者可能是偶然。

patterns.name: 百分比或小数数值中的数字 token
patterns.context: 多种数值表达中，激活落在后续数字或数值边界附近；有时前面是 of、rate、reach、roughly、resolution 等引出数值的词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域统计、经济、医学与科学文本

patterns.name: 一般性数量或规模表述
patterns.context: 描述调查样本、用户或设备数量、总额、平均值等；同一上下文还可能出现百分比、比率或测量值。
patterns.domain: 人口调查、科技预测、经济与医学研究

patterns.name: 数字附近的标点及分词边界
patterns.context: 数字被标点、空格或子词切分时，激活也可能落在相邻 token；仅凭这些例子无法确定标点本身是触发因素。

patterns.name: 路径相关人名中的 way
patterns.context: 人名 Ridgway 内出现 way 子串，周围是板球生涯叙述；激活较弱，可能是偶然或词形相关。

patterns.name: 计量与实验观测数值
patterns.context: 医学病毒载量及天文学图像分辨率等专业测量语境，数值后接单位或测量术语。

patterns.name: 未能归入明确模式的体育叙述
patterns.context: 虽出现 average，但主要内容是球员首次出赛及 wickets；与其他段的统计数值模式联系不确定。

en.description: Activation most often occurs in quantitative statements: means, ratios, percentages, amounts, thresholds, distances, or similarity metrics, often adjacent to numbers and units; the domains and metrics vary considerably.

patterns.name: Statistical means and averages
patterns.context: Describes a mean or average level, often followed by a value, ratio, or cost; the term itself and nearby statistical expressions show strong activation.
patterns.domain: Sports statistics, legal finance, and mining economics

patterns.name: rate metrics with numeric values
patterns.context: In economic growth, advertising expenditure forecasts, or epidemiology, rate is followed by a percentage or annualized value; “at a … rate” also occurs.

patterns.name: Medical quantitative thresholds and loads
patterns.context: Clinical indicators, thresholds, or treatment outcomes in medical research; the specific metrics differ between the two passages.

patterns.name: Chemical bond lengths and interatomic distances
patterns.context: In materials or computational chemistry, describes the distance between an atomic pair and gives a symbolic value.

patterns.name: Percentage, value, and unit expressions
patterns.context: Values are embedded in statistical statements; sometimes a percentage is adjacent to a value, and sometimes it is accompanied by an indicator name. This pattern partially overlaps with other statistical patterns.

patterns.name: Currency amounts and financial inflows/outflows
patterns.context: Amounts begin with a dollar sign and describe income, expenditure, or unit costs; strong activation occurs near amount-related words.

patterns.name: Approximate or estimated values
patterns.context: Uncertainty or approximation wording introduces estimates of years, growth rates, or other values.

patterns.name: Numeric comparisons or changes
patterns.context: Compares forecast values or proportions over time, using change expressions such as up from and increases.

patterns.name: Molecular similarity without an evident shared statistical trigger
patterns.context: Reports a similarity index in a genome comparison; although it includes percentages and values, its specific context differs from distances, means, or economic ratios.

9_433.description: 激活多出现在定量陈述中：均值、比率、百分比、金额、阈值、距离或相似性指标，常邻接数字与单位；具体领域和指标差异较大。

patterns.name: 统计均值与平均值
patterns.trigger: “average»10« of»6« 12»2«.”（3）；“average»2« monthly»3« income”（4）；“an« average»4« operating»5« cash»5« costs”（6）
patterns.context: 描述均值或平均水平，常接数值、比率或成本；该词本身及邻近统计表达激活较强。
patterns.domain: 体育统计、法律财务、矿业经济

patterns.name: 数值的 rate 指标
patterns.trigger: “an»2« annual»6« rate»9« of»8 2«.»15« percent”（7）；“forecast»3« to»6« 1»2«.»28%”（8）；“transmission rate« is»5 2.4%”（9）
patterns.context: 在经济增长、广告支出预测或流行病学中，rate 后接百分比或年化数值；也出现“at a … rate”。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、公共卫生统计

patterns.name: 医学定量阈值与负荷
patterns.trigger: “DNA»4 load»9« cut»6-«off»7« value»8« of»6 5000 copies”（5）；“insufficient erection« for»1 penetration”（1）
patterns.context: 医学研究语境中的临床指标、阈值或治疗结果；两段的具体指标不同。

patterns.name: 化学键长与原子间距
patterns.trigger: “Na - O« distance»4 $d_{{\rm Na-O}} = 2.3$ Å”及“Na - Si« distance»10”（2）
patterns.context: 材料或计算化学中，描述原子对间的距离并给出符号化数值。

patterns.name: 百分比、数值与单位表达
patterns.context: 数值嵌入统计性陈述；有时百分比紧邻数值，有时伴随指标名称。此模式与其他统计模式部分重叠。
patterns.domain: 医学微生物学、体育统计

patterns.name: 货币金额与财务收支
patterns.context: 金额以美元符号开头，并描述收入、支出或单位成本；高激活落在金额相关词附近。

patterns.name: 近似或估计值
patterns.context: 不确定性或近似措辞引出估算的年限、增长率或数值。
patterns.domain: 矿业经济、宏观经济新闻

patterns.name: 数值比较或变化
patterns.trigger: “revised … forecast to 1.28% growth … up from … 1.24%”（8）；“increases … to 6.36%”（9）
patterns.context: 对预测值或比例作前后比较，使用 up from、increases 等变化表达。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、公共卫生统计

patterns.name: 无明显共享统计触发的分子相似性
patterns.trigger: “highest similarity … with an ANI value of 99.17% and dDD”（10）
patterns.context: 基因组比较中报告相似性指数；虽含百分比和数值，但与距离、均值或经济比率的具体语境不同。

en.description: Activation spans quantitative reporting in scientific, medical, technical, financial, economic, and sports texts: metrics or statistics adjacent to values, units, or percentages, commonly in descriptions of numeric results. Triggering domains vary, with no single thematic keyword.

patterns.name: Technical and scientific numeric statistics
patterns.context: In scientific or technical descriptions, a statistic, measurement, or metric name appears before a value, unit, or percentage; multiple tokens around these metric terms and values activate.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, crystallography, microbial taxonomy, and patented technology

patterns.name: Financial and economic value reporting
patterns.context: In business, legal-financial, or economic news, amounts and percentages are stated in connection with income, wealth, growth forecasts, or growth rates.
patterns.domain: Economic news, personal finance, and bankruptcy law materials

patterns.name: Sports statistics
patterns.context: In cricket match recaps, numbers report players’ performance and tournament statistics.

9_433.description: 激活覆盖科研、医学、技术、财务经济及体育文本中的定量报告：指标或统计量与其数值、单位、百分比相邻，常见数值结果的说明。触发领域多样，未见单一主题词。

patterns.name: 技术与科研数值统计
patterns.context: 在科研或技术说明中，数值、单位或百分比之前出现统计量、测量值或指标名称；这些指标词及其数值附近的多个 token 激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、晶体学、微生物分类及专利技术

patterns.name: 财务与经济数值报告
patterns.context: 在商业、法律财务或经济新闻中，围绕收入、财富、增长预测或增长率陈述金额和百分比。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、个人财务及破产法律材料

patterns.name: 体育统计数字
patterns.context: 板球赛事回顾中，以数字报告球员的比赛成绩和锦标赛统计。

en.description: Primarily responds to precise numeric expressions near metrics, ratios, thresholds, and experimental parameters, especially when values are adjacent to units, percentages, decimals, ranges, or “of/is/rate” structures; domains vary widely, and the trigger form is more consistent than the topic.

patterns.name: Ratios or metrics in quantitative relationships
patterns.context: In technical or report-style sentences, a value is assigned the meaning of a metric, ratio, yield, threshold, score, or measurement; common formats include “metric + of/is + value,” as well as “rate of” and “ratio of.”
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, patents, scientific papers, and quantitative accounts in news/commentary

patterns.name: Experimental conditions and operating parameters
patterns.context: Values describe experimental or device operating conditions, material proportions, speed, pressure, time, or bandwidth, embedded in methods or technical descriptions.
patterns.domain: Chromatography / experimental methods, patented device descriptions, astronomical observations

patterns.name: Percentage and range-style values
patterns.context: Activation occurs near numeric expressions such as percentages, ranges, or precise decimals; values sometimes indicate proportions or comparisons, and sometimes biological measurements, so meanings are not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: Medical results, microbial taxonomy, patents, and public policy commentary

patterns.name: Adjacent numeric, unit, and punctuation formats
patterns.context: Adjacent to measurement values, units, range parentheses, colons, or decimal points; no specific metric name is required, and numeric formatting itself may contribute to activation.
patterns.domain: Scientific and medical data reporting, engineering parameters

patterns.name: Numeric thresholds for grouping or clinical decisions
patterns.context: A value serves as a threshold, boundary, or grouping condition for determining risk, income category, or experimental result.
patterns.domain: Clinical research, medical testing, news / policy commentary

9_433.description: 主要对指标、比率、阈值及实验参数附近的精确数值表达起反应，尤其是数值与单位、百分比、小数、范围或“of/is/rate”结构相邻；领域跨度大，触发形式比主题更一致。

patterns.name: 定量数值关系的比值或指标
patterns.trigger: “cut-off value”“step yield”“process yield”“ANI value”“albumin-to-globulin ratio”“pain score”“urine calcium:creatinine ratio”“tax rate”“clearance”“total bandwidth”等指标名，常接“of”或“is”及数值
patterns.context: 在技术或报告式语句中，数值被赋予指标、比率、产率、阈值、评分或测量值的含义；常见格式为“指标 + of/is + 数值”，也包括“rate of”及“ratio of”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利、科学论文及新闻/评论中的定量叙述

patterns.name: 实验条件和操作参数
patterns.trigger: “at a flow rate of 0.3244 ml min”“in 7 min”“80% ACN”“at 3000 psi”“with a total bandwidth of 7.5 GHz”
patterns.context: 数值描述实验或设备运行条件、材料比例、速度、压力、时间或带宽，嵌在方法或技术说明中。
patterns.domain: 色谱/实验方法、专利设备说明、天文观测

patterns.name: 百分比及范围型数值
patterns.context: 激活落在百分数、范围或精确小数等数字表达附近；有时数值表示占比或比较，有时是生物测量值，含义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 医学结果、微生物分类、专利及公共政策评论

patterns.name: 相邻数值、单位与标点格式
patterns.context: 紧邻测量数值、单位、范围括号、冒号或小数点；不要求特定指标名称，数字格式本身可能参与激活。
patterns.domain: 科学与医学数据报告、工程参数

patterns.name: 数值阈值用于分组或临床判定
patterns.trigger: “of 8 or more”“less than $8,500 a year”“At a plasma CMV DNA load cut-off value of 5000 copies”
patterns.context: 数值作为阈值、界限或分组条件，用于判定风险、收入类别或实验结果。
patterns.domain: 临床研究、医学检验、新闻/政策评论

en.description: Often occurs in quantitative descriptions: the preposition of near measurements, thresholds, proportions, or scores; also appears in rate/average expressions, numeric ranges, and technical conditions. Some activation occurs in different syntactic positions, such as follow-up and result statistics, and cannot be reduced to a single trigger word.

patterns.name: Quantity / measurement following of
patterns.context: The preposition of commonly occurs before a value or quantitative result, especially measurements, thresholds, scores, proportions, or statistics in scientific and technical texts; however, the trigger is not adjacent to a number after of in every passage.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, analytical chemistry, sports statistics, tax, and technical documents

patterns.name: rate measurement expressions
patterns.context: When rate or average denotes a quantitative rate or average, it occurs near a specific value or measurement condition.
patterns.domain: Analytical chemistry, sports statistics, patented technology

patterns.name: Follow-up duration
patterns.context: Describes the follow-up period and its duration in clinical narratives.

patterns.name: Numeric thresholds and ranges
patterns.context: Values serve as thresholds, intervals, or application conditions; no fixed unit or syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: B-tree page-size conditions
patterns.context: Software documentation discusses data item size, page size, and the resulting storage behavior.

patterns.name: Other numeric result contexts
patterns.context: Activation occurs in statistical results, taxonomic similarity, or tax-rate statements, without forming a specific context that accounts for the other passages.
patterns.domain: Medical research, microbial taxonomy, tax reporting

9_433.description: 多见于量化叙述：介词 of 邻近测量值、阈值、比例或评分；也出现在 rate/average、数值范围和技术条件中。部分激活落在 follow-up、结果统计等不同句法位置，无法归结为单一触发词。

patterns.name: of 后的数量/测量值
patterns.context: 常见于数值或量化结果前的介词 of，尤其是科学技术文本中的测量值、阈值、评分、比例或统计量；但触发点并非每段都紧贴 of 后的数字。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、分析化学、体育统计、税务及技术文档

patterns.name: rate 测量表述
patterns.context: rate 或 average 表示某种量化速率、平均值时，邻近具体数值或测量条件。
patterns.domain: 分析化学、体育统计、专利技术

patterns.name: 随访时长
patterns.context: 临床叙述中描述随访期间及其时长。

patterns.name: 数值阈值及范围
patterns.context: 数值用于阈值、区间或应用条件；不要求固定单位或句法位置。

patterns.name: B-tree 页面大小条件
patterns.context: 软件文档中谈论数据项大小、页面大小及其导致的存储行为。

patterns.name: 其他数字结果语境
patterns.context: 激活出现在统计结果、分类学相似度或税率陈述中，未形成一个足以涵盖其他段落的特定语境。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、微生物分类、税务报道

en.description: Primarily responds to quantitative expressions in scientific, technical, and statistical texts: values and units, measurement parameters, experimental conditions, thresholds, and predicted or historical values. It spans software, economics, medicine, ecology, and various scientific papers, often accompanied by formulas or formatting markers.

patterns.name: Numeric values and units
patterns.context: Technical or scientific descriptions provide measurements, parameters, thresholds, dimensions, speeds, or timescales; common forms include a number adjacent to a unit or accompanied by mathematical notation.
patterns.domain: Software documentation, economic news, astronomy, medicine, biology, physics, and materials science

patterns.name: Statistical values and thresholds
patterns.context: When reporting forecasts, detection thresholds, or historical statistics, numbers quantify proportions, decision boundaries, or orders of magnitude; words indicating statistical meaning occur before or after the values.
patterns.domain: Economic news, clinical research, ecology, and population descriptions

patterns.name: Experimental conditions and parameters
patterns.context: Methods for experiments or simulations specify instrument settings, material samples, operating conditions, or computational parameters, often introduced by “of” or “at.”

patterns.name: Formatted technical values and markers
patterns.context: Values are embedded in formulas, LaTeX, unit expressions, or paper citations / figure markers; formatting may include subscripts, currency symbols, or encoding artifacts.

patterns.name: Sequence words preceding specific values
patterns.context: Numbers are introduced by phrases indicating comparison, change, or quantity; activation may occur near the value and may also involve words describing the numeric relationship.

9_433.description: 主要响应科学、技术及统计文本中的定量表达：数值与单位、测量参数、实验条件、阈值和预测/历史数值；覆盖软件、经济、医学、生态及多类科学论文，常伴公式或格式标记。

patterns.name: 数值单位与量纲表达
patterns.trigger: 数值后接单位或量纲，如“4096 bytes”“7.5 GHz”“25.5 W/mm2”“220μm”“1.63 fs”“100 km s”“300 km s−1”
patterns.context: 技术或科学叙述中给出测量值、参数、阈值、尺寸、速度或时间尺度；常见形式是数字与单位相邻，或带有数学标记。
patterns.domain: 软件文档、经济新闻、天文学、医学、生物学、物理与材料科学

patterns.name: 统计值与阈值
patterns.trigger: “forecast of 1.8% growth”“load cutoff value of 5000 copies”“record low of 500 fish”
patterns.context: 报告预测、检测阈值或历史统计时，数字用于量化比例、判定界限或数量级；数值前后有描述统计意义的词语。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、临床研究、生态与种群描述

patterns.name: 实验条件和参数
patterns.trigger: “bandwidth of 7.5 GHz”“intensity threshold at 25.5 W/mm2”“sample thickness of approximately 220μm”“time step of 1.63 fs”
patterns.context: 实验或模拟方法中说明仪器设置、材料样品、操作条件或计算参数，常由“of”“at”等引出数值。

patterns.name: 格式化技术数值及标记
patterns.context: 数值嵌在公式、LaTeX、单位表达或论文引用/图表标记中；格式可能包含上下标、货币符号或编码痕迹。

patterns.name: 特定数值前的序列词
patterns.trigger: “up from an April forecast”“from a record low of 500 fish”“with a total bandwidth of”
patterns.context: 数字由比较、变化或数量说明短语引出；激活可落在数值附近，也可能伴随描述数值关系的词。

en.description: Primarily responds to numbers and nearby expressions, especially measurements, experimental parameters, thresholds, and settings introduced by prepositions in scientific and technical texts; also includes output, speed, and tax-rate percentages in news.

patterns.name: Values and units in measurement results
patterns.context: In scientific, medical, or engineering texts, a value appears as a measurement result, threshold, experimental parameter, or material/device specification; activation is often on or near the value.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical papers, technical documents

patterns.name: Prepositions introducing values and parameters
patterns.context: A preposition introduces a measurement, condition, or parameter, with the value and unit forming a phrase; commonly co-occurs with scientific reporting or specifications.

patterns.name: Thresholds, defaults, or setpoints
patterns.context: A value is described as a decision threshold, default setting, or experimental/system parameter rather than a general quantity.

patterns.name: Output, throughput, and rate
patterns.context: Values describe output or speed per unit of time, usually qualified by expressions such as “per day” or “velocity.”

patterns.name: Tax rates and percentages
patterns.context: A percentage represents a tax rate and appears in a description of income or a taxpayer group.

9_433.description: 主要对数值及其邻近表达作出反应，尤其是科学技术文本中由介词引出的测量、实验参数、阈值和设定值；也涉及产量、速度及新闻中的税率百分比。

patterns.name: 测量结果中的数值及单位
patterns.trigger: 数字、数值范围或数值表达，常紧邻单位或物理量，如“4.95”“7.5 GHz”“9,470 metric tons per day”“312 GW/cm^2”
patterns.context: 科学、医学或工程文本中，数值作为测量结果、阈值、实验参数或材料/设备规格出现；激活位置常在数值或其附近。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学论文、技术文档

patterns.name: 数值前的介词与参数引介
patterns.trigger: “of”“at”“with”“for”以及其后的参数短语，如“bandwidth of 7.5 GHz”“at 775 nm”“a time step of 1.63 fs”
patterns.context: 介词引出测量值、条件或参数，数值与单位构成短语；常与科学报告或规格说明共现。

patterns.name: 阈值、默认值或设定值
patterns.trigger: “cut-off value of 5000 copies”“default to 4”“a time step of 1.63 fs”等
patterns.context: 数值被说明为判定阈值、默认设置或实验/系统参数，而非一般数量叙述。
patterns.domain: 医学、软件工程、实验科学

patterns.name: 产量、吞吐量与速率
patterns.trigger: “average plant throughput of 9,470 metric tons per day”及“1590ft/sec”
patterns.context: 数值描述单位时间内的产出或速度，通常由“per day”“velocity”等限定。
patterns.domain: 采矿报道、历史军事叙述

patterns.name: 税率与百分比
patterns.context: 百分比表示税率，置于收入或纳税人群体的说明中。

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to noun phrases that introduce or report quantitative attributes in technical texts, especially density, content, load, throughput, dimensions, temperature, bandwidth, and activation energy. The common structure is “attribute of value/unit,” across science, engineering, and medicine.

patterns.name: Density and its measurement
patterns.context: Technical descriptions introduce the density of a material, carrier, or defect, often followed directly by a value or unit; passages 1, 5, and 7 explicitly contain density, while passage 9 lacks the word but has a similar quantitative measurement structure.
patterns.domain: Materials science, biological genomics, semiconductor devices; passage 9 is clinical virology measurement

patterns.name: Measurement or specification of a numeric quantity
patterns.context: Reports numeric attributes of technical objects, commonly with a noun followed by of and a specific value, unit, or magnitude; passages 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 follow this structure.
patterns.domain: Astronomical observations, software documentation, mining, optical experiments, stellar physics

patterns.name: Energy and activation-energy terminology
patterns.context: Describes the activation energy of a physical quantity such as relaxation time or viscosity; the phrase occurs twice consecutively in passage 3 and is followed by a symbolic value.

patterns.name: Quantitative descriptions of carriers
patterns.context: A carrier density phrase is followed by a value or formula in a sentence reporting a measurement.

patterns.name: Genomic composition and percentage
patterns.context: Describes the overall GC content of a bacterial chromosome, followed by a percentage.

patterns.name: Clinical detection threshold
patterns.context: Clinical measurement context for viral load, describing a detection threshold followed by a value in copies.

patterns.name: Performance scale of particles or equipment
patterns.context: Engineering performance descriptions of mining production capacity or wafer defect levels, both quantified by magnitude.

patterns.name: Page-size parameter
patterns.context: Software implementation documentation explains B-tree page size and its effect on overflow pages.

patterns.name: Experimental sample thickness
patterns.context: Sample preparation descriptions in microscopy / optics give the sample thickness followed by an approximate value and length unit.

patterns.name: Stellar effective temperature
patterns.context: Stellar physics descriptions give the effective temperature of a star as a value in kelvins.

patterns.name: Bandwidth specification
patterns.context: Observational equipment specifications give the total bandwidth as a value in GHz.

9_433.description: 神经元主要响应技术文本中引出或报告定量属性的名词短语，尤其密度、含量、载荷、吞吐量、尺寸、温度、带宽及激活能；多见“属性 of 数值/单位”结构，领域跨科学、工程与医学。

patterns.name: 密度及其测量值
patterns.context: 技术描述中介绍某种材料、载流子或缺陷的密度，并常紧接数值或单位；段1、5、7明确出现 density，段9虽无该词，但有相似的量化测量结构
patterns.domain: 材料科学、生物基因组、半导体器件；段9为临床病毒学测量

patterns.name: 数值量的测定或规格
patterns.context: 报告技术对象的数值属性，常见名词后接 of 和具体数值、单位或量级；段2、4、6、8、10均如此
patterns.domain: 天文观测、软件文档、采矿、光学实验、恒星物理

patterns.name: 能量及激活能术语
patterns.context: 松弛时间或黏度等物理量的激活能描述；段3中该短语连续出现两次，并接符号化数值

patterns.name: 载流子相关的量化表述
patterns.context: 载流子密度短语后跟数值或公式，位于测量结果句中

patterns.name: 基因组组成与百分比
patterns.context: 介绍细菌染色体时说明其总体 GC 含量，后接百分比

patterns.name: 临床检测阈值
patterns.context: 病毒载量的临床测量语境，描述检测阈值并接 copies 数值

patterns.name: 粒子或设备的性能规模
patterns.context: 采矿生产能力或晶圆缺陷水平的工程性能描述，均以数值量级刻画
patterns.domain: 采矿报道、半导体专利背景

patterns.name: 页面尺寸参数
patterns.context: 软件实现文档中说明 B-tree 页面大小及其对溢出页的影响

patterns.name: 实验样品厚度
patterns.context: 显微/光学样品制备描述中，样品厚度后接近似数值与长度单位

patterns.name: 恒星有效温度
patterns.context: 恒星物理描述中，给出恒星的有效温度及开尔文数值

patterns.name: 带宽规格
patterns.context: 观测设备配置说明中，给出总带宽及 GHz 数值

en.description: Primarily responds to names of metrics appearing around values in technical texts, such as throughput, calcium level, resolution, density, thickness, similarity, irradiance, stress, and bandwidth; these metrics belong to different disciplines. Passage 7 is general narrative and is difficult to explain with this pattern.

patterns.name: Technical parameter nouns following values
patterns.context: Describes a measurement, material property, performance metric, or experimental setting in a technical or scientific text; common structures place modifiers before the noun and a value or unit after it, or vice versa.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical papers, patents, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Metric terms in quantitative reporting
patterns.context: Around reported values, metrics include averages, concentrations / levels, resolution, density, thickness, similarity, irradiance, stress, or bandwidth; contexts across different disciplines can trigger activation.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain quantitative scientific and engineering prose

patterns.name: Mismatched general narrative
patterns.context: A general historical narrative discusses causal speculation; the passage has no salient quantitative-parameter reporting structure.

9_433.description: 主要响应技术文本中围绕量值出现的指标名词，如吞吐量、钙水平、分辨率、密度、厚度、相似度、辐照度、应力和带宽；这些指标分属不同学科。第7段是一般叙述，难以由此模式解释。

patterns.name: 量值后的技术参数名词
patterns.context: 技术或科学文本中，描述一个测量量、材料性质、性能指标或实验设置；常见结构为名词前接修饰语、名词后接数值或单位，或反之。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学论文、专利和技术说明

patterns.name: 定量报告中的指标词
patterns.trigger: “average”“serum calcium level”“resolution”“charge carrier density”“sample thickness”“ANI value”“peak irradiance”“contact stress”“total bandwidth”
patterns.context: 围绕数值报告平均值、浓度/水平、分辨率、密度、厚度、相似度、辐照度、应力或带宽等指标；不同学科语境均可触发。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的定量科学与工程文体

patterns.name: 不匹配的通用叙述
patterns.context: 一般历史叙述中谈及因果猜测；片段没有显著的定量参数报告结构。
patterns.domain: 通俗历史或说明性散文

en.description: All passages highlight a parameter or metric name in quantitative statements, followed by or associated with values, units, ranges, or comparison results; domains differ but include mining capacity, stress, similarity, lifespan, blood calcium, bandwidth, thickness, window size, irradiance, and resolution.

patterns.name: Values in measurement parameters
patterns.context: A value, unit, or numeric range appears near the name of a parameter or measured quantity; the value itself is usually not marked, and activation concentrates on the quantity name.
patterns.domain: Quantitative statements in scientific papers, patents, medical cases, and legal-financial explanations

patterns.name: Numeric relationships and reporting constructions
patterns.context: The quantity name appears in a phrase reporting a value, comparison result, or set parameter; common collocations include average/total/peak, value/level, and stress/expectancy/size/resolution.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary technical and factual explanatory prose

patterns.name: Life expectancy in law
patterns.context: When calculating the present value of retirement benefits, life expectancy is described using a life-expectancy table and the person’s age.
patterns.domain: Legal opinion or trial factual statement

patterns.name: Medical treatment target
patterns.context: A case narrative adjusts a medication dose with the goal of bringing serum calcium to the lower end of the reference range.

patterns.name: Names of academic metrics or quantities
patterns.context: Activation falls on nouns naming experimental, engineering, or statistical quantities, rather than proper names, general narrative, or units.
patterns.domain: Engineering, physics, biomedicine, and statistical technical texts

9_433.description: 各段均在定量陈述中突出参数或指标名，后接或关联数值、单位、范围及比较结果；领域虽异，包含矿业产能、应力、相似度、寿命、血钙、带宽、厚度、窗口大小、辐照度和分辨率。

patterns.name: 计量参数中的数值
patterns.context: 在参数或测量量名称之后，附近出现数值、单位或数值范围；数值本身通常未标记，激活集中在量名上。
patterns.domain: 科技论文、专利、医学病例及法律财务说明中的定量陈述

patterns.name: 数值关系与报告句式
patterns.context: 量名处于报告数值、比较结果或设定参数的短语中，常见搭配包括 average/total/peak、value/level、stress/expectancy/size/resolution。
patterns.domain: 跨学科技术与事实性说明文

patterns.name: 法律中的预期寿命
patterns.context: 计算退休福利现值时，以生命预期表和当事人年龄描述预期寿命。
patterns.domain: 法律意见或庭审事实陈述

patterns.name: 医学治疗目标
patterns.context: 病例叙述调整药物剂量，目标是使血清钙达到参考范围较低端。

patterns.name: 学术指标或量值的名称
patterns.context: 激活落在用来命名实验、工程或统计量的名词上，而不是专名、一般叙述或单位上。
patterns.domain: 工程、物理、生物医学及统计技术文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word forms and proper names: World (mostly in names), Exp-, Category labels, and sporadic words in migration, sports, medicine, and biographical entries. No clear cross-domain rule is apparent.

patterns.name: World in proper or organization names
patterns.context: Appears in names or titles, followed by nouns for specific fields, events, organizations, etc.; the word itself activates strongly.

patterns.name: Exp word-initial fragment
patterns.context: Appears in words beginning with Exp, including “Expense(s)” and “Expansion”; the following stems differ.

patterns.name: Category classification label
patterns.context: Appears as a category field at the end of a Wikipedia entry, followed by a colon and category name.

patterns.name: Migration-related migrate
patterns.context: Describes people moving somewhere, followed by the destination “to Germany”.

patterns.name: Sports events and results narratives
patterns.context: Lists competitors and event background in descriptions of billiards events.

patterns.name: Medical term role
patterns.context: Describes a physiological or disease-related function in the construction “plays a fundamental role in”.

patterns.name: Anemia- and transfusion-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses transfusions and iron overload complications in patients with sickle cell anemia.

patterns.name: Sports doubles events
patterns.context: Describes men's doubles partners, medals, or event champions.

patterns.name: Names and positions of people
patterns.context: Titles of biographical entries and descriptions of birth details and university positions.

9_757.description: 激活分散于若干词形与专名：World（多为名称）、Exp-、Category 标签，以及迁移、体育、医学和人物条目中的零散词。跨领域一致规则不明显。

patterns.name: World 用于专名或机构名称
patterns.context: 出现在名称或标题中，后接特定领域、赛事、组织等名词；该词本身激活较强。

patterns.name: Exp 词首片段
patterns.context: 出现在以 Exp 开头的词中，包括 “Expense(s)” 和 “Expansion”；后续词干不同。
patterns.domain: 邮件主题、欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: Category 分类标签
patterns.context: 作为维基百科条目末尾的分类字段，后接冒号及分类名称。

patterns.name: 迁移相关 migrate
patterns.context: 谈及人群迁往某地，后接目的地 “to Germany”。

patterns.name: 体育赛事及成绩叙述
patterns.context: 台球赛事介绍中，列述参赛选手及赛事背景。

patterns.name: 医学术语 role
patterns.context: 在 “plays a fundamental role in” 结构中说明生理或疾病相关作用。

patterns.name: 贫血与输血相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论镰状细胞贫血患者输血及铁过载并发症。

patterns.name: 体育双打项目

patterns.name: 人物姓名与职务

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word-initial or subword fragments: School, Air, please, Exp, and a few Polish word forms, event names, and species-name fragments; their contexts differ.

patterns.name: English word-initial School
patterns.context: English words or phrases beginning with School; in [9] it is followed by the plural suffix s, and in [10] by problems.

patterns.name: English word-initial Air
patterns.context: Begins with Air and discusses inflammation or pollution and their health effects.

patterns.name: please in emails
patterns.context: Polite requests in email body text; once near the beginning of a sentence and once after “Attached”.

patterns.name: Exp in email subjects
patterns.context: Appears as the initial fragment of Expense/Expenses in email subjects, with strong activation in both instances.

patterns.name: Polish word-form fragments
patterns.context: Polish sentence fragments involving word segmentation; no clear semantic condition shared with the other segments.

patterns.name: World in event names
patterns.context: Appears after a year as part of the sports event name “World Table Tennis Championships”.

patterns.name: Fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in “great sturgeon (Huso huso)” as a subword segmentation of the English fish name.

9_757.description: 激活分散在若干词首或子词片段：School、Air、please、Exp，以及少数波兰语词形、赛事名称和物种名片段；各自上下文不同。

patterns.name: 英语词首 School
patterns.context: 英文中以 School 开头的词或短语；在 [9] 后接复数词尾 s，在 [10] 后接 problems。

patterns.name: 英语词首 Air
patterns.context: 以 Air 开头，谈及炎症或污染及其健康影响。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、环境健康文本

patterns.name: 邮件中的 please
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的礼貌请求；一次位于句首附近，一次在“Attached”之后。

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的 Exp
patterns.context: 邮件主题里作为 Expense/Expenses 的词首片段出现，且两处均有较强激活。

patterns.name: 波兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子片段，涉及词形切分；没有明显与其他段共享的语义条件。

patterns.name: 赛事名称中的 World
patterns.context: 位于年份之后，构成体育赛事名称“World Table Tennis Championships”。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在“great sturgeon (Huso huso)”中，是英文鱼名的子词切分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、物种名称

Other patterns include Khmer characters, legal boilerplate, military reporting, medical cases, email attachment records, and biology abstracts.

patterns.name: toolbar term and related interface controls

9_757.description: 激活集中于多领域文本中的 toolbar 字段或控件：配置、资源名、浏览器选项与自动化操作；另有 Khmer 字符、法律固定语、军事报道、医学病例、邮件附件记录及生物学摘要等不同模式。

patterns.name: toolbar 词及相关界面控件

patterns.name: 出版状态语句

patterns.name: 军事组织名称

en.concept: Recognition of word forms with specific stems
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on different extensions of the amphib word family and the actin word family; there are also sporadic activations for Archive-related terms, hyphenated Node.js titles, and Montenegro/Yugoslavia-related word forms.

patterns.name: amphibian word family
patterns.context: The amphib stem takes different affixes and appears in sentences or phrases; referents include amphibians, amphibious robots, and the mineral amphibole.

patterns.name: actin word family
patterns.context: actin appears as a biological term or within compound terms.

patterns.name: Archive-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses preserving user content, historical archives, and internet archive organizations.

patterns.name: Year and hyphenated Node.js title
patterns.context: Title-style phrase connecting a time span, a technology name, and a use case with hyphens.

patterns.name: Montenegro/Yugoslavia word forms

9_757.concept: 含特定词干的词形识别
9_757.description: 激活主要集中于 amphib 词族的不同扩展形式和 actin 词族；另对 Archive 档案用语、Node.js 连字符标题及 Montenegro/Yugoslavia 相关词形有零散激活。

patterns.name: amphibian词族

patterns.name: actin词族

patterns.name: 档案相关词

patterns.name: 年份与 Node.js 连字符标题
patterns.context: 标题式短语，以连字符连接时间长度、技术名称与使用情境。

patterns.name: Montenegro/Yugoslavia词形
patterns.context: 涉及蒙特内哥罗移民及其当时属于南斯拉夫的历史叙述。

en.description: The most consistent trigger is the colon and backslash in Windows drive paths, often accompanied by directory names, filenames, and path strings in technical Q&A, commands, and code. Segment 10 also activates on LaTeX backslash commands, suggesting that the backslash itself may be a broader trigger.

patterns.name: Windows drive paths
patterns.context: In Windows paths or command-line text, especially a drive letter followed by a backslash; multiple activations fall on the drive letter, colon, and slash.
patterns.domain: Windows instructions, command lines, code, and errors; includes documentation and discussions

patterns.name: Directories and filenames in paths
patterns.context: Path separators connect drive letters, directories, user folders, or filenames; often appears in discussions of path settings, file locations, or access problems.
patterns.domain: Windows, Excel/VBA, .NET errors, and file-path Q&A

patterns.name: Escaped or literal strings in paths
patterns.context: Path-like strings appear in code, commands, or quoted text; quotes, literal-string syntax, or the path itself may accompany activation.
patterns.domain: PowerShell, C#, Excel/VBA, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Backslash commands in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematical expressions, the backslash is a command prefix rather than a Windows path separator.

9_757.description: 最一致的触发是 Windows 盘符路径中的冒号与反斜杠，常伴随目录名、文件名及路径字符串，出现在技术问答、命令和代码里。第10段也激活于 LaTeX 的反斜杠命令，说明反斜杠本身可能是更广泛的触发。

patterns.name: Windows 驱动器路径
patterns.context: 在 Windows 路径或命令行文本中，尤其是盘符后接反斜杠；多个示例激活落在盘符、冒号和斜杠上。
patterns.domain: Windows 使用说明、命令行、代码和报错；涵盖文档与讨论

patterns.name: 路径中的目录与文件名
patterns.context: 路径分隔符连接盘符、目录、用户文件夹或文件名；常在讨论路径设置、文件位置或访问问题时出现。
patterns.domain: Windows、Excel/VBA、.NET 错误与文件路径问答

patterns.name: 路径字符串中的转义或逐字量
patterns.context: 代码、命令或引述文本中出现类似路径的字符串；引号、逐字字符串写法或路径本身均可能伴随激活。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的反斜杠命令
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式中反斜杠作为命令前缀，而非 Windows 路径分隔符。

en.description: Activations often occur in web text, especially question openings, terminology, and external links in technical Q&A; they also cover specific technical content such as HTML, regex, layouts, and XML. Other examples include digit problems, HN design comments, and literary criticism, with no single trigger semantics.

patterns.name: Question-post openings and interrogative sentences
patterns.context: Commonly appears at the start of StackExchange question bodies, where the question asks about a term, method, or answer; the marker itself activates, as do several words in the question.

patterns.name: Web links and URL fragments
patterns.context: Multiple URL fragments activate repeatedly when the body cites an external page, code example, or resource link; nearby words may also activate.
patterns.domain: Web text, technical Q&A, and code configuration

patterns.name: Class and programming technology questions
patterns.context: Technical questions about classes, data structure behavior, or SSL communication; activation locations are scattered, with no fixed term combination.

patterns.name: HTML and example-code markers
patterns.context: Technical content containing HTML snippets, comments, line breaks, and links to online code examples.

patterns.name: Regular expression examples
patterns.context: Russian-language description of a problem matching an IP at the start of a line with a regular expression, listing examples and a regex101 link.

patterns.name: Float layout and column heights
patterns.context: Describes a float layout breaking due to inconsistent column heights and includes a Plunker example.

patterns.name: XML Schema configuration
patterns.context: The schemaLocation attribute in an XML configuration and URLs related to a Maven POM.

patterns.name: Digit arithmetic problem
patterns.context: Asks for the hundreds digit of an integer, with short-answer-style line breaks.

patterns.name: Literary criticism and narrative vocabulary
patterns.context: Comments on characterization and humor in a work and narrates the heroine's experience of unjust suspicion; unlike the other technical Q&A patterns.

patterns.name: Design evaluation and entity links in an HN comment
patterns.context: Discusses the reasons for Quora's new design and includes HTML entity encoding and linked content.

9_757.description: 激活常见于网页文本，尤其是技术问答中的提问开头、术语与外链；也覆盖 HTML、正则、布局、XML 等具体技术内容。另有数位题、HN设计评论和文学评论，无法归为单一触发语义。

patterns.name: 问题帖开头与问句
patterns.context: 常见于 StackExchange 问题正文的开头，问句询问某个术语、做法或答案；标记本身有激活，问句中的若干词也有激活。

patterns.name: 网页链接与 URL 片段
patterns.context: 在正文引用外部页面、代码示例或资源链接时，多个 URL 片段反复激活；链接周围的词也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、技术问答及代码配置

patterns.name: 类与编程技术提问
patterns.context: 谈到类、数据结构行为或 SSL 通信的技术问题；触发位置分散，未呈现固定术语组合。

patterns.name: HTML 与示例代码标记
patterns.context: 包含 HTML 片段、注释、换行及在线代码示例链接的技术内容。

patterns.name: 正则表达式示例
patterns.context: 俄语说明正则表达式在行首匹配 IP 的问题，并列出示例及 regex101 链接。

patterns.name: 浮动布局与列高度
patterns.context: 描述列高不一致导致浮动布局出错，并附 Plunker 示例。

patterns.name: XML Schema 配置
patterns.context: XML 配置中的 schemaLocation 属性及 Maven POM 相关 URL。

patterns.name: 数位算术题
patterns.context: 询问整数的百位数字，带有短答案式换行。

patterns.name: 文学评论与叙事词汇
patterns.context: 评论作品的人物刻画与幽默，并叙述女主人公遭受不公怀疑；与其他技术问答模式不同。

patterns.name: HN 评论中的设计评价与实体链接
patterns.context: 讨论 Quora 推出的新设计及其可能原因，夹有 HTML 实体编码和链接内容。

en.description: Activations are scattered across specific strings in patent terminology, code licenses and compression descriptions, paper formulas and machine-learning text, email proper names, and forum comments/links; no shared semantic or formal trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Body Shop proper name
patterns.context: Part of a name, preceded by the preposition «in the» and followed by «Fuel Station».

patterns.name: toner save term
patterns.context: Patent background text discussing print-data classification and the toner save method applicable to each category.

patterns.name: meat and animal products
patterns.context: A phrase in a link URL about meat and animal products; the body discusses the standard of living in the United States.

patterns.name: Compression algorithm performance tradeoff
patterns.context: Describes an algorithm's performance in terms of compression speed and compression ratio.

patterns.name: Apache License version label
patterns.context: A license declaration in a code file header, followed by the license definition and licensing terms.

patterns.name: Distribution generalization and optimization formula
patterns.context: Introduces a predictive model and its optimization problem, including mathematical symbols and formulas.

patterns.name: Rent trends and source link
patterns.context: States that an indicator has remained stable in recent years and includes a chart link from a rental website.

patterns.name: Academic search filtering operation
patterns.context: Instructs the user to adjust a filter slider and links to a Semantic Scholar year search.

patterns.name: Blog name and thesis term
patterns.context: Mentions a humorous blog and its URL, describing it in the body as a more serious version.

patterns.name: Mathematical formula containing cosh
patterns.context: A derivation involving the hyperbolic cosine function, fractions, and logarithms.

9_757.description: 激活分散于专利术语、代码许可证与压缩说明、论文公式及机器学习文字、邮件专名和论坛评论/链接中的具体词串；看不出共同的语义或形式触发条件。

patterns.name: Body Shop 固有名称
patterns.context: 作为名称的一部分，前有介词 «in the»，后接 «Fuel Station»。

patterns.name: toner save 术语
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中，讨论打印数据分类及各类别适用的 toner save 方法。

patterns.name: meat and animal products
patterns.context: 链接 URL 中出现关于肉类和动物产品的短语，正文谈及美国生活水平。

patterns.name: 压缩算法性能权衡
patterns.context: 描述算法在压缩速度与压缩率之间的表现。

patterns.name: Apache License 版本标注
patterns.context: 代码文件头部的许可证声明，后续接许可证定义及许可条款。

patterns.name: 分布泛化与优化公式
patterns.context: 介绍预测模型及其优化问题，包含数学符号和公式。

patterns.name: 租金走势及来源链接
patterns.context: 称某指标近年保持平稳，并附带租房网站的图表链接。
