patterns.name: 学术搜索筛选操作
patterns.context: 指导用户调整筛选滑块，链接到 Semantic Scholar 的年份搜索。

patterns.name: 博客名称及 thesis 词
patterns.context: 提及一个幽默博客及其网址，正文将其称为较严肃版本。

patterns.name: 含 cosh 的数学公式
patterns.context: 公式推导中出现双曲余弦函数、分式和对数。

en.description: A clearer pattern is selective activation on English intraword subword splits and camel-case identifier fragments; other activations are scattered across mathematical symbols, interface words, email words, patent terminology, and numbers, with no unified condition.

patterns.name: English intraword subwords and suffixes
patterns.context: Activation falls on intraword subwords in segmented English words, especially between a stem and a derivational or inflectional suffix; adjacent ordinary words usually do not activate.

patterns.name: Case boundaries in identifiers
patterns.context: Components of camel-case program identifiers are marked separately, especially in Java method parameters or variable names.

patterns.name: Specific tokens and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical expressions and symbolic computations; activations involve variables, exponent symbols, and numbers, but the overall pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Scattered semantic/contextual words
patterns.context: These words or numbers activate in local contexts across the segments, but there is no consistent cross-segment semantic or syntactic condition; examples include interface layout descriptions, code, email text, patent technical text, and table numbers.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: programming Q&A, email, patents, tables

9_757.description: 较清楚的现象是对英语词内拆分子词及驼峰标识符片段的选择性激活；其余激活分散于数学符号、界面词、邮件词、专利用语和数字，缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: 英语词内子词与后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的英语词的词内子词上，尤其词干与派生或屈折后缀之间；相邻的普通词通常不激活。

patterns.name: 标识符中的大小写边界
patterns.context: 驼峰式程序标识符的组成部分被分别标记，尤其在 Java 方法参数或变量名中。

patterns.name: 特定 token 与格式片段
patterns.context: 出现在数学表达式及符号化计算中；激活涉及变量、幂符号与数字，但整体规律不明确。

patterns.name: 语义/上下文相关的零散词
patterns.context: 这些词或数字在各段局部语境中激活，但跨段无一致的语义或句法条件；包括界面布局描述、代码、邮件文本、专利技术文本及表格数字。
patterns.domain: 多领域：编程问答、邮件、专利、表格

en.concept: Expressions of speech and thought, with sporadic triggers
en.description: Activations are scattered across contexts. They occur especially when narrators use thought to explain a judgment or action, and in that clauses introducing something understood or communicated; there are also words related to the future/expectations, locations, and generic things or experiences, with no single stable theme.

patterns.name: Narrative shift emphasizing “thought”
patterns.context: A first-person narrator explains why they took an action or formed a judgment; also appears in comments on another person's judgment.

patterns.name: Understanding or cognition in that-clauses
patterns.context: that introduces a clause followed by something someone understood, was told, or judged; examples here include “her name and initials will not be…” and “others besides just me…”, as well as the construction “told them the venue was…”.
patterns.domain: Medical paper statements, news reports, technical discussions

patterns.name: Future or location in hypothetical contexts
patterns.context: Discusses the near-future relationship between humans and objects, expectations for an open-source project, or information about the area around a location; trigger words are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Technical comments, open-source project narratives, encyclopedic entries

patterns.name: Words related to generic things or experiences
patterns.context: Appears in contexts discussing object design or personal car-care experiences; the two segments have no evident shared local syntactic pattern.

9_757.description: 激活分散于多种语境：尤其出现在叙述者用 thought 解释判断或行动，以及 that 引出的理解、告知内容中；另见未来/期望、地点和泛指事物或经验相关词，未见单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 强调“thought”的叙述转折
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述者说明自己为何采取某个行动或形成判断；也出现在对他人判断的评论中。

patterns.name: that 从句中的理解或认知
patterns.context: that 引出从句，后接某人理解、被告知或判断的内容；本组中后接 “her name and initials will not be…”、“others besides just me…” 等，也有 “told them the venue was…” 的结构。
patterns.domain: 医学论文声明、新闻报道、技术讨论

patterns.name: 设想中的未来或定位
patterns.context: 谈论近未来人类与物品的关系、开源项目的期望，或地点周边信息；触发词并不一致。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、开源项目叙述、百科条目

patterns.name: 泛指事物或经验相关词
patterns.context: 在讨论物品设计或个人汽车护理经验的语境中出现；两段没有明显共同的局部句法模式。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、汽车护理经验

en.concept: Expressions of speech and thought, with sporadic activations
en.description: Strong activations often fall on reporting verbs and words such as think and Thought that express others' speech or thoughts; other activations include proper-name fragments, sporadic words such as before and syntactic positions, and beam and which in optical patent text. Overall, the triggers are not unified.

patterns.name: Quoting or reporting another person's speech
patterns.context: Activation falls on reporting verbs followed by or introducing another person's words, judgment, or instructions; «think»9 in segment 8 also appears in a construction asking what someone thinks.
patterns.domain: News, forum dialogue, personal narratives, patent dialogue procedures

patterns.name: Expressions of ideas and thought
patterns.context: Expressions of thinking or asking about intentions and opinions; «Thoughts» in segment 9 is a heading introducing the poster's own ideas.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments and proper-name boundaries
patterns.context: The activated fragment is within a proper name or at an intraword segmentation boundary, rather than a clearly semantic full word: Pelotas, McMaster, HPE.

patterns.name: Temporal precedence conjunction
patterns.context: Narrates events that happened before leaving a store, expressing temporal precedence.

patterns.name: Ordinary vocabulary or syntactic-position triggers
patterns.context: These high-activation words occur in different syntactic positions and semantic environments, with no consistent local trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Finance, forums, personal narratives, patents, Q&A

patterns.name: Optics technical phrase
patterns.context: Appears in patent technical descriptions of optical fibers, output beams, and wavelength ranges; apart from these two higher-activation markers, there is no obvious concentration of activations.

9_757.concept: 言语与思考表达，兼有零散触发
9_757.description: 强激活较常落在引述动词以及think、Thought等表达他人话语或想法的词上；另有专名片段、before等零散词和句法位置，以及光学专利文本中的beam、which，整体触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 引述或转述他人发言
patterns.context: 激活落在引述动词上，后接或引出他人的话语、判断、指示；第8段的«think»9也出现在询问对方想法的句式中。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论坛对话、个人叙述、专利对话流程

patterns.name: 想法与思考表达
patterns.context: 思考或询问意图、观点的表达；第9段的«Thoughts»是发帖者引出个人想法的标题。
patterns.domain: 专利对话示例、问答论坛

patterns.name: 特定词片段与专名边界
patterns.context: 激活片段处于专名或词内分词边界，而非明确的完整语义词：Pelotas、McMaster、HPE。
patterns.domain: 百科、技术论坛、财经新闻

patterns.name: 时间先后连接词
patterns.context: 叙述离开商店之前发生的事件，表达时间先后。
patterns.domain: 个人经历、法律相关叙述

patterns.name: 普通词汇或句法位置触发
patterns.context: 这些高激活词分散在不同句法位置和语义环境中，未见一致的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 财经、论坛、个人叙述、专利、问答

patterns.name: 光学技术短语
patterns.context: 出现在光纤、输出光束及波长范围的专利技术描述中；除这两个较高标记外没有明显集中激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across technical Q&A, encyclopedias, patent examples, and forum discussions: these include narration after “me,” category names and fragments of place names, markers of reasoning, engineering and container terminology, institutional Q&A, and understanding-style responses and weekend topics in forums.

patterns.name: Reference or content clause after “me”
patterns.context: In first-person narration, verbs such as tell or force follow me, often introducing a that-clause or quoted content.

patterns.name: Biological names in taxonomy entries
patterns.context: In encyclopedia entries introducing a taxon, genus, or species, proper taxonomic names are split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: “Thoughts” expressing reasoning or a claim
patterns.context: After describing an approach or explaining a need, a questioner uses “my thoughts” to introduce their reasoning.

patterns.name: Asking when someone can do something in dialogue
patterns.context: In dialogue-system examples, after the answer “no,” a follow-up asks when the task is expected to be completed.
patterns.domain: Dialogue examples in patent background sections

patterns.name: Mechanical engineering and prototyping terminology
patterns.context: First-person recollections of work experience mention engineers consulting websites and doing prototyping.

patterns.name: Split fragments in place names
patterns.context: When describing residents, award winners, or cultural figures from a place, place names and personal names are split into subwords.

patterns.name: Container permissions and processes
patterns.context: Discussion of processes inside containers gaining excessive access after a privileged flag is set.

patterns.name: Institution names and web-service Q&A
patterns.context: A Q&A asks for the name and contact information of an external institution and answers with the website software it developed.

patterns.name: Concessive response: “I get what you’re saying”
patterns.context: A forum response first acknowledges the other person’s point, then adds a qualification or rebuttal; paragraph 10 also has a similar acknowledge-then-concede structure.

patterns.name: Social customs around weekends and church
patterns.context: Using whether people go to church on Sundays as an example, the discussion asks whether people today still need a shared day of rest.

9_757.description: 激活分散于技术问答、百科、专利示例及论坛讨论：包括“me”后的叙述、分类名和地名片段、思路标记、工程与容器术语、机构问答，以及论坛中的理解式回应和周末话题。

patterns.name: “me”后的指代或内容从句
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中，me 后接告知、强迫等动词，常继续引出 that 从句或引用内容。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答；个人经历叙述

patterns.name: 分类条目中的生物学名称
patterns.context: 百科条目在介绍分类单元、属或物种时，专有分类名被拆分为多个 token。

patterns.name: 表达思路或主张的“thoughts”
patterns.context: 提问者在描述方案或解释需求后，用“我的想法”引出自己的推理。

patterns.name: 对话中询问对方何时能做某事
patterns.context: 对话系统示例中，回答“no”后接续询问完成任务的预计时间。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的对话示例

patterns.name: 机械工程与原型设计用语
patterns.context: 以第一人称回忆职业经历，谈工程师查阅网站、开展原型设计。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 个人经验/技术讨论

patterns.name: 地名中的拆分片段
patterns.context: 叙述某地的居民、获奖者或文化人物时，地名和人名被拆分成子词。

patterns.name: 容器权限与进程
patterns.context: 讨论给容器设置特权标志后，容器内进程获得过多访问权限。

patterns.name: 机构名称与网络服务问答
patterns.context: 问答中询问外部机构的名称和联系方式，并回答其开发的网站软件。

patterns.name: “I get what you’re saying”的让步回应
patterns.context: 论坛讨论中先表示理解对方观点，再提出补充或反驳；第10段也有相近的理解后让步结构。

patterns.name: 周末与教会的社会习惯讨论
patterns.context: 以周日是否去教会为例，讨论现代人是否仍需要共同休息日。

en.description: Activations have no stable, single meaning: they clearly include personal pronouns in that-clauses, purpose/result introducers, numeric index structures, and several proper-name fragments; other terms are scattered across varied contexts.

patterns.name: That in object clauses
patterns.context: That introduces a clause, especially when followed by a personal pronoun as subject; several fragments appear, but not every that triggers activation
patterns.domain: Forums, comments, and general explanatory text

patterns.name: Purpose or summary introducers
patterns.context: A word introduces a goal, result, or intended outcome, with activation on these introducers

patterns.name: Thoughts word form
patterns.context: In the title-like phrase “My Thoughts:”, Thoughts has the strongest activation

patterns.name: Numeric and index sequences
patterns.context: Code or mathematical discussions of arrays or index calculations; after a sequence, the text asks for the maximum value of the third index

patterns.name: Internal fragments of brands/proper names
patterns.context: Embedded in a gun-store/product name or a game-system proper name, with unstable trigger boundaries; activation may favor capitalized fragments within proper names

patterns.name: Research-related noun fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the website name “MedicalResearch.com” in a medical disclaimer

patterns.name: Other sporadic word forms
patterns.context: These words activate sporadically in different syntactic and semantic environments, without a shared local context

9_757.concept: 混合的词形与句法线索
9_757.description: 激活没有稳定单一语义：明显包括 that 从句中的人称代词、目的/结果引导词、数字索引结构及若干专名片段；其余词项分散于多种语境。

patterns.name: 宾语从句中的 that
patterns.trigger: “that”或 “that his wife”; 激活集中在 that 后的 “you”“me”“we”
patterns.context: that 引导的从句中，尤其是 that 后接人称代词作主语；多个片段出现，但并非每个 that 都触发
patterns.domain: 论坛、评论及一般说明文本

patterns.name: 目的或总结引导词
patterns.context: 词语引出目标、结果或所追求内容，激活落在这些引导词上

patterns.name: thoughts 词形
patterns.context: 标题式短语 “My Thoughts:” 中，Thoughts 激活最强

patterns.name: 数字与索引序列
patterns.trigger: 多组方括号数字及 “third index”
patterns.context: 数组或索引计算的代码/数学讨论；序列后询问第三个索引的最大值

patterns.name: 品牌/专名内部片段
patterns.context: 嵌在枪店/产品名称或游戏系统专名中，触发边界不稳定，可能偏向专名中的大写字母片段
patterns.domain: 用户叙述、游戏网站介绍

patterns.name: 研究相关名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在医疗免责声明中的网站名称 “MedicalResearch.com”

patterns.name: 其他零散词形
patterns.context: 这些词在不同句法和语义环境中零散激活，缺少共同的局部语境

en.concept: Lexical items and phrase fragments in specific contexts
en.description: Activations are scattered across diverse texts: realize in rebuttal sentences, you in lyrics, me in personal narratives, plan in business quotes, way introducing an approach, aims/objectives for research goals, mainstream in wrestling, and NoSQL in a software name. Only some patterns recur.

patterns.name: Cognition verbs in prompts, arguments, or goal statements
patterns.context: The trigger is realize, followed by is that introducing an explanation, rebuttal, or argument; the trigger position is the same in two passages.

patterns.name: Personal pronoun you
patterns.context: In paragraph 1, you appears in lyrics and refers to the addressee; in paragraph 2, me appears in a personal narrative and indirect quotation. The semantics and style differ, with insufficient evidence to group them as one pattern.
patterns.domain: Lyrics; narrative about a gun-store experience

patterns.name: Quoted report of company plans and cash accumulation
patterns.context: Quotes speculation about a company’s future strategy, with plan adjacent to a possessive relation and a description of cash accumulation.

patterns.name: Introducing a method or approach
patterns.context: Uses way is to to introduce a specific technical procedure.

patterns.name: Concluding marker for research objectives
patterns.context: NIH project text first lists research objectives, then uses To achieve ... to shift to the implementation plan or subsequent work.

patterns.name: Mainstream label in popular wrestling assessments
patterns.context: mainstream is split across tokens; it appears in the context of assessments of American professional wrestling.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a software name
patterns.context: Activation falls on the NoSQL fragment of a camel-case project name, rather than on the equivalent word in ordinary sentences.

9_757.concept: 特定语境中的词汇与短语片段
9_757.description: 激活分散在多种文本中：反驳句的 realize、歌词中的 you、个人叙述中的 me、商业引语中的 plan、方案引入的 way、研究目标 aims/objectives、摔角词 mainstream 和软件名 NoSQL。仅部分模式有重复。

patterns.name: 提示、论点或目标陈述中的认识动词
patterns.trigger: “What you fail to realize is that”“What you don't realize is that”
patterns.context: 触发点是 realize，后接 is that 引出解释、反驳或论据；两段中触发位置相同。

patterns.name: 人称代词 you
patterns.context: 段1 的 you 出现在歌词中，指向对话对象；段2 的 me 出现在个人叙述及间接引语中。两处语义和文体不同，缺乏足够证据归为同一模式。
patterns.domain: 歌词；枪械商店经历叙述

patterns.name: 公司计划与现金积累的报道引语
patterns.trigger: “company's plan”后接 «plan»9，并出现“collect as much cash as possible”
patterns.context: 引述对公司未来策略的推测，plan 紧邻所属关系和现金积累描述。

patterns.name: 方法或方案的引入
patterns.trigger: “One way”后接«way»9，再接“is to simply split”
patterns.context: 以 way is to 引入具体技术操作方案。

patterns.name: 研究目标的收束标记
patterns.trigger: “To achieve these objectives”中的«objectives»9；“To achieve these aims”中的«aims»9
patterns.context: NIH 项目文本先列研究目标，随后用 To achieve ... 转入执行方案或后续工作。

patterns.name: 大众摔角评价中的主流标签
patterns.context: mainstream 被拆分跨 token 呈现；在对美国职业摔角的评价语境中出现。

patterns.name: 软件名称中的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在驼峰式项目名的 NoSQL 片段，而非普通句子中的同类词。

en.description: Activations are scattered across many fields: quotations and plans, methods and research objectives, commentary, and entities in finance, technology, research, music, wrestling, firearms, and politics. Their commonality is weak; they often occur near content continuations or key nouns.

patterns.name: Quoting in object clauses
patterns.context: Introduces the content of a statement after a verb, especially what a person or institution said or planned; the trigger often follows a reporting verb

patterns.name: Introducing a judgment or method
patterns.context: Introduces a practice, typical method, or research objective, often with phrases such as One way / typical approach / objectives

patterns.name: Developing a viewpoint or argument
patterns.context: Presents evaluations and arguments about works, people, plots, or political reform; activation falls on nouns or content-continuation points in the discussion

patterns.name: Domain terms composed of proper names and abbreviations
patterns.context: Near institution, technology, or research-domain names and abbreviations, activation may concentrate on proper-name fragments rather than a consistent syntactic position

patterns.name: Quantities and forecast data
patterns.context: Financial news reports forecasts, earnings, and per-share values

patterns.name: Special research grants and project history
patterns.context: States the source and year of project funding, renewals, and core research training for the project

patterns.name: Video signal processing explanation
patterns.context: Explains conversion, recording, aspect ratio, and subsequent processing of high-definition signals

patterns.name: Time-series data analysis
patterns.context: Introduces a dataset that changes over time and explains that a visual summary is used to select a time interval

patterns.name: Juxtaposed geographic and political entities
patterns.context: Lists the constituent regions of the United Kingdom and contrasts them with England in discussing the need for reform

patterns.name: Evaluations of performances and events
patterns.context: Calls for credible characters, storylines, and actual matches, then comments on mainstream American wrestling

patterns.name: Music album and recording reviews
patterns.context: Discusses dialogue and volume on an album, and the possibility of assembling a live CD

patterns.name: Narrative about buying a firearm
patterns.context: Recounts buying a gun lock at a gun shop and a clerk explaining laws related to used guns

patterns.name: Abstract statements about funding plans
patterns.context: Discusses a company’s long-term plans and its goal of accumulating as much cash as possible

9_757.description: 激活分散于多领域：引述与计划、方法和研究目标、评论论述，以及财经、技术、科研、音乐、摔角、枪械和政治实体等内容；共同点较弱，常落在内容承接或关键名词附近。

patterns.name: 宾语从句引述
patterns.trigger: « me»10« that»7« the»6« law»5；« analyst»5« said»9« he»6；« plan»9« is»1
patterns.context: 动词后引出陈述内容，尤其是人物或机构的说法、计划；触发位置常在引述谓语之后

patterns.name: 判断或方法引入
patterns.trigger: « way»9« is»1；« approach»9 is to；« objectives»9
patterns.context: 介绍一种做法、典型方法或研究目标，常由 One way / typical approach / objectives 等短语引出

patterns.name: 观点或论点展开
patterns.context: 围绕作品、人物、情节或政治改革展开评价和论述；激活落在论述中的名词或观点承接处
patterns.domain: 评论、娱乐讨论、政治评论

patterns.name: 专名与缩写组成的领域术语
patterns.context: 机构、技术或研究领域专名及缩写附近，激活可能集中在专名片段而非统一句法位置
patterns.domain: 枪械相关叙述、财经、科研

patterns.name: 数量与预测数据
patterns.trigger: «5»3« billion»8« predicted»6；« 31»« cents»1 per« share»3；« 26»1« cents»4
patterns.context: 财务新闻中报告预测、收益及每股数值

patterns.name: 专项研究资助与项目经历
patterns.context: 陈述项目获得资助的来源、年份、续期，以及项目核心研究训练

patterns.name: 视频信号处理说明
patterns.trigger: down-convert & record；« signal»2 coming from；« wides»creen
patterns.context: 说明高清信号的转换、录制、画幅及后续处理方式

patterns.name: 时间序列数据分析
patterns.context: 介绍随时间变化的数据集，并说明可视化摘要用于筛选时间区间

patterns.name: 地理与政治实体并列
patterns.context: 并列列举英国构成地域，并与 England 对照讨论改革需求

patterns.name: 演出与赛事内容评价
patterns.context: 要求可信角色、故事线和实际比赛，随后评论美国主流摔角

patterns.name: 音乐专辑与录音评论
patterns.context: 讨论专辑中的对白、音量及拼制现场 CD 的可能性

patterns.name: 枪械购买叙述
patterns.trigger: « lock»3«)»5 from« Ade»2«'s»3« Gun»3« Shop»3；« me»10« that»7
patterns.context: 讲述在枪店购买枪锁及店员解释二手枪相关法律
patterns.domain: 个人叙述、枪械法律话题

patterns.name: 抽象的资金计划陈述
patterns.trigger: « collect»2« as»6 much« cash»4« as»8 possible
patterns.context: 讨论公司长期计划及尽可能收集现金的目标
patterns.domain: 创业公司讨论、论坛引述

en.description: Activations are scattered across texts from many domains, often appearing in tokenized word fragments, abbreviations, hyphenated compounds, and possessive boundaries; numbers, function words, and isolated content words also trigger. The examples do not share a unified semantic theme, and some may be due to context or tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Abbreviations, hyphens, and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on word fragments split by special tokenization, abbreviation letters, or internal hyphens; the same fragment can occur across diverse topics.

patterns.name: Professional abbreviations or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur around abbreviations for medicine, funding projects, equipment, or place names, but the abbreviations have different meanings.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in noun phrases and compounds
patterns.context: The trigger fragment is embedded in descriptive noun phrases, compounds, or domain terms, with no unified topic.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, technical explanations, natural history, and online discussions

patterns.name: Near possessives and apostrophes
patterns.context: Activation concentrates near possessive forms or word-final apostrophes, followed by a noun or abbreviation.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and neighboring text
patterns.context: In a few passages, activation occurs near years, values, or units; it is unclear whether numbers themselves are a shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Project descriptions, animal ranges, music reviews

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers in conjunctions and common expressions
patterns.context: Some common function words are marked in different contexts, usually alongside stronger domain terms or token fragments; this may be an adjacency or context effect.

patterns.name: Several isolated content-word triggers
patterns.context: Appears in only one passage; topics differ, and the available examples are insufficient to establish a shared semantic pattern.

9_757.description: 激活分散在多领域文本中，常见于分词拆开的词片段、缩写、连字符复合词及所有格边界；另有数字、功能词和孤立内容词触发。各例语义不统一，部分可能由上下文或分词边界造成。

patterns.name: 缩写、连字符与分词边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在被特殊分词拆开的词片段、缩写字母或词内连字符附近；同一片段可跨多种主题出现。

patterns.name: 专业缩写或专名片段
patterns.context: 医学、资助项目、设备或地名缩写处出现激活，但各处缩写的含义不同。

patterns.name: 名词短语及复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在描述性名词短语、复合词或领域术语中；并无统一主题。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、技术说明、自然史与网络讨论

patterns.name: 所有格与撇号附近
patterns.context: 激活集中在所有格或词尾撇号附近，后接名词或缩写。

patterns.name: 数字、单位及其邻近文本
patterns.context: 少数片段中年份、数值或单位附近有激活；无法确认数字本身是共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 项目介绍、动物活动范围、音乐评论

patterns.name: 连接词与常见表达中的零散触发
patterns.trigger: « and»、« but»、« it»、« the»、« that»、« do»
patterns.context: 一些常见功能词在不同语境中被标记，周围通常还有较强的领域词或分词片段；可能是邻接或上下文效应。

patterns.name: 若干孤立的内容词触发
patterns.context: 仅在单段出现，主题彼此不同，现有样本不足以确认共同语义模式。
patterns.domain: 评论、宣传、枪支经历、医学

en.description: Primarily responds to discourse-organizing expressions that introduce subsequent content: proposing a method (approach/way/method), beginning a list or explanation (First/first/possibility), and, less commonly, speculation, expected evaluations, and inverted proposed constructions.

patterns.name: “way / approach / method” followed by an explanation of a plan
patterns.context: Introduces a method, approach, or steps to be discussed next; the following text typically explains them. Activation is concentrated on approach, way, method, and adjacent articles/ordinals.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, forum/web explanations, and practical guides

patterns.name: “First, …” list development
patterns.context: The preceding text has announced innovations, reasons, or a plan divided into items; First begins the first item.
patterns.domain: Research grant applications and academic papers

patterns.name: “The first is that” introducing a problem or explanation
patterns.context: After listing multiple problems, reasons, or possibilities, an ordinal or possibility introduces a specific explanation; strong activation falls on introducers such as first/possibility.
patterns.domain: Patent background sections and medical papers

patterns.name: “guess, however, is that” speculation
patterns.context: The author first states a personal guess, then uses is that to introduce a judgment; the tone is commentarial and cautious.

patterns.name: “thought it would” expectation statement
patterns.context: Evaluates whether a product or tool meets or exceeds the user’s prior expectations; activation concentrates on the collocation thought it.

patterns.name: “proposed are” inversion introducing research work
patterns.context: After Also at the beginning of a sentence, proposed + are appears in inversion to introduce proposed research or discovery work; this is not the usual subject-first order.

9_757.description: 主要响应引出后续内容的篇章组织表达：提出方法（approach/way/method）、开始列举或解释（First/first/possibility），也覆盖推测、预期评价及 proposed 倒装等少见触发。

patterns.name: “way / approach / method”后接方案说明
patterns.trigger: [1] «A»2« typical»1« approach»10 is；[2] «One»3« way»9 is；[10] «A»2« second»3« method»9 in
patterns.context: 引出接下来要讲的做法、方案或步骤，后文通常继续说明其内容；触发较集中在 approach、way、method 及其相邻冠词/序数词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、论坛/网页说明及实用指南

patterns.name: “First, …”列举展开
patterns.context: 前文已宣布创新点、原因或方案分为若干项，First 后开始列出第一项。
patterns.domain: 科研资助申请与学术论文

patterns.name: “The first is that”提出问题或解释
patterns.context: 在先列举多个问题、原因或可能性之后，用序数词或 possibility 引出具体解释；强激活落在 first/possibility 一类引导词上。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术与医学论文

patterns.name: “guess, however, is that”推测
patterns.context: 作者先表达个人推测，再由 is that 引出判断；具有评论、审慎推论语气。

patterns.name: “thought it would”预期表达
patterns.context: 评价某产品或工具符合甚至超过使用者原先预期，激活集中于 thought it 的搭配。

patterns.name: “proposed are”倒装引出研究工作
patterns.context: 句首 Also 后以 proposed + are 倒装，引出拟开展的研究或发现工作；不是常规主语先行语序。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划文本

en.concept: Expressions of key judgments and explanations
en.description: Activations occur in expressions of explanations and research goals, possibilities and methods, and superlative evaluations; they also appear in medical, legal, conflict-reporting, and time-data contexts. There is no unified domain theme across passages.

patterns.name: Explanations, judgments, or research goals in sentences
patterns.context: Trigger words often occur in sentences presenting a conjecture, possible cause, typical method, or research goal, and are often adjacent to structures such as is, are, and that.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, research abstracts, Q&A, and general discussion

patterns.name: Superlatives or degree evaluations
patterns.context: Evaluates risk or the difficulty of a practice; carries the main evaluative emphasis in the phrase.

patterns.name: Court references in legal texts
patterns.context: Refers to a court in formal legal discussion, especially in contexts such as jurisdiction or before the court.

patterns.name: Points of contention in conflict reporting
patterns.context: Used with sticking to identify a key dispute in negotiations or ceasefire issues.

patterns.name: Symptoms and quality of life in medicine
patterns.context: Discusses chronic conditions, symptoms, and their impact on quality of life in transplant survivors.

patterns.name: Time processing and temporal change
patterns.context: Concerns the representation, selection, and storage of time-series data or time-zone objects.

9_757.description: 激活分布于解释与研究目标、可能性和方法、最高级评价等表达，也见于医学、法律、冲突报道及时间数据语境；不同段落间缺乏统一的领域主题。

patterns.name: 句子中的解释、判断或研究目标
patterns.context: 触发词多出现在提出猜测、可能原因、典型方法或研究目标的句子中，常与 is、are、that 等结构相邻。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、研究摘要、问答及一般论述

patterns.name: 最高级或程度评价
patterns.context: 评价风险或某种做法的难易程度；在短语中承载重点评价。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的法院指称
patterns.context: 正式法律论述中指法院，尤其出现在 jurisdiction 或 before the court 等语境。

patterns.name: 冲突报道中的争议焦点
patterns.context: 与 sticking 搭配，指出谈判或停火问题中的关键争议。

patterns.name: 医学中的症状与生活质量
patterns.context: 讨论移植幸存者的慢性疾病、症状及生活质量影响。

patterns.name: 时间处理与时间变化
patterns.context: 涉及时间序列数据或时区对象的表示、选择与存储。

en.concept: Structural cues and markers in passages
en.description: Activations occur in introductory language for court motions, statistical numerals and punctuation, colloquial sentence openings in technical Q&A, and descriptions of subproject costs and funding sources in NIH texts; the latter pattern repeats four times.

patterns.name: Introduction to court proceedings
patterns.context: In legal opinions or pleadings, introduces a motion currently before the court; activation concentrates on court/Court and also marks presently/currently and motions.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in demographic statistics
patterns.context: In census-style descriptions of household composition, proportions, and average size, activation falls on tokens such as numbers, percent signs, and periods.

patterns.name: Colloquial continuation in code explanations
patterns.context: A colloquial sentence opening in technical Q&A that shifts into explaining code or the cause of a problem; activation mainly falls on idea, thing.

patterns.name: Repeated lexical pattern in project funding descriptions
patterns.context: Describes subproject cost estimates, use of center infrastructure, and NIH/NCRR funding sources; paragraphs 7–10 are duplicate copies of the same text.

9_757.concept: 文段中的结构性提示词与标记
9_757.description: 激活分布于法庭动议引入语、统计数字标点、技术问答口语解释句首，以及 NIH 子项目成本与资金来源说明；后者重复出现四次。

patterns.name: 法庭审理引入语
patterns.trigger: “Presently before the court are” / “Currently before the Court is”
patterns.context: 法律意见或诉讼文书中，引出法院当前待处理的动议；激活集中在 court/Court，且也标记 presently/currently、motions。

patterns.name: 人口统计中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 人口普查式描述家庭构成、比例、平均规模时，激活落在数值、百分号和句点等 token。

patterns.name: 代码解释中的口语承接
patterns.trigger: “So the idea” / “Ok the thing is that”
patterns.context: 技术问答中，转入解释代码或问题原因的口语化句首；主要激活 idea、thing。

patterns.name: 项目经费说明中的重复词汇模式
patterns.trigger: “other sources, including other NIH sources”及“the Total Cost … the subproject … utilized … provided by the … grant”
patterns.context: 说明子项目成本估算、中心基础设施使用及 NIH/NCRR 资助来源；第7至10段是同一文本的重复副本。

en.concept: Multiple patterns, not reducible to a single concept
en.description: There is more than one activation pattern: “thing is” in colloquial speech, “what is” in math problems, fixed patent phrasing, and local words or topics in legal, medical, and railway texts. The two patent passages overlap substantially, while most others are unique to their respective passages.

patterns.name: “thing is” expression
patterns.context: In colloquial speech or Q&A, “The thing is” introduces an explanation, transition, or viewpoint; [1] also appears in a Q&A passage about jQuery.

patterns.name: what is in a math problem
patterns.context: Uses “what is” to ask for the result of arithmetic expressions in different bases.

patterns.name: Patent phrasing about information-processing systems
patterns.context: Introduces prior art or systems available for users to choose from in the field of information processing and storage; [4] and [10] have highly overlapping text.

patterns.name: court in legal documents
patterns.context: Formal legal statements concerning court jurisdiction and pending motions.

patterns.name: Health risks for transplant survivors
patterns.context: Describes long-term health risks and quality-of-life-related symptoms in HSCT survivors.

patterns.name: Roscrea railway place name
patterns.context: Describes Roscrea station and its railway line and connection points.

9_757.concept: 多模式，无法归为单一概念
9_757.description: 激活模式不止一种：口语中的“thing is”、数学题的“what is”、专利固定措辞，以及法律、医学和铁路文本中的局部词语或主题；专利两段高度重合，其余多为各自独有。

patterns.name: “thing is”表达
patterns.trigger: «thing»（[1]为“«Ok»« the»« thing»« is»”，[5]为“«The»« thing»« is»”，[8]为“«The»« thing»« is»”）
patterns.context: 口语或问答中以“The thing is”引出解释、转折或观点；[1]也出现于关于 jQuery 的问答片段。

patterns.name: 数学题中的 what is
patterns.context: 以“what is”询问不同进制的算术表达式结果。

patterns.name: 信息处理系统专利措辞
patterns.context: 介绍信息处理与存储领域的现有技术或可供用户选择的系统；[4]、[10]有高度重合的文字。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的 court
patterns.context: 法院管辖权及待审动议的正式法律陈述。

patterns.name: 移植幸存者健康风险
patterns.context: 描述 HSCT 幸存者的长期健康风险及生活质量相关症状。

patterns.name: Roscrea 铁路地名
patterns.context: 介绍 Roscrea 车站及其所在铁路线和连接点。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式地理／铁路条目

en.concept: Local patterns such as topic introductions and document boilerplate
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on the colloquial topic introduction “The thing” and the legal-opinion phrase “Presently before the court”; other scattered contexts include patent information processing, HTML symbols, data formats, geometry, personal sexual experiences, workplaces, and politics, and are difficult to group under one meaning.

patterns.name: “The thing…” topic introduction
patterns.context: Common in expressions such as “The thing is that…”, “The thing I … is…”, and “the thing about…”, which introduce an explanation, uncertainty, or evaluation; no fixed topic is required.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, blog comments, colloquial narratives

patterns.name: Current matter before the court in legal documents
patterns.context: After jurisdiction, parties, and litigation background, introduces the motion currently before the court; the phrase activates across tokens, especially “Presently” and “court”.

patterns.name: Patent background on information processing and storage
patterns.context: Activates when describing the value and growing use of information and ways or systems for processing and storing it; several related words repeat in this passage.
patterns.domain: Related technical background in patent specifications

patterns.name: Closing angle bracket in code examples
patterns.context: Appears near the right angle bracket in the HTML tag “<tr>”; activation occurs only in code snippets and may relate to markup symbols.

patterns.name: CSV/JSON data formats
patterns.context: Format names appear in explanatory text in technical Q&A about data population, loading, and errors; local activation here is weak and shows no clear independent pattern.

patterns.name: Geometric angle-relation terminology
patterns.context: Appears when explaining relationships among parallel lines, perpendicular lines, and angles; surrounding text is a geometry solution or concept explanation.

patterns.name: Narratives about sexual orientation and experience
patterns.context: Appears in first-person discussions of sexual experiences with men and women and statements about one’s sexual orientation; activation is distributed across multiple related words.

patterns.name: Women and workplace evaluations
patterns.context: Appears in contexts discussing interrupting work matters, personal appearance, and women; there is insufficient evidence of a stable connection to other patterns.

patterns.name: FBI and investigative political commentary
patterns.context: Appears in comments about investigative targets, FBI leadership, and dismissal; activation on salient marked words is weak, while stronger “thing” more likely reflects the topic-introduction pattern.

patterns.name: Insurance and rental dispute background
patterns.context: Recounts insurance compensation, a defendant’s failure to maintain rental premises, and a motion for summary judgment; it shares a court-document context with the legal pattern in the same piece, but trigger distribution in this passage is weak.

9_757.concept: 话题引入与文书套语等局部模式
9_757.description: 强激活主要落在口语化讨论中的“The thing”话题引入，以及法律意见书的“Presently before the court”；另有专利信息处理、HTML符号、数据格式、几何、个人性经历、职场与政治等零散语境，难归为同一词义。

patterns.name: “The thing…”话题引入
patterns.context: 常见于 “The thing is that…”、“The thing I … is…”、“the thing about…” 等表达，开启解释、困惑或评价；不要求固定主题。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、博客评论、口语化叙述

patterns.name: 法律文书中的当前待审事项
patterns.context: 置于管辖权、当事方及诉讼背景之后，引出法院当前审理的动议；该短语跨词激活，尤其落在 “Presently” 与 “court”。

patterns.name: 信息处理与存储的专利背景
patterns.context: 在描述信息价值、使用增长，以及处理、存储信息的方式或系统时激活；本段同时有多个相关词重复出现。
patterns.domain: 专利说明书的相关技术背景

patterns.name: 代码示例中的闭合尖括号
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML 标签 “<tr>” 的右尖括号附近；激活仅见于代码片段，可能与标记语言符号有关。

patterns.name: CSV/JSON 数据格式
patterns.context: 在讨论数据填充、加载及报错的技术问答中，格式名称出现在解释性文字里；此处的局部激活较弱，未显出明确独立规律。

patterns.name: 几何角度关系术语
patterns.context: 在说明平行线、垂线及角的关系时出现；周围是几何题解或概念解释。

patterns.name: 性取向与性经历叙述
patterns.context: 在第一人称讨论与男性、女性的性经历并说明自身性取向时出现；激活分布在相关叙述多个词上。
patterns.domain: 个人经历或性话题叙述

patterns.name: 女性与职场评价
patterns.context: 在讨论打断工作事务、个人形象及女性的语境中出现；没有足够证据与其他模式构成稳定联系。

patterns.name: FBI及调查政治评论
patterns.context: 在评论调查目标、FBI领导层与解职时出现；显著标记词激活较弱，较强的 “thing” 更像话题引入模式。

patterns.name: 保险与租赁纠纷背景
patterns.context: 叙述保险赔付、被告疏于维护租赁场所及简易判决动议；与同篇法律模式共享法院文书语境，但本段触发分布较弱。

en.description: Activations are scattered across -ing, nominal suffixes, and plural endings in English words, and also appear in proper-name segmentation, years, called, and code-variable symbols; isolated strong activations such as strong, progresses, and works are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: ING endings
patterns.context: In English words split into subwords, especially -ing forms of verbs; activation falls on the ending rather than a stable semantic category.
patterns.domain: General English, technology, and web text

patterns.name: Noun endings or nominalizing suffixes
patterns.context: In multisyllabic nouns or nominalized expressions, activation is distributed across the latter part or plural ending.

patterns.name: Subwords within proper names
patterns.context: When personal or place names are split into multiple subwords, several internal fragments activate; also seen in game character names.
patterns.domain: Paper bibliographies, encyclopedia entries, game text

patterns.name: Numbers and years
patterns.context: Years appear as standalone numbers in titles or bibliographic information.

patterns.name: Semantic use of called
patterns.context: Used to introduce the name or an alternate name of something.

patterns.name: Code variable placeholders
patterns.context: In code, a dollar sign is followed by a variable name and validation conditions.

patterns.name: unexplained: phrases and other activations
patterns.context: These highly activated words have no obvious common morphological or semantic relation in their respective sentences; other activations also do not fit a stable pattern.

9_836.description: 激活散布于英语词的 -ing、名词后缀和复数词尾，也出现于专名切分、年份、called及代码变量符号；strong、progresses、works等孤立强激活难以统一解释。

patterns.name: ING 词尾
patterns.context: 在拆分为子词的英语词中，尤其是动词的 -ing 形式；激活落在词尾，而非稳定的词义类别。
patterns.domain: 普通英语、科技与网络文本

patterns.name: 名词词尾或名词化后缀
patterns.context: 多音节名词或名词化表达中，激活分布于后半部或复数词尾。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词
patterns.context: 人名、地名被切分成多个子词时，若干内部片段激活；也见于游戏角色名。
patterns.domain: 论文书目、百科条目、游戏文本

patterns.name: 数字及年份
patterns.context: 年份作为独立数字出现在标题或书目信息中。

patterns.name: called 的词义性用法
patterns.context: 用于引出事物的名称或别称。

patterns.name: 代码变量占位符
patterns.context: 代码中的美元符号后接变量名及验证条件。

patterns.name: unexplained：短语及其余激活
patterns.context: 这些高激活词在各自句子中没有显然一致的形态或语义联系；其他激活也未归入稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 放射生物学、疾病检测、商务邮件

en.description: Activations are distributed across common phrases, proper names or titles, scientific terms, numbers, and code variables and operators; sources and contexts vary, with no stable shared local trigger or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Continuation of common words or phrases
patterns.context: Within common phrases or noun phrases, activation falls on semantic content words and adjacent parts; however, the phrases differ markedly across passages.
patterns.domain: Emails, web text, academic and medical text

patterns.name: Proper names, names, and titles
patterns.context: Within proper names, titles, or organization names; activation often concentrates on split subword fragments or words in a name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, bibliographies, emails, and web text

patterns.name: Technical and scientific terms
patterns.context: Specialized terms and term phrases in scientific or medical sentences.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and research project text

patterns.name: Years or number-related content
patterns.context: Numbers embedded in titles, dates, or proper names, with limited evidence of standalone occurrences.

patterns.name: Variables and operators in code templates
patterns.context: In code templates with braces and conditionals, activation involves variable markers and operators.

9_836.description: 激活分布于常见词组、专名或标题、科学术语、数字，以及代码变量和操作词；文本来源和语境多样，未见稳定统一的局部触发词或句法条件。

patterns.name: 常见词或短语的延续
patterns.context: 在句中常见词组或名词短语里，激活落在语义内容词及其相邻部分；但不同段落中的词组差异明显。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页文本、学术及医学文本

patterns.name: 专名、名称与标题
patterns.context: 专名、标题或机构名称内部；激活常集中在被拆分的词片段或名称中的词。
patterns.domain: 百科、书目、邮件及网页文本

patterns.name: 技术及科学术语
patterns.context: 科学或医学句子中的专业术语及术语短语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研项目文本

patterns.name: 年份或数字相关内容
patterns.context: 数字嵌入标题、日期或专名之中，单独出现的证据有限。

patterns.name: 代码模板中的变量及操作词
patterns.context: 代码花括号与条件判断模板中，激活涉及变量标记和操作词。

en.description: Activations span Russian, medical, encyclopedia, and code text, falling on within-word fragments after tokenization, proper names, and code symbols; medical abstracts and code syntax each show local regularities, but no single stable semantic or syntactic function explains all segments.

patterns.name: Within-word segmentation and subword spellings
patterns.context: Activation falls on complete word forms or internal fragments split by the tokenizer, often involving personal names, specialized terms, long words, or uncommon spellings; these do not form a unified semantic category.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, including Russian parliamentary text, medical abstracts, encyclopedias, and film and television text

patterns.name: Numbers and terms in medical abstracts
patterns.context: In medical title or abstract contexts, activation occurs near identifiers, diagnostic or examination descriptions, and biomedical terms; specific trigger locations vary across segments.

patterns.name: Symbols and markers in code
patterns.context: In program text, activation occurs near lists of operators or punctuation, structural symbols in Elixir code, or boundary markers in template syntax; the specific trigger symbols vary by segment.
patterns.domain: GitHub code (including operator lists, Elixir, and templates)

patterns.name: Proper-name or title fragments
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple subword fragments; these occur in a parliamentary sentence about Iceland, biographical entries, and descriptions of actors' roles.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary text, encyclopedia entries, entertainment websites

patterns.name: Repeated contextual fragments
patterns.context: A phrase about Iceland is repeated in the same parliamentary passage, and recurring within-word fragments activate again.

9_836.concept: 跨领域子词与符号片段
9_836.description: 激活跨俄语、医学、百科及代码文本，落在分词后的词内片段、专名和代码符号上；医学摘要与代码语法各自有局部规律，但没有单一稳定语义或句法功能能解释所有段。

patterns.name: 词内分片与子词拼写
patterns.context: 激活落在词语的完整形式或被分词器切开的内部片段上，常涉及人名、专科术语、长词或不常见拼写；本身不构成统一语义类别。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言，含俄语议会文本、医学摘要、百科与影视文本

patterns.name: 医疗摘要中的编号与术语
patterns.context: 医学标题或摘要语境，编号、诊断／检查描述及生物医学术语附近出现激活；不同片段中的具体触发位置并不一致。

patterns.name: 代码中的符号与标记
patterns.context: 程序文本中，运算符／标点清单、Elixir 代码的结构符号，或模板语法的边界标记附近激活；具体触发符号因段而异。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码（含运算符清单、Elixir、模板）

patterns.name: 专名或标题片段
patterns.context: 专名在文本中被拆成多个子词片段；分别出现于关于冰岛的议会句子、人物条目及演员角色描述。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、百科条目、娱乐类网页

patterns.name: 上下文重复片段
patterns.context: 同一议会片段中有关冰岛的短语重复，重复出现的词内片段再次激活。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the character fragment shiv, which occurs across usernames, titles, and code paths; there are also number strings and several unrelated within-word fragments and abbreviations that cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: shiv string
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the contiguous string shiv spanning subword boundaries; it can occur in usernames, title author names, or code paths.
patterns.domain: HackerNews usernames and titles; GitHub HTML/script paths

patterns.name: Number and separator sequences
patterns.context: Non-natural-language strings consisting of numbers, slashes, spaces, and punctuation; activation falls on number fragments.
patterns.domain: Math problems or formatted number text

patterns.name: sensational word-form fragment
patterns.context: Activation covers a within-word fragment of sensational, in a title-like phrase.

patterns.name: maintainable word-form fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a within-word fragment of maintainable; the surrounding text discusses programming languages and their web links.

patterns.name: incentivised word-form fragment
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on a within-word fragment of incentivised in a sentence discussing interest rates, capital, and investment returns.

patterns.name: VPS abbreviation characters
patterns.context: The abbreviation VPS appears twice, with activation on the PS fragment; the text discusses hosting services and user experience.

9_836.concept: shiv 字符串及偶发片段
9_836.description: 最稳定的触发是字符片段 shiv，跨用户名、标题和代码路径出现；另有数字串及若干互不相同的词内片段和缩写，无法由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: shiv 字符串
patterns.context: 激活集中在横跨子词边界的连续字符串 shiv；可出现在用户名、标题作者名或代码路径中。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 用户名与标题；GitHub HTML/脚本路径

patterns.name: 数字与分隔符序列
patterns.context: 数字、斜线、空格和标点组成的非自然语言串；激活落在数字片段上。
patterns.domain: 数学题或格式化数字文本

patterns.name: sensational 词形片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖 sensational 的词内片段，位于标题式短语中。

patterns.name: maintainable 词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 maintainable 的词内片段；周围谈编程语言及其网页链接。

patterns.name: incentivised 词形片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 incentivised 的词内片段，句子讨论利率、资本与投资回报。

patterns.name: VPS 缩写字符
patterns.context: 缩写 VPS 在两处出现，激活落在 PS 片段；讨论托管服务及使用体验。

en.description: Activations are scattered across within-word subword fragments: they mainly cover biomedical terms, and also occur in CMake identifiers, proper names, or link text; a few hits involve code-review terms. No unified semantic trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on within-word subword fragments of specialized nouns or compounds, commonly in biomedical text; the fragments are not tied to any one complete word.

patterns.name: Project configuration and file identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs in CMake configuration files, project names, variables, version numbers, and other code or identifiers; activation often spans within-word fragments after tokenization.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments of proper names or terms
patterns.context: Occurs in proper names, link titles, or hard-to-identify text fragments; local context alone is insufficient to determine a common semantic theme.

patterns.name: Code-review-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in web or discussion text referring to code review or related links; appears only in different contexts in the samples, with no stable broader trigger condition.

9_836.description: 激活分散在词内子词片段：主要覆盖生物医学术语，也见于 CMake 标识符、专名或链接文本；少量命中代码审查词。尚无统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专业术语中的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专业名词或复合词的词内子词片段上，常见于生物医学文本；片段并不固定为某个完整词。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 生物医学文本

patterns.name: 项目配置与文件标识符
patterns.context: 出现在 CMake 配置文件、项目名、变量和版本号等代码或标识符中；激活常跨越分词后的词内片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、构建配置

patterns.name: 专名或术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名、链接标题或不易辨认的文本片段中；仅凭局部上下文难以确定共同语义。

patterns.name: 代码审查相关词
patterns.context: 出现在网页/讨论文本中，指代码审查或相关链接；在样本中只出现于不同语境，未显示稳定的更广泛触发条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to purpose, especially research-purpose phrasing in abstracts, and also to the fixed phrase for the purpose of; there are additional sporadic activations on American Dream, Serine/threonine, and web titles and link fragments.

patterns.name: Purpose phrasing in academic abstracts
patterns.context: Occurs in research abstracts or methods descriptions, often introducing a research objective, subject of investigation, or evaluation purpose; activation concentrates on purpose and adjacent subwords.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts in medicine, education, and other fields

patterns.name: Non-research purpose expressions introduced by purpose
patterns.context: purpose occurs in the fixed phrase “for the purpose of,” followed by an action or goal; it need not be in a contemporary research abstract.

patterns.name: Dream in a proper name or title
patterns.context: Dream forms a proper name or title with American, appearing in an album title and repeated entry titles.

patterns.name: Fragments in the Serine/threonine term
patterns.context: These split subwords together form Serine/threonine, in the context of protein kinase names.

patterns.name: Sporadic terms in web titles or links
patterns.context: Terms occur in HackerNews link titles, paths, or date numbers; no evident local phrasing is shared with other activated fragments.

patterns.name: Word boundaries and fragmented activations
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across subwords of multiple words, with no stable shared triggering context across segments; they may be sporadic or caused by tokenization boundaries.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; not attributable to a single genre

9_836.description: 主要响应 purpose，尤其是研究摘要中的研究目的句式，也响应固定短语 for the purpose of；另有 American Dream、Serine/threonine 及网页标题、链接片段等零散激活。

patterns.name: 学术摘要中的目的句式
patterns.trigger: “The purpose of this study was to”及“The purpose of evaluating”
patterns.context: 出现在研究摘要或方法描述中，常用于引出研究目标、考察对象或评估目的；激活集中在 purpose 及其邻近子词。

patterns.name: purpose 引出的非研究目的表达
patterns.context: purpose 位于固定短语 “for the purpose of” 中，后接行动或目标；不要求是现代研究摘要。

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的 Dream
patterns.context: Dream 与 American 构成专名或标题，出现于专辑标题及重复的条目标题中。
patterns.domain: 百科标题、音乐专辑条目

patterns.name: Serine/threonine 术语中的片段
patterns.context: 这些被拆分的子词共同拼成 Serine/threonine，位于蛋白激酶名称语境。

patterns.name: 网页标题或链接中的零散词项
patterns.trigger: “Who-is-smarter-Elon-Musk-or-Jeff-Bezos”“Rules_for_n”“What Americans Buy”及 URL 数字片段
patterns.context: 词项出现在 HackerNews 链接标题、路径或日期数字中；未见与其他激活段共享的明显局部句式。

patterns.name: 词语边界与片段化激活
patterns.context: 激活分散在多个词的子词上，缺少跨段稳定的共同触发语境；可能是偶发或由分词边界造成。
patterns.domain: 跨领域、无法归为单一文体

en.description: Most strong activations come from Dutch parliamentary text, often falling on within-word fragments, formal forms of address, and set phrases; there are also isolated activations in philosophy bibliographies, code URLs, English encyclopedia text, and Polish text, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Common Dutch endings/within-word fragments in parliamentary text
patterns.context: Dutch EuroParl speeches or formal written text; activations are scattered within words, with no stable complete word or fixed semantic phrase.
patterns.domain: European Parliament debates, resolutions, and formal speeches

patterns.name: Dutch polite forms of address and parliamentary set phrases
patterns.context: Forms of address, polite expressions, and formal statements in parliamentary speeches; co-occurs with within-word fragment activations in segments 1, 2, and 4.

patterns.name: Cross-lingual within-word fragments: accented letters and Romance-language forms
patterns.context: In Dutch philosophical bibliography text or English Wikipedia proper names, activation falls on local word fragments without forming a shared semantic category.
patterns.domain: Philosophy bibliographies, English encyclopedia text, and proper names

patterns.name: Local strings in code and URLs
patterns.context: URL strings in Python/Selenium code; activation does not extend to the surrounding code.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments related to forest protection in Polish
patterns.context: Polish sentences discuss European forest protection and related information; highlights fall on within-word character fragments, with no clear connection to the Dutch word-form pattern.

patterns.name: English encyclopedia list markers
patterns.context: English encyclopedia entries introducing Miró's works and Barcelona museums, containing cross-references and lists; activation occurs on sporadic terms.

patterns.name: Possible general within-word fragment activations
patterns.context: Occurs in formal parliamentary text, but trigger locations and word forms vary across segments, so a distinct semantic pattern cannot be established.

9_836.description: 多数强激活来自荷兰语议会文本，常落在词内碎片及正式称呼、套语；另有哲学书目、代码网址、英语百科和波兰语文本中的孤立激活，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会文本中的常见词尾/词内片段
patterns.trigger: 反复出现在词内的「onder」「end」「en」「ing」「lijk」「heid」等碎片，例如「onder」「tek«end»」「onder«ling»e」「uitz«onder»li«jk»」；另有「↵」等标记
patterns.context: 荷兰语 EuroParl 发言或正式书面文本；激活分散在单词内部，未见一个稳定的完整词或固定语义短语
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会辩论、决议及正式发言

patterns.name: 荷兰语礼貌称呼与议事套语
patterns.trigger: 「mijnheer」「de Voorzitter」「ik wil zeggen」「Wij zullen hem ... welkom heten」「Mijnheer Solana」
patterns.context: 议会发言中的称呼、礼貌表达和正式陈述；与段1、2、4中的词内片段激活并存

patterns.name: 跨语言词内片段：重音字母及罗曼语词形
patterns.context: 在荷兰语哲学书目文字或英语维基百科专名中，激活落在词的局部片段，未形成共同语义
patterns.domain: 哲学书目、英语百科及专名

patterns.name: 代码与网址中的局部字符串
patterns.context: Python/Selenium 代码里的 URL 字符串；该激活不延伸到周围代码

patterns.name: 波兰语森林保护相关词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子讨论欧洲森林保护及相关信息；高亮落在词内字符片段，未与荷兰语词形模式建立明确联系

patterns.name: 英语百科列表标记
patterns.context: 介绍米罗作品与巴塞罗那博物馆的英语百科条目，包含交叉引用和列表；激活位于零散词项

patterns.name: 可能的泛词内片段激活
patterns.context: 正式议会文本中出现，但各段触发位置和词形不一致，不能据此确认独立语义模式

en.description: Activations often fall on Dutch en endings or conjunctions and English the; there are also within-word fragments in patent technology text, the term Sommerfeld, and date words. They co-occur across corpora, but it is difficult to determine whether this reflects word forms, subword fragments, or genre effects.

patterns.name: Dutch word ending “en”
patterns.context: Occurs in Dutch words or at word-form boundaries; the strongest examples include “hadden,” “en,” and “gendergelijkheid.”
patterns.domain: EuroParl Dutch parliamentary speeches; also found in Dutch PhilPapers text

patterns.name: Dutch within-word “der”/“dag” fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in words or date expressions, such as “donderdag”; no clear independent semantic condition.

patterns.name: “the” and technical within-word fragments in patent English
patterns.context: In technical explanations in patent background passages, the article the or words containing similar letter fragments activate.

patterns.name: “Sommerfeld” fragment in an English academic term
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper term Sommerfeld integral in the body of a paper; there is no evidence yet that activation is triggered by the term's meaning rather than its word fragments.

patterns.name: English discourse word “the”
patterns.context: The article the occurs in a technical narrative sentence in general English expository text.

patterns.name: Mixed miscellaneous subword fragments in text
patterns.context: Many strong activations fall on common Dutch endings or the English article, but activation boundaries do not always align with complete words; the fragments alone do not reveal a unified trigger condition.

9_836.description: 激活常落在荷兰语的 en 词尾或连接词，以及英语 the；另有专利技术文本、Sommerfeld 术语和日期词内片段。跨语料共现，但难判定是词形、子词片段还是文体效应。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾「en」
patterns.context: 出现在荷兰语词或词形边界处；最强例子是「hadden」「en」及「gendergelijkheid」等。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 荷兰语议会发言；也见于 PhilPapers 荷兰语文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内「der」/「dag」片段
patterns.context: 嵌在词或日期表达中，如「donderdag」；没有明显独立语义条件。

patterns.name: 专利英语「the」及技术词内片段
patterns.context: 专利背景段落的技术说明中，冠词 the 或含相近字母片段的词被激活。

patterns.name: 英语学术术语内「Sommerfeld」片段
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文的专有术语 Sommerfeld integral 中；暂无证据表明激活由术语意义而非字词片段触发。

patterns.name: 英语论述词「the」
patterns.context: 一般英语说明文中，冠词 the 位于技术叙述句内。

patterns.name: 文中混合的杂项子词片段
patterns.context: 多处强激活落在荷兰语常见词尾或英语冠词上，但激活边界并不总能对应完整词；单靠片段无法确定统一触发条件。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across word fragments in Dutch parliamentary and philosophical texts, and local fragments such as Rear, Rhen, Brief, Wonder, and List in English; only mensen recurs in two Dutch passages, and overall there is no unified semantic or genre condition.

patterns.name: Dutch personal noun “mensen”
patterns.context: Means “people” in continuous Dutch text; the word occurs once in ordinary narration and once in a parliamentary speech.
patterns.domain: Dutch philosophical text, European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Forms of address or polite expressions in Dutch parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Dutch European Parliament speeches or records; includes addressing the president or speaking to an audience in the gallery.

patterns.name: Dutch within-word fragments and endings
patterns.context: Dutch words are split into multiple tokens; high activations fall on several within-word fragments, with no stable, consistent semantic or morphological condition.

patterns.name: Fragment “Rear” in an English proper name
patterns.context: In English historical narration, the fragment occurs in the naval rank “Rear Admiral.”

patterns.name: Fragment “Rhen” in a place or personal name
patterns.context: In parenthetical birth and death information in an English biography, the triggering fragment occurs in the place name “Rhenen.”

patterns.name: “Brief” in an English entry heading
patterns.context: In the patent text section heading “Brief Description of the Prior Art.”

patterns.name: English initial fragment “Wonder”
patterns.context: Occurs once in the adjective “Wonderful” and once in the sentence-initial question word “Wonder”; the contexts differ in topic and genre.

patterns.name: List navigation word “List”
patterns.context: At the “See also” list navigation at the end of a Wikipedia entry.

9_836.description: 强激活分散在荷兰语议会与哲学文本的词片段，以及英语中 Rear、Rhen、Brief、Wonder、List 等局部片段；只有 mensen 在两段荷兰语文本中重现，整体缺少统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 荷兰语人称词“mensen”
patterns.context: 荷兰语连续文本中指“人/人们”；一次处于普通叙述，一次处于议会发言，均出现该词。
patterns.domain: 荷兰语哲学文本、欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会发言中的称呼或礼貌表达
patterns.context: 荷兰语欧洲议会演讲或记录；包含对主席的称呼，或面向旁听席的人群。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内片段及词尾
patterns.context: 荷兰语词被拆分成多个 token；高激活落在若干词内片段，但没有稳定一致的词义或词形条件。

patterns.name: 英文专名中的片段“Rear”
patterns.context: 英语历史叙述中，片段位于海军军衔“Rear Admiral”内。

patterns.name: 地名或人名中的片段“Rhen”
patterns.context: 英语人物传记的括号生卒信息中，触发片段出现在地名“Rhenen”内。

patterns.name: 英文条目标题中的“Brief”
patterns.context: 专利文本的章节标题“Brief Description of the Prior Art”中。

patterns.name: 英文词首片段“Wonder”
patterns.context: 一次位于形容词“Wonderful”中，一次位于句首疑问词“Wonder”；上下文主题与文体不同。

patterns.name: 列表或章节导航词“List”
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾的“See also”列表导航处。

en.concept: Multilingual parliamentary records and speech formats
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in forms of address, speaker turns, and formatting markers in multilingual European Parliament records; they also cover Portuguese word-form fragments, Dutch personal nouns and policy terms, and a passage of Portuguese bibliographic text, with no single word meaning explaining all activations.

patterns.name: Parliamentary forms of address and chair speech format
patterns.context: Addresses to the chair, members, or commissioners in parliamentary speeches; common in speaker labels after a line break, followed by a comma and continued speech.
patterns.domain: European Parliament transcripts, Portuguese or English

patterns.name: Parliamentary speaker names and role markers
patterns.context: At speaker-turn changes, names and delegation/language markers occur alongside line breaks and forms of address to the chair.

patterns.name: Procedural cues and applause markers
patterns.context: Parliamentary records use line breaks and parentheses to mark applause, speaker changes, or meeting procedures.

patterns.name: Personal nouns in formal Dutch parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: In Dutch passages, these occur near direct speech or forms of address to the audience; their fragments activate strongly.
patterns.domain: European Parliament speeches and policy discussions

patterns.name: Formal Dutch policy and trade discussion
patterns.context: Dutch statements concerning EU regulations, trade measures, or industrial policy; no single consistent trigger word.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments and word boundaries in Portuguese text
patterns.context: Split subword fragments within Portuguese words activate in parliamentary speeches or bibliographic descriptions.
patterns.domain: Portuguese parliamentary records and written narratives

patterns.name: Portuguese formal speech opening
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary speeches address the chair as “Senhor Presidente,” often immediately after a line break and speaker-turn change.

patterns.name: Dutch “mensen”
patterns.context: When the word occurs in general social or policy discussion, its word fragments activate strongly; this differs from the parliamentary form-of-address format.
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers and European Parliament records

patterns.name: Portuguese work titles and author descriptions in bibliographies
patterns.context: Bibliographic or review text describing an author, works, and experiences in Portugal.

9_836.concept: 多语议会记录与发言格式
9_836.description: 激活主要集中于欧洲议会多语记录的称谓、发言轮次与格式标记；另覆盖葡语词形片段、荷兰语人称词及政策词，以及一段葡语书目文字，未见单一词义可解释全部。

patterns.name: 议会称谓与主席发言格式
patterns.context: 议会发言中称呼主席、议员或委员；常见于换行后的发言人标记，后接逗号并继续讲话
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会逐字记录，葡萄牙语或英语

patterns.name: 议会发言人姓名及职务标记
patterns.context: 发言轮次切换处，姓名、代表团/语言标记与换行、主席称呼相邻

patterns.name: 议事程序提示与掌声标记
patterns.context: 议会记录中以换行和括号标出掌声、发言切换或会议程序

patterns.name: 荷兰语正式议会讲话中的人称词
patterns.context: 荷兰语段落中出现在直接讲话或对听众的称呼附近；这些词的片段有较强激活
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会演讲及政策讨论

patterns.name: 荷兰语正式政策与贸易论述
patterns.context: 涉及欧盟法规、贸易措施或产业政策的荷兰语陈述；缺少一致的单一触发词

patterns.name: 葡语文本中的词形片段及词界
patterns.context: 葡语词内部被切分的子词片段激活，出现在议会发言或书目介绍中
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会记录与书面叙述

patterns.name: 葡语敬语发言起始格式
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言以“Senhor Presidente”称呼主席，常紧随换行及发言轮次转换

patterns.name: 荷兰语«mensen»
patterns.context: 该词在一般社会或政策论述中出现时，单词片段强激活；与议会称呼格式并不相同
patterns.domain: 哲学论文与欧洲议会记录

patterns.name: 书目中的葡萄牙语作品名与作者介绍
patterns.context: 叙述作者、作品及葡萄牙经历的书目/评论文字

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the Portuguese infinitive dizer; other activations are scattered across Dutch policy subword fragments, English fore-, wonder, gender-equality titles, and sporadic English subword fragments, spanning languages and varied contexts.

patterns.name: Portuguese “dizer”
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speeches, the infinitive meaning “to say”; the word occurs in all three passages, and this subword fragment is the strongest trigger.

patterns.name: Dutch policy and administrative subword fragments
patterns.context: Appears in Dutch parliamentary texts about the European coastal economy, policy implementation, or trade protection; activation falls on compound words or subword fragments. Also includes eigen, meaning “own.”

patterns.name: English fore- subword fragments
patterns.context: English words beginning with fore- appear in a ship's equipment list and prose about a flag; the two instances differ in meaning and style.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg, nautical terminology list and literary prose

patterns.name: English wonder / wondering fragments
patterns.context: In the Hacker News sentence “Wonder if this can be used…”, activation falls on the latter part of wonder; the context discusses video generation.

patterns.name: Dutch gender-equality title
patterns.context: Appears in the title of a European Commission report and other formal title information, such as the rapporteur's name.

patterns.name: Sporadic English subword fragments
patterns.context: Two fragments occur in an attribution and at the beginning of a Hacker News comment; no shared meaning or stable contextual condition is apparent.

9_836.description: 主要强烈响应葡语不定式 dizer；其余激活分散在荷兰语政策词片段、英文 fore-、wonder、性别平等标题及零散英文词片段，跨语种且语境不一。

patterns.name: 葡语“dizer”
patterns.context: 在葡萄牙语议会发言中，表示“说/要说”的不定式；三段都出现该词，且该词片段是最高强度触发点。

patterns.name: 荷兰语政策与行政词片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于欧洲沿海经济、政策执行或贸易保护的荷兰语议会文本中；激活落在复合词/词片段上，另有“自身、本国的”eigen。

patterns.name: 英文 fore 词片段
patterns.context: 英文中 fore- 开头的词，分别出现在船具清单和关于旗帜的散文中；两处语义与文体不同。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg，航海术语清单及文学散文

patterns.name: 英文 wonder / wondering 片段
patterns.context: Hacker News 句子“Wonder if this can be used…”中，激活落在 wonder 的后半部分；上下文讨论视频生成。

patterns.name: 荷兰语性别平等标题
patterns.context: 出现在欧盟委员会报告标题及报告员署名等正式标题信息中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，荷兰语文件标题/元数据

patterns.name: 零散英文词片段
patterns.context: 两个片段分别位于 Hacker News 评论的署名和句首；看不出共同语义或稳定上下文条件。

en.description: Activations stand out mainly on parts of individual words and fixed expressions across several languages: Dutch policy words and constructions, Portuguese parliamentary phrasing, and a few isolated words in philosophical and poetic prose. There is no clear shared word meaning.

patterns.name: ten slotte / als gevolg
patterns.context: Dutch “ten + …” constructions; in both cases, a fixed multisyllabic expression follows. In [1], “tenuitvoerlegging” occurs at the end of a passage about policy; in [4], “ten zeerste” appears in a formal address.

patterns.name: werkgelegenheid
patterns.context: Activation falls specifically on the beginning of “werkgelegenheid,” in a list of EU economic and social goals.

patterns.name: remontam
patterns.context: Portuguese verb form in a sentence about unresolved issues dating back to earlier years; the strongest activation lies within the word.

patterns.name: Senhora
patterns.context: Portuguese formal address “Senhora Presidente,” following a name and a change of speaker.

patterns.name: Speech and quotation
patterns.context: In [6], a Portuguese introduction to direct speech ends with a colon; in [8], the English “Guess” appears in a dramatic quoted exclamation. The similarity is limited to a transition into or within direct speech.

patterns.name: onvermijdelijk
patterns.context: Dutch adjective in a causal sentence about a conflict that cannot be avoided.

patterns.name: toegevoegde waarde
patterns.context: Dutch policy term in a passage about cost-benefit analysis and evaluation of a new agency.

patterns.name: mensen
patterns.context: Dutch word for people; used in a parliamentary reference to citizens in the gallery.

9_836.description: Activaties vallen vooral op delen van afzonderlijke woorden en vaste uitdrukkingen in meer talen: Nederlandse beleidswoorden en constructies, Portugese parlementaire formuleringen en enkele losse woorden in filosofisch en poëtisch proza. Er is geen duidelijke gedeelde woordbetekenis.

patterns.name: ten slotte / als gevolg
patterns.context: Nederlands “ten + …”-constructies; in beide gevallen volgt een vaste, meerlettergrepige uitdrukking. In [1] staat “tenuitvoerlegging” aan het eind van een passage over beleid; in [4] “ten zeerste” in een formele aanspreking.

patterns.name: werkgelegenheid
patterns.context: Activatie valt specifiek op het begin van “werkgelegenheid”, in een opsomming van economische en sociale EU-doelen.

patterns.name: remontam
patterns.context: Portugese werkwoordsvorm in een zin over openstaande kwesties die teruggaan tot eerdere jaren; de sterkste activatie ligt binnen het woord.

patterns.name: Senhora
patterns.context: Portugese formele aanspreking “Senhora Presidente”, na een naam en een spreekbeurtwisseling.

patterns.name: spreken en citaat
patterns.context: In [6] staat een Portugese introductie van directe rede met dubbele punt; in [8] staat het Engelse “Guess” in een dramatische geciteerde uitroep. De overeenkomst is beperkt tot een overgang naar of binnen directe rede.

patterns.name: onvermijdelijk
patterns.context: Nederlands adjectief in een causale zin over een conflict dat niet te vermijden is.

patterns.name: toegevoegde waarde
patterns.context: Nederlands beleidsbegrip in een passage over kosten-batenanalyse en evaluatie van een nieuw agentschap.

patterns.name: mensen
patterns.context: Nederlands woord voor personen; gebruikt in een parlementaire verwijzing naar burgers op de tribune.

en.description: Activations are scattered across Portuguese word forms (especially regist-/registro, dever, and parliamentary vocabulary), the patent phrase on the other hand, minus signs in mathematical answers, and several unrelated within-word fragments; the samples do not establish a single semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: register / registro word family
patterns.context: Portuguese word forms meaning “record, registration,” or English patent-context words related to registering; no fixed syntactic position is required
patterns.domain: Philosophy papers, Portuguese vocabulary discussions, patent texts

patterns.name: Portuguese conditional dever
patterns.context: Inflected forms of Portuguese dever; occur respectively in “Deveríamos resolver” and “Deveria estar”
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, StackExchange math discussions

patterns.name: other hand in patent citations
patterns.context: Patent background text uses on the other hand to introduce another technology or alternative for comparison

patterns.name: Portuguese past participles/first-person plural forms
patterns.context: Within-word fragments in Portuguese parliamentary passages; include varied words such as última, desta, sessão, legislatura, and recordar, with no common syntactic trigger apparent

patterns.name: Proper-name or loanword-like fragments in Portuguese spelling
patterns.context: Place names, within-word fragments, or loanword-like spellings in Portuguese texts; some overlap with the register word family above

patterns.name: Minus signs in mathematical answers
patterns.context: At the beginning of an answer after a formula in math Q&A, the minus sign activates more strongly than most tokens in the same passage

patterns.name: Local triggers with no consistent pattern
patterns.context: Scattered letter or number fragments in patent passages, with no stable lexical or semantic condition apparent

patterns.name: Within-word fragments with no consistent pattern
patterns.context: Different within-word fragments appear across philosophy, patent, parliamentary, math, and forum texts; no shared trigger condition can be established

9_836.description: 激活分散于葡语词形（尤其 regist-/registro、dever 及议会用词）、专利句式 on the other hand、数学答案负号，以及若干互不相同的词内片段；无法从样本确认单一语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: register / registro 词族
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中表示“记录、登记”的词形，或英语专利语境中登记/注册相关词；不要求固定句法位置
patterns.domain: 哲学论文、葡萄牙语词汇讨论、专利文本

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语条件式 dever
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语 dever 的变位词形；分别出现在「Deveríamos resolver」与「Deveria estar」中
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、StackExchange 数学讨论

patterns.name: 专利引文中的 other hand
patterns.trigger: 「on»4« the»5« other»10 hand」及「on»4« the»5« other»9 hand」
patterns.context: 专利背景文本以 on the other hand 引入另一项技术或对照方案

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语过去分词/第一人称复数词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会语段中的词内片段；包括 última、desta、sessão、legislatura、recordar 等多种词，未见统一句法触发条件

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语书写的专名或借词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语文本中的地名、词内片段或借词式书写；部分与上面的 register 词族重叠
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、葡萄牙语词汇讨论

patterns.name: 数学答案中的负号
patterns.context: 数学问答里公式之后的答案开头，负号激活强于同段多数 token

patterns.name: 无法归入一致模式的局部触发
patterns.context: 专利段落中的零散字母或数字片段，未显示稳定词汇或语义条件

patterns.name: 无法归入一致模式的词内片段
patterns.trigger: 「« influ»」「« present»」「« not»」「« specify»」「« depressed»」「« ent»」「« he»」「« ú»」
patterns.context: 跨哲学、专利、议会、数学和论坛文本出现的不同词内片段；没有可证实的共同触发条件

en.description: Activations occur across multilingual parliamentary transcripts, with more prominent activations on forms of address to the chair, line breaks, and Dutch word fragments. Isolated examples also occur in an English conversation about mental illness, a German recess time, and a Portuguese expression of judgment; no unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Dutch “mensen” and its endings
patterns.context: A Dutch noun meaning people or related forms occur in a passage; activation falls on a subword within the word and is often near a sentence or clause boundary.
patterns.domain: EuroParl political speeches and PhilPapers discussion

patterns.name: Parliamentary address “Senhor Presidente”
patterns.context: Formal address to the chair or a member in parliamentary speeches, usually at the start of a speech after a line break or in a salutation.

patterns.name: Dutch endings -ingen / -ing
patterns.context: Nominal endings or within-word segments in Dutch forms; sometimes occur near sentence endings, but not all examples are strong.

patterns.name: Speech/meeting markers in multilingual parliamentary records
patterns.context: Near line breaks, applause markers, or language labels, especially at speaker changes in parliamentary speeches; activation may also fall on adjacent forms of address.

patterns.name: English conversation about mental illness
patterns.context: Fictional dialogue mentions “mental disease” and “insanity”; activation concentrates on an emphatic response.

patterns.name: German meeting recess time
patterns.context: A number in a time expression is activated when meeting minutes announce a recess.

patterns.name: Portuguese emphatic judgment
patterns.context: In an explicit judgment expression at the beginning of a sentence, such as “É evidente,” activation falls within the adjective.

patterns.name: Sporadic within-word fragments, unclear pattern
patterns.context: Scattered subword activations across passages, with no consistent cross-example clues in meaning or context; they should not be grouped into a clear pattern.

9_836.description: 激活分布于多语种议会转录，较显著地落在称呼主席、换行及荷兰语词形片段；另有英语精神疾病对话、德语休会时间和葡语判断表达等孤例，未见统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 荷兰语“mensen”及其词尾
patterns.context: 荷兰语段落中出现表示人的名词或相关词形；激活落在词内子词，且常邻近句子或分句边界。

patterns.name: 议会称谓“Senhor Presidente”
patterns.context: 议会发言中对主席或议员的正式称呼，通常在换行后的发言开头或称呼语中。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词尾 -ingen / -ing
patterns.context: 荷兰语词形中的名词词尾或词内分段；有时出现在句末附近，但并非所有例子都强。

patterns.name: 跨语言议会记录的发言／会议标记
patterns.context: 换行、掌声标记或语言标签附近，尤其是议会发言人切换处；激活也可落在相邻称呼词。

patterns.name: 英语精神疾病对话
patterns.context: 小说对话谈及“mental disease”及“insanity”，激活集中在带感叹意味的回应。

patterns.name: 德语会议休会时间
patterns.context: 会议记录宣布休会时，时间表达中的数字被激活。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语强调判断
patterns.context: 句首“É evidente”一类明确判断表达中，激活落在形容词内部。

patterns.name: 零散词内片段，模式不明
patterns.trigger: 如“coleg”“Bushill-Matthews”中的片段、“produção/ produtos”相关片段、“desvio”中的片段
patterns.context: 各段零星子词激活，缺少跨例一致的词义或语境线索；不宜并入明确模式。

en.concept: Multilingual local word fragments and phrasing
en.description: The main pattern is local word-fragment activation in Portuguese parliamentary text, especially around evident, opinion statements, verbs, and parliamentary phrasing; other heterogeneous patterns involve Dutch opinion and victim-related terms, mathematical symbols, lexical explanations, and German constitutional phrasing. The third passage is unexplained.

patterns.name: Portuguese “evidente” and related continuations
patterns.context: In Portuguese parliamentary speeches, when expressing a position, making a transition, or evaluating a view; the strongest response falls on the ending of “evidente,” and also occurs after a similar “certo” and on “dizer”

patterns.name: Portuguese infinitive ending -ar
patterns.context: In Portuguese verbs or infinitive forms, activation sometimes falls on the -ar ending and also occurs within “recordar”; the trigger position is not fully consistent

patterns.name: Words and word boundaries in Portuguese parliamentary formulas
patterns.context: Function words, verbs, and following elements in long Portuguese sentences may activate; no single fixed syntactic position is apparent
patterns.domain: EuroParl speeches and StackExchange explanatory text

patterns.name: Dutch expressions of opinion
patterns.context: After reporting a victimization rate, the text shifts to the speaker's view; strong responses concentrate on “mening” (opinion) and nearby words

patterns.name: Dutch victim-related words
patterns.context: Topics involving violence and its victims; activation occurs within compound words or nouns

patterns.name: Portuguese “open” and constructive phrasing
patterns.context: When emphasizing keeping dialogue open and constructive, activation concentrates on the word for open and its repeated use

patterns.name: Symbols and numbers in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In derivative calculations or algebraic expressions, line breaks, minus signs, coefficient numbers, and adjacent variables show high activation

patterns.name: Discussion of informal usage in a Portuguese quotation
patterns.context: Explains that a word was once fashionable in informal circles and discusses its subsequent use and inclusion in dictionaries

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary salutations and forms of address
patterns.context: When greeting or addressing the chair or a member in a parliamentary speech

patterns.name: German constitutional-process phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses restarting the constitutional process and expresses the view that achieving a goal would be easier

patterns.name: Local word fragments in general Portuguese vocabulary
patterns.context: These activations are distributed across different word classes and syntactic positions, with insufficient evidence for a unified morphological or semantic trigger

9_836.concept: 多语种局部词片与措辞
9_836.description: 主线是葡语议会语料中的局部词片激活，尤其明显、意见表达、动词及议会措辞；另有荷兰语意见与受害者用词、数学符号、词汇说明和德语宪法表述等异质模式。第3段无法解释。

patterns.name: 葡语“evidente”及其延续
patterns.trigger: « evident»8«e»10« que»5« perman»2ece»2mos»1；« evident»9«e»10«,»6« sen»8hora»6；« é»3« cert»6o»5« -,»3 a tít…« dizer»9
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言中，围绕表态、转折或对某观点作评价时；最强响应落在“evidente”词尾，亦见于相近的“certo”之后及“dizer”
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡语口语化议会辩论

patterns.name: 葡语不定式 -ar 词尾
patterns.trigger: « dist»2«anc»2«iar»5；« particip»3«ar»2；« record»7«ar»9；« pens»7«o»7« até»9（相邻但不构成同一词尾）
patterns.context: 葡语动词或不定式词形中，激活有时落在 -ar 结尾，也出现在词内“recordar”；触发位置并不完全一致
patterns.domain: EuroParl 与 StackExchange 葡语文本

patterns.name: 葡语议会套语中的词与词边界
patterns.trigger: « por»8« uma»2；« com»5；« gost»5«aria»7；« record»7«ar»9；« dizer»9« que»4
patterns.context: 葡语长句中的功能词、动词及其后续成分均可能激活；未见单一固定句法位置
patterns.domain: EuroParl 演讲及 StackExchange 说明文字

patterns.name: 荷兰语意见表述
patterns.trigger: « Ik»3« ben»4« d»2«us»6« van»5« mening»9« dat»6
patterns.context: 在统计受害比例后转入发言者观点，强响应集中于“mening”（意见）及附近词

patterns.name: 荷兰语受害者相关词
patterns.context: 涉及暴力及其受害者的议题；复合词或名词内部均有激活
patterns.domain: EuroParl 荷兰语社会议题发言

patterns.name: 葡语“开放”及建设性表述
patterns.context: 强调保持对话开放、建设性时；激活集中在开放一词及其重复表达

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的符号与数字
patterns.context: 导数计算或代数式中，换行、减号、系数数字和变量相邻位置出现高激活

patterns.name: 葡语引语中的非正式用语讨论
patterns.context: 解释某词曾是非正式圈子里的时尚说法，并讨论其后续使用和词典收录

patterns.name: 葡语议会致辞及称谓
patterns.context: 议会发言中向主席或议员致意、称呼对方时

patterns.name: 德语宪法进程表述
patterns.trigger: « den»5« Mitt»3elpunkt stellen…« den»3« Ver»2fassungsprozess wieder anzustoßen
patterns.context: 讨论重新启动宪法进程，并表达对更易实现某目标的判断

patterns.name: 葡语一般词汇中局部词片
patterns.context: 这些激活分布在不同词类和句法位置，没有足够证据归为统一的词形或语义触发条件

en.concept: Portuguese word forms and number-format fragments
en.description: Activations occur mainly on regist- word forms, parliamentary forms of address, and expressions such as tenho in Portuguese data; another group appears on numbers and decimal points in unit-conversion problems. Several other Portuguese word-form fragments are scattered and lack a unified condition.

patterns.name: Portuguese record/registration word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in Portuguese sentences, where the stem regist- takes different inflectional endings; surrounding contexts involve an author's experience, listening and recording, or project performance.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic introductions, European Parliament speeches and reports

patterns.name: Polite forms of address in European Parliament speeches
patterns.context: Addressing the chair or a female member in European Parliament speeches or proceedings; several subword fragments in these forms of address activate.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person singular tenho
patterns.context: Portuguese first-person singular present tense, used respectively to mean “I have a small correction” and “I have nothing to add.”
