patterns.name: Portuguese expressions for naturally/of course and related discourse words
patterns.context: Discourse transitions or stance expressions in parliamentary speeches; the triggering words differ but are used to organize a statement or emphasize a judgment.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal points in unit-conversion problems
patterns.context: Math problems ask for conversions between units of length, mass, volume, or time; values and decimal points are tokenized separately, with activation concentrated on number tokens and weaker activation on the prompt text.

patterns.name: Evaluative word forms in Portuguese political reports
patterns.context: Word-form fragments activate when discussing project improvement or restrictions on parliamentary activity; no clear shared lexical item links them to the other high-activation patterns.
patterns.domain: European Parliament reports and policy speeches

patterns.name: Sporadic Portuguese endings/syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Distributed across different syntactic positions and words; difficult to group into a stable semantic or grammatical trigger condition.

9_836.concept: 葡语词形与数字格式片段
9_836.description: 激活主要见于葡语语料中的 regist- 词形、议会称谓及 tenho 等发言用语；另一组出现在单位换算题的数字和小数点。另有若干分散的葡语词形片段，缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: 葡语中记录/登记词形
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语句子中，词干 regist- 接后缀形成不同变位；周边语境分别涉及作者经历、听取并记录、项目表现。
patterns.domain: 书目介绍、欧洲议会发言与报告

patterns.name: 欧洲议会发言中的礼貌称呼
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言或议事记录中，称呼主席或女议员；这些称谓的若干分词片段有激活。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称单数 tenho
patterns.context: 葡语第一人称单数现在时，分别用于表示“我有一个小修正”和“我没什么可补充”。

patterns.name: 葡语自然/当然及相近话语词
patterns.context: 议会发言中的论述衔接或立场表达；触发词并不相同，均用于组织陈述或强调判断。

patterns.name: 单位换算题中的数字与小数点
patterns.context: 数学题要求在长度、质量、体积或时间单位间换算；数值和小数点分段呈现，激活集中于数字 token，而题干文字激活较弱。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 单位换算练习

patterns.name: 葡语政治报告中的评价词形
patterns.context: 谈及项目改善或议会活动受到限制时，词形片段出现激活；与其他高激活模式没有明确共同词项。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会报告与政策发言

patterns.name: 零散葡语词尾/句法片段
patterns.context: 分布在不同句法位置和不同词汇中，难以归并为稳定的词义或语法触发条件。

en.description: Occur mainly in Dutch parliamentary text, distributed across degree adverbs, predicates, time expressions, prepositions, and within-word fragments; also include German and Portuguese word fragments, Morning in a book-review quotation, and numbers and units in math Q&A. Trigger conditions are not unified.

patterns.name: Emphatic expressions in Dutch parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Near degree or relational adverbs in formal Dutch sentences, such as “very certain,” “very precise,” “in front of…,” and “among/between”; not necessarily the same fixed phrase.

patterns.name: Dutch verbs and expression fragments
patterns.context: Common predicates or time expressions in Dutch parliamentary sentences; activation falls on within-word fragments or adjacent words, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Dutch fragments and function words
patterns.context: High-frequency prepositions and articles occur in continuous Dutch text, as do fragments inside compounds marked as split tokens; the instances are not all the same word or meaning.
patterns.domain: European Parliament and Dutch philosophical texts

patterns.name: Multilingual endings or within-word fragments
patterns.context: In non-Dutch texts, activation falls on endings, stems, or within-word fragments, with no consistent language or semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: Word in a publication title and quotation
patterns.context: Appears in the book-review quotation attribution “--_Morning Post._”; there is insufficient evidence to link it to other patterns.

patterns.name: Numbers and unit fragments in math problems
patterns.context: Number strings, units, and decimal digits are marked in conversion or quantity questions; activations include not only numbers but also text fragments.

9_836.description: 主要见于荷兰语议会文本，激活分布在程度副词、谓语、时间表达、介词及词内片段；另见德语和葡语词片段、书评引文中的Morning、数学问答的数字与单位，触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: 荷兰语议会发言中的强调表达
patterns.context: 在荷兰语正式句子中，程度或关系副词附近，如“非常确定”“非常精确”“在……面前”“其中/相互”等；未必是同一个固定短语。

patterns.name: 荷兰语动词与表达片段
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会语句中的常见谓语或时间表达，激活落在词内片段或相邻词上，缺少统一的词义条件。

patterns.name: 荷兰语中词片段及虚词
patterns.context: 荷兰语连续文本中出现高频介词、冠词，以及被拆分标记的复合词内部片段；并非每处同一词或同一语义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会及荷兰语哲学文本

patterns.name: 多语种词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 非荷兰语文本中，激活落在词尾、词干或词内片段，未显示一致的语言或词义条件。
patterns.domain: 德语哲学、葡萄牙语议会文本

patterns.name: 出版物标题和引文中的词
patterns.context: 出现在书评引文署名“--_Morning Post._”中；没有足够证据说明它与其他模式相关。
patterns.domain: 19世纪书籍前言或出版物文本

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与单位片段
patterns.context: 换算或数量问答中，数字串、单位及小数数字被标记；激活对象不止数字，也包括文本词片段。

en.description: Activations concentrate on Portuguese tenho in several speech contexts, alongside scattered word forms: Dutch onder and gest-, end within German endlich, English wonder, and Portuguese vez. They span languages and parts of speech, with no unified visible semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person “tenho”
patterns.context: Tenho occurs in first-person statements; in [1] and [3] it is followed by a complement or discourse content, and in [5], [6], and [9] it appears in parliamentary speech or Q&A contexts.
patterns.domain: Portuguese forum text and European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Dutch “onder”
patterns.context: Functions as a preposition or adverb in Dutch parliamentary procedural language, occurring in “onderbroken” and “onder leiding,” respectively.

patterns.name: Dutch “gest-” word form
patterns.context: Means being supported in a Dutch sentence and occurs between “word … door de lidstaten.”

patterns.name: Within-word “end” in German
patterns.context: Occurs within an adverbial form meaning “finally” in philosophical discussion.

patterns.name: English “wonder”
patterns.context: Describes something as worthy of wonder in a dramatic line, occurring in poetic dialogue.

patterns.name: Portuguese “vez”
patterns.context: Part of an expression of frequency in the construction “é a segunda vez que…” (“this is the second time that…”).

9_836.description: 激活集中于葡语 tenho（多种发言语境），另有零散词形：荷兰语 onder、gest-，德语 endlich 内的 end、英语 wonder，以及葡语 vez；跨语言、跨词类，缺少统一可见语义模式。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称“tenho”
patterns.trigger: «Ten»…«ho»，即葡语动词 tenho（“我有/我已经……”）
patterns.context: 第一人称陈述中出现 tenho；在[1]和[3]后接补语或话语内容，在[5]、[6]、[9]出现在议会发言或问答语境。
patterns.domain: 葡语论坛文本及欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 荷兰语“onder”
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会程序表述中作介词或副词，分别出现在“onderbroken”和“onder leiding”等结构里。

patterns.name: 荷兰语“gest-”词形
patterns.context: 荷兰语句中表示受到支持，位于“word … door de lidstaten”之间。

patterns.name: 德语词内“end”
patterns.context: 哲学论述中出现在表示“最终”的副词词形内部。

patterns.name: 英语“wonder”
patterns.context: 戏剧台词中描述某事值得惊叹，词形处在诗体对白中。

patterns.name: 葡语“vez”
patterns.context: “é a segunda vez que…”（这是第二次……）结构中，作为次数表达的一部分。

en.description: Activations span multilingual parliamentary speeches, Portuguese within-word fragments, and formal forms of address; they also occur in Go assignment initialization, Dutch policy compounds, and old-book layout. There is no single stable meaning.

patterns.name: Portuguese endings and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Portuguese words are split into multiple tokens; activation covers within-word fragments and common endings, with some instances in the middle or at the beginning of a sentence.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Portuguese speeches and StackExchange Portuguese Q&A

patterns.name: Multilingual parliamentary forms of address and polite speech
patterns.context: Formal forms of address to the chair, commissioners, or interlocutors in parliamentary speeches, as well as polite expressions and turn-taking phrases; prominent activation occurs near forms of address.
patterns.domain: EuroParl German, Dutch, and Portuguese parliamentary debates

patterns.name: Dutch honorific and affirmative expression
patterns.context: After addressing someone as “Mijnheer Solana,” the speaker expresses pleasure or agreement; activation falls on the honorific, pronouns, and emphatic expressions.

patterns.name: Assignment operator in Go standard-library code
patterns.context: Short variable declaration inside a Go function, followed by a make call and buffer initialization.

patterns.name: Buffer declaration in Go code
patterns.context: Creates a byte-slice buffer in a socket-options function; activation concentrates on the local variable and initialization statement.

patterns.name: Time word in an English book advertisement quotation
patterns.context: After publication information such as edition, cloth binding, and price, an English endorsement is attributed to the Morning Post; activation concentrates on Morning in the newspaper name.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg old-book advertisements or publication layout

patterns.name: Spanish “to say” and its complement
patterns.context: Expresses “I also wanted to say something about them”; the strongest activation is on the verb meaning to say or speak.

patterns.name: Punctuation in English Go documentation comments
patterns.context: A socket-function description sentence ends and a new line follows, immediately before a Go function declaration.

patterns.name: Dutch policy vocabulary and paternity leave
patterns.context: Discusses paternity leave and its connection to another type of parental leave; activation occurs within a compound policy term.

patterns.name: English layout and publication-information formatting
patterns.context: Book edition, binding, and price information are separated from quotations, attributions, and publication locations by decorative symbols and line breaks.

9_836.concept: 多语种分词与语境片段
9_836.description: 激活跨多语种议会发言、葡语词内片段及正式称呼，也见Go赋值初始化、荷兰语政策复合词和旧书版式；没有单一稳定词义。

patterns.name: 葡语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词被分成多个 token；激活覆盖词内片段及常见词尾，部分实例处于句中或句首。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 葡语发言及 StackExchange 葡语问答

patterns.name: 多语言议会称呼与礼貌发言
patterns.context: 议会发言中对主席、委员或对方的正式称呼，以及礼貌表达和发言转接语；称呼附近有突出激活。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 德语、荷兰语和葡语议会辩论

patterns.name: 荷兰语敬语与肯定表达
patterns.context: 以“Mijnheer Solana”称呼对方后，表达高兴或赞同；激活落在敬语、代词和强调性表达上。

patterns.name: Go 标准库代码中的赋值符
patterns.context: Go 函数体内短变量声明，后接 make 调用及缓冲区初始化。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的缓冲区声明
patterns.context: socket 选项函数中创建字节切片缓冲区；激活集中于局部变量及初始化语句。

patterns.name: 英文书籍广告引文中的时间词
patterns.context: 书籍版本、布面与价格等出版信息之后，英文推荐语署名为 Morning Post；激活集中在报纸名称中的 Morning。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 旧书籍广告或出版物版面

patterns.name: 西班牙语“说”及其补语
patterns.context: 表达“我也想说一些关于它们的事”；激活最强处是表示说、讲的动词。

patterns.name: 英语 Go 文档注释中的标点
patterns.context: socket 函数说明句结束并换行，紧接 Go 函数声明。

patterns.name: 荷兰语政策词汇与父亲假期
patterns.context: 讨论父亲假期及其与另一类育儿假期的关联；激活位于复合政策术语内部。

patterns.name: 英文版面与出版信息格式
patterns.context: 书籍版本、装帧和价格信息与引文、署名、出版地之间以装饰符号和换行分隔。

en.concept: Intent and discourse organization in speech
en.description: Activations favor first-person expressions of desire or plans, speech transitions, and forms of address to the chair in Portuguese and Dutch parliamentary speeches. They also cover oral corrections, language explanations, book quotations, Go buffer code, and Dutch policy passages; these patterns are not fully unified.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person expression of desire or inquiry
patterns.context: Portuguese verb gostaria (“would like”) is followed by de + infinitive to express a polite desire or question; it also occurs in “gostaria de dizer.”

patterns.name: Portuguese dizer “to say”
patterns.context: The verb dizer occurs in first-person parliamentary speech, followed respectively by “alguma coisa” and a “que” clause; in some contexts it is adjacent to the expression of desire with gostaria.

patterns.name: Transitions or evaluations in Portuguese political speeches
patterns.context: A parliamentary speech shifts to an additional opinion after stating an important event, or expresses surprise; this does not fully overlap with expressions of desire or speech verbs.

patterns.name: Portuguese forms of address to the chair and polite speech openings
patterns.context: The speaker addresses the presiding officer as “Madam/Sir President” before making a statement or expressing an intention; the core form of address and construction span languages, but the activating words differ.

patterns.name: Portuguese parliamentary term for oral alteration
patterns.context: Before a vote, a member announces a small oral alteration.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-meaning explanation and usage examples
patterns.context: The preceding text discusses a word's meaning in Angolan Portuguese and its prepositional collocation, then gives a first-person example sentence.

patterns.name: Dutch wil ik “I want to”
patterns.context: “wil ik” occurs after a time adverbial, expressing what the speaker will do next; it broadly resembles the expression of desire in Portuguese gostaria de.

patterns.name: Morning Post in an English book title and promotional quotation
patterns.context: A newspaper name and quotation appear in the publication information and endorsement layout of a 19th-century book.

patterns.name: Buffer initialization in Go code
patterns.context: Creates a byte-slice buffer with make inside the GetSockoptString function.

patterns.name: Dutch onlang(s) before a political name
patterns.context: A parliamentary sentence mentions something that recently happened to or was said by a political figure; activation concentrates on the time adverb and the following passage.

patterns.name: Dutch summary ending after addressing the chair
patterns.context: After “I will conclude,” the speaker addresses Madam President and continues speaking to the members.

patterns.name: Dutch sentence-initial relative or complement fragment
patterns.context: The passage continues the preceding text, expressing that something merits recognition within the framework of an initiative; the trigger does not clearly form a unified construction with the subsequent time expression.

9_836.concept: 发言中的意图与话语组织
9_836.description: 激活偏向葡语、荷兰语议会发言中的第一人称意愿/计划表达、发言转折及主席称呼，也涵盖口头修正、语言释义、书籍引文、Go 缓冲区代码和荷兰语政策语段；这些模式并非完全统一。

patterns.name: 葡语第一人称表达愿望或提问
patterns.trigger: «g»1«ost»7«aria»7« também»5« de»5 d«izer»10« alg»3«uma»5 co«isa»4；«G»2«ost»8«aria»6« de»5« saber»9
patterns.context: 葡语动词 gostaria（愿意、想要）后接 de + 不定式，表达礼貌愿望或询问；也出现于「gostaria de dizer」后。

patterns.name: 葡语 dizer「说」
patterns.context: 动词 dizer 出现在第一人称议会发言中，分别接「alguma coisa」及「que」从句；与 gostaria 的愿望表达在部分语境中相邻。

patterns.name: 葡语政治发言中的转折或评价
patterns.context: 议会发言中陈述重要事件后转入补充意见，或表达惊讶；与愿望、说话动词并不完全重合。

patterns.name: 葡语主席称呼及礼貌发言开头
patterns.trigger: «Sen»4«hor»4« Presidente»5«,»7« ten»9«ho»5« uma»2；«M»2«ev»3«rou»1«w»4« de»3« Voor»2«zitter»2«,»6« van»3«mor»2«gen»4« wil»9« ik»5
patterns.context: 以「主席女士/先生」称呼主持人后，开始陈述或表达意图；核心称呼、句型跨语言，但激活词不同。

patterns.name: 葡语 oral alteration 议事用语
patterns.context: 投票前议员宣布提出一项小的口头修正。

patterns.name: 葡语词义解释与用法举例
patterns.context: 前文讨论某词在安哥拉葡语中的含义及介词搭配，随后以第一人称句子举例。

patterns.name: 荷兰语 wil ik「我想要」
patterns.context: 时间状语之后出现「wil ik」，表达发言者接下来要做的事；与葡语 gostaria de 有宽泛的意愿表达相似。

patterns.name: 英语书名与宣传引文中的 Morning Post
patterns.context: 十九世纪书籍的出版信息和推荐语排版中，出现报纸名称及引用。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的缓冲区初始化
patterns.context: GetSockoptString 函数中用 make 创建 byte 切片缓冲区。

patterns.name: 荷兰语政治姓名前的 onlang(s)
patterns.context: 议会句子中提及某政治人物近期发生或表示的事情；激活集中在时间副词和其后续语段。

patterns.name: 荷兰语主席称呼后总结收尾
patterns.context: 「我将结束」之后称呼主席女士，并继续面向委员发言。

patterns.name: 荷兰语句首关系或补语片段
patterns.context: 句段开头延续前文，表示在某倡议框架内值得认可；触发部分与后续时间表达不构成明显统一句式。

en.concept: Word-initial subword fragments and formatting boundaries
en.description: Activation falls mainly on the word-initial subword fragments “Ser” and “Der,” alongside several newline and email-format fragments. Ser often occurs in biomedical vocabulary; Der occurs in German text and names. Other sporadic activations lack a consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial subword fragment “Der”
patterns.context: At the beginning of German sentences or names/forms of address; both instances immediately follow a newline, and the latter is inside an email recipient’s name.
patterns.domain: German-language European Parliament text, Enron emails

patterns.name: Word-initial subword fragment “Ser”
patterns.context: At the beginning of English biomedical terms or proper nouns, followed by subword fragments forming Serine, Serodiagnosis, Serum, Ser608Leu, Serotonergic, Serotonin, and Serigne; the first five occur in PubMed/NIH-related text, and the last is a personal name.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper titles/abstracts, NIH project text; also a Wikipedia personal name

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Social
patterns.context: At the beginning of a title or abstract, followed by a social-science topic phrase such as “influences in sports activity”.

patterns.name: Local patterns in email formatting
patterns.context: Email body endings, signatures, quoted display names, email addresses, dates, and other email-header formatting fragments. Activations are scattered across formatting symbols and name/address fragments.

patterns.name: Newline markers in body text
patterns.context: The newline itself is marked, occurring at line breaks in abstract body text and parliamentary records, and in blank lines after Wikipedia entry titles; the text following the newline varies.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, European Parliament records, Wikipedia

patterns.name: Sporadic subword fragments without a clear pattern
patterns.context: Fragments occur inside German compounds, “Habits” in an English abstract, gene polymorphism markers, and proper nouns. Apart from word-initial fragments such as “Ser” or “Der,” no stable shared condition is apparent.

9_1610.concept: 词首子词元与格式边界
9_1610.description: 激活主要落在词首子词元“Ser”和“Der”，并伴随若干换行及邮件格式片段；Ser 多见于生物医学词汇，Der 见于德语文本与姓名，其他零散激活缺乏统一语义。

patterns.name: 词首子词元“Der”
patterns.context: 在德语句子或姓名/称呼开头；两处均紧接换行，后一处位于邮件收件人姓名内部。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会德语文本、Enron 邮件

patterns.name: 词首子词元“Ser”
patterns.context: 出现在英语生物医学词汇或专名开头，后续子词元分别组成 Serine、Serodiagnosis、Serum、Ser608Leu、Serotonergic、Serotonin、Serigne；前五个为 PubMed/NIH 相关文本，最后一个为人名。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题/摘要、NIH 项目文本；另有维基百科人名

patterns.name: 句首 Social
patterns.context: 标题或摘要开头，后接“influences in sports activity”等社会科学主题表述。

patterns.name: 邮件格式中的局部模式
patterns.context: 邮件正文结尾、签名、带引号的显示名、邮箱地址及日期等邮件头格式片段。激活分散在格式符号和姓名/地址片段上。

patterns.name: 正文中的换行标记
patterns.context: 换行本身被标记，出现在摘要正文换行、议会记录换行及维基百科条目标题后的空行；换行后文本不统一。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、欧洲议会记录、维基百科

patterns.name: 无法明确归纳的零散子词元
patterns.context: 分别处于德语复合词、英文摘要中的“Habits”、基因多态性标记及专名内部，除“Ser”或“Der”等词首片段外看不出稳定共同条件。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、PubMed 摘要、维基百科

en.concept: Local word-form fragments and boundary markers
en.description: Activation is scattered across several local word forms and markers: biomedical examples consistently highlight initial Ser; code examples highlight XML tag openings; the rest involve sentence-initial Most, an internal fragment of Habits, and ’Twas in a Christmas poem.

patterns.name: Sentence-/word-initial Ser- subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or subword fragments beginning with Ser, which continue into different words; in these examples, the fragment is at the start of the displayed context.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers on protein kinases, tuberculosis diagnosis, culturing, gene polymorphisms, and serotonin-related topics

patterns.name: XML tag opener
patterns.context: Tag openings in C# XML documentation comments; the “///” comment prefix is also marked.

patterns.name: Was in an idiom
patterns.context: The opening of the Christmas poem “’Twas the Night Before Christmas,” with an apostrophe contraction and a proper noun.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Most
patterns.context: A sentence begins with Most, followed by notable, then introduces virtual- and augmented-reality systems.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Habits
patterns.context: After a paragraph break, a new sentence begins “Habits of leisure time sports activity”; activation falls on a trailing subword fragment.
patterns.domain: Medical abstract on adolescent sports activity

9_1610.concept: 局部词形片段与边界标记
9_1610.description: 激活分散在多类局部词形与标记上：生物医学例子共同突出词首 Ser；代码例子突出 XML 标签起始；其余分别是句首 Most、Habits 的词内片段和圣诞诗句中的 ’Twas。

patterns.name: 句首/词首 Ser- 子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在以 Ser 开头的词或子词片段上，后续拼成不同词；这些例子中该片段都位于所示上下文起始处。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文，涉及蛋白激酶、结核诊断、培养、基因多态性及血清素相关内容

patterns.name: XML 标签起始符
patterns.context: C# XML 文档注释中的标签起始；同时标记“///”注释前缀。

patterns.name: 习语中的 Was
patterns.context: 圣诞诗句“’Twas the Night Before Christmas”的开头，带撇号缩写与专名。

patterns.name: Most 句首词
patterns.context: 句子中以 Most 起始，后接 notable，随后引出虚拟现实与增强现实系统。

patterns.name: Habits 词内片段
patterns.context: 段落换行后新句以“Habits of leisure time sports activity”开头，激活落在词尾子词片段。
patterns.domain: 青少年体育活动的医学论文摘要

en.concept: Stems in technical terms and melt
en.description: Activation concentrates on “rhe”-related words (including rheology and rheumatic) and melt; there are also patterns involving conjunctival, punctuation in a coal-waste passage, citation/quantity punctuation, place-name segmentation, and sporadic technical terms.

patterns.name: rheology-related terminology
patterns.context: The token sequence beginning «rhe» receives the strongest activation in medical, food-science, and biomedical prose; it appears in rheology terms and in “rheumatic.”

patterns.name: melt
patterns.context: The word “melt” is activated in contexts about resistance to melting, heat, glacial meltwater, and melt emulsification.
patterns.domain: Food science, literary prose, geology, and patents

patterns.name: conjunctival
patterns.context: A specific anatomical term in a scientific title about the bacterial flora of cats.

patterns.name: coal-waste context
patterns.context: Activation peaks on punctuation following an abbreviation for coal combustion waste, within discussion of ash ponds and regulation.

patterns.name: quantity punctuation
patterns.context: Comma and closing-parenthesis tokens are strongly activated in a bibliographic citation and a parenthetical population range.
patterns.domain: Patent prose and informal city description

patterns.name: city-name tokenization
patterns.context: Unusual segmented place-name and stylized spelling in an informal passage about Asheville; no clear link to the scientific or lexical patterns.

patterns.name: miscellaneous scientific terms
patterns.context: Technical vocabulary appears in scientific or patent passages, but these tokens do not form a consistent shared trigger beyond technical subject matter.

9_1610.concept: 技术词中的词干与 melt
9_1610.description: 激活集中在“rhe”相关词（含 rheology 与 rheumatic）和 melt；另有 conjunctival、煤废弃物段落中的标点、引用/数量标点、地名切分及零散技术词模式。

patterns.name: rheology-related terminology
patterns.context: The token sequence beginning «rhe» receives the strongest activation in medical, food-science, and biomedical prose; it appears in rheology terms and in “rheumatic.”

patterns.name: melt
patterns.context: The word “melt” is activated in contexts about resistance to melting, heat, glacial meltwater, and melt emulsification.
patterns.domain: Food science, literary prose, geology, and patents

patterns.name: conjunctival
patterns.context: A specific anatomical term in a scientific title about the bacterial flora of cats.

patterns.name: coal-waste context
patterns.context: Activation peaks on punctuation following an abbreviation for coal combustion waste, within discussion of ash ponds and regulation.

patterns.name: quantity punctuation
patterns.context: Comma and closing-parenthesis tokens are strongly activated in a bibliographic citation and a parenthetical population range.
patterns.domain: Patent prose and informal city description

patterns.name: city-name tokenization
patterns.context: Unusual segmented place-name and stylized spelling in an informal passage about Asheville; no clear link to the scientific or lexical patterns.

patterns.name: miscellaneous scientific terms
patterns.context: Technical vocabulary appears in scientific or patent passages, but these tokens do not form a consistent shared trigger beyond technical subject matter.

en.description: In most passages, activation falls on melt: including melting, fusion, meltwater, melting reactions, and the political decline or figurative dissolution expressed by melt down. In passage 7, activation falls on AND in a title, which this account does not explain.

patterns.name: melt and its compound forms
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the word melt, covering melting of ice and snow, materials melting when heated, political decline, and figurative dissolution. The specific meaning varies by context.
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, patent technology, chemistry, literature

patterns.name: Uppercase AND
patterns.context: The all-caps word appears in the title-like phrase “DEVELOPMENT AND APPLICATIONS OF NEW PROBES”; there is no nearby melt trigger.
patterns.domain: NIH project title or database text

9_1610.description: 绝大多数片段中，激活落在 melt：包括融化、熔化、融水、熔融反应，以及 melt down 的政治衰退或比喻消融。第7段则激活标题中的 AND，无法由此解释。

patterns.name: melt 及其复合形式
patterns.context: 激活集中在 melt 一词上；涵盖冰雪融化、材料受热熔化、政治衰退及比喻性的消融。具体含义随上下文变化。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、专利技术、化学、文学

patterns.name: 大写 AND
patterns.context: 全大写词出现在项目标题式短语 “DEVELOPMENT AND APPLICATIONS OF NEW PROBES” 中；没有邻近 melt 触发。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目标题或数据库文本

en.description: High activations are scattered across domains and semantic content, often falling on specific fragments of words, abbreviations, or symbols (such as AP, ys, NGO, ≲, Beer, Ecosystem, inveterate). No stable shared semantic or syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Strong activation on fixed phrases and at word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on specific fragments of complete words, abbreviations, or multi-subword forms; some are internal suffixes/fragments, while others are standalone words or symbols. These examples alone do not establish a unified contextual or semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: emails, parliamentary text, social and scientific articles, fiction, encyclopedias, and web text

9_1610.concept: 词汇/子词片段检测（暂定）
9_1610.description: 高激活分散在不同领域和语义内容中，常落在词语、缩写或符号的特定片段（如AP、ys、NGO、≲、Beer、Ecosystem、inveterate）；未见稳定的共同语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 固定语块与词边界处的强激活
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词、缩写或多子词词形的特定片段上；有些是词内后缀/词片，有些是独立词或符号。仅凭这些例子无法确定统一的上下文语义条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、议会文本、社会与科学文章、小说、百科及网页文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across several text types, with emphasis on uppercase emphasis WILL and uppercase names or proper nouns segmented into subwords. It also responds strongly to isolated fragments such as accused, island, C.S.I., and mimic, without a unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: Uppercase WILL
patterns.context: Emphatic uppercase WILL appears within sentences, expressing prediction, intent, or a name-spelling fragment in legal opinions; its position is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Forums, legal text, religious emails, business emails

patterns.name: Uppercase HADIT／HADITU
patterns.context: A segmented form of the uppercase proper noun HADITU in historical narrative, in sentences describing its influence or control.

patterns.name: Continuous uppercase fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Names in legal documents are segmented into subwords, with name components shown as uppercase fragments; WILLIAM is especially prominent in two legal passages.

patterns.name: Identity or label terms
patterns.context: A first-person occupational statement describes helping people accused of crimes cope with charges.

patterns.name: Geographic term island
patterns.context: An English learner discusses Japanese history and states in a simple sentence that Japan is an island country.

patterns.name: Abbreviated title / media marker
patterns.context: An abbreviation in an article title or site name, followed by content about a bank-card skimmer.

patterns.name: Neuroscience term fragment
patterns.context: Discusses whether an electronic nose imitates neural architecture when comparing it with biological olfaction.

9_1610.description: 激活分散于多类文本，集中涉及大写强调 WILL、按子词切分的大写人名或专名；另对 accused、island、C.S.I.、mimic 等孤立词片段强烈响应，缺少统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: 大写 WILL
patterns.context: 大写强调的 WILL 出现在句中，表达预测、意愿或法律意见中的姓名拼写片段；触发位置并不固定。
patterns.domain: 论坛、法律文本、宗教邮件、商务邮件

patterns.name: 大写 HADIT／HADITU
patterns.context: 历史叙述中大写专名 HADITU 的分词形式，位于描述其影响力或控制力的句子中。

patterns.name: 人名拼写中的连续大写片段
patterns.context: 法律文书的人名按子词切分，姓名部分以大写片段呈现；WILLIAM 在两个法律段落中尤为突出。

patterns.name: 身份或标签词
patterns.context: 第一人称职业自述中，描述帮助被控犯罪者应对指控。
patterns.domain: 个人简介、法律职业自述

patterns.name: 地理词 island
patterns.context: 英语学习者谈日本历史时，以简单句说明日本是岛国。
patterns.domain: 非正式、学习者英语叙述

patterns.name: 缩写标题／媒体标记
patterns.context: 文章标题或站点名中的缩写，后接关于银行卡 skimmer 的内容。

patterns.name: 神经科学术语片段
patterns.context: 比较电子鼻与生物嗅觉系统时，讨论其是否模仿神经架构。

en.concept: Function words and common word fragments across domains
en.description: Activation spans multiple genres and topics, often falling near determiners and common function words. Other patterns include fixed patent phrasing, religious vocabulary, institutional/legal entities, and news and speech fragments; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Determiner DET and tail
patterns.context: Triggers often fall near determiners; in passage 1, DET and AIL are marked as separate fragments, which does not establish a specific word meaning.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A; also patent, academic, and legal text

patterns.name: Fixed phrasing in patent claims
patterns.context: Chemical patents describe materials, processes, or components using patent-style enumeration.

patterns.name: Theological and religious discourse
patterns.context: Discusses divinity, creation, God, or biblical narratives.

patterns.name: Describing group membership and background
patterns.context: States the composition, expertise, or background of an organization’s or committee’s members.

patterns.name: Drug development and synthesis
patterns.context: Describes ADC plans, quantities of drug materials, and synthesis requirements.

patterns.name: Trusts and institutions in legal documents
patterns.context: Formal legal narrative describing the management and payment of entities, joint offices, and trust funds.

patterns.name: Historical/speech-like exhortation and insulting commands
patterns.context: Addresses an audience in a classical oratorical style, with humiliating commands or mockery.
patterns.domain: Historical political speech or literary quotation

patterns.name: News caption and land-conservation issues
patterns.context: Local news caption mentioning horseback riders, a location, and congressional reauthorization of a fund.

patterns.name: Protocol/message formats and XML
patterns.context: Discusses message types or checks whether DETAILS contains XML; the specific trigger relates to formatting fragments.

patterns.name: Wording about servitude, freedom, and peace
patterns.context: Uses rhetorical contrast to discuss servitude, freedom, and departure; its clear commonality with the other passages is uncertain.

9_1610.concept: 多领域文本中的功能词及常见词片段
9_1610.description: 激活分布于多种文体与主题，常落在限定词及常见功能词附近；另有专利固定措辞、宗教词汇、机构/法律实体，以及新闻和演说片段，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 冠词/限定词 DET 与尾部
patterns.context: 触发常落在限定词附近；第1段中 DET 与 AIL 被拆分标记，不能据此确定具体词义。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答；也见专利、学术及法律文本

patterns.name: 专利权利要求的固定措辞
patterns.context: 化学专利描述材料、工艺或组分，出现专利式枚举措辞。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/技术文本

patterns.name: 神学与宗教论述
patterns.context: 讨论神性、创造、神或圣经叙事。
patterns.domain: 宗教哲学与基督教论述

patterns.name: 描述群体成员与背景
patterns.context: 陈述组织或委员会的成员构成、专长或背景。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究项目/机构文本

patterns.name: 药物研发与合成
patterns.context: 说明 ADC 方案、药物材料用量及合成需求。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划文本

patterns.name: 法律文件中的信托与机构
patterns.context: 正式法律叙述，说明实体、联合办公室及信托基金的管理和付款。

patterns.name: 历史/演说式劝诫与侮辱性命令
patterns.context: 以古典演说口吻劝诫受众，并带有屈辱性的命令或讥讽。
patterns.domain: 历史性政治演说或文学引文

patterns.name: 新闻图片说明与土地保护议题
patterns.context: 地方新闻图片说明，提及骑马者、地点及国会重新授权基金。
patterns.domain: 地方新闻/公共土地政策

patterns.name: 协议/消息格式与 XML
patterns.context: 讨论消息类型或检查 DETAILS 是否包含 XML；具体触发与格式化片段有关。

patterns.name: servitude、自由与和平措辞
patterns.context: 以修辞性对照谈奴役、自由及离去；与其余段落的明确共同点不清。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 文学或历史性文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across multiple genres, often falling on internal word fragments, uppercase names, or title words. Other sporadic patterns involve function words in formal text, pronouns in quotations, numbers, and list formatting, making it difficult to identify a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Internal word fragments and suffixes
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on contiguous or adjacent letter fragments within words, often stems, endings, or participial forms of longer words; these occur in different contexts.

patterns.name: Uppercase names and legal citation formatting
patterns.context: Names appear in all caps or segmented uppercase, often alongside initials, commas, periods, or list formatting; examples include court personnel and names in book catalogs.

patterns.name: State names and uppercase words in headings
patterns.context: All-caps words, state names, or company names appear in news headlines or page headers; uppercase forms may co-occur with internal word segmentation.

patterns.name: Function words and conventional expressions in formal style
patterns.context: Connectives, articles, and conventional legal phrases in formal or institutional text are marked; triggers are scattered, with no single fixed collocation apparent.

patterns.name: Incomplete or unusual word-form fragments
patterns.context: Long words are segmented into letter fragments, with activation on internal substrings; some fragments may be parts of word forms rather than standalone words.

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and negative contractions in dialogue
patterns.context: Direct quotations embedded in news reports, where pronouns or negative contractions are marked; this pattern has only one example.

patterns.name: Numbers and list formatting
patterns.context: Activation appears near years, numbers, indentation, and short name fragments in lists or catalog entries.

9_1610.description: 激活分散于多种文体，常落在词内字母片段、全大写姓名或标题词；另有正式文本功能词、引语代词、数字及列表排版等零散模式，难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 词内字母片段与后缀
patterns.context: 激活集中在词内部连续或相邻的字母片段，常是较长词的词干、词尾或分词形式；在不同上下文中均出现。

patterns.name: 大写姓名及法律引文排版
patterns.context: 姓名以全大写或分段大写显示，常伴随姓名缩写、逗号、句点或名单式排版；包括法院人员姓名及书籍目录姓名。

patterns.name: 州名及标题中的大写词
patterns.context: 新闻标题或页眉中出现全大写词、州名或公司名称；大写形态和词内分段可能共同出现。

patterns.name: 正式语体中的功能词与惯用表达
patterns.context: 较正式或机构化文本中的连接词、冠词和司法惯用表达被标记；触发较分散，未见单一固定搭配。

patterns.name: 残缺或不寻常的词形片段
patterns.context: 长词被拆成字母片段，激活落在内部子串；部分片段可能是词形的一部分而非独立词。

patterns.name: 对话中的人称代词及否定缩写
patterns.context: 新闻报道中嵌入直接引语，代词或否定缩写被标记；本模式样本仅一段。

patterns.name: 数字与条目式排版
patterns.context: 列表或目录条目中的年份、编号、缩进和短姓名片段附近出现激活。

en.description: Activation is scattered across different word forms and legal, academic, catalog, and commentary contexts. Some peaks fall on internal fragments of words such as quant, maxim, and RELIGIOUS; others occur on words such as jurisdiction, license, apply, and conducted. No unified semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Internal re- / renewed change
patterns.context: Occurs in a narrative describing a tropical cyclone changing intensity again; the internal fragments involve the re- prefix and intensify.

patterns.name: Quantification and measurement word forms
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the quant- stem in statements about quantifying data or genetic effects.

patterns.name: Maximization word form
patterns.context: The trigger falls on the maxim- stem in a sentence about using resources efficiently and avoiding waste.

patterns.name: Jurisdiction
patterns.context: A legal provision addresses whether a court has authority to review a certain type of administrative or removal decision.

patterns.name: Rights granted by a software license
patterns.context: An open-source license lists the rights to use, copy, modify, distribute, and sublicense software.

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a catalog heading
patterns.context: Activation concentrates inside the segmented word RELIGIOUS, which appears in an all-caps, catalog-style section heading.

patterns.name: Provision does not apply
patterns.context: A regulation uses shall not apply to state that a provision does not apply in a specific situation, followed by conditions relating to parents or guardians.

patterns.name: Conducting an experiment
patterns.context: Describes how an experimental procedure is carried out; here, an RHI session is conducted without metronome sounds.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of abstract
patterns.context: In discussing whether political influence should be considered abstractly, strong activation falls on think; abstract has only weaker internal-fragment activation.

9_1610.description: 激活分散在不同词形和法律、学术、目录及评论语境中；部分高点落在 quant、maxim、RELIGIOUS 等词内片段，也有 jurisdiction、license、apply、conducted 等词，未见统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 词内 re- / 重新变化
patterns.context: 出现在描述热带气旋强度再次变化的叙述中；词内片段涉及 re- 前缀及 intensify。

patterns.name: 量化与测量词形
patterns.context: 触发点落在 quant- 词干，出现在说明对数据或遗传影响进行量化的语句中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与遗传学论文

patterns.name: 最大化词形
patterns.context: 触发点落在 maxim- 词干，句子谈及高效利用资源、避免浪费。

patterns.name: 司法管辖权
patterns.context: 在法律条文中，法院是否有权审查某类行政或移除决定。

patterns.name: 软件许可授予权利
patterns.context: 开源许可文本列举使用、复制、修改、分发及再许可软件的权利。

patterns.name: 目录标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在分词标注的 RELIGIOUS 一词内部；该词出现在目录式大写章节标题中。

patterns.name: 条款不适用
patterns.context: 法规以 shall not apply 表述某条款不适用于特定情形，后接父母或监护人相关条件。

patterns.name: 实验实施
patterns.context: 描述实验环节如何进行；此处为在无节拍器声条件下实施 RHI session。

patterns.name: 抽象一词的内部片段
patterns.context: 在讨论是否应以抽象方式思考政治影响时，强激活落在 think；abstract 仅有较弱的内部片段激活。

en.concept: Wording on legal scope of application
en.description: Primarily responds to wording in legal provisions that limits scope or excludes applicability, as well as fixed process-description phrasing in patents. There are also sporadic activations on UN and IG letter fragments in uppercase headings or inside words.

patterns.name: Applicability/non-applicability wording in legal provisions
patterns.context: Legal provisions specify which people or situations a provision or law applies to, or exclude certain subjects; common collocates include section, provisions, persons, and insurers.

patterns.name: Process descriptions in patent text
patterns.context: This fixed phrase introduces a process or measurement step, near words such as measuring, manufacturing, deformation, and strain.

patterns.name: Segmented UN fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the contiguous letters UN inside a word, rather than on an obvious semantic unit; examples occur in a publication title and the word for a community.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment in headings
patterns.context: Activation corresponds to the letters IG inside English words, surrounded by catalog headings or uppercase subheadings; the specific semantics vary.

9_1610.description: 主要响应法律条文中限定适用范围或排除适用的措辞，以及专利中的固定工艺描述句式；另对若干大写标题或词内的 UN、IG 字母片段有零散激活。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的适用／不适用措辞
patterns.context: 法律规定说明某条款或法律适用于哪些人或情形、或排除哪些对象；常与 section、provisions、persons、insurers 等搭配。

patterns.name: 专利文本中的过程描述
patterns.context: 以该固定句式引出工艺或测量步骤，附近出现 measuring、manufacturing、deformation、strain 等词。

patterns.name: UN 的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词中连续的 UN 字母片段，而非明显的语义单位；分别出现在通讯刊名、社区一词中。

patterns.name: 标题中的词首片段
patterns.context: 激活对应英文词内部的 IG 字母片段，周边是目录标题或大写小标题；具体语义不一致。

en.description: Activations occur across many types of contexts: legal clauses on non-applicability, obligations, and liability; split word fragments; prompts to think or recall; and sporadic content from medical, diplomatic, email, and business reporting. No single semantic pattern explains all passages.

patterns.name: Negative or exception clauses
patterns.context: Legal text describing a clause as inapplicable, commonly using the structure not apply or shall not apply; another passage contains not required.

patterns.name: Legal contract obligations and clause references
patterns.context: Contracts or legal provisions stating that a party is bound by contract terms, or citing clauses, provisions, or contractual relationships.

patterns.name: Split word forms/subword fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on morpheme fragments inside Swedish words and letter fragments in English uppercase headings; these are not complete words.
patterns.domain: Swedish news/diplomatic texts, email subject lines, news headlines

patterns.name: Prompts to think in quotations or appeals
patterns.context: In advice or political rhetoric, think appears in contexts asking readers/listeners to imagine something, pause to think, or recall something.

patterns.name: Reminding someone of something
patterns.context: An event as subject evokes a word or meaning for someone.

patterns.name: Frustration with and relief from automated phone systems
patterns.context: Describes frustration caused by an automated phone system, then shifts to imagining the relief of being rid of it.

patterns.name: Delivery of diplomatic documents
patterns.context: In Swedish reporting, the subject submits a memorandum, document, or proposal to Chinese authorities; high activation falls on a fragment within läm-nade.

patterns.name: Legal proof and immunization
patterns.context: Legal provisions use a doctor's certificate or public health authority confirmation as proof of immunization; activations are weak and scattered.

patterns.name: Accidental conduct in negligence liability
patterns.context: Discusses whether teachers must anticipate the various everyday accidents and related risks involving students.

patterns.name: Subject line for a revised settlement agreement
patterns.context: An email subject line uses an uppercase, split-marked word to indicate that an agreement draft has been revised and to request that earlier versions be disregarded.

patterns.name: Healthcare company and margins
patterns.context: Business reporting assesses a company's health in its industry and mentions price increases and margins.

9_1610.description: 激活分布于多类语境：法律中的不适用、义务和责任条款；拆分词片段；劝人思考或回想；以及医疗、外交、邮件和商业报道等零散内容。无单一语义模式能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 否定或例外条款
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述某条款不适用，常见结构为 not apply，或 shall not apply；另有一段含 not required。

patterns.name: 法律合同义务与条款列举
patterns.context: 合同或法律条文中说明一方受合同条款约束，或援引条款、规定、合同关系。

patterns.name: 被拆分的词形/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在瑞典语词内部的词素片段、英文大写标题中的字母片段；并非完整词。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语新闻/外交文本、邮件标题、新闻标题

patterns.name: 引述或呼吁中的思考提示
patterns.context: 劝告或政治修辞中，think 出现在要求读者/听者设想、停顿思考或回顾某事的语境。

patterns.name: 使某人想起或提醒
patterns.trigger: « reminds»1« him»1 of« the»1« word»1« courage»2
patterns.context: 主语事件使人联想到某个词或意义。

patterns.name: 自动语音电话带来的挫折与宽慰
patterns.trigger: « agony»4 ... «repeat»2 ... automated voice ... «wastes»2；«think»9 of the relief
patterns.context: 描述电话自动语音系统造成的烦恼，并转向想到摆脱它后的宽慰。

patterns.name: 外交文件交付
patterns.context: 瑞典语报道中，主语将备忘录、文件或提案提交给中国当局；高激活落在 läm-nade 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 法律证明与免疫接种
patterns.context: 法律条文以医生证明或公共卫生部门确认作为免疫接种证明；激活较弱且分散。

patterns.name: 法律过失责任中的意外行为
patterns.context: 讨论教师是否须预见学生日常发生的各种意外行为及相关危险。

patterns.name: 修订版和解协议标题
patterns.context: 邮件标题以大写、拆分标记的词说明协议草案已修订，并要求忽略早期版本。

patterns.name: 健康公司与利润率
patterns.context: 商业报道评价某公司在行业中的健康程度，并提及提价和利润率。

en.description: Strong activations often fall within several words: the maxim word family, think, learned, pivot, establish, rescued, and eligibility. Maxim and think each occur across multiple passages, while the others are mostly isolated. Passage 5 has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: maxim word-form fragment
patterns.context: The triggering fragment occurs in forms such as maximise/maximizes/maximally; surrounding contexts concern resource use, course objectives, and caregiver participation. The shared word form may be the main trigger rather than a unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Healthcare quality guidelines, education programs, medical research

patterns.name: think prompts
patterns.context: Imperative or thought-guiding expressions ask the reader to imagine something; one concerns courage and Robinson, while another occurs in a fictional character's inner speech.

patterns.name: learn word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Occurs only in the chapter title “WHAT JACK LEARNED FROM PEDRO”, with the trigger falling on the participial form learned.
patterns.domain: Novel table of contents or chapter title

patterns.name: pivot word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Appears in a description of a mechanical structure, explaining that a platform component rotates around a frame; activation is concentrated on a fragment within pivot.

patterns.name: establish word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Appears in yoga meditation guidance, instructing the reader to establish a safe mental space; activation falls on a fragment within establish.

patterns.name: rescue word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Appears only in the chapter title “JACK IS RESCUED”, with the trigger falling on a fragment within rescued.
patterns.domain: Novel table of contents or chapter title

patterns.name: eligibility word-form fragment at the end
patterns.context: Appears in an all-caps subheading in a formal email, indicating a client's eligibility for a program.

9_1610.description: 强激活多落在若干词内部片段：maxim 词族、think、learned、pivot、establish、rescued、eligibility；其中 maxim 与 think 各跨多段，其余多为孤例。第5段缺少明显对应规律。

patterns.name: maxim 词形片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 maximise/maximizes/maximally 等词形中；周围上下文分别涉及资源利用、课程目标、照护者参与。可能主要由共同词形触发，而非统一语义。
patterns.domain: 医疗质量指南、教育项目、医学研究

patterns.name: think 思考指令
patterns.context: 祈使式或引导思考的表达，要求读者设想某事；一个是关于勇气与 Robinson，另一个是小说人物的内心话语。
patterns.domain: 体育报道引语、小说对话

patterns.name: 结尾 learn 的词形片段
patterns.context: 仅见于章节标题“WHAT JACK LEARNED FROM PEDRO”中，触发落在 learned 的分词词形。

patterns.name: 结尾 pivot 的词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在机械结构描述中，说明平台组件绕框架转动；激活集中于单词 pivot 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 结尾 establish 的词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑜伽冥想指导中，指示建立一个安全的心理空间；激活落在 establish 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 结尾 rescue 的词形片段
patterns.context: 只出现在章节标题“JACK IS RESCUED”中，触发落在 rescued 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 结尾 eligibility 的词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在正式邮件的全大写小标题中，表示客户参加项目的资格。

en.concept: Prompts to think and sporadic word-form cues
en.description: The strongest theme is think/Think and its objects of thought, often used to advise, recall, or evaluate. Other cues include medical maxim, philosophical belongs, split fragments in tables of contents, and sporadic cues involving names, pauses, and controversy reporting.

patterns.name: think and subsequent thought content
patterns.context: Imperative or advisory contexts ask readers to imagine, consider, or evaluate something; explicitly appears in passages 1, 2, 3, 5, and 10, while passage 6 also has «LE»ARN»9«ED»5
patterns.domain: Commentary, persuasion, fiction, and chapter titles

patterns.name: maxim in medical quality terminology
patterns.context: Formal descriptions of healthcare service quality or clinical care; the term spans token boundaries
patterns.domain: PubMed medical and health sciences academic text

patterns.name: belong indicating affiliation or relation
patterns.context: Discusses the relationship of beings to an inherent order and the good

patterns.name: Local fragment of the name Robinson
patterns.context: Appears in the name Jackie Robinson Day; the same passage also has think, but the name fragment may be an independent trigger

patterns.name: Name fragments and spelling patterns
patterns.context: In uppercase chapter listings, markers fall on split name, word, or number fragments; there is no clear shared semantic condition
patterns.domain: Novel table of contents or scanned text

patterns.name: Emphatic pause in political speech
patterns.context: Asks listeners to stop and think about the stakes; the pause word and think occur in the same sentence

patterns.name: Word fragments related to insults and reputation
patterns.context: Public criticism sparks controversy involving insults to residents and students and damage to reputation; the trigger lies within a word

9_1610.concept: 思考提示及零散词形线索
9_1610.description: 最强主线是 think/Think 及其思考对象，常用于劝告、回想或评估；另有医疗 maxim、哲学 belongs、目录中的拆词片段，以及零散姓名、停顿和争议报道线索。

patterns.name: think 及其后续思考内容
patterns.context: 祈使或劝告语境中要求读者想象、考虑或评估某事；段1、2、3、5、10明确出现，段6另有 «LE»ARN»9«ED»5
patterns.domain: 评论、劝说、小说叙述及章节标题

patterns.name: 医疗质量术语中的 maxim
patterns.context: 医疗服务质量或临床照护的正式描述；词项跨 token 边界呈现
patterns.domain: PubMed 医疗卫生学术文本

patterns.name: 表示归属或关系的 belong
patterns.context: 讨论存在者与内在秩序、善之间的归属关系

patterns.name: 人名 Robinson 的局部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Jackie Robinson Day 的人名中；同段亦有 think，但该姓名片段可能是独立触发线索

patterns.name: 人名片段与拼写模式
patterns.context: 大写章节目录中，标记落在拆分的人名、词语或编号片段上；没有明显共享的语义条件

patterns.name: 政治演说中的强调停顿
patterns.context: 要求听众停下来思考利害关系；停顿词与 think 同处一句
patterns.domain: 政治邮件或演说式文本

patterns.name: 辱骂、声誉相关词语片段
patterns.context: 公开批评引发争议，涉及侮辱居民、学生及损害声誉；触发位置在词内部

en.description: Activations are scattered across words and common phrases such as care and think, split-marked word fragments, code regex flags, and legal restrictions; there is no clear unified meaning across them.

patterns.name: Common expressions with care
patterns.context: Appears in expressions of negation, low concern, or caution; intensity falls on care itself, while the negation word is not always the trigger.
patterns.domain: News, art commentary, and historical narrative

patterns.name: Imperative think
patterns.context: Appears in “Just think” or “think about”, often as advice or a prompt to imagine.

patterns.name: Irregular capitalization/participial fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within words activate; examples are mostly uppercase emphatic text or cross-lingual forms, but also include ordinary words.
patterns.domain: Novel chapter titles, online insults, parliamentary text

patterns.name: Regex fragments in code
patterns.context: In the middle of a Python regular expression flag name, near escape characters and character-class expressions.

patterns.name: Legal obligation/restriction language
patterns.context: Legal clauses that limit a liability or obligation by stating it does not apply.

9_1610.description: 激活分散在 care、think 等词及其常见短语，也出现在被拆分标记的词内片段、代码正则标志和法律限制语句；各处没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: care 常见表达
patterns.context: 在否定、低在意程度或涉及谨慎的表达中出现；强度落在 care 本身，而否定词不总是触发点。
patterns.domain: 新闻、艺术评论及历史叙述

patterns.name: think 命令式
patterns.context: 出现在 “Just think” 或 “think about” 中，常用于劝告或设想。

patterns.name: 不规则大写/分词片段
patterns.context: 词内子词片段受到激活；样例多为大写强调文本或跨语言词形，但也见于普通单词。
patterns.domain: 小说章节标题、网络辱骂、议会文本

patterns.name: 代码中的正则表达式片段
patterns.context: Python 正则表达式标志名中部，且附近有转义符与字母类表达式。

patterns.name: 法律义务/限制用语
patterns.context: 法律条文中限定某项责任或义务不适用的句式。

en.description: Activations concentrate on internal fragments of several English and Swedish word forms: scrutin-, maxim-, recommendation-related forms, and think, nobody, learn, advantaged, and enunciate. These words belong to different contexts, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern yet apparent.

patterns.name: scrutinise stem and policy review
patterns.context: The scrutin- stem occurs in contexts discussing policy positions or ethical issues, followed by different suffix forms

patterns.name: maxim- stem
patterns.context: The maxim- stem forms maximise or maximally in sentences about resource use and information provision

patterns.name: People going against the crowd and nobody
patterns.context: Discusses consumer choices, going in a different direction from the crowd, and other people's reactions

patterns.name: Encouraging expression with think about
patterns.context: Direct quotation encourages someone to think about another person's actions in response to fear

patterns.name: Recommendation-related word forms
patterns.context: Swedish verb forms recommending an action

patterns.name: learned in chapter titles
patterns.context: All-caps, book-table-of-contents-style chapter title highlighting a fragment within learned
patterns.domain: Novel table of contents or chapter title

patterns.name: advantaged
patterns.context: Describes one party being unfairly given a market advantage in a legal dispute

patterns.name: enunciate
patterns.context: States legal policy in a bankruptcy provision or judicial opinion

9_1610.description: 激活集中于若干英语及瑞典语词形的内部片段：scrutin-、maxim-、推荐相关词形，以及 think、nobody、learn、advantaged、enunciate 等；这些词分属不同语境，尚无统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: scrutinise 词干及政策审查
patterns.trigger: «scrutin»10«ise»2« or»2 develop a particular policy« position»2；«scrutin»9«ized»2
patterns.context: scrutin- 词干位于讨论政策立场或伦理议题的语境中，后接不同形态词尾

patterns.name: maxim- 词干
patterns.context: maxim- 词干构成 maximise 或 maximally，处在说明资源利用、信息提供的句子中

patterns.name: 人群逆向与 nobody
patterns.trigger: «crowd»5 is going one way；«nobody»10 wants to hear
patterns.context: 谈论消费选择、与大众不同的方向，以及他人的反应

patterns.name: think about 的鼓励表达
patterns.context: 直接引语中劝人思考某人的行为，以应对恐惧

patterns.name: 推荐相关词形
patterns.context: 瑞典语中建议采取行动的动词词形
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、市场竞争讨论

patterns.name: 章节标题中的 learned
patterns.context: 书籍目录式全大写章节标题，突出 learned 的词内片段

patterns.name: advantaged
patterns.context: 法律争议中描述一方被不公平地赋予市场优势

patterns.name: enunciate
patterns.context: 破产法条文或司法意见中陈述法律政策

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual parliamentary and academic texts, English narrative, and math problems. They fall on specific word fragments or numbers and cover negation, dependence, need, guarantees, interrogative expressions, and zero, without a stable shared meaning.

patterns.name: Character “ç” within a Portuguese word
patterns.context: Activation falls on ç in a Portuguese word, in “alcançar”; the same corpus passage later contains Portuguese words such as “respeita”.

patterns.name: Relationship expressed through dependence on features
patterns.context: A Portuguese academic sentence says that the relationship between creativity, innovation, and CT depends on their respective features; activation is concentrated on fragments of “depender” and “características”.

patterns.name: Apostrophe suffix in a negative contraction
patterns.context: The n't portion of an English contraction, especially the t after the apostrophe; the same passage also contains the expression “couldn’t think of”.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC, personal tribute or interview-style text

patterns.name: Negation and expressions of care
patterns.context: English dialogue negates that someone or bystanders care about something; activation falls on care.

patterns.name: “Need” and its policy context
patterns.context: A Spanish parliamentary sentence says that something “needs” European Parliament approval; activation is concentrated on fragments of the stem and suffix of necesitar.

patterns.name: Local authorities and duty to guarantee
patterns.context: A Portuguese parliamentary speech asks Strasbourg's local authorities to guarantee certain conditions; activations occur in “autoridades locais” and “garantam”.

patterns.name: Interrogative “no doubt”
patterns.context: The fixed expression “no hay duda de que” (“there is no doubt that”) in Spanish parliamentary text; activation falls on duda.

patterns.name: Self-expression and vulnerability
patterns.context: First-person discussion of theater, self-presentation, and personal origins; look appears in the direct quotation “look where I’m from”.

patterns.name: Present perfect structure meaning “have been”
patterns.context: News commentary uses “have never been more …” to emphasize the vulnerable state of independent news and democracy.

patterns.name: The digit zero in a math problem
patterns.context: Zero appears as a digit in a negative operand in a decimal multiplication problem.

9_1610.description: 激活分散于多语种议会与学术文本、英语叙述和数学题；分别落在特定词片段或数字上，涵盖否定、依赖、需要、保障、疑问表达及零，缺少稳定共同语义。

patterns.name: 葡语词内的“ç”字符
patterns.context: 激活落在葡语词的 ç 上，出现在“alcançar”中；同一语料段随后有“respeita”等葡语词。

patterns.name: 依赖特征的关系表述
patterns.context: 葡语学术句中，创造力、创新与 CT 之间的关系被说成取决于各自特征；激活集中在“depender”和“características”的词片段。

patterns.name: 否定缩写中的撇号词尾
patterns.context: 英语缩写中的 n't 部分，尤其是撇号后的 t；同段附近还有“couldn’t think of”这一表达。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC，个人致辞或访谈式文本

patterns.name: 否定与关心表达
patterns.context: 英语对话中，否定某人或旁人关心某事；激活落在 care。

patterns.name: “需要”及其政策语境
patterns.context: 西班牙语议会句中，表示某事项“需要”欧洲议会批准；激活集中在 necesitar 的词干及词尾片段。

patterns.name: 地方当局与保障责任
patterns.context: 葡语议会发言要求斯特拉斯堡地方当局保障某些情况；激活分布于“autoridades locais”和“garantam”。

patterns.name: 疑问式“不怀疑”
patterns.context: 西班牙语议会文本中的固定表达“no hay duda de que”（毫无疑问）；激活落在 duda。

patterns.name: 自我表达与脆弱性
patterns.context: 第一人称谈论戏剧、自我展示及个人来处；look 出现在直接引语“look where I’m from”中。

patterns.name: “曾经如此”的完成时结构
patterns.context: 新闻评论中以“have never been more …”强调独立新闻与民主的脆弱处境。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字零
patterns.context: 小数乘法题的负数操作数中，零作为数字字符出现。

en.description: Activation patterns vary: numbers in mathematical calculations, durations and concentrations in experimental methods, and several English or Portuguese word fragments, dialogue words, and healthcare service terms. No single semantic or formatting pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal calculations
patterns.context: Occurs in multiplication problems, numerical expressions, and calculation instructions, including decimals, negative numbers, and numbers near operators; activations are distributed over digit substrings rather than whole words.

patterns.name: Time quantities in experimental procedures
patterns.context: In tissue section or sample processing steps, numbers indicate incubation or treatment duration; passages 2 and 10 also involve peroxidase blocking.

patterns.name: Percentages in biomedicine
patterns.context: Percentages follow solution or serum concentrations and specify experimental treatment conditions; appear in passages 2 and 10.

patterns.name: Specific substrings within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls inside split English words, across different words and contexts; it is difficult to reduce these to a unified meaning or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: look in spoken dialogue
patterns.context: In character dialogue, Look introduces the listener's attention or evidence; only one instance.

patterns.name: gostaria in Portuguese
patterns.context: In European Parliament Portuguese speech, the first-person conditional expresses “would like/wish”; activation falls on the initial fragment.

patterns.name: respeita in Portuguese
patterns.context: In European Parliament Portuguese proceedings, appears in the structure “no que respeita a” (“with regard to”); an internal word fragment activates.

patterns.name: Healthcare service quality descriptions
patterns.context: Lists dimensions of healthcare service quality or efficiency, describing timeliness, reduced delays, service delivery, and resource use; activation falls on initial or internal fragments of English words.

9_1610.description: 激活模式多样：数学计算中的数字、实验方法中的时长和浓度，以及若干英语或葡萄牙语词片段、对白词和卫生服务术语；没有单一语义或格式能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 数字与小数计算
patterns.context: 出现在乘法题、数值表达和计算指令中，包含小数、负数及运算符附近的数字；激活分布在数字子串而非完整词上。

patterns.name: 实验步骤中的时间量
patterns.context: 组织切片或样本处理步骤中，数字表示孵育、处理时长；段2和段10还涉及过氧化物酶封闭。

patterns.name: 生物医学中的百分数
patterns.context: 百分数跟在溶液或血清浓度之后，用于实验处理条件；段2、10出现。

patterns.name: 英语词内部的特定子串
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的英文词内部，涵盖不同词及不同语境；目前难以归结为统一词义或语法条件。
patterns.domain: 英语散文与生物医学文本

patterns.name: 口语对白中的 look
patterns.context: 人物对话中以 Look 引出对听者的注意或证据；仅此一例。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语中的 gostaria
patterns.context: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言中，第一人称条件式表达“愿意/希望”；激活落在词首片段。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语中的 respeita
patterns.context: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语议事文本中，出现在“no que respeita a（关于）”结构；词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 卫生服务质量描述
patterns.context: 列举医疗服务质量或效率维度，描述及时性、减少延误、服务交付及资源利用；激活落在英语词的开头或内部片段。
patterns.domain: 卫生政策/医疗服务指南

en.concept: Diverse word fragments and local expressions
en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: Spanish expressions of need, legal case-law formulas and discussions of witness credibility, negative expressions, numbers in mathematical formulas, imperative phrases, and Portuguese word fragments. Trigger conditions are local and vary considerably, with no single stable feature apparent.

patterns.name: Spanish word form for “need”
patterns.context: In a Spanish sentence, “se necesita” follows “se” and means “is needed”; it is followed by the noun phrase “la aprobación”.

patterns.name: Function words in a judicial review formula
patterns.context: Describes the standard for appellate review of evidentiary rulings or trial-court discretion, especially the judicial formula “will not be controlled unless abused”.

patterns.name: Negation and existential quantifier emphasis
patterns.context: Activation falls on an initial word in a negative or restrictive expression; one example is “nothing in the world can”, another is the sentence-initial “Without directly replying”. They have no clear shared syntactic context.
patterns.domain: Personal essay/football fan profile; nineteenth-century novel dialogue and narrative

patterns.name: Fractions and rational-number operations
patterns.context: Equations and evaluation problems involving negative numbers, integers, or fractions; number activations are inconsistent, and other similar numbers are often unmarked.

patterns.name: Witness credibility and adversarial cross-examination
patterns.context: Legal discourse states that questioning an adverse witness and presenting material affecting credibility are appropriate; the sentence “Nowhere is this better established” is prominent.

patterns.name: Imperative in a celebrity anecdote
patterns.context: A report recounts someone backstage telling another person to leave a locker room; high activation falls on the command “get out”.

patterns.name: Portuguese internal word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Portuguese words: “somente” (“only”) and “depender” (“depend on”); there is no clear shared semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Academic abstract on the relationship between creativity, innovation, and CT

9_1610.concept: 多样词片段与局部表达
9_1610.description: 激活分散于多种语言和文体：西语需要表达、法律判例公式及证人可信度论述、否定表达、数学算式数字、命令短语、葡语词内片段。触发条件局部且彼此差异明显，难以归为单一稳定特征。

patterns.name: 西班牙语「需要」词形
patterns.context: 西班牙语句中在“se”之后构成“se necesita”，表示需要；后面接名词短语“la aprobación”。
patterns.domain: 欧盟政治／法律制度说明，EuroParl

patterns.name: 司法审查公式中的功能词
patterns.trigger: «will»5« not»8« be»9« controlled»4« unless»4；另有« discretion»5、« judge»4
patterns.context: 描述证据采信或审判裁量受上诉审查的标准，尤其是“will not be controlled unless abused”这一司法公式。

patterns.name: 否定与存在量化强调
patterns.context: 激活落在否定或限制性表达的起始词上；一例为“nothing in the world can”，另一例为句首“Without directly replying”。两者没有明显共同句法环境。
patterns.domain: 个人随笔／足球爱好者简介；十九世纪小说对话叙事

patterns.name: 分数与有理数运算
patterns.context: 包含负数、整数或分数的算式及求值题；数字激活不稳定，其他类似数字常未标记。

patterns.name: 证人可信度与对抗式盘问
patterns.context: 法律论述称询问不利证人的动机、展示影响可信度的材料是适当的；突出句中“Nowhere is this better established”。

patterns.name: 名人轶事中的命令词
patterns.context: 报道人物在后台转述他人命令某人离开更衣室；高激活落在命令“get out”上。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部片段：“somente”（仅仅）以及“depender”（取决于）；无明显共同语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 关于创造力、创新与CT关系的学术摘要

en.description: Activations occur across languages and genres: local words and phrases concerning participation, need, nominal status, negative evaluation, or replies, as well as recurring legal-text patterns with will not plus a verb and exception/conditional review language; experimental duration numbers also occur.

patterns.name: Need/necessity expressions
patterns.context: A sentence states that an action or approval is “necessary”, followed by an object or condition; only one instance.

patterns.name: Participation-related word form
patterns.context: Describes a new mechanism encouraging a group to participate; the Greek word form is split into fragments.

patterns.name: Negative expression for a direct reply
patterns.context: In dialogue narration, a character does not answer directly, after which their action is recounted; appears once.

patterns.name: Negative judgment in judicial discretion/review
patterns.context: A court states that a discretionary decision will not be controlled unless there is abuse; a similar legal “will not … unless” structure also occurs in appellate review.

patterns.name: Court does not attempt to elaborate
patterns.context: A court states that the document will not detail the allegations here; a procedural note in a legal memorandum.

patterns.name: Negative evaluation/possibility statement
patterns.context: Uses “nothing in the world can…” for a strong evaluation; only one instance.

patterns.name: Nominal status/representation of a committee
patterns.context: A parliamentary report is submitted in the committee's name; activation is concentrated on the Portuguese expression for “on behalf of/in the name of”.

patterns.name: Stem in a negative contraction
patterns.context: The English quotation contains wasn’t, with strong activation on a stem fragment after the split; the context discusses successful people.

patterns.name: Experimental duration number
patterns.context: An experimental procedure gives the hydrogen peroxide treatment duration as “15 min”; activation falls near the number and unit.

patterns.name: Statement that a court will not reverse
patterns.context: Explains that an appellate court will not reverse a district court decision unless a subsequent condition is met; this shares the legal review structure with passage 4 but has a different predicate.

9_1610.concept: 分散的否定与判断表达
9_1610.description: 激活分布于多种语言和文体：有参与、需要、名义、否定评价或回答等局部词句，也反复出现在法律文本的 will not 加动词及例外／条件式审查表述；另有实验时长数字。

patterns.name: 需要／需要性表述
patterns.context: 句中表达某种行动或批准是“必需的”，后接对象或条件；只有一例。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 参与／参加相关词形
patterns.context: 描述新机制鼓励某群体参与；希腊语词形分片标记。

patterns.name: 直接回应的否定表达
patterns.context: 对话叙述中，人物没有直接回答，随后转述其动作；只出现一次。

patterns.name: 司法裁量／审查中的否定判断
patterns.context: 法院表述裁量决定不受控制，除非存在滥用；相近的“will not … unless”法律句式也见于判决审查。

patterns.name: 法院不尝试详述
patterns.context: 法院说明本文件不会在此详尽列述指控；法律备忘录中的程序性说明。

patterns.name: 否定式评价／可能性陈述
patterns.context: 以“世界上没有什么能……”表达强烈评价；只有一例。

patterns.name: 委员会名义／名义身份
patterns.context: 议会报告由委员会名义提交；激活集中在葡语“代表／以……名义”表达。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会程序文本

patterns.name: 否定缩写中的词干
patterns.context: 英语引语中出现 wasn’t，强激活落在分词后的词干片段；上下文谈及成功人士。

patterns.name: 实验时长数字
patterns.context: 实验步骤中给出过氧化氢处理时长“15 min”；激活落在数字及单位附近。

patterns.name: 法院不会撤销的表述
patterns.context: 说明上诉法院除非满足后续条件，否则不会推翻地区法院决定；与第4段同属法律审查句式，但谓语不同。

en.description: Activations are scattered across languages and genres: English negative forms and restrictive expressions, internal fragments in Spanish and Greek words, and digit substrings in math problems. There is no clear unified semantic or formal feature.

patterns.name: Negative auxiliary and following action in English sentences
patterns.context: English sentences use not in structures such as will not be controlled and will not attempt; activation is especially concentrated on not and the following predicate

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Spanish necesitar
patterns.context: In a Spanish sentence, the verb necesitar is split into subword fragments; the context concerns a requirement for parliamentary approval

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Greek συμμετέχουν
patterns.context: A sequence of Greek subword fragments forms a verb meaning participate, in the context of fisheries policy measures

patterns.name: English adverb directly
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Without directly replying introduces a narrative in which a character does not answer directly

patterns.name: English negative pronoun nothing
patterns.context: A football fan states that nothing in the world can match the emotional experience of football

patterns.name: English negative contraction n't
patterns.context: The character quotation contains wasn’t, in a summary of successful people's flexibility

patterns.name: Mathematical numerical and operator strings
patterns.context: In symbolic math problems, activation falls on numbers or digit substrings; examples involve equations, fractions, algebraic expressions, and evaluation

9_1610.description: 激活分散于不同语言和文体：英语否定形式、否定或限制性表达，西班牙语及希腊语词内片段，以及数学题中的数字子串。各处缺少统一明显的语义或形式特征。

patterns.name: 英语句中否定助动词与后续动作
patterns.context: 英语句子中，否定词 not 出现在 will not be controlled、will not attempt 等结构里；激活尤其集中于 not 及其后续谓语

patterns.name: 西班牙语 necesitar 的词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语句中，动词 necesitar 被分成子词片段；上下文是需要议会批准的条件

patterns.name: 希腊语 συμμετέχουν 的词内片段
patterns.context: 希腊语连续子词片段组成表示参与的动词，处于捕鱼政策措施的语境

patterns.name: 英语副词 directly
patterns.context: 句首 Without directly replying，引出人物没有直接回答的叙事

patterns.name: 英语否定代词 nothing
patterns.context: 足球爱好者陈述世界上没有任何事物能比得上足球带来的情感体验

patterns.name: 英语否定缩写 n't
patterns.context: 人物引语中的缩写 wasn’t，出现在对成功人士灵活性的概括中

patterns.name: 数学数值与运算符号串
patterns.context: 符号化数学题中，激活落在数字或数字子串；涉及方程、分数、代数表达式与求值

en.description: Activations across all segments fall on Bessel, vessel, or word fragments containing essel; contexts include Bessel mathematical terms and names, as well as vessels, microvessels, hulls, and anatomical names. Segment 1 also contains cloak vocabulary, with no clear connection to the main word form.

patterns.name: High-activation substrings in Bessel terminology
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the spelling fragment Bessel or essel near word-internal or word boundaries; examples occur in mathematical terms, names, and vessel-related words.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and science papers, medical papers, patents

patterns.name: Invisibility-cloak vocabulary
patterns.context: Discussion of invisibility cloaks and their shells; Bessel analysis also appears in the same segment.

patterns.name: Vessel and balloon-catheter contexts
patterns.context: Descriptions of balloon overexpansion and balloon-to-vessel ratios.

patterns.name: Microvessel density and tissue assessment
patterns.context: Tissue sections, protein-expression scoring, and microvessel-density quantification occur near one another.

patterns.name: Bessel potentials and kernels
patterns.context: Local properties of Bessel potentials, or discussions of convergence and universality involving Bessel kernels and other kernels.

patterns.name: The name Bessel van der Kolk
patterns.context: The name Bessel van der Kolk appears in writing about bodily imprints and trauma.

patterns.name: The anatomical name Kiesselbach
patterns.context: Appears within the name Kiesselbach plexus in patent descriptions of the nasal septal mucosa and intranasal drug delivery.

patterns.name: Microvessel formation and cytokines
patterns.context: Discussion of IL-19's effects on endothelial cells and microvessel formation.

patterns.name: Vessel structures and deployment
patterns.context: Descriptions of floating hulls and their carried structures, rigid connections, and deployment of underwater objects.

patterns.name: Multivessel disease
patterns.context: Multivessel disease is mentioned among factors associated with stent thrombosis.

9_1724.description: 各段激活都落在 Bessel、vessel 或含 essel 的词形片段上；涵盖 Bessel 数学术语与姓名，以及血管、微血管、船体和解剖名称等语境。第1段另有 cloak 词汇，但与该主词形无明显关联。

patterns.name: Bessel 术语中的高激活子串
patterns.context: 激活集中在拼写片段 Bessel 或词内/词界附近的 essel；出现在数学术语、姓名以及血管相关词中。
patterns.domain: 数学与科学论文、医学论文、专利

patterns.name: 不可见斗篷词汇
patterns.context: 讨论隐形斗篷及其外壳；同段也出现 Bessel 分析。

patterns.name: 血管与球囊导管语境
patterns.context: 球囊过度扩张及 balloon-to-vessel 比值的描述。

patterns.name: 微血管密度与组织评估
patterns.context: 组织切片、蛋白表达评分及微血管密度定量相邻出现。

patterns.name: Bessel 势与核函数
patterns.context: Bessel potentials 的局部性质，或 Bessel 核与其他核的收敛、普适性讨论。

patterns.name: Bessel van der Kolk 姓名
patterns.context: 姓名 Bessel van der Kolk 出现在身体印记与创伤主题的文字中。
patterns.domain: 身心健康类非虚构文字

patterns.name: Kiesselbach 解剖名
patterns.context: 鼻中隔黏膜及鼻腔给药的专利描述中，出现在 Kiesselbach 丛名称内。

patterns.name: 微血管生成与细胞因子
patterns.context: 讨论 IL-19 对内皮细胞及微血管形成的作用。

patterns.name: vessel 结构与部署
patterns.context: 浮动船体及其携带结构、刚性连接和水下物体部署的描述。

patterns.name: 多血管疾病
patterns.context: 列举支架血栓相关因素时提到多血管疾病。

en.description: The strongest and most recurrent signal is word-initial Ind, spanning Indiana, the medical term Indications, and other Ind- words; remaining activations are sporadic, occurring on legal citation numbers, the ending of Trinity, and function words in chemical titles.

patterns.name: Ind-initial forms and the beginning of Indiana
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on word-initial Ind; this may continue as Indiana (e.g., Indiana Hoosiers, Indiana v. Edwards) or form other words.

patterns.name: Indications in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: The beginning of Indications triggers activation; examples occur in contexts involving medical indications, surgery, treatment, or outcomes.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment of Indirect
patterns.context: Word-initial Ind is followed by direct to form indirect; this example also involves a description of light illumination.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Indocyanine green
patterns.context: In the dye name Indocyanine green, activation is distributed across the beginning and subsequent in-word fragments.

patterns.name: Numbers and legal citation format
patterns.context: Reporter volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, and page numbers in U.S. case citations; strong activation falls on the volume-number digits.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Trinity
patterns.context: In the proper name Trinity, activation concentrates on the ending fragment inity; occurs in institution names.

patterns.name: myristicyclin in a chemical name
patterns.context: A synthesis paper title contains synthesis, of, and a racemic marker; myristicyclin A itself is unmarked.

9_1724.description: 最强且反复的信号是词首 Ind，涵盖 Indiana、医学术语 Indications 及其他 Ind- 词；其余激活零散落在法律引证数字、Trinity 词尾和化学标题功能词等处。

patterns.name: Ind- 开头及 Indiana 词首
patterns.context: 激活集中在词首 Ind；后续可接 Indiana（如 Indiana Hoosiers、Indiana v. Edwards），也可继续构成其他词。
patterns.domain: 维基百科标题、医学摘要

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的 Indications
patterns.context: Indications 一词开头触发；出现在医学适应证、手术、治疗或结果相关语境。

patterns.name: Indirect 的词首片段
patterns.context: 词首 Ind 后接 direct，形成 indirect；本例还涉及光线照明的描述。

patterns.name: Indocyanine green 词内片段
patterns.context: 染料名称 Indocyanine green 中，激活分布于词首和后续词内片段。

patterns.name: 数字与法律引证格式
patterns.context: 美国判例引证中的报告卷号、报告集缩写和页码；强激活落在卷号数字。

patterns.name: Trinity 词内片段
patterns.context: 专名 Trinity 中，激活集中于词尾片段 inity；出现在机构名称中。

patterns.name: 化学名称中的 myristicyclin
patterns.context: 合成论文标题中出现合成、of 和外消旋标记；myristicyclin A 本身未标记。
patterns.domain: PubMed 化学/药物研究摘要标题

en.description: The main pattern is token activation on word-initial Ind, especially in Indiana, Indications, Indirect, and Indocyanine; strong activations also occur on webpage source markers and in-word fragments of two Bulgarian words, which cannot be explained by one shared meaning or domain.

patterns.name: Word-initial Ind token activation
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the beginnings of words or phrases starting with Ind; subsequent meanings and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Specific HTML/script markers
patterns.context: In Wikipedia page HTML/JavaScript configuration text, activation falls on specific markers and numbers rather than word-initial Ind.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Bulgarian
patterns.context: Activation falls on an in-word fragment of the Bulgarian word «перспектива», in a sentence about people having prospects in rural areas.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: Bulgarian in-word fragment and HTML
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment of the Bulgarian word «первые»; the word is embedded in HTML paragraph tags and webpage text.

9_1724.concept: 词首 Ind，另有离群激活
9_1724.description: 主要模式是词首 Ind 的分词激活，尤其是 Indiana、Indications、Indirect、Indocyanine；另有网页源码标记及两个保加利亚语词内片段的强激活，无法由同一词义或领域统一解释。

patterns.name: 词首 Ind 分词激活
patterns.trigger: 词首 «Ind»10；随后有时是 «ications»5、«irect»5 或 «ocy»9«anine»8« green»7
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Ind 开头的词或短语开头；后续词义和上下文不固定。

patterns.name: 特定 HTML/脚本标记
patterns.context: 维基百科页面的 HTML/JavaScript 配置文本中，激活落在特定标记与数字上，而非 Ind 词首。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活位于保加利亚语词 «перспектива» 的词内片段，出现在句子谈及人们在乡村地区拥有前景的语境中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会保加利亚语文本

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内片段及 HTML
patterns.context: 激活位于保加利亚语词 «первые» 的开头片段；词语嵌在 HTML 段落标记和网页文本中。

en.concept: Boundaries and markers in technical phrases
en.description: Activations often fall on the ends of quoted technical phrases, titles, search terms, or proper names and their punctuation; they also occur on italicized scientific names, abbreviations, compound terms, numbers, and figure/table references. The shared feature across domains is a local boundary or marker cue, not a single topic.

patterns.name: Bibliographic information and source citation markers
patterns.context: When listing search terms, guideline names, paper titles, or cited content in sequence, especially at the end of quoted phrases and on following punctuation or citation markers
patterns.domain: Bibliographic and citation text in medical literature, patents, academic papers, and technical documents

patterns.name: Phrase endings in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Proper names, work titles, nicknames, or category labels appear as quoted phrases; activation falls at the phrase ending or on immediately following punctuation

patterns.name: Latin scientific names and italic boundaries
patterns.context: Latin scientific names of plant pathogens or microorganisms are set in italics, often alongside species names, disease descriptions, or scientific-name boundaries

patterns.name: Numbers and units/numerical expressions
patterns.context: Ages, years, statistical sample sizes, and measurements for individuals or study samples appear in prose or abstracts

patterns.name: Boundaries within compressed terms and technical names
patterns.context: Technical names formed by joining hyphens, abbreviations, and ordinary words, especially those related to image encoding and data compression

patterns.name: Psychometric/statistical method markers
patterns.context: Abbreviations and terms appearing when papers introduce model coefficients, regression results, or statistical visualizations

patterns.name: Boundaries of professional medical terms or diagnostic categories
patterns.context: Medical diagnoses, disease categories, or clinical guideline titles are listed as phrases, usually in quotation marks

patterns.name: Materials/process phrases and figure/table references
patterns.context: After describing coating materials, construction steps, or experimental subjects, parenthetical term labels and figure/table references provide additional information

9_1724.description: 激活常落在引号内的专业短语、题名、检索词或专名末尾及其标点，也见斜体学名、缩写、复合术语、数值和图表引用；跨领域共享的是局部边界/标记线索，而非单一主题。

patterns.name: 书目信息与来源引文标记
patterns.trigger: 引号中的文献题名或搜索词以逗号分隔，并以引文边界标记收尾，如 “carotid artery disease,”、“Management of cholestatic liver diseases,”、“Real-Time Image Redundancy Reduction Using Transform Coding Techniques,”；也包括 “vitreous finish,” 后的图号标记
patterns.context: 连续列举检索词、指南名称、论文题名或引文内容时，尤其在引号内的短语末尾及其后的标点/引用标记
patterns.domain: 医学文献、专利、学术论文及技术文档中的书目和引文文本

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的短语末尾
patterns.trigger: “Open Arms”、“Faithfully”、“I'll Be Alright Without You”中的 “Faithfully,”；“The Golden Child,”；“Old/Mid School”
patterns.context: 专名、作品名、绰号或类别标签作为引号中的短语出现，激活落在短语末尾或紧随其后的标点
patterns.domain: 百科条目、音乐与人物传记

patterns.name: 拉丁学名及其斜体边界
patterns.trigger: “Rhizoctonia solani”、“Pseudomonas syringae pv.”、“Lachrymans”、“Trichoderma”中的斜体标记 «*»
patterns.context: 植物病原体或微生物拉丁学名以斜体排印，常伴随物种名、病害描述或学名边界
patterns.domain: 植物病理学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 数字与单位/数值表达
patterns.context: 人物或研究样本的年龄、年份、统计样本量及测量值出现在叙述或摘要中
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与百科传记

patterns.name: 压缩术语及技术名称内部边界
patterns.trigger: “cosine-transform/DPCM compression algorithm”及“Transform Coding Techniques”中的复合技术术语
patterns.context: 连字符、缩写与普通词拼接构成的技术名称，尤其与图像编码、数据压缩相关

patterns.name: 心理测量/统计方法标记
patterns.context: 论文中介绍模型系数、回归结果或统计可视化时出现的缩写和术语
patterns.domain: 神经科学与统计方法论文

patterns.name: 专业医学术语或诊断类别边界
patterns.trigger: “cholestatic liver diseases,”及“carotid artery disease,”、“coronary artery disease,”
patterns.context: 医学诊断、疾病类别或临床指南标题以短语形式列出，通常位于引号中

patterns.name: 材料/工艺短语与图表引用
