patterns.context: 描述涂层材料、施工步骤或实验对象后，以括号中的术语标签和图表引用补充说明

en.description: Strong activation primarily occurs on colons that connect a main title to a subtitle in academic titles, across topics such as medicine, engineering, and the environment; there is also a response to quotation marks in methods paragraphs and references to supplementary materials.

patterns.name: Colons in titles
patterns.context: A subtitle, study description, or specific research subject follows the main title; a long noun phrase usually precedes the colon.
patterns.domain: Academic paper titles, especially in medical and scientific literature

patterns.name: Quotation marks in methods passages and supplementary-material references
patterns.context: The main text describes methods or points to supplementary tables, with formatted cross-references.
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper text and supplementary materials

9_1724.concept: 学术文本中的结构标记
9_1724.description: 主要对学术标题中连接主标题与副标题的冒号强烈激活，跨医学、工程、环境等主题；另对方法段落的引号标注及补充材料引用有反应。

patterns.name: 标题中的冒号
patterns.context: 标题主标题之后接副标题、研究说明或具体研究对象；冒号前通常已有较长的名词短语。
patterns.domain: 学术论文标题，尤其是医学与科学文献

patterns.name: 方法文段中的引号与补充材料引用
patterns.context: 正文说明方法或指向补充表格，并出现格式化的交叉引用。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文正文及补充材料

en.concept: Sensitive to formatting boundaries and punctuation
en.description: Activations are distributed across colons and nearby numbers, field labels, percentages, and identifiers; they also occur on fragments of technical compound words, bibliographic title boundaries, and common function words. The corpus is mostly formatted emails and academic abstracts, with no unified pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers and formatted fields before colons
patterns.context: Numbers, times, or identifiers appear densely; activation concentrates on colons and adjacent numbers, often alongside spaces or line breaks
patterns.domain: Formatted text such as email meeting schedules and operations notices

patterns.name: Label headings introduced by colons
patterns.context: An all-caps section label in a report or abstract is followed by a colon; some heading characters are split into marked tokens
patterns.domain: Research grant abstracts, public health research abstracts

patterns.name: Percentages and experimental-condition values
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation in quantitative results, proportions, or experimental conditions; values are usually embedded in sentences

patterns.name: Compound words in disease and research terminology
patterns.context: Technical long words, hyphenated words, or less common terms are split into multiple subword fragments; activations are distributed within and between words

patterns.name: Boundary punctuation in titles, proper names, and bibliographic information
patterns.context: Punctuation and boundary words are activated in research titles, project identifiers, and biographical or bibliographic records

patterns.name: English function words and comparison structures
patterns.context: Prepositions, articles, conjunctions, or comparison words in ordinary sentences; no single stable syntactic environment
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and general academic text

patterns.name: Title case and abbreviation fields
patterns.context: Field labels, abbreviations, and capitalized text in email templates or research abstracts

9_1724.description: 激活分散于冒号及其邻近数字、栏目标签、百分比和编号，也见专业复合词片段、书目标题边界及常见功能词；语料多为格式化邮件和学术摘要，模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 冒号前的数字与格式字段
patterns.context: 数字、时间或标识符密集出现；激活集中在冒号及其相邻数字，常伴随空格或换行
patterns.domain: 邮件会议安排、运维通知等格式化文本

patterns.name: 冒号引出的标签标题
patterns.trigger: “PUBLIC HEALTH RELEVANCE:”“PARTICIPANTS:”“MAIN RESULTS:”中的冒号及标题文字
patterns.context: 报告或摘要中全大写栏目标签之后接冒号，部分标题字符被拆分标记
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要、公共卫生研究摘要

patterns.name: 百分比与实验条件数值
patterns.context: 定量结果、比例或实验条件中的数字和标点；数值通常嵌在句子中

patterns.name: 疾病与研究术语中的复合词
patterns.context: 专业长词、连字符词或较少见术语被拆成多个子词片段；激活散布于词内及词间
patterns.domain: 眼科、药理、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 标题、专名与书目信息的边界标点
patterns.trigger: “Clinical Trial * 15-EI-10038:”“Bonnie Zimmerman interviewed by Susan Sayer”“Lesbian Nation:”“Study”后的引号
patterns.context: 研究标题、项目编号、人物书目记录中，标点和边界词获得激活
patterns.domain: 临床试验登记、访谈/书目记录

patterns.name: 英语功能词及比较结构
patterns.context: 普通句子中的介词、冠词、连词或比较词；并无单一稳定句法环境
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及一般学术文本

patterns.name: 标题式大小写与缩写字段
patterns.context: 邮件模板或科研摘要中的字段标签、缩写和大写格式文本
patterns.domain: 企业运维邮件、科研摘要

en.description: Activations are distributed across genres: structural markers in research text, study-plan titles, and medical terminology; they also occur in recipe steps, Japanese order-status explanations, and news headlines. No single meaning covers all examples.

patterns.name: Punctuation or structural boundaries in medical and research text
patterns.context: In research abstracts, study plans, or paper text, punctuation is followed by objectives, methods, results, headings, or new paragraphs; not all punctuation triggers activation, so consider this alongside other patterns
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, NIH study plans, research reports

patterns.name: Study-plan titles and application terminology
patterns.context: In structured study plans or applications, heading labels and colons introduce objectives, plans, or application descriptions; the recipe step label «Mixture:» also shows strong activation
patterns.domain: NIH grant applications and research plans; also cooking recipes

patterns.name: Specialized discipline terms ending in -ology
patterns.context: Professional medical terms appear in research objectives or care descriptions in the context of cancer treatment research

patterns.name: Acute promyelocytic leukemia terminology
patterns.context: Describes leukemia cells, cell lines, and related biological mechanisms

patterns.name: Kidney-disease section headings
patterns.context: A paper poses, as a question, whether a particular biomarker can distinguish diseases

patterns.name: Katakana words in Japanese order-status explanations
patterns.context: Japanese customer-service or system explanations describing updates to website order status and related information when a receiving function malfunctions
patterns.domain: Japanese technical support or e-commerce explanations

patterns.name: PLAY BALL headline
patterns.context: An all-caps English phrase appears in a news caption or page headline
patterns.domain: News coverage, sports or entertainment pages

patterns.name: Recipe steps and utensil descriptions
patterns.context: Baking or cooking instructions describing oven temperature, a frying pan, and preparation steps

patterns.name: Antibody labels in biomedical research
patterns.context: Describes the therapeutic effects of antibody preparations, vaccines, or tumor models
patterns.domain: Immunology, oncology, and infectious disease research

9_1724.description: 激活分布在多种体裁：科研文本的结构标记、研究计划标题和医学专业术语；另见食谱步骤、日文订单状态说明及新闻标题。没有单一词义能覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: 医学与科研文本中的标点或结构边界
patterns.trigger: 高激活常落在段落或句子边界标点，如 «:»、«.»、«↵»；也包括论文小节标题中的 «?»
patterns.context: 科研摘要、研究计划或论文正文中，标点后接目标、方法、结果、标题或新段落；但并非所有标点都触发，需结合其他模式看
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 研究计划、科研报告

patterns.name: 研究计划标题及申报术语
patterns.context: 结构化研究计划或申请材料中，标题标签和冒号引出目标、方案或应用说明；食谱中的步骤标签 «Mixture:» 也有强激活
patterns.domain: NIH 资助申请、科研计划；另有烹饪食谱

patterns.name: 以 -ology 结尾的专业学科词
patterns.context: 癌症治疗研究语境中，专业医学词出现在研究目标或照护描述里

patterns.name: 急性早幼粒细胞白血病术语
patterns.context: 描述白血病细胞、细胞系及相关生物机制

patterns.name: 肾脏疾病小节标题
patterns.trigger: «Does suPAR Discriminate Primary FSGS from Other Proteinuric Kidney Diseases?»
patterns.context: 论文中以疑问句形式提出特定生物标志物能否鉴别疾病的问题
patterns.domain: 肾脏病学论文小节标题

patterns.name: 日文订单状态说明中的片假名词
patterns.context: 日文客服或系统说明，讲述接收功能异常时网站订单状态等信息的更新
patterns.domain: 日语技术支持或电商说明

patterns.name: PLAY BALL 标题
patterns.context: 新闻图注或版面标题中出现大写英文短语
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、体育或娱乐版面

patterns.name: 食谱步骤与器具描述
patterns.context: 烘焙或烹饪指令，描述烤箱温度、平底锅及准备步骤

patterns.name: 生物医学研究中的抗体标签
patterns.context: 描述抗体制剂、疫苗或肿瘤模型中的治疗作用
patterns.domain: 免疫学、肿瘤学与传染病研究

en.description: The most consistent activation feature across segments is the comma, often at the boundary of a clause, parenthetical, appositive, or list; some segments also involve parentheses, quotations, or punctuation adjacent to line breaks. Languages and topics vary.

patterns.name: Activation on commas and neighboring words
patterns.context: Activation generally falls on comma tokens; words around commas often mark clause, parenthetical, or list boundaries, but languages and content vary.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, including parliamentary speeches, news, encyclopedias, and medical texts

patterns.name: Parentheticals and discourse transitions in French parliament
patterns.context: In French parliamentary contexts, commas set off forms of address, concessive parentheticals, or evaluative phrases from the rest of a sentence.

patterns.name: Commas in English quotations and news sentences
patterns.context: Commas separate place-name abbreviations, quoted information, or appositives; the neuron also activates on punctuation after closing parentheses.

patterns.name: Punctuation after closing parentheses or figure citations
patterns.context: Punctuation occurs near the boundary of an inserted structure formed by parentheses or citation markers.

patterns.name: Speech-marker boundaries in parliamentary transcripts
patterns.context: Commas are adjacent to line breaks or parentheses in descriptions recording collective parliamentary actions.

9_1724.description: 各段激活最一致的特征是逗号，常处于从句、插入语、同位语或列举的边界；部分段还涉及括号、引语或换行相邻的标点。语言与主题多样。

patterns.name: 逗号及其前后词的激活
patterns.context: 激活普遍落在逗号 token；逗号前后常为从句、插入语或列举边界，但具体语言和内容不同。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本；议会发言、新闻、百科及医学文本等

patterns.name: 法语议会中的插入语和话语衔接
patterns.trigger: « chers »collègues« , »« à »observer；« Par dérogation »,；« Le problème », c'est；« avec raison »,
patterns.context: 法语议会语境中，逗号将呼语、让步插入语或评价性短语与句子其余部分分隔。

patterns.name: 英语引语与新闻句中的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号用于地名缩写、引语信息或同位语分隔；神经元也激活在括号闭合后的标点位置。

patterns.name: 括号闭合或图表引用后的标点
patterns.context: 标点位于括号或引用标记构成的插入结构边界附近。

patterns.name: 议会逐字记录中的发言标记边界
patterns.context: 逗号与换行、括号相邻，出现在记录议会集体动作的叙述中。

en.description: The most stable signal is commas and nearby tokens, especially commas after numbers and years; other local patterns include parliamentary forms of address and institutional terms, and Italian che clauses. Some in-word activations cannot be grouped under one semantic topic.

patterns.name: Commas after decimal numbers
patterns.context: A comma follows numerical expressions such as years, dates, and percentages; activation often falls on the numbers and comma.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary speeches and medical texts

patterns.name: In-sentence commas and preceding words
patterns.context: Commas mark pauses, parentheticals, or clause boundaries within sentences; no particular language or topic is required.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary, academic, and legal texts

patterns.name: Forms of address and speech formulas in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: European Parliament speeches or institutional discussions, often with forms of address, names of parliamentary institutions, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Italian «che» clauses/connections
patterns.context: In Italian sentences, introduces a clause or connects subsequent explanation, with a comma immediately following.

patterns.name: Punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Statute numbers are cited in criminal-justice discussions, with a comma after the statutory citation.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations near French word endings and punctuation
patterns.context: Sentence-final periods, line breaks, or in-word token fragments in French prose; aside from punctuation, there is no stable shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Medical statistical expressions
patterns.context: A medical description gives the proportion of cases, with activations near the number, percent sign, and comma.

patterns.name: Other isolated multilingual fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across in-word fragments or ordinary words in different languages, with no consistent trigger apparent from the available context.

9_1724.description: 最稳定的信号是逗号及其邻近 token，尤其数字、年份后逗号；另有议会称呼与机构词、意大利语 che 从句等局部模式，部分词内激活无法归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 十进制数字后逗号
patterns.context: 年份、日期、百分比等数字表达后接逗号；激活常落在数字和逗号上。
patterns.domain: 多语言议会发言及医学文本

patterns.name: 句中逗号及其前词
patterns.trigger: 逗号，常与前面的词共同激活，如 « que»6«,»10、« arrivée»6«,»8、« che»4«,»8
patterns.context: 逗号用于句中停顿、插入语或从句边界；不要求特定语言或主题。
patterns.domain: 多语言议会、学术及法律文本

patterns.name: 议会演讲中的称呼与发言程式
patterns.trigger: « Monsieur le Président»、« La Présidente»、« Chers collègues»、« Le Parlement»
patterns.context: 欧洲议会演讲或机构讨论，常伴随称呼、议会机构名称及标点。

patterns.name: 意大利语「che」从句/衔接
patterns.context: 意大利语句中引出从句或衔接后续说明，逗号紧随其后。
patterns.domain: 意大利语学术及议会文本

patterns.name: 法律条文引证标点
patterns.context: 刑事司法讨论中引用法规编号，逗号出现在条文引证之后。

patterns.name: 法语词尾与标点附近的零散激活
patterns.context: 法语叙述中句末句点、换行或词内分词片段；除标点外没有稳定的共享词义模式。

patterns.name: 医学统计表达
patterns.context: 医学描述中给出病例比例，数字、百分号及逗号附近激活。

patterns.name: 其他孤立多语种片段
patterns.context: 激活散落于不同语言的词内片段或普通词，现有上下文看不出一致触发条件。
patterns.domain: 意大利语、法语、西班牙语文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across line breaks and punctuation, fragments of proper names and dates, French word forms, paper and code-format markers, and a few contextual words; there is no stable cross-domain semantic or grammatical commonality, making it difficult to assign a single function.

patterns.name: English sentence-final punctuation and line breaks
patterns.context: A line break follows the end of a sentence or paragraph, especially when the text consists of multiple paragraphs or headings
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, papers, and code repository documentation

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names and dates
patterns.context: Subword fragments within proper names, dates, or words; they occur across languages and formats without a unifying semantic condition
patterns.domain: News, parliamentary speeches, paper metadata, and general English

patterns.name: earlier in expressions of uncertainty
patterns.context: Discusses communication, change, or uncertainty by describing the state of earlier communication

patterns.name: appears in author-submission notes
patterns.context: The phrase «As this appears to have been submitted by the author», used to speculate about the submitter's identity

patterns.name: French word forms and pronoun fragments
patterns.context: Words, inflectional endings, or split word forms in French parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Formatting markers and code metadata
patterns.context: Structural markers in lists, copyright notices, or YAML/YAML-like paper metadata
patterns.domain: GitHub project documentation, ArXiv paper dumps

patterns.name: Season narrative in sports coverage
patterns.context: News narrative about Boston and Montreal matches and the teams' season prospects

patterns.name: Formula-title separators in scientific text
patterns.context: Formatting structure when the body of a paper transitions to a heading or section

9_1724.description: 激活分散在换行和标点、专名日期片段、法语词形、论文与代码格式标记，以及少数语境词上；跨领域缺乏稳定词义或语法共性，难以归为单一功能。

patterns.name: 英文句末标点与换行
patterns.context: 句子或段落结束后紧接换行，尤其文本由多个段落或标题组成时
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括新闻、论文、代码库说明

patterns.name: 专名与日期中的片段
patterns.context: 专名、日期或词语内部的子词片段；不同语种和格式中均出现，缺少统一词义条件
patterns.domain: 新闻、议会发言、论文元数据及普通英文

patterns.name: 不确定性表达中的 earlier
patterns.context: 讨论沟通、变化或不确定性时，说明较早沟通的状况

patterns.name: 作者提交说明中的 appears
patterns.context: 短语 «As this appears to have been submitted by the author»，用于推测提交者身份

patterns.name: 法语词形与代词片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中的词语、屈折词尾或被切分的词形

patterns.name: 格式化标记及代码元数据
patterns.context: 列表、版权声明或 YAML/类 YAML 论文元数据的结构性标记
patterns.domain: Github 项目说明、ArXiv 论文转储

patterns.name: 体育报道中的赛季叙述
patterns.context: 关于波士顿与蒙特利尔比赛及球队赛季前景的新闻叙述

patterns.name: 科学文本中的公式标题分隔
patterns.trigger: «Basic Formulae»后的 «↵»9 和等号分隔线
patterns.context: 论文正文转入标题或章节时的排版结构

en.description: All snippets are academic papers. Activations concentrate around section headings, separators, the start of body text after headings, and metadata; there are also local triggers such as citations, terminology, and subject-specific keywords, while the topics themselves vary widely.

patterns.name: Section-heading boundaries and styles
patterns.context: Activations often fall on a newline, heading text, or separator beneath a heading; the text appears at the start of a paper or at a section transition.
patterns.domain: ArXiv and PubMed Central academic papers

patterns.name: Body text beginning near a heading
patterns.context: Occurs when body text begins after a section heading; activations may fall at the start of the first sentence or on a nearby token. Sentence topics vary.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and abstract-like front matter
patterns.context: The paper title, date, keywords, or front matter between the title and body; the body topic need not be consistent.
patterns.domain: ArXiv paper metadata or preprint format

patterns.name: References and citation markers
patterns.context: Citation or footnote markers appear in the body, near a heading, or in front matter.

patterns.name: Proper nouns, abbreviations, and terminology lists
patterns.context: Near technical terms, abbreviations, or classification keywords; activations may fall on the terms themselves or adjacent structural markers.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: chromosomes and cell imaging
patterns.context: Discusses cell division, chromosome states, or imaging methods.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: tumor cells
patterns.context: The title or opening of a biomedical paper discusses circulating tumor cells and malignant properties.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: quantum and condensed-matter physics
patterns.context: The title or introduction of a physics paper discusses quantum dots, antiferromagnetic spin ladders, or magnetic fields.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: mathematical topology
patterns.context: Discusses preimages of regular values, manifolds, or pseudoholomorphic maps.

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: signal processing and error correction
patterns.context: The title and introduction concern signal degradation, error correction, or image restoration.
patterns.domain: Applied mathematics or signal processing papers

patterns.name: Specific keyword cluster: astronomical observation methods
patterns.context: Discusses occultation spectroscopy methods and their data analysis or results.

patterns.name: Formatting noise outside headings
patterns.context: The activation distribution includes newlines, Markdown/LaTeX-like formatting, punctuation, or split subword fragments, which do not necessarily correspond to stable semantic triggers.
patterns.domain: Typesetting and transcription formats in paper corpora

9_1724.description: 所有片段均为学术论文，激活集中在章节标题、分隔线、标题后正文起始及元数据附近；另有引用、术语与各学科主题词等局部触发，主题本身差异很大。

patterns.name: 章节标题边界与标题样式
patterns.trigger: «↵» 后的章节标题，如 “Parity Invariance”“General Remarks”“Results and Discussion”“Introduction”“Pseudo quotient maps”，以及其后的 “=================” 或 “------------”
patterns.context: 激活常落在换行、标题文字或标题下方的分隔线；文本处于论文开篇或章节切换位置。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 学术论文

patterns.name: 标题附近的正文起始
patterns.trigger: 标题或分隔线后首句的开头，如 “A parity transformation”“The final difference spectrum”“Communication between the nucleus”“The corruption of signals by”“Spin ladder systems have been”“The time evolution of”
patterns.context: 章节标题之后进入正文时出现，激活可落在首句开头或其邻近 token；句子内容领域各异。

patterns.name: 论文元数据与摘要式前置材料
patterns.trigger: “title:”“date:”“[Keywords]”“Error-correcting codes and image restoration”“Spin correlations in the two-leg antiferromagnetic ladder”
patterns.context: 论文标题、日期、关键词或标题与正文之间的前置区域；不要求正文主题相同。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文元数据或预印本格式

patterns.name: 参考文献与引用标记
patterns.context: 引用或脚注标记出现在正文、标题附近或前置文本中。

patterns.name: 专名、缩写与术语列表
patterns.context: 技术术语、缩写或分类关键词附近；激活可能落在术语本身或紧邻的结构标记上。
patterns.domain: 跨学科科学论文及术语表

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：染色体与细胞成像
patterns.context: 讨论细胞分裂过程、染色体状态或成像方法。

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：肿瘤细胞
patterns.context: 生物医学论文标题或引言开头讨论循环肿瘤细胞及恶性特征。

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：量子与凝聚态物理
patterns.context: 物理学论文标题或引言讨论量子点、反铁磁自旋梯或磁场。

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：数学拓扑
patterns.trigger: “inverse images of regular values”“manifolds”“Pseudo quotient maps”
patterns.context: 讨论正则值逆像、流形或伪商映射。

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：信号处理与纠错
patterns.trigger: “Error-correcting codes and image restoration”“The corruption of signals”
patterns.context: 标题及引言涉及信号受损、纠错或图像恢复。
patterns.domain: 应用数学或信号处理论文

patterns.name: 特定主题词簇：天文观测方法
patterns.context: 讨论掩星光谱方法及其数据分析或结果。

patterns.name: 非标题位置的格式噪声
patterns.trigger: “[@mb:1+1]”“oc”以及日期、标点、分隔符等邻近片段
patterns.context: 激活分布包含换行、Markdown/LaTeX 式格式、标点或被拆分的词片段，未必对应稳定语义触发。
patterns.domain: 论文语料的排版与转写格式

en.description: Activations are scattered across multilingual corpora: common function words, subword fragments within words, punctuation, and newline separators all occur. There are also dates and numbers, IRC questions, academic terminology, names and place names, and sporadic subword fragments across different styles, without a stable semantic or domain pattern.

patterns.name: French « le/les/une» and similar words after commas
patterns.context: Across languages and genres, short function words or common words appear after commas, sentence boundaries, or phrase structures; trigger positions are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, English comments, news, literature

patterns.name: Subword fragments in tokenized words or inflections
patterns.context: Italian, French, English, and other words are split into subword tokens; activations fall on within-word fragments or word-form boundaries, without a single shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: IRC, parliamentary text, papers, editorial lists

patterns.name: Punctuation, separators, and formatting markers
patterns.context: Near newlines, commas, or title separators made of repeated symbols; several passages also contain other activated words, so the formatting marker cannot be identified as the primary trigger.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary records, academic papers, journal editorial lists

patterns.name: Numeric years and ordinal-like numbers
patterns.context: Numbers appear in dates or year expressions in parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: Questions and colloquial words in dialogue
patterns.context: In an IRC conversation, a user asks what to do after logging in; a bot explains the steps after entering a username and password.

patterns.name: English nouns and subheadings in technical discussion
patterns.context: Academic text discusses the electroweak field or siRNA design, with newlines and heading separators nearby.

patterns.name: Location information after a name
patterns.context: An editorial list gives a city and country after a name; activations occur on a subword in Tokyo and adjacent formatting markers.

patterns.name: Name and verb fragments in reporting
patterns.context: The former occurs in a date in a parliamentary speech; the latter occurs in a person's name and a news sentence about the economy. They cannot be grouped under a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in English design reviews
patterns.context: The sentence defines design and contrasts appearance with function; activations fall on common English expressions.

patterns.name: Pronoun fragments within a literary sentence
patterns.context: In a literary sentence about how words can comfort and constrain, activations concentrate on fragments of a contraction.

patterns.name: Verb fragments in Portuguese parliamentary phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses moving a vote to the following day and considering the matter; activations fall on verb tokens in Portuguese constructions.

9_1724.concept: 多语种常见子词与边界
9_1724.description: 激活分散于多语种语料：常见功能词、词内子词片段、标点与换行分隔符均有出现；另见日期数字、IRC疑问、学术术语、人名地名及不同文体中的零散词片段，未形成稳定语义或领域模式。

patterns.name: 法语文中逗号后的 « le/les/une» 等词
patterns.trigger: [2] «,»,« une»；[3] «,»,« cet»；[4] «something» 后的 « looks»；[7] « the»；[9] « are»；[10] « ser»
patterns.context: 多种语种与文体中，逗号、句界或短语结构之后出现短功能词或常见词；触发位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 议会发言、英文评论、新闻、文学

patterns.name: 分词或词形中的子词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语、法语、英语等词被切成子词 token，激活落在词内片段或词形边界；缺少单一共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: IRC、议会文本、论文、编辑名单

patterns.name: 标点、分隔符及格式标记
patterns.context: 换行、逗号或由重复符号构成的标题分隔线附近；若干段同时含其他激活词，不能确定格式标记是主要触发因素。
patterns.domain: 议会记录、学术论文、期刊编辑名单

patterns.name: 数字年份及序数式数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在议会发言的日期或年份表达中。

patterns.name: 对话中的疑问与口语词
patterns.context: IRC对话中，用户询问登录后该做什么；机器人回答输入用户名和密码后的步骤。

patterns.name: 科技论述中的英文名词与小标题
patterns.context: 学术文本谈及电弱场或 siRNA 设计，附近有换行和标题分隔符。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 姓名后的来自地信息
patterns.context: 编辑名单中姓名后标注城市、国家；激活出现在 Tokyo 的子词和相邻格式标记。

patterns.name: 人名及报道中的动词片段
patterns.context: 前者处在议会发言的日期中，后者处在经济新闻的人名和报道句中；无法归为同一语义触发。

patterns.name: 英文设计评论中的词内片段
patterns.context: 句子定义设计，并对比外观与功能；激活落在常见英文表达中。

patterns.name: 文学句中的代词词内片段
patterns.context: 关于文字具有安慰和约束作用的文学性句子中，激活集中在缩写词片段。

patterns.name: 葡语议会表述中的动词片段
patterns.context: 讨论将投票移至次日并审议该问题；激活落在葡语结构中的动词 token。

en.description: Activations occur across genres: line-numbered and formatted legal texts, French parliamentary speeches, technical discussions, descriptions of organizational information, and paper titles. “Sounds like” appears in forums and emails, alongside technical “looks like”; overall, there is no unified topic or stable trigger word.

patterns.name: “Sounds like” evaluative opening
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or new sentence, followed by a brief judgment about preceding content; other passages use “sounds …” evaluatively, but not the same complete phrase.

patterns.name: Legal document structure and numbering
patterns.context: Occurs near court names, rulings, citations, or numbering, especially in formatted legal text after a newline.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Political phrases in French parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: In French parliamentary speeches, addressing colleagues and mentioning terrorist attacks and related people.
patterns.domain: French speeches in the European Parliament

patterns.name: Spaceflight control and landing descriptions
patterns.context: Technically compares control logic during a booster’s descent phase and landing methods.

patterns.name: Organizational information transparency and real-time visibility
patterns.context: Describes information visibility across an organization and its beneficiaries, followed by evaluative language.

patterns.name: “Looks like” similarity expression
patterns.context: In a technical discussion, compares a system or requirement to something else; preceding text discusses NoSQL, complexity, and ACID.

patterns.name: Paper subsection headings and formal notation
patterns.context: After a section heading and separator, variables are defined or mathematical results are stated.

9_1724.description: 激活分布在多种体裁中：法律文本的换行编号与格式、法语议会发言、技术讨论、组织信息描述及论文标题。论坛和邮件中可见“Sounds like”，另有技术类“looks like”；整体缺少统一的主题或稳定触发词。

patterns.name: “Sounds like”评价开头
patterns.context: 句首或新句开头，后接对前述内容的简短判断；另有段落以“sounds …”表达评价，但并非相同的完整短语。

patterns.name: 法律文书结构与编号
patterns.context: 出现在法院名称、裁判说明、引注或编号附近，尤其是换行后的格式化法律文本。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及法律文书

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的政治词句
patterns.context: 法语议会演说中称呼同僚、提及恐怖袭击和相关人物。

patterns.name: 太空飞行控制与着陆描述
patterns.context: 对助推器下降阶段的控制逻辑及着陆方式作技术比较。

patterns.name: 组织信息透明与实时可见性
patterns.context: 描述组织范围内的信息可见性及其服务对象，随后带有评价语气。

patterns.name: “looks like”相似性表达
patterns.context: 技术讨论中将某系统或需求与另一事物作类比；其前文谈NoSQL、复杂度与ACID。

patterns.name: 论文小节标题与形式化记号
patterns.context: 章节标题、分隔线之后开始定义变量或陈述数学结果。
patterns.domain: 数学或计算机科学论文

en.description: Primarily activates on words such as sounds/sounded and look/looks that express auditory impressions or appearance; there are also discrete patterns involving Spanish word forms, fragments in French discussion of Irish, and legal document formatting symbols.

patterns.name: Sound or auditory impression
patterns.context: Sounds/sounded follows a sound subject or described object to express how it sounds; it is sometimes followed by an adjective or a like phrase.
patterns.domain: Reviews, product discussions, music, narrative; includes [2], [4], [5], [8], [10]

patterns.name: Appearance or action presentation
patterns.context: Describes how a design looks, or asks to make a dangerous operation look dangerous; the trigger is look/looks, not a sound word.
patterns.domain: Design reviews and software interface suggestions; includes [3], [6]

patterns.name: French verb-form fragments
patterns.context: A word ending or internal fragment of a verb form is marked in a Spanish sentence, with no clear semantic condition shared with other highly activated passages.

patterns.name: Irish name and language status
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses interpretation services for Irish and its recognition as an independent language; activations are scattered across within-word fragments.
patterns.domain: European Parliament interpretation and language policy; includes [1]

patterns.name: Newlines and legal formatting markers
patterns.context: Activations occur on layout markers such as newlines, asterisks, and numbering in court documents; distinct from adjacent legal body text.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court decision formatting; includes [9]

9_1724.concept: 感知印象表达，兼有离散模式
9_1724.description: 主要对 sounds/sounded 及 look/looks 这类表达听觉印象或外观呈现的词激活；另有西班牙语词形、法语爱尔兰语讨论中的片段，以及法律文件排版符号等离散模式。

patterns.name: 声音或听觉印象
patterns.context: 声音主语或描述对象后出现 sounds/sounded，用来表达听起来如何；有时后接形容词或 like 短语。

patterns.name: 外观或动作呈现
patterns.context: 描述设计看起来如何，或要求让危险操作显得危险；触发词为 look/looks，而非声音词。
patterns.domain: 设计评论与软件界面建议；涵盖 [3]、[6]

patterns.name: 法语动词词形片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语句子中动词词形的词尾或内部片段被标记，未见与其他高激活段共享的明显语义条件。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学论述；涵盖 [7]

patterns.name: 爱尔兰语名称及语言地位
patterns.context: 法语句子讨论爱尔兰语的解释服务及其作为独立语言获承认；激活分散在词内片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会口译与语言政策；涵盖 [1]

patterns.name: 换行及法律格式标记
patterns.context: 法院文件中的换行、星号和编号等排版标记处激活；区别于相邻法律正文。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院判决格式；涵盖 [9]

en.description: Primarily activates on auditory evaluations with sound/sounds and “Sounds like”-style inferences or analogical reactions. There are also adjacent appearance and impression words, as well as activation on a time word in an encyclopedia passage, which does not fit the stable primary pattern.

patterns.name: Sound judgment or evaluation
patterns.context: sound/sounds is used as a sensory or evaluative verb, followed by an adjective, comparative construction, or evaluative phrase; it may refer to actual auditory impressions or serve as a “sounds good/cool” type of response.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, everyday conversation, forum discussions

patterns.name: “Sounds like” inference or analogy
patterns.context: Sounds/sound is followed by like, introducing an inference, impression, possibility, or similar object.

patterns.name: Evaluative/perceptual expressions near sound-related words
patterns.context: Occurs in the same passage as a sound judgment, often describing appearance, impressions, or conjecture before or after it; these words are not stable triggers shared by all passages.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, reviews of products or objects

patterns.name: Time-narrative word
patterns.context: A time phrase in a historical account; it has no clear connection to the sound evaluations or sounds-like constructions in the other passages.

9_1724.description: 主要对 sound/sounds 的听感评价及“Sounds like”式推断或类比反应。另有相邻的外观、印象词，以及一段百科时间词激活，不能归入稳定主模式。

patterns.name: 声音判断或评价
patterns.trigger: “sounds huge”“Sounds good to me”“Sounds really cool”“they sound as good as they look”
patterns.context: sound/sounds 作感官或评价动词，后接形容词、比较结构或评价短语；既可指实际听感，也可作“听起来不错/很酷”式回应。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、日常对话、论坛讨论

patterns.name: “Sounds like”推断或类比
patterns.trigger: “Sounds like a job”“sound like a chain saw”“tgethr sounds like T gethr”“Sounds like it might be a little more expensive”“Sounds like non-drivable”
patterns.context: Sounds/sound 后接 like，引出推断、印象、可能性或相似对象。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、产品讨论、邮件

patterns.name: 声音相关词附近的评价/感知表达
patterns.context: 与声音判断同段出现，常在声音评价前后描述外观、印象或推测；这些词并非各段共有的稳定触发项。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、对产品或物件的评论

patterns.name: 时间叙述词
patterns.context: 历史说明中的时间短语；与其余段落的声音评价或 sounds like 结构无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式技术史叙述

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the evaluative expression “looks”: commenters judge how something appears based on context, followed by an adjective or like phrase. It also responds to the evaluative expression “Sounds like,” meaning something sounds or gives an impression of being a certain way.

patterns.name: Evaluating appearance or impression
patterns.context: The subject is often it; judges a product, price, project, school, photo, or work, followed by an adjective or a judgment introduced by like.
patterns.domain: HackerNews comment threads, covering tech products, work and life, education, images, and art

patterns.name: How something sounds
patterns.context: Begins with Sounds to express an impression of a team or app, followed by a like phrase.

9_1724.description: 主要对评价性表达“looks”强烈响应：评论者依据上下文判断事物看起来如何，后接形容词或 like 短语；另对“Sounds like”这一听起来像/给人印象的评价表达响应。

patterns.name: 评价外观或观感
patterns.context: 主语多为 it；对产品、价格、项目、学校、照片或作品作判断，后接形容词或 like 引出的判断内容。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论对话，涵盖科技产品、就业与生活、教育、图片及艺术

patterns.name: 声音听起来如何
patterns.context: 以 Sounds 开头表达对团队或应用的印象，后接 like 短语。

en.description: Primarily responds to colloquial phrases that express inference, impression, evaluation, or agreement in dialogue, especially “Sounds like,” “sounds good,” and “seems to”; it also responds to “Immediately after” in technical descriptions.

patterns.name: Sounds like evaluation or inference
patterns.context: A judgment or inference about preceding information, meaning it sounds or looks like something; followed by a noun phrase, evaluation, or suggestion.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, Ubuntu IRC, and forum-style online conversations

patterns.name: Sounds + evaluative word
patterns.context: Sounds is followed directly by an adjective as a positive evaluation, without like.

patterns.name: Sounds good
patterns.context: Uses sounds good to express agreement or acceptance of a proposal.

patterns.name: Looks like inference
patterns.context: Makes an inference based on current information, followed by a clause.

patterns.name: Seems to as inference
patterns.context: Uses seem to to introduce a conjecture about a property or state.

patterns.name: After outside dialogue
patterns.context: The time adverb immediately modifies after, introducing the period following glass-fiber drawing.

9_1724.description: 主要响应对话中表达推断、印象、评价或赞同的口语短语，尤以“Sounds like”“sounds good”“seems to”为主；另响应技术说明里的“Immediately after”。

patterns.name: Sounds like 评价或推断
patterns.context: 对前文信息作出听来像是、看起来像是的判断或推断；后接名词短语、评价或建议。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、Ubuntu IRC 和论坛式网络对话

patterns.name: Sounds + 评价词
patterns.context: Sounds 后直接接形容词作积极评价，不带 like。

patterns.name: Sounds good
patterns.context: 以 sounds good 表示赞同或接受提议。

patterns.name: Looks like 推断
patterns.context: 依据当前信息作出推断，后接从句。

patterns.name: Seems to 表推断
patterns.context: 用 seem to 引出对性质或状态的推测。

patterns.name: 非对话中的 after
patterns.context: 时间副词 immediately 修饰 after，引出玻璃纤维拉制后的时间阶段。

en.concept: Temporal adjacency expressions, with sporadic phrases
en.description: Primarily sensitive to temporal adjacency expressions introduced by immediately, especially after, following, upon, and before; there are also sporadic activations on day in specific dates, affirmative email replies, expressions of organizational composition, and the Portuguese time phrase “last year.”

patterns.name: Immediately-based temporal adjacency expressions
patterns.context: A time adverb directly introduces an event or time point, often meaning “immediately after/before.”

patterns.name: day as a temporal anchor
patterns.context: day refers to the date on which a particular event occurs, or is used to compare adjacent days; in some examples it co-occurs with immediately.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, legal narratives, informal comments

patterns.name: Positive response phrase
patterns.context: A brief affirmative reply to a travel arrangement in an email.

patterns.name: made up composition expression
patterns.context: The subject is an organization, followed by a description of the associations that make it up.

patterns.name: Portuguese time word
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence mentions the past year; highlights are scattered across multiple subwords after tokenization, with the strongest activation on a subword in ano.
patterns.domain: Portuguese speeches in the European Parliament

9_1724.concept: 时间邻接表达，伴随零散词组
9_1724.description: 主要对 immediately 引出的时间邻接表达敏感，尤其 after、following、upon、before；另对具体日期中的 day、邮件肯定语、组织组成表达及葡萄牙语“去年”时间短语有零散激活。

patterns.name: immediately 时间邻接表达
patterns.context: 时间副词紧接着引出某事件或时间点；多为“紧接……之后/之前”。
patterns.domain: 专利、法律文本、历史叙述

patterns.name: day 作时间锚点
patterns.context: day 指某个具体事件发生的日子，或用于对比相邻日子的情形；在部分例子中与 immediately 同现。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、法律叙述、非正式评论

patterns.name: 正面回应短语
patterns.context: 邮件中对行程安排作简短肯定回应。

patterns.name: made up 构成表达
patterns.context: 主语为组织，后接其由若干协会组成的说明。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语时间词
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中提及过去一年；高亮分散在分词后的多个子词，最强处为 ano 的子词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语发言

en.description: Primarily responds to explicit temporal anchoring and adjacency expressions (day, immediately, moment); it also activates on colloquial analogical phrases “sounds/looks like” and HTML tag structures, showing multiple distinct patterns.

patterns.name: Specific date or adjacent day
patterns.context: Refers to the day an event occurred, or uses “the day before/after” to describe the temporal relationship between adjacent events.

patterns.name: Temporal adjacency expressions
patterns.context: Emphasizes that an event occurs immediately after another event or at a specific moment.
patterns.domain: Patent descriptions, historical narratives, French parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: “sounds/looks like” judgment
patterns.context: Uses a sensory or appearance-based analogy to introduce an evaluation, inference, or suggestion; not limited to literal sound or vision.

patterns.name: HTML tags and code structure
patterns.context: Closing tags, tags, and attributes appear in HTML/JavaScript snippets.

9_1724.description: 主要响应明确的时间定位与紧邻时间表达（day、immediately、moment）；另对口语类比句式“sounds/looks like”和HTML标签结构有激活，呈现多个不同模式。

patterns.name: 具体日期或相邻日
patterns.context: 指某事件发生的当天，或以“the day before/after”说明相邻事件的时间关系。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科技讨论、历史叙述

patterns.name: 紧邻时间表达
patterns.trigger: “Immediately after drawing”“years immediately before”“au moment où”
patterns.context: 强调某事件紧接另一事件发生，或强调事件发生的特定时刻。
patterns.domain: 专利说明、历史叙述、法语议会发言

patterns.name: “sounds/looks like”判断
patterns.context: 用感知或外观类比来引出评价、推测或建议；不限于字面声音或视觉。

patterns.name: HTML 标签与代码结构
patterns.context: HTML/JavaScript 片段中出现闭合标签、标签和属性。

en.description: Activations concentrate on HTML tags, list/subnavigation structures, and closing boundaries in source code; there are also date-reference phrases, document headings/table formatting, numeric markers, and a few hyphenated compounds. There is only local overlap across different text types.

patterns.name: Relative date expressions
patterns.context: A date or time-reference phrase appears in a sentence; in [1], “the day” refers to the day the device was put into service, [2] means the day after an election victory, and [7] occurs in a pre-battle narrative.
patterns.domain: News reports, technical reviews, historical encyclopedias

patterns.name: HTML list and subnavigation markers
patterns.context: In HTML/template code, lists, navigation containers, and closing tags are nested consecutively across newlines; [3]–[6] all contain subnavigation structures.
patterns.domain: Github web templates or documentation source

patterns.name: Boundary/closing symbols in code or markup
patterns.context: Paired or consecutive closing markers and tag boundaries in source code, often adjacent to newlines and indentation; [8] is also an HTML document structure.

patterns.name: Heading and field structure in HTML documents
patterns.context: An HTML document organizes explanatory text with headings, paragraphs, or emphasis tags, with source structure before and after the tags.

patterns.name: Table separators and document heading markers
patterns.context: Structural punctuation and formatting markers in headings, field tables, or article titles; [10] is a Markdown-style data dictionary, while [9] is a news/article headline.

patterns.name: Date numbers and currency symbols
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in technical descriptions or economic narratives, adjacent to currency symbols, field headings, or version labels; examples are sparse, so it is unclear whether this is a separate semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Hyphenated compounds and proper-name segmentation
patterns.context: Hyphens in compounds or proper names and their adjacent words are shown as split fragments; this occurs in only a few passages.
patterns.domain: Technical reviews, historical texts, news headlines

9_1724.description: 激活集中于源码中HTML标签、列表/子导航结构及闭合边界；另见日期定位短语、文档标题/表格格式、数字标记和少量连字符复合词。不同文本类型间仅有局部重合。

patterns.name: 相对日期表达
patterns.trigger: “the day” [2]；“the day”在“out of date the day the machine is put in the field”中 [1]；“immediately before war was declared”中的“immediately” [7]
patterns.context: 日期或时间定位短语出现在句子中；[1] 的“the day”表示设备投入使用之日，[2] 表示选举胜利后的次日，[7] 则是临战时间叙述。
patterns.domain: 新闻报道、技术评论、历史百科

patterns.name: HTML 列表与子导航标记
patterns.context: HTML/模板代码中，列表、导航容器及闭合标签在换行间连续嵌套；[3]–[6]均有子导航结构。
patterns.domain: Github 网页模板或文档源码

patterns.name: 代码或标记语言中的边界/闭合符号
patterns.context: 源码中成对或连续的闭合标记、标签边界，常与换行和缩进相邻；[8]也是HTML文档结构。

patterns.name: HTML 文档中的标题与字段结构
patterns.context: HTML文档以标题、段落或强调标签组织说明文字，标签前后有源码结构。

patterns.name: 表格分隔符与文档标题标记
patterns.context: 标题、字段表或文章标题的结构性标点与格式标记；[10]是Markdown式数据字典，[9]是新闻/文章标题。

patterns.name: 日期数字与货币符号
patterns.context: 数字嵌在技术说明或经济叙述中，并与货币符号、字段标题或版本标签相邻；样例较少，无法确认是否为独立语义模式。

patterns.name: 连字符复合词与专名切分
patterns.context: 复合词或专名中的连字符及其邻接词被拆分呈现；仅少数段落出现。
patterns.domain: 技术评论、历史文本、新闻标题

en.description: Primarily responds to indented whitespace in legal documents and Eighth Circuit Court headings; also responds to indentation in email columns, sample-size and drug-dose numbers in medical abstracts, and code indentation.

patterns.name: Indented whitespace in page headers
patterns.context: Spaces indent the start of lines in court document headers or title layouts; the strongest responses often fall on longer runs of whitespace.

patterns.name: Eighth Circuit Court name
patterns.context: The court name appears in a heading, especially “Eighth Circuit Court of Appeals,” written across lines in uppercase; some passages also contain formatting elements such as case numbers and party captions.

patterns.name: Indented column headings in email templates
patterns.context: Spaces align promotional publication headers and column headings at the end of email bodies.

patterns.name: Sample-size numbers in medical abstracts
patterns.context: Statistical formatting around sample-size numbers, parentheses, commas, and other punctuation when clinical study abstracts list different patient groups.

patterns.name: Chemotherapy dose numbers
patterns.context: Drug doses are expressed as numbers followed by mg in rectal cancer treatment regimens; activation is concentrated on the oxaliplatin dose.

patterns.name: Indentation whitespace in code
patterns.context: Long whitespace indentation in code lines, near command, path, or file-handling fragments.

9_1732.concept: 排版空白与格式化文本
9_1732.description: 主要响应法律文书中缩进空白及第八巡回法院抬头；另对邮件栏目缩进、医学摘要中的样本量与药物剂量数字，以及代码缩进有响应。

patterns.name: 页眉缩进空白
patterns.context: 法院文件页眉或标题排版中，行首用空格缩进；最强响应常落在较长的空白串上。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 第八巡回法院名称
patterns.trigger: «United States Court of Appeals»、«FOR THE EIGHTH CIRCUIT»、«For the Eighth Circuit»
patterns.context: 法院抬头中出现法院名称，尤其是大小写分行书写的“第八巡回上诉法院”；部分段落也有案号、当事人标题等格式元素。

patterns.name: 邮件模板中的缩进栏目标题
patterns.context: 邮件正文末尾的宣传刊物页眉及栏目标题前，以空格对齐版面。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的样本量数字
patterns.context: 临床研究摘要列举不同患者组时，样本量数字及其前后的括号、逗号等统计格式。

patterns.name: 化疗剂量数字
patterns.context: 直肠癌治疗方案中，药物剂量以数字加 mg 表示；激活集中于奥沙利铂剂量。

patterns.name: 代码中的缩进空白
patterns.context: 代码行中长空白缩进，附近包含命令、路径或文件处理片段。

en.description: The most stable commonality is sentence-initial “We” and the statements that follow, especially proposals, evaluations, and findings in NIH abstracts; it also activates on HIV terminology and local word sequences such as announcements and questions in Enron emails.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial “We” and following statements
patterns.context: First-person plural subject at the start of a sentence, followed by research statements, aims, or findings; activation extends to several subsequent tokens.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts and business email

patterns.name: HIV-related biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Fragments about HIV susceptibility in biomedical contexts; no sentence-initial “We”.

patterns.name: Research proposals and intervention aims
patterns.context: Proposes research plans related to nutritional interventions and physical activity.

patterns.name: Research evaluation plans
patterns.context: Describes the impact of something and its duration in the future tense.

patterns.name: Writing traces and questions in email
patterns.context: Email fragments containing repeated or possibly split forms of “We”, sentence-final punctuation, and question openings; local token boundaries are unusual.

patterns.name: Business announcement wording
patterns.context: Announces a person or matter in a formal, polite tone; followed by the name Dave Delain.

patterns.name: Biomedical research findings and subjects
patterns.context: States research findings related to receptors, viruses, or targeted therapies; sentences in the passage are incomplete.

patterns.name: Descriptions of research areas or directions
patterns.context: Describes better defining the natural history of an object.

patterns.name: Omics methods
patterns.context: Proposes using quantitative proteomics methods; “proteomics” is split into multiple tokens.

9_1732.description: 最稳定的共同点是句首“We”及其后续陈述，尤其是NIH摘要中的提案、评估和研究发现；另对HIV术语及Enron邮件中的公告、问句等局部词串激活。

patterns.name: 句首“We”及后续陈述
patterns.context: 句首第一人称复数主语，后接研究陈述、研究目的或发现；激活也延伸到后续若干 token。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要及商务邮件

patterns.name: HIV 相关生物医学术语
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中关于 HIV 易感性的片段；没有句首“We”。

patterns.name: 研究提案与干预目的
patterns.context: 提出营养干预和身体活动相关研究方案。

patterns.name: 研究评估计划
patterns.context: 以将来时描述评估某项影响及其时间长度。

patterns.name: 邮件中的写作痕迹与问句
patterns.context: 邮件片段，含重复或疑似拆分的“We”词形、句末标点及问句开头；局部 token 边界不寻常。

patterns.name: 商务公告措辞
patterns.context: 以正式、礼貌的口吻宣布某人或某事；后接人名 Dave Delain。

patterns.name: 生物医学研究发现与对象
patterns.context: 陈述受体、病毒或靶向治疗相关研究发现；段内句子均不完整。

patterns.name: 研究领域或方向描述
patterns.context: 描述正在更好地界定某对象的自然史。

patterns.name: 组学方法
patterns.context: 提出使用定量蛋白质组学方法；“proteomics”被拆成多个 token。

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: many fall on importance, subword fragments of longer words, numbers, and proper-name abbreviations; the rest cover research proposals, patents, school entries, and business email, with no unified semantic or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: The word importance and related discussion
patterns.context: Academic or research writing discusses the importance, role, or relative significance of something.
patterns.domain: NIH research abstracts involving cell receptors, virology, and family-planning policy

patterns.name: Subword fragments within long words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the beginning or stem fragments of longer words split into multiple tokens; meanings and topics are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Commercially competitive nanoparticle proposal
patterns.context: Proposes developing commercially competitive magnetic nanoparticles; the sentence begins with “We hypothesize that”.

patterns.name: Meeting and researcher count
patterns.context: Describes a research collaboration meeting and reports that approximately 60 researchers attended.

patterns.name: School name and paragraph boundary
patterns.context: The proper name contains St, followed by a standalone heading-style line and a blank line.

patterns.name: Scissors patent terminology
patterns.context: A patent background section begins with a formal description of an invention and its components.

patterns.name: Numbered identifiers and sample counts
patterns.context: Biomedical text contains hyphenated identifiers and sample counts with an approximation sign and thousands separators.

patterns.name: TCGA/project abbreviations
patterns.context: Proper-name abbreviations for a cancer genomics project and its proteome atlas platform; activation is concentrated on tokens within the abbreviations.

patterns.name: Family planning and population policy
patterns.context: Compares the policy roles of family-planning programs and economic development.
patterns.domain: NIH research abstracts, population and public health policy

patterns.name: Repeated abbreviations in natural gas contracts
patterns.context: An attachment or email body lists two EOL Firm Gas contracts/documents.

9_1732.description: 激活线索分散：多处落在 importance、较长词的分词片段、数字和专名缩写上；其余覆盖科研提案、专利、学校条目与商务邮件，缺少统一语义或文体模式。

patterns.name: importance 一词及其论述
patterns.trigger: “importance”（[3] 中 “the importance of”，[7] 中 “intrinsic importance”，[9] 中 “programs importance relative to”）
patterns.context: 学术或研究性文字中讨论某事物的重要性、作用或相对重要程度。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究摘要，涉及细胞受体、病毒学及家庭计划政策

patterns.name: 长词内部分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆成多个 token 的较长词的开头或词干片段；具体词义与主题并不一致。

patterns.name: 商业竞争性 nanoparticle 提案
patterns.context: 提出开发有商业竞争力的磁性纳米粒子；句子以“We hypothesize that”开头。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究摘要，生物医学/材料研究

patterns.name: 会议及研究者数量
patterns.context: 描述研究合作会议，并报告约 60 名研究者参加。

patterns.name: 学校名称与段落边界
patterns.trigger: “St Mary’s Town and Country School”及其后的换行
patterns.context: 专名中出现 St，随后是标题式独立行和空行。

patterns.name: 剪刀专利术语
patterns.context: 专利背景段落以发明及其构件的正式描述开头。

patterns.name: 数字化编号与样本数量
patterns.context: 生物医学文字中出现带连字符的编号，以及带近似符号、千位逗号的样本数。

patterns.name: TCGA/项目缩写
patterns.context: 癌症基因组项目及其蛋白质图谱平台的专名缩写；激活集中在缩写内部 token。

patterns.name: 家庭计划与人口政策
patterns.trigger: “Family planning programs”“population control policies”“importance relative to”
patterns.context: 比较家庭计划项目与经济发展的政策作用。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究摘要，人口与公共卫生政策

patterns.name: 天然气合同缩写重复
patterns.trigger: “GTC”在“EOL Firm Gas GTC”中重复出现
patterns.context: 附件或邮件正文列出两份 EOL Firm Gas 合同/文件。

en.description: Activation is scattered across neonatal medicine, group comparisons, medical statistics, chemotaxis, combustion materials, genetics, and hacking; it often falls on word fragments, specific nouns, or numbers. There is also a heading and a news example that do not fit a unified medical pattern.

patterns.name: Neonatal or infant contexts
patterns.context: Medical descriptions concerning newborns, premature infants, or infants; sometimes associated with disease, stress, or blood components.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activation falls on word fragments spanning tokens that form jaundiced and Stare Nadratowo; the second example is isolated heading-style text with unclear contextual conditions.
patterns.domain: Medical text; Wikipedia heading or proper name

patterns.name: Group differences and age groups
patterns.context: Compares groups by sex, ethnicity, age, or social advantage, and discusses disparities.

patterns.name: contacts in service-use statistics
patterns.context: In statistics on children's healthcare visits, a numerical count is followed by contacts; strongest activation falls on the number fragment.

patterns.name: Chemotaxis and cell migration
patterns.context: Appears in a heading about chemokine receptor dimerization and biological responses.

patterns.name: Carpets and indoor combustion materials
patterns.context: Describes the burning and smoke of synthetic building materials, carpets, and upholstered furniture indoors.

patterns.name: Genetic variants and birth defects
patterns.context: Describes how common gene copy-number variants are in patients with GU birth defects.

patterns.name: Hacker threats
patterns.context: Recent hacker threats facing UK businesses; the sentence mentions Paradise Papers.

patterns.name: HDL composition and umbilical cord blood
patterns.context: Discusses HDL composition in individuals with normal and abnormal lipoproteinemia, and mentions neonatal umbilical cord plasma.

patterns.name: Neonatal jaundice and G6PD deficiency
patterns.context: Compares jaundice rates in the first week of life and reports findings from a cohort of neonates with G6PD deficiency.

patterns.name: Routine formatting or low-semantic cues
patterns.context: Activation falls on cross-token word fragments, tokenization boundaries, or common measurement/compound words; these do not share a semantic trigger.

9_1732.description: 激活分散于新生儿医学、群体比较、医疗统计、趋化、燃烧材料、遗传学及黑客等语境；多落在词内片段或具体名词、数字上，另有标题和新闻例无法与医学模式统一。

patterns.name: 新生儿或婴儿相关语境
patterns.context: 围绕新生儿、早产儿或婴儿的医学描述；有时与疾病、压力或血液成分相关。

patterns.name: 特定词内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 的词形片段上，分别组成 jaundiced 和 Stare Nadratowo；第二例是孤立标题式文本，难以确定语境条件。
patterns.domain: 医学文本；Wikipedia 标题或专名

patterns.name: 群体差异与年龄分组
patterns.context: 比较不同性别、族裔、年龄或社会优势群体，并讨论差距。
patterns.domain: 社会科学、人口统计研究

patterns.name: 数量统计中的 contacts
patterns.context: 在儿童就诊统计中，数值计数后接 contacts；最强激活落在数字片段。

patterns.name: 趋化与细胞迁移
patterns.context: 出现在趋化因子受体二聚化及生物反应的标题中。

patterns.name: 地毯与室内燃烧材料
patterns.context: 描述建筑内部合成材料、地毯和软垫家具燃烧及烟雾。

patterns.name: 基因变异与出生缺陷
patterns.context: 描述 GU 出生缺陷患者中基因拷贝数变异的常见程度。

patterns.name: 黑客威胁
patterns.context: 英国企业面临近期黑客威胁，句子提及 Paradise Papers。

patterns.name: HDL 组成及脐带血
patterns.context: 讨论正常及异常脂蛋白血症个体的 HDL 组成，并提及新生儿脐带血浆。

patterns.name: 新生儿黄疸与 G6PD 缺乏
patterns.context: 对比新生儿第一周黄疸比例，并报告 G6PD 缺乏新生儿队列结果。

patterns.name: 常规格式或低语义线索
patterns.context: 激活分别落在跨 token 词语片段、分词边界或常见计量/复合词上；无法归入同一语义触发条件。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on specialized terms, molecules, and cell-line names in biomedical corpora, and also responds to formal institution names, experimental animals and their sources, numbered research entries, and repeated work titles.

patterns.name: Biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Appears in biomedical text, often as technical nouns, molecules, or disease names; component fragments within nouns also activate in multiple examples.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research plans, and abstracts

patterns.name: Institution and project names
patterns.context: Formal institution names and their components appear consecutively.

patterns.name: Repeated work titles
patterns.context: A title is repeated on adjacent lines, and title words and parts of the repetition activate.

patterns.name: Experimental models and material sources
patterns.context: Experimental methods specify animal characteristics and sources of experimental materials; an institution name is in Portuguese.

patterns.name: Numbered entries and cell-line names
patterns.context: Numbered project or research task entries contain terms such as chromosomal rearrangements and tumor cell lines.

9_1732.description: 激活主要集中于生物医学语料中的专业术语、分子与细胞系名称，也响应正式机构名、实验动物及来源、编号研究条目；另对重复作品标题有激活。

patterns.name: 生物医学专业术语
patterns.trigger: “Natural Killer (NK) cell neoplasms”, “haptoglobin 2-1 polymers”, “Sod2 overexpression”, “p53 tumor suppressor”, “adrenergic and cholinergic components”
patterns.context: 出现在生物医学文本中，常为专业名词、分子或疾病名称；多个样例中名词内部的组成片段也有激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、研究计划及摘要

patterns.name: 机构与项目名称
patterns.trigger: “University of Massachusetts Center for Clinical and Translational Science”
patterns.context: 正式机构名称及其组成部分连续出现。

patterns.name: 作品标题重复
patterns.context: 标题在相邻行重复出现，标题词及其部分重复得到激活。

patterns.name: 实验模型与材料来源
patterns.trigger: “Twenty male Wistar rats”及“Centro de Desenvolvimento de Modelos Experimentais para Medicina e Biologia”
patterns.context: 实验方法中列明动物特征和实验材料来源，机构名称含葡萄牙语。

patterns.name: 编号条目与细胞系命名
patterns.context: 项目或研究任务的编号条目中出现染色体重排、肿瘤细胞系等术语。

en.concept: Local markers in technical texts and structured fragments
en.description: Activation is scattered across several types of technical text: component relations in patents, increasing numbers, geographic coordinates, paper metadata, hepatitis viruses, signaling pathways, structured data, and physics and astronomy abstracts; there is no evident shared vocabulary or topic.

patterns.name: Spatial relationships and components in patent claims
patterns.context: A long patent-style sentence describes outer and inner connector components, a cage, and their relative positions and functions

patterns.name: Increasing integer sequence
patterns.context: Many numbers are listed in approximately increasing order, without recognizable ordinary sentence context
patterns.domain: PhilPapers page or numerical list/numbered content in text

patterns.name: Coordinates and terminology in a Mars geography entry
patterns.context: A geographic range is given first, followed by proper-name examples and then a transition to a heading or encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Author and institution formatting on a paper's first page
patterns.context: Paper first-page metadata before the abstract or main text, with backslashes, line breaks, and address fields

patterns.name: Hepatitis virus title and introduction
patterns.context: The opening of a paper's introduction introduces the subject using the full disease/virus name and its abbreviation

patterns.name: Signaling pathways and fluorescence assay terminology
patterns.context: Describes thyroid hormone-related pathways and experimental methods for detecting PIP3 using fluorescent proteins

patterns.name: Structured code or tabular numerical records
patterns.context: Machine-readable, repeated row-wise records consisting of field markers, letter codes, and numbers

patterns.name: Research abstract on magnetic skyrmions
patterns.context: An abstract discusses the effects of curvature on the formation, shape, size, and phase evolution of magnetic structures

patterns.name: Stellar spectra and astronomy observation abstract
patterns.context: An abstract reports velocity and metallicity measurements for a group of stars

patterns.name: Virus distribution heading
patterns.context: A brief heading limits the distribution of a viral infection to the region Namibia

9_1732.concept: 专业文本与结构化片段中的局部标记
9_1732.description: 激活分散于多种专业文本：专利构件关系、递增数字、地理坐标、论文元数据、肝炎病毒、信号通路、结构化数据及物理和天文摘要；没有明显共享的词汇或主题。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的空间关系与构件
patterns.trigger: “configured to transmit torque therebetween”“interposed between”“radially inner surface”“radially outer surface”
patterns.context: 专利式长句描述外/内接头构件、保持架及其相对位置和功能
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景/技术描述

patterns.name: 递增整数序列
patterns.trigger: 连续数字 token，如“2 3 4 5 6 7 9 10 … 15 16 … 47”，且数字激活尤强
patterns.context: 大量数字按近似递增顺序列出，缺少可辨认的普通句子上下文
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 页面或文本中的数字列表/编号内容

patterns.name: 火星地貌条目中的坐标与术语
patterns.trigger: “between 10 N and 10 S latitude”“240 W”“210 W longitude”“Fretted terrain”
patterns.context: 先给出地理范围，再以专名举例并转入标题或百科正文
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 英文天文学/火星地理条目

patterns.name: 论文首页作者与机构排版
patterns.trigger: 换行排列的作者、单位和地址：“Chang-han Rhee”“Peter W. Glynn”“Stanford University”“Stanford, CA … U.S.A.”
patterns.context: 摘要或正文前的论文首页元数据，带反斜线、换行和地址字段

patterns.name: 肝炎病毒相关医学标题与引言
patterns.context: 论文引言开头，以疾病/病毒全称及缩写引入研究对象
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 信号通路与荧光实验术语
patterns.context: 描述甲状腺激素相关通路及用荧光蛋白检测 PIP3 的实验方法
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目摘要/生物医学研究

patterns.name: 结构化代码或表格数值记录
patterns.context: 由字段标记、字母代码和数值组成，按行重复的机器可读记录

patterns.name: 磁性斯基尔米子研究摘要
patterns.context: 摘要中讨论曲率对磁性结构形成、形状、尺寸及相演化的影响
patterns.domain: ArXiv 凝聚态/材料物理论文

patterns.name: 恒星光谱与天文观测摘要
patterns.context: 摘要报告对一组恒星进行速度和金属丰度测量

patterns.name: 病毒感染分布标题
patterns.context: 以地区名称 Namibia 限定病毒感染分布的简短标题

en.concept: Structured text in heterogeneous formal styles
en.description: Activation is distributed across legal arguments and citations, scientific descriptions and references in patent technical backgrounds, encyclopedia-style historical and geographical narratives, and an account of a dispute over a waste dump; it also falls on common function words, proper names, numbers, punctuation, and split subwords, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Relational words and quotation structures in legal arguments
patterns.context: In legal document sentences, introduces claims, reasons, limitations, or statutory/case citations; the words themselves are not fixed, and activation is also distributed across legal quotations and surrounding grammatical structures
patterns.domain: FreeLaw court opinions and legal citations

patterns.name: Academic citation format
patterns.context: Literature reviews or reference entries in patent backgrounds, containing abbreviations, numbers, punctuation, and publication information
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and technical references

patterns.name: Scientific terminology and quantitative descriptions
patterns.context: Technical statements describing microorganisms, compounds, materials, or molecular weight ranges, often with abbreviations, numbers, and units
patterns.domain: Scientific and technical text in USPTO patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Narratives of named places and dates
patterns.context: Chronologically recounts changes and abolitions of parish territories, with proper names and dates embedded in encyclopedia-style sentences
patterns.domain: Wikipedia church geography and history entries

patterns.name: Spelling fragments or non-semantic subword activation
patterns.context: Token boundaries split words, abbreviations, or unusual characters; this fragment alone does not establish a unified semantic condition

patterns.name: Narrative of public land and opposition
patterns.context: Describes the proposed location of a waste dump and how public and institutional opposition led to seeking another site

9_1732.concept: 异质正式文体中的结构化文本
9_1732.description: 激活分布于法律论证及引文、专利技术背景中的科学描述和参考文献、百科历史地理叙述，以及一段弃土场争议；同时落在常见功能词、专名、数字、标点和拆分子词上，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的关系词与引述结构
patterns.trigger: “that”“which”“of”“in”“as”“the”等功能词，以及引述法条或判例时的标点和编号
patterns.context: 法律文书句子中，引入主张、理由、限制条件或法条/判例引文；词语本身不固定，激活也分布在法律引述及周边语法结构上
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法院意见与法律引文

patterns.name: 学术文献引用格式
patterns.trigger: 期刊、作者、卷期、页码和年份等引用串，如“Journal of American Chemical Society, Vol. 120 p. 9714, 1998”及“IEEE TRANS COMM., vol. 43, no. 10, pp. 2582-2594, October 1995”
patterns.context: 专利背景中的文献综述或参考文献条目，含缩写、数字、标点及出版信息
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与技术文献引用

patterns.name: 科学技术术语与定量描述
patterns.trigger: “Transposable elements”“boron compound containing a heterocyclic ring”“cellulosome”“26 polypeptides”“2.10⁶ to 6.5×10⁶ Da”等
patterns.context: 描述微生物、化合物、材料或分子量范围的技术性陈述，常伴随缩写、数字和单位
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景中的科学技术文本

patterns.name: 专名与数字化时间地点叙述
patterns.context: 按时间顺序叙述教区领土变更及撤销，专名和日期嵌在百科条目句式中
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 教会地理与历史条目

patterns.name: 拼写片段或非语义性子词激活
patterns.context: 分词/token 边界导致单词、缩写或异常字符被拆分；仅凭此段无法确定统一语义条件
patterns.domain: 法律文本与异常字符/子词分词

patterns.name: 公共用地与公众反对叙述
patterns.trigger: “Some spoil was deposited there”“violent objections by a great many citizens and public bodies”“spoil site”
patterns.context: 叙述弃土场选址及公众、机构反对导致另寻地点

en.concept: Proper names and technical terms in academic text
en.description: Activation is distributed across several types of academic text: bibliographic formatting, physics and cosmology (especially dark matter, dark energy, and particle experiments), as well as biological content such as splicing and repetitive DNA; there is no single narrow topic.

patterns.name: Reference entry format
patterns.context: Many marked tokens occur in citations or bibliography entries, including journal names, volume/issue, and page numbers

patterns.name: Dark matter and particle physics
patterns.context: Discusses dark matter candidate particles and detection experiments, especially particle masses, detectors, and nuclear recoils

patterns.name: Cosmology and dark energy
patterns.context: Discusses the role of dark energy in the universe's energy composition, evolution, or models of cosmic structure

patterns.name: Excitation and damping of rotating dust grains
patterns.context: Ion processes in interstellar gas affect dust grain rotation

patterns.name: Alternative splicing and SR proteins
patterns.context: Describes splicing regulation in plants or animals and proteins related to Arabidopsis

patterns.name: Formula for the two-photon production process
patterns.context: Marked particle symbols and variables appear in mathematical expressions for cross-sections or luminosity

patterns.name: Repetitive DNA and evolutionary insertion
patterns.context: Discusses repetitive selfish DNA, insertion sites, and evolutionary relationships

patterns.name: Antimatter search experiment
patterns.context: Describes a space experiment searching for primordial antimatter, using a spectrometer to identify antiparticles and reject background

9_1732.concept: 学术文本中的专名与技术术语
9_1732.description: 激活分布于多类学术文本：书目格式、物理与宇宙学（尤其暗物质、暗能量及粒子实验），也包括剪接、重复 DNA 等生物学内容；没有统一的窄主题。

patterns.name: 参考文献条目格式
patterns.trigger: 作者名、标题、期刊名、卷期、页码等书目信息，如 “Reason Papers 35”, “Vol. 38”, “pp. 203-19”
patterns.context: 文献引用或参考书目条目中，期刊名、卷期和页码等被标记的 token 较多

patterns.name: 暗物质与粒子物理
patterns.context: 讨论暗物质候选粒子及探测实验，尤其是粒子质量、探测器与核反冲

patterns.name: 宇宙学与暗能量
patterns.context: 讨论暗能量对宇宙能量组成、演化或宇宙结构模型的作用

patterns.name: 旋转尘粒的激发与阻尼
patterns.context: 星际气体中的离子过程影响尘粒旋转

patterns.name: 选择性剪接与 SR 蛋白
patterns.context: 描述植物或动物中剪接调控及拟南芥相关蛋白
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、植物遗传学

patterns.name: 双光子产生过程的公式
patterns.context: 截面或光度的数学表达式中出现带标记的粒子符号和变量

patterns.name: 重复 DNA 与进化插入
patterns.context: 讨论重复性自私 DNA、插入位点与进化关系

patterns.name: 反物质搜寻实验
patterns.context: 说明空间实验搜寻原初反物质并用谱仪识别反粒子、排除背景

en.description: Most fragments are from physics papers involving particles, nuclear physics, cosmology, and QCD; there is also a popular, prophetic-style astronomy text. The commonality is primarily physics/astronomy terminology and related technical contexts, rather than a single trigger object.

patterns.name: High-energy particle physics and colliders
patterns.context: Discusses the Higgs boson, the Standard Model, particle production and decay, or collider experiments and their energies; words are split into subword tokens in multiple examples.
patterns.domain: High-energy physics, experimental particle physics papers

patterns.name: Higgs decay and radiative corrections
patterns.context: Summarizes calculations of the Higgs decay width and its corrections, not necessarily in the context of collider experiments.

patterns.name: Dark matter and cosmological models
patterns.context: Describes the role of dark matter in the universe and structure formation, or discusses parameters such as dark matter mass.

patterns.name: Nuclear reactions and unstable nuclei
patterns.context: Introduces research background on probing unstable nuclear structures using nuclear reactions.

patterns.name: Photon distribution functions and beams
patterns.context: Defines or describes photon distributions in unpolarized beams using formulas.

patterns.name: QCD matter and the critical point
patterns.context: Discusses non-equilibrium properties, expansion, and evolution near the critical point of matter in heavy-ion collisions.

patterns.name: Doomsday predictions and astronomical event narratives
patterns.context: In a popular, prophetic tone, links government finances, lunar eclipses, and a reversal of the Sun's magnetic field.
patterns.domain: Non-academic online text; astronomy and doomsday discourse

9_1732.description: 多数片段来自物理论文，涉及粒子、核物理、宇宙学及QCD；另有一段通俗预言式天文文本。共同点偏向物理/天文术语与相关专业语境，触发对象并不单一。

patterns.name: 高能粒子物理与对撞机
patterns.trigger: “Higgs Boson”“Standard Model”“Large Hadron Collider”“13 TeV”“top quark”“proton-proton collisions”“collider Tevatron”“CERN”
patterns.context: 讨论希格斯粒子、标准模型、粒子产生与衰变，或对撞机实验及其能量；多个例子中词被拆分成子 token。
patterns.domain: 高能物理、实验粒子物理论文

patterns.name: 希格斯衰变与辐射修正
patterns.context: 概述希格斯衰变宽度计算及其修正，而不一定出现对撞机实验语境。

patterns.name: 暗物质与宇宙学模型
patterns.context: 说明暗物质在宇宙及结构形成中的作用，或讨论暗物质质量等参数。
patterns.domain: 宇宙学、暗物质理论论文

patterns.name: 核反应与不稳定原子核
patterns.context: 介绍以核反应探测不稳定核结构的研究背景。

patterns.name: 光子分布函数与束流
patterns.context: 通过公式定义或描述非偏振束流中的光子分布。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理、公式化技术表述

patterns.name: QCD 物质与临界点
patterns.context: 讨论重离子碰撞中物质的非平衡性质、膨胀及临界点附近的演化。
patterns.domain: 核物理、相对论重离子物理

patterns.name: 末日预言与天文事件叙述
patterns.trigger: “US government runs out of money”“lunar eclipse”“Window of Opportunity”“solar magnetic field reversal”
patterns.context: 以通俗、预言式语气把政府财政、月食和太阳磁场反转联系起来。
patterns.domain: 非学术网络文本；天文与末日论述

en.description: Primarily responds to particles, nuclear and astrophysical entities, processes, and terminology in physics papers, often covering subwords of proper names and abbreviations; it also appears in discussions emphasizing degree, targets, or extremes. There is also terminology for theoretical calculation order and a passage of aviation narrative with action and direction words.

patterns.name: Emphasized entities or terminology in high-energy physics
patterns.context: Appears in particle, nuclear, or astrophysics papers; often falls within proper names, particle names, or field abbreviations, surrounded by terminology about physical processes, experiments, theories, or models.
patterns.domain: ArXiv high-energy physics, nuclear physics, particle astrophysics

patterns.name: Academic descriptions of physical objects and processes
patterns.context: Describes particle production or decay, collisions and scattering, signals, or astronomical events; occurs in technical statements in paper abstracts or main text.

patterns.name: Expressions of degree, comparison, and extremes
patterns.context: Technical discussion emphasizes scale, importance, extremes, or targets; these collocations do not appear in every passage.

patterns.name: Theoretical calculation order and precision terminology
patterns.context: Describes theoretical calculation precision or perturbative expansion order in the context of theoretical predictions.

patterns.name: Aviation actions and directional words
patterns.context: Recounts a pilot maneuvering an aircraft, aircraft movement, and a wingman breaking away; differs from the other physics terminology contexts.

9_1732.description: 主要响应物理学论文中的粒子、核与天体物理实体、过程和术语，常覆盖专名及缩写的子词；也出现在强调程度、目标或极值的论述中。另有理论计算阶数术语和一段航空叙事中的动作、方向词。

patterns.name: 高能物理中被强调的实体或术语
patterns.context: 出现在粒子、核、天体物理论文中；常落在专名、粒子名称或领域缩写内部，且周围有物理过程、实验、理论或模型术语。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 高能物理、核物理、粒子天体物理

patterns.name: 物理对象及过程的学术描述
patterns.context: 描述粒子产生或衰变、碰撞与散射、信号或天体事件；处于论文摘要或正文中的技术陈述。

patterns.name: 程度、比较及极值表述
patterns.context: 在技术论述中强调量级、重要性、极值或目标；这些搭配并非每段都有。
patterns.domain: 学术论文，主要为物理学

patterns.name: 理论计算阶数与精度术语
patterns.context: 描述理论计算精度或微扰展开阶数，出现在理论预测的语境中。

patterns.name: 航空动作及方向词
patterns.context: 叙述飞行员操纵飞机、飞机移动及僚机分离；与其余物理学术语语境不同。

en.concept: Scientific and technical processes and named-entity contexts
en.description: Primarily activates in specialist papers discussing particle production, decay, reactions, and related experimental or theoretical work; also appears in Standard Model/new physics, nuclear reactions, biomedical kinase contexts, and a flight-pilot narrative, with sporadic triggers.

patterns.name: Reactions and particle processes in high-energy physics
patterns.context: Discusses particle production, decay, scattering, experimental observations, or theoretical calculations, often alongside particle symbols, energy scales, experimental facilities, or process names; it is not triggered by a single fixed word.
patterns.domain: High-energy physics, particle physics, and nuclear theory papers

patterns.name: Standard Model and new physics searches
patterns.context: Discusses the scope of the Standard Model, dark matter or new-particle searches, collider experiments, and theoretical frameworks.
patterns.domain: Particle physics theory and experimental papers

patterns.name: Kinase families and tumor cells
patterns.context: Biomedical background passages discussing cells, structural differences in protein kinase families, or depletion.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology and biomedical patent background

patterns.name: Nuclear reactions and Coulomb forces
patterns.context: Discusses deuteron–proton reactions, three-body reaction modeling, and Coulomb interactions in heavy nuclei.

patterns.name: Maneuvers and fighter aircraft in a flight narrative
patterns.context: A first-person narrative describes piloting an aircraft, abrupt maneuvers, and actions involving wingmen or enemy aircraft.

9_1732.concept: 科学技术过程与专名语境
9_1732.description: 主要激活于专业论文中粒子产生、衰变、反应及相关实验或理论讨论；也见于标准模型/新物理、核反应、生物医学激酶背景，以及一次飞行操纵叙事，触发较分散。

patterns.name: 高能物理中的反应与粒子过程
patterns.trigger: “production”, “reactions”, “decays”, “boson”, “quark”, “proton”, “ion”, “hyperons”及相邻粒子名称或物理过程
patterns.context: 处于粒子产生、衰变、散射、实验观测或理论计算的讨论中，常伴随粒子符号、能标、实验设施或过程名；并非只由某个固定词触发。
patterns.domain: 高能物理、粒子物理及核物理论文

patterns.name: 标准模型与新物理搜索
patterns.trigger: “effective field theory”, “DM searches”, “LHC”, “SM”, “grand-unification scale”, “Higgs boson”, “CERN Large Hadron Collider”
patterns.context: 讨论标准模型适用范围、暗物质或新粒子搜索、对撞机实验及理论框架。
patterns.domain: 粒子物理理论与实验论文

patterns.name: 激酶家族与肿瘤细胞
patterns.context: 生物医学背景段落中谈及细胞、蛋白激酶家族的结构差异或耗竭。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、生物医学专利背景

patterns.name: 核反应与库仑力
patterns.context: 讨论氘核与质子反应、三体反应建模及重核中的库仑相互作用。

patterns.name: 飞行叙事中的操纵与战机
patterns.context: 第一人称叙事中描述驾驶飞机、急促操纵及与僚机或敌机的动作。
patterns.domain: 通俗叙事或回忆性文本

en.description: Primarily responds to colliders, experimental facilities, and their operational context in high-energy physics papers; also covers experimental measurement progress and terminology from various particle-physics topics. A few activations occur in common paper prose or texts from other fields and cannot be assigned to one specific trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Particle collider names
patterns.context: In high-energy physics papers, when experiments, energy ranges, or future runs are mentioned, activations cluster around collider names and nearby location or run-time words.

patterns.name: Experimental and measurement progress
patterns.context: Describes reaction or decay channels that have been studied, measured, or are to be measured at experimental facilities; activations include expressions of experimental progress and the prepositions at and by.

patterns.name: Collider physics research topics
patterns.context: High-energy physics texts discuss physics beyond the Standard Model, the Higgs, bosons, symmetry breaking, or hadron-collision phenomena; triggers are spread across topic terms and physical quantities.

patterns.name: Sporadic cross-corpus patterns
patterns.context: Appears respectively in a cancer-treatment review, a transition in academic prose, and a discussion of hadron ratios; there is insufficient evidence that they share a specific trigger condition.

9_1732.description: 主要响应高能物理论文中的对撞机、实验设施及其运行背景，也覆盖实验测量进展和多种粒子物理主题术语；少数激活落在论文常见叙述或其他领域文本中，难以归为同一具体触发模式。

patterns.name: 粒子对撞机名称
patterns.context: 在高能物理论文中，提到实验、能区或未来运行时，激活集中在对撞机名称及其前后的地点、运行时间词语

patterns.name: 实验与测量进展
patterns.trigger: «final»6« state»4 have been extensively« conducted»6« up»9« to»8« recent»6 at»6；«measured»6« by»9；«performed»5« at»8
patterns.context: 描述实验反应或衰变道已经开展、测量或将在实验设施测量时，激活实验进展表达及介词 at、by

patterns.name: 对撞机物理研究主题
patterns.trigger: «physics»2« beyond»5« standard»5« model»5；«dark»4« matter»4；«Higgs»5« Bos»3«on»5；«electro»weak»4« symmetry»3« breaking»6；«vector»6« bosons»4；«large»3« $p_T$
patterns.context: 高能物理文本讨论标准模型之外、希格斯、玻色子、对称性破缺或强子碰撞现象；触发词分散在主题术语与物理量上
patterns.domain: 粒子物理理论与现象学

patterns.name: 跨语料偶发模式
patterns.trigger: «Techn»1«ological« advances»2« over»8« recent»5 decades；«at»9« this»3 point»4；«proton»-«to»-«pion»
patterns.context: 分别出现在癌症治疗综述、论文叙述转折及强子比例讨论中；没有充分证据显示它们共享具体触发条件
patterns.domain: 生物医学、学术叙述、粒子物理

en.description: Primarily responds to descriptions of particle processes and experimental colliders in high-energy particle physics papers, especially at followed by experimental facilities or names such as LHC and Tevatron; also covers related research topics including the Higgs, the Standard Model, dark matter, hadron decays, and heavy-ion collisions.

patterns.name: High-energy physics experimental facilities and colliders
patterns.context: Discusses searches, measurements, or future studies of particle or decay processes at specific experimental facilities or colliders; experimental names near «at» are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Collisions and production in particle physics
patterns.context: Discusses particle production, processes, or electroweak symmetry research at colliders.
patterns.domain: Particle physics paper titles, abstracts, or main text

patterns.name: Standard Model and new physics particles
patterns.context: Introduces Standard Model particles, the Higgs boson, or physics beyond the Standard Model, often linked to experimental searches.

patterns.name: Dark matter searches and effective field theory
patterns.context: Uses effective field theory to interpret dark matter searches and discusses analyses at the Large Hadron Collider.

patterns.name: Baryon and hadron decays, CP asymmetry
patterns.context: Discusses hadron or baryon decays, masses, and experimental measurements; references to collider experiments also trigger the experimental context described above.

patterns.name: Proton–ion collisions and transverse-momentum scaling
patterns.context: Discusses scaling behavior at high transverse momentum and the yield ratio of protons to π mesons.

9_1732.concept: 高能粒子物理实验语境
9_1732.description: 主要响应高能粒子物理论文中关于粒子过程与实验碰撞机的表述，尤其是 at 接实验设施或 LHC、Tevatron 等名称；也覆盖希格斯、标准模型、暗物质、强子衰变及重离子碰撞等相关研究主题。

patterns.name: 高能物理实验设施与碰撞机
patterns.context: 讨论粒子或衰变过程在特定实验设施、碰撞机上的搜索、测量或未来研究；«at»附近的实验名称尤其显著

patterns.name: 粒子物理中的碰撞与产生
patterns.context: 谈论碰撞机中的粒子产生、过程或电弱对称性研究
patterns.domain: 粒子物理论文标题、摘要或正文

patterns.name: 标准模型与新物理粒子
patterns.context: 介绍标准模型粒子、希格斯粒子或超出标准模型的物理，并常连接实验搜索

patterns.name: 暗物质搜索与有效场论
patterns.context: 以有效场论方法解释暗物质搜索，提及在大型强子对撞机上的分析
patterns.domain: 暗物质粒子现象学论文

patterns.name: 重子与强子衰变、CP不对称
patterns.context: 讨论强子或重子衰变、质量与实验测量；涉及对撞机实验时也会触发前述实验语境

patterns.name: 质子—离子碰撞与横动量标度
patterns.context: 讨论高横动量下的标度行为及质子与π介子的产额比
patterns.domain: 相对论重离子／强相互作用物理

en.description: Primarily responds to structures in particle physics papers where at introduces a collider or experimental facility, often alongside names such as CERN and LHC; also covers topics such as Higgs, electroweak physics, dark matter, hadrons, electron colliders, and theoretical calculations, as well as paper titles and citation formats.

patterns.name: The location marker at in particle physics contexts
patterns.context: In high-energy physics papers, the preposition at introduces an experimental facility, collider, or experimental site; the same local structure recurs across passages.
patterns.domain: High-energy particle physics and experimental physics papers

patterns.name: Collider and experimental facility names
patterns.context: Activations appear near facility names when particle experiments or colliders are mentioned; some names follow at, while others appear in descriptions of experimental projects.

patterns.name: Higgs and Standard Model particle phenomena
patterns.context: Discusses the Higgs boson, its mass, discovery, and electroweak symmetry breaking, usually in the context of particle searches, theory, or experiments.
patterns.domain: Particle physics theory and experimental papers

patterns.name: LHC searches and dark matter analyses
patterns.context: Discusses dark matter searches and collider analyses within an effective field theory framework; co-occurs with facility-location structures.

patterns.name: Descriptions of experimental results and theoretical exclusions
