patterns.name: 版面与格式边界
patterns.context: 页面换行、栏目标题或帖子标题附近，包含网页结构或文本分段。

patterns.name: 关系与性健康讨论
patterns.context: 讨论避孕产品及其在固定伴侣关系中的用途。

patterns.name: 历史人物传记叙述
patterns.context: 描述人物身份、别名及人生关系。

patterns.name: 心理健康政策术语
patterns.context: 讨论社区心理健康服务市场及相关政策管理。

en.description: Primarily responds to “I’m a” in first-person self-introductions, followed by descriptions of identity, age, or interests; also activates after become followed by an identity or relationship, and on the initial fragment of Improve. The Linda biography in segment 4 has no clear corresponding trigger.

patterns.name: “I'm a” self-introductions
patterns.context: First-person copula in a personal biography or account; often followed by descriptions of identity, age, interests, or personality. There are also examples of “Im” and “proving” split across words, whose relation to self-introductions is uncertain.
patterns.domain: Personal biographies, blog accounts, forum posts; also investment news

patterns.name: Age expressions
patterns.context: An age number is linked to “year old,” “older,” or an age range to describe the speaker.

patterns.name: Statements about identity or interests
patterns.context: First-person descriptions of personality, identity, or hobbies; partially overlaps with age expressions in biographies.
patterns.domain: Dating profiles, blog biographies, forums, interest blogs

patterns.name: Identity or relationship after become
patterns.context: In historical accounts, describes a person's social recognition or relationship status after the copula become.

patterns.name: Initial Im/Im-prove fragment
patterns.context: Improve/improvements are split across tokens, with activation on the initial fragment; subsequent forms and contexts differ, possibly reflecting tokenization or spelling-boundary effects.

9_2290.concept: 自我介绍中的身份陈述
9_2290.description: 主要响应第一人称自我介绍中的“I’m a”及身份、年龄、兴趣描述；另在become后接身份或关系、以及Improve词首片段上激活。段4的Linda简介没有明显对应触发。

patterns.name: “I'm a”自我介绍
patterns.context: 个人简介或自述中出现第一人称系词；多段后续描述身份、年龄、兴趣或性格。另有“Im”“proving”跨词切分的例子，不能确定与自我介绍同因。
patterns.domain: 个人简介、博客自述、论坛发言；另有投资新闻

patterns.name: 年龄表达
patterns.context: 年龄数字与“year old”“older”或年龄段相连，描述本人。

patterns.name: 身份或兴趣自述
patterns.context: 以第一人称介绍个性、身份或爱好；与简介中的年龄表达部分重合。
patterns.domain: 交友资料、博客简介、论坛及兴趣博客

patterns.name: become 后接身份或关系
patterns.context: 历史叙述中，系词 become 后描述人物获得的社会认知或关系状态。

patterns.name: 词首 Im/Im-prove 片段
patterns.context: Improve/improvements 被跨 token 拆分，激活落在词首片段；后续词形和语境不同，可能是分词或拼写边界效应。
patterns.domain: 英语学习宣传；公司业绩新闻

en.description: Most segments activate near “I am/I’m a” in first-person introductions, followed by a personal identity or characteristic; other activations occur within a token, on a Portuguese legal word fragment, and on numbers in LaTeX fractions.

patterns.name: “I am a…” in self-introductions
patterns.context: First-person self-introductions followed by age, identity, interests, or personal traits; also includes state descriptions such as “I’m a struggling…”.
patterns.domain: Personal blogs, dating profiles, job-seeking/startup forums, lawyer biographies

patterns.name: Within a word spelled letter by letter
patterns.context: A word is split into multiple tokens, with activation on the initial substring “Im” rather than the complete word; here it forms “Improving”.

patterns.name: Portuguese legal vocabulary
patterns.context: Portuguese sentences discuss provisions related to fair trials, with multiple words split into subword tokens; strong activations cover fragments of “relativas,” “julgamentos,” “justos,” and other words.

patterns.name: Numbers and fraction structures in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In LaTeX mathematical formulas, fraction commands and numbers occur within nested radical and fraction expressions.

9_2290.description: 多数段落在第一人称介绍中于“I am/I’m a”附近激活，后接个人身份或特点；另有分词内部、葡语司法词片段及LaTeX分数数字激活。

patterns.name: 自我介绍中的“I am a…”
patterns.context: 第一人称自我介绍，随后给出年龄、身份、兴趣或个人特点；也包括“I’m a struggling…”等状态描述。
patterns.domain: 个人博客、交友资料、求职/创业论坛、律师简介

patterns.name: 逐字母拼出的词内部
patterns.context: 词被分成多个 token，激活落在词首子串“Im”而非完整词上；此处构成“Improving”。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语司法词汇
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子谈及公平审判相关规定，多个词被拆分成子词 token；强激活覆盖“relativas”“julgamentos”“justos”等词片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会葡萄牙语法律文本

patterns.name: 数学公式中的数字与分数结构
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学公式中，分数命令和数字位于嵌套根式、分式表达式内。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的数学排版

en.concept: Local word forms and phrase collocations
en.description: Activations show several local patterns: Im- tokenization boundaries, I’m a descriptions in self-introductions, become state phrases, Portuguese legal phrasing, patent trend statements, and more than quantity comparisons. Common words also show sporadic activations.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundary at the Im- prefix
patterns.context: Im is followed by improving or improvements; activations fall on the split initial word part and subsequent morphemes.
patterns.domain: English personal introductions, educational copy, and financial news

patterns.name: First-person self-description after be
patterns.context: In self-introductions or personal accounts, I’m/Im is followed by a and a description of identity, personality, or state; activation spans adjacent words.

patterns.name: State or credential after become
patterns.context: Describes a gradually developing state or a formal credential after become/becoming; activation covers become and the following phrase.

patterns.name: European Parliament Portuguese legal phrasing
patterns.context: Portuguese text discusses fair trials and related provisions, with recurring legal terms and Portuguese word segmentation.

patterns.name: Trend adverbial phrase in patent background
patterns.context: States that home computer processing power is increasing, in comparison with mainframes and workstations; activations concentrate at the sentence beginning and on degree adverbs.

patterns.name: Geographic quantity comparison phrase
patterns.context: Uses more than to introduce the number of regions covered in a media program or copyright business description.
patterns.domain: Film and television business promotional copy

patterns.name: Cross-segment general word-form cues
patterns.context: Common function words and tokenization boundaries occur in different contexts; apart from local collocations, there is no consistent semantic condition across all segments.

9_2290.description: 激活呈现多种局部模式：Im-分词边界、自我介绍中的 I’m a 描述、become 状态短语，以及葡语法律措辞、专利趋势陈述和 more than 数量比较；高频词也有零散激活。

patterns.name: 辅音前缀 Im- 的分词边界
patterns.context: Im 后接 improving 或 improvements；激活落在被拆分的词首及后续词素上。
patterns.domain: 英语个人介绍、教育文案和财经新闻

patterns.name: be 动词后的第一人称自我描述
patterns.trigger: «I»«'m»« a»« struggling»« single»-«founder»；«I»«'m»« a»« lot» older；«Im»« a»« fun»« guy»
patterns.context: 自我介绍或个人经历叙述中，I’m/Im 后接 a 与身份、性格或状态描述；激活横跨相邻词。

patterns.name: become 后接状态或资历
patterns.trigger: «become»« a»« little»« obsessed»；«becoming»« officially»« trained»« and»« qualified»
patterns.context: become/becoming 后描述逐渐形成的状态，或取得正式资历；激活覆盖 become 及后续短语。
patterns.domain: 美妆博客、职业服务介绍

patterns.name: 欧洲议会葡语法律措辞
patterns.context: 葡语谈论公平审判及相关规定，带有重复的法律术语和葡语词素拆分。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会法律／政策文本

patterns.name: 专利背景中的趋势副词短语
patterns.trigger: «As»« the»« average» processing power« of» home computers« has»« increased»« tremend»«ously»
patterns.context: 陈述家用计算机处理能力提高，并与大型机、工作站比较；激活集中在句首及程度副词。

patterns.name: 地理数量比较短语
patterns.trigger: air«ing»« in»« more»« than»« 160»« territories»« worldwide»
patterns.context: 媒体节目或版权业务介绍中，用 more than 引出覆盖地区数。

patterns.name: 跨文段的泛化词形线索
patterns.context: 不同语境中出现的高频功能词及分词边界；除局部搭配外，没有在全部片段中一致的语义条件。

en.description: Activations fall on substrings of various words or on common words: Improving/Improvements, Corporate, become, in, am, and ’m a in forum self-descriptions; increase also appears in company mission copy. Trigger forms and contexts are not consistent.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “Im”
patterns.context: The trigger occurs at the beginning of a word, with subsequent fragments completing “Improving” or “Improvements”; surrounding text concerns English skills or business improvement.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment “Cor”
patterns.context: Occurs before a company department or job-title signature, forming “Corporate”; adjacent to “Credit and Financial Services” or “Communications”.

patterns.name: “become” and following words
patterns.context: Describes a change in experience or state in a personal account, especially expressions meaning “become a bit…”.

patterns.name: “in” and statements about growth
patterns.context: Describes something as becoming more popular, with the trigger on the preposition “in”.

patterns.name: “am” and self-statements
patterns.context: First-person self-introduction forms such as “I am having Hands-on experience”.

patterns.name: “I’m a”-style opening self-descriptions
patterns.context: Forum posts begin in the first person and state an identity or circumstance, such as “a struggling single-founder” or “a lot older”.

patterns.name: “increase” in company introductions
patterns.context: Describes the benefits of improving healthcare in a company mission statement.

9_2290.description: 激活落在多种词内片段或常见词上：Improving/Improvements、Corporate、become、in、am，以及论坛自述中的’m a；另见公司使命文案中的increase。触发形式和语境并不统一。

patterns.name: 词内片段“Im”
patterns.context: 触发位于单词开头，后续片段继续组成“Improving”或“Improvements”；周边谈英语技能或业务改善。

patterns.name: 词内片段“Cor”
patterns.context: 出现在公司部门或职务署名前，组成“Corporate”；紧邻“Credit and Financial Services”或“Communications”。

patterns.name: “become”及其后续词
patterns.context: 个人叙述中描述经历或状态变化，尤其是“变得有点……”的表达。

patterns.name: “in”及增长表述
patterns.context: 描述某事物的流行度正在上升，触发落在介词“in”上。

patterns.name: “am”及自我陈述
patterns.trigger: «am»，后接第一人称经历或身份陈述
patterns.context: “I am having Hands-on experience”等第一人称自我介绍句式。

patterns.name: “I’m a”类自述开头
patterns.trigger: «'m»后接«a»及个人身份或处境描述
patterns.context: 论坛帖子以第一人称说明自己是某种身份或处境，如“a struggling single-founder”“a lot older”。

patterns.name: 公司介绍中的“increase”
patterns.context: 公司使命陈述中描述提升医疗保健带来的益处。

en.description: Strong activations fall on substrings of unrelated words, such as As, est, in, ir, and Im, across Portuguese and English and multiple genres. Some occur only once; no stable semantic or syntactic pattern explains them as a whole.

patterns.name: As at sentence start or mid-sentence
patterns.context: In English company introductions or promotional copy, As introduces company identity, affiliation, or a subsequent explanation; capitalization varies with syntactic position.

patterns.name: Initial est in Portuguese estaleiros
patterns.context: In a Portuguese sentence about collective layoffs, estaleiros (shipyards) is segmented, with activation on the initial substring est.
patterns.domain: European Parliament employment and industry topics

patterns.name: Est in Portuguese Grupo Estudos
patterns.context: Within the proper name “Grupo de Estudos Kinosophia,” Estudos (studies) is segmented, with activation on the initial substring Est.

patterns.name: Preposition in in sentence-final position
patterns.context: English patent background text describes the rapid growth of VoIP's popularity, with in introducing a popularity phrase.

patterns.name: Preposition in in a time adverbial
patterns.context: English medical text describes a growing osteoporosis problem, with in introducing a recent-years time adverbial.

patterns.name: Within-word segmentation of irre
patterns.context: In English discussion of employees losing the relevance of prior jobs, activation falls on the initial substring ir in irrelevant.
patterns.domain: Technology industry employment discussions, forum text

patterns.name: Segmentation of initial Improving
patterns.context: In English-learning promotional text, initial Improving is segmented, with activation on the initial substring Im.

patterns.name: Within-word ir in a verb meaning decrease
patterns.context: In Portuguese discussion of resource allocation and preparation periods, ir is part of the ending of dimin(u)ir (decrease); annotation covers only this within-word substring.
patterns.domain: European Parliament policy or administrative texts

patterns.name: Weak, scattered activations in common words and phrases
patterns.context: Across different languages and syntactic environments, activations are distributed over substrings of common words, function words, and word-form fragments, with no stable, recurring local trigger.
patterns.domain: Mixed: news, corporate copy, patents, medicine, education, and forums

9_2290.description: 强激活落在多种不相干词的子串上：As、est、in、ir、Im 等，跨葡语与英语及多种文体。部分仅单例；未见足以统一解释的稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 句首或句中 As
patterns.context: 英语企业介绍或宣传文案中，As 引出公司身份、归属或后续说明；大小写因句法位置不同。
patterns.domain: 企业网站介绍、公司宣传

patterns.name: 葡语 estaleiros 前的 est
patterns.context: 葡语关于集体裁员的句子中，estaleiros（船厂）被切分，激活落在词首子串 est。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会就业与产业议题

patterns.name: 葡语 Grupo Estudos 中的 Est
patterns.context: 专名“Grupo de Estudos Kinosophia”内，Estudos（研究）被切分，激活落在词首子串 Est。

patterns.name: 介词 in 的句末位置
patterns.context: 英语专利背景文字描述 VoIP 流行度迅速上升，in 引出 popularity 短语。

patterns.name: 介词 in 的时间状语
patterns.context: 英语医学文字描述骨质疏松问题增长时，in 引出近期年份时间状语。

patterns.name: 词内 irre 的切分
patterns.context: 英语关于员工前职失去相关性的讨论中，激活落在 irrelevant 的词首子串 ir。
patterns.domain: 技术行业就业讨论、论坛文字

patterns.name: 词首 Improving 的切分
patterns.context: 英语学习宣传文字中，句首 Improving 被切分，激活落在词首子串 Im。
patterns.domain: 教育宣传、学习服务文案

patterns.name: 递减动词中的词内 ir
patterns.context: 葡语谈资源配置和准备周期时，ir 是 dimin(u)ir（减少）词尾的一部分；标注仅覆盖该词内子串。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政策或行政文本

patterns.name: 一般词语或短语中的弱分散激活
patterns.trigger: 如“«cent»6ros”“«trabal»6had«ores»5”“«in»9 popularity”“«in»9 recent years”之外的多种词内切分；本组较弱而无明确共同词项
patterns.context: 不同语言和句法环境中，激活分布在普通词的子串、功能词及词形片段上，未显示稳定复现的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：新闻、企业文案、专利、医学、教育及论坛

en.concept: Within-word letter fragments and word forms
en.description: Primarily activates on fragments such as est within Portuguese words, common word endings, and verb forms; it also responds to English -ing forms and short fragments in a few English words or proper names. Triggers span multiple genres, with no unified thematic semantics.

patterns.name: Plural words and within-word endings
patterns.context: Mostly word endings or continuous letter fragments within Portuguese words, commonly in plurals, verb conjugations, or noun/adjective suffixes; can also occur within words in other languages.
patterns.domain: Primarily Portuguese political texts, also philosophy, technical texts, and English word forms

patterns.name: Within-word fragment est
patterns.context: Strongly responds to the letter fragment est inside words; examples do not involve the same complete word or require a specific syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Portuguese European Parliament and philosophy texts; also academic titles

patterns.name: English progressive verb forms
patterns.context: English -ing forms, especially initial or within-word fragments connected to the -ing ending; occurs in different sentences and contexts.

patterns.name: Portuguese progressive verb forms
patterns.context: Portuguese progressive verb forms; fragments occur within complete verbs.

patterns.name: Fragments in names
patterns.context: Occurs near names of Portuguese institutions/research groups and personal names; the names themselves are not marked, and activations may arise from letter fragments within them.

patterns.name: Within-word Portuguese fragment ar
patterns.context: A within-word letter substring that does not constitute a clear, independent semantic unit.

patterns.name: Unclassified sporadic within-word activations
patterns.context: Short letter fragments in a small number of English words or proper names; their relationship to the word-form patterns above is uncertain.

9_2290.description: 主要对葡萄牙语词内的 est 等片段、常见词尾及动词词形激活；也对英语 -ing 形式和少数英语/专名中的短片段响应。触发跨越多种文体，未见统一主题语义。

patterns.name: 复数词及词内词形结尾
patterns.context: 多为葡萄牙语词中的词尾或词内连续字母片段，常见于复数、动词变位或名词/形容词后缀；也可能跨语言出现在词中。
patterns.domain: 以葡萄牙语政治文本为主，另见哲学、技术文本及英文词形

patterns.name: 词内片段 est
patterns.context: 对单词内部的字母片段 est 强烈响应；这些例子并非同一个完整词，也不要求特定句法功能。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语欧洲议会与哲学文本；另见学术标题

patterns.name: 英语进行时词形
patterns.context: 英语 -ing 形式中，特别是词首或词内片段与 -ing 结尾相连；出现于不同句子和语境。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语进行时词形
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语动词进行时词形；片段分散在完整动词内部。

patterns.name: 姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语机构/研究组名称与人名附近；姓名本身未标记，触发可能来自名称中的字母片段。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段 ar
patterns.context: 词内字母子串，不构成明确独立语义单位。

patterns.name: 未能归类的零散词内激活
patterns.context: 少量英语或专名中的短字母片段；与上述词形模式关系不确定。
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术论坛、医学摘要

en.description: Activations occur on subword fragments and common words in multilingual, multidomain text: within-word segmentation in formal Portuguese texts, initial English fragments, function words in business and patent contexts, and domain-name lists. Trigger conditions are not consistent.

patterns.name: Initial fragments in Portuguese/tokenized text
patterns.context: Activations fall within words or near word boundaries, often in Portuguese political, parliamentary, and academic texts; the same type of subword segmentation appears repeatedly, but the specific triggering fragments vary.

patterns.name: Initial English fragments and subsequent word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur at the beginning of English words or at within-word segmentation points, as well as on short function words; contexts include medical terms, personal introductions, and consumer product reviews.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, webpage personal introductions, and lifestyle text

patterns.name: Articles and structural words in business organization contexts
patterns.context: In descriptions of company operations and functions, activations are distributed across common function words, verbs, and business nouns; there is no clear evidence that a particular word alone triggers them.

patterns.name: Short strings after domain separators
patterns.context: Several strings resembling website names or paths appear consecutively after periods; activations concentrate on subword fragments within these strings.

patterns.name: Degree and connective words in patent technical text
patterns.context: In patent background descriptions related to semiconductor manufacturing contamination, activations fall on trend descriptions and common connectives.

9_2290.description: 激活分布于多语种、多领域文本的子词片段和常见词：葡语正式文本的词内切分、英语词首片段、商务与专利语境中的功能词，以及域名列表。触发条件不统一。

patterns.name: 葡语/分词化文本中的词首片段
patterns.trigger: 「Est」「est」「dos」「de」「a」「com」等葡语词被拆成子词；如「Est」后接「amos」「a」，「est」后接「rut」；「dos」后接「est」「ale」
patterns.context: 激活落在词内或词边界附近，常见于葡语政治、议会、学术文本；多处呈现同一类子词切分，但具体触发片段并不完全一致

patterns.name: 英语词首片段及后续词界
patterns.context: 激活出现在英语词语的开头或词内切分处，也有短功能词；语境分别是医学名词、人物介绍、消费品评论等
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、网页个人介绍及生活方式文本

patterns.name: 商业组织语境中的冠词与结构词
patterns.context: 企业运营与职能描述中，激活分散在常见功能词、动词和商业名词上；没有明显只由某个单词触发的证据

patterns.name: 域名分隔符后的短字符串
patterns.context: 点号后连续列出多个类似网站名称或路径的字符串，激活集中在这些字符串内部的子词片段

patterns.name: 专利技术文本中的程度与连接词
patterns.context: 半导体制造污染相关的专利背景说明中，激活落在趋势描述和常见连接词上

en.concept: Local strings such as Est and ordinal suffixes
en.description: The most consistent cue is the substring Est/est in Portuguese words; there are also activations on the English century ordinal suffixes th and st, est in the domain name estate, and the phrase keep up. Triggers span languages and genres, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Est word forms in Portuguese text
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on words or word parts beginning with Est/est in Portuguese spelling, especially the subword “Est”; capitalization is not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Portuguese biographies, academic introductions, EU policy texts, and dictionary definitions

patterns.name: English century ordinal format
patterns.context: Occurs in English category entries as the suffix of century ordinal numbers; adjacent to a hyphen and century.

patterns.name: est in website domain names
patterns.context: est is the beginning of the domain suffix estate, located after a period; unlike other fragments, it does not occur in a natural-language sentence.

patterns.name: up in an English phrase
patterns.context: Part of the English phrasal verb keep up in a business advice context.

9_2290.concept: Est/序数后缀等局部字符串
9_2290.description: 最稳定的线索是葡语词中 Est/est 子串；另对英语世纪序数后缀 th、st、域名 estate 的 est 及短语 keep up 有激活。触发线索跨语言、跨文体，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 葡语文本中的 Est 词形
patterns.trigger: «Est»，以及 «est»；出现在 «Escola Estadual»、«Grupo de Estudos»、«infra-estruturas»、«Estamos»、«Estremadura» 等词中
patterns.context: 激活集中于葡萄牙语拼写中以 Est/est 开头的词或词段，尤其是 «Est» 这一子串；大小写不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 葡语个人简介、学术介绍、欧盟政策文本及词典释义

patterns.name: 英语世纪序数格式
patterns.context: 出现在英语分类条目中，作为世纪序数词的后缀；与连字符和 century 相邻。
patterns.domain: 英语维基百科分类列表

patterns.name: 网站域名中的 est
patterns.context: est 是网址域名后缀 estate 的开头，位于点号之后；不像其他片段那样处于自然语言句子中。

patterns.name: 英语词组中的 up
patterns.context: 作为英语短语动词 keep up 的组成部分，处于商业建议语境。

en.description: The strongest activations often fall on the “est/ou” fragments (Portuguese estou, Estadual, and domain est), and also respond to English grown, becoming, rising, and hyped. These word meanings and contexts are scattered and cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenized activation in the verb “estou”
patterns.context: The Portuguese sentence contains the first-person singular form “estou” of estar; activation falls on a subword fragment, followed by different complements.

patterns.name: Personal growth or change
patterns.context: First-person English accounts describe growing or changing over time, through experiences, or through training; nearby text often contains “I’ve/I’ve”.

patterns.name: Expressions of change in progress
patterns.context: In English personal accounts, “becoming” introduces a description of gradually becoming a certain state or improving.

patterns.name: Fragment in a Portuguese educational institution name
patterns.context: In a personal résumé or educational background, a state school name is tokenized; the strongest response falls on the initial fragment of “Estadual”.

patterns.name: “rising” in a market-development context
patterns.context: In a business advice sentence, “rising markets” is listed with new markets, new trades, and industry information.

patterns.name: “est” fragments and domain strings
patterns.context: When domain names are listed consecutively, domain labels include strings beginning with “est”.

patterns.name: “hyp” fragment in a marketing context
patterns.context: When discussing product popularity or consumer interest, the adjective “hyped” is tokenized; this fragment is unrelated to the growth, Portuguese “estou,” or “Estadual” patterns above.

9_2290.description: 最强激活多落在“est/ou”片段（葡语estou、Estadual及域名est），也响应英语grown、becoming、rising和hyped；这些词义与语境分散，无法用单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 动词“estou”的分词激活
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句中出现第一人称单数 estar 形式“estou”；激活落在该词的分词上，后接不同补语
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语议会文本、论坛问答

patterns.name: 个人成长或变化
patterns.context: 英语第一人称叙述中，描述自己经过时间、经历或训练而成长、改变；附近常有“I’ve/I’ve”
patterns.domain: 个人博客、个人经验叙述

patterns.name: 成形中的变化表达
patterns.context: 英语个人叙述中以“becoming”引出逐渐成为某种状态或变得更好的描述
patterns.domain: 生活方式、日常饮食计划

patterns.name: 葡语教育机构名称片段
patterns.context: 个人履历或教育经历中，州立学校名称被分词切分；最强响应落在“Estadual”的开头片段
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语履历/教育背景

patterns.name: 市场发展语境中的“rising”
patterns.context: 商业建议句中，“rising markets”与新市场、新交易及行业信息并列

patterns.name: “est”词片段与域名字符串
patterns.context: 连续列举域名时，域名标签中出现以“est”开头的字符串片段

patterns.name: 营销语境中的“hyp”片段
patterns.context: 谈论产品热度或消费者关注时，形容词“hyped”被分词；该片段不属于上述成长、葡语“estou”或“Estadual”模式

en.description: The strongest commonality is weak: activations fall on short tokens, subword fragments, and quotation marks across varied contexts. Identifiable local patterns include Louise’s tokenized spelling, patent terminology, mathematical symbols, code-comment words, and quoted titles; the domains differ substantially.

patterns.name: Tokenized spelling of the name Lou
patterns.context: The name Louise is split into two tokens, Lou and ise; it can occur in a salutation or sentence, followed by punctuation, a conjunction, or body text.

patterns.name: Patent-style terms
patterns.context: Several common patent terms and technical words activate in fixed headings and technical descriptions in patent background sections.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in phrases
patterns.context: Near webpage titles or URLs, activations fall on split word fragments and short tokens, with no confirmable shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression tokens
patterns.context: Near variables, equals signs, numbers, and plus signs in short math problems; activations are concentrated on formula symbols and variables.

patterns.name: Code comments and configuration terms
patterns.context: Parameter explanations, type descriptions, and quoted status values in code comments; also appears on quotation marks in Go import lists.

patterns.name: Song titles and quotation marks
patterns.context: Song titles recur in link text and quotation marks; both title words and quotation marks activate.

patterns.name: Title words in quotation marks
patterns.context: In entertainment-work titles beginning with quotation marks, the quotation mark and opening title word activate; later content does not show the same strength pattern.

9_2480.concept: 短 token 与词片段
9_2480.description: 最强共同点较弱：激活落在多种上下文中的短 token、词片段及引号上。可辨认的局部模式包括 Louise 的分词拼写、专利术语、数学符号、代码注释词和引号内标题；领域彼此差异明显。

patterns.name: 姓名 Lou 的切分拼写
patterns.context: 名字 Louise 被分成 Lou 和 ise 两个 token；可出现在称呼或句中，后接标点、连接词或正文。

patterns.name: 专利文体词语
patterns.context: 专利背景部分的固定标题与技术描述中，若干常见专利术语及技术词被激活。

patterns.name: 短语中的分词 token
patterns.context: 网页标题或网址附近，激活落在被切分的单词片段和短 token 上，缺少可确认的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 数学表达式 token
patterns.context: 简短数学题的变量、等号、数值和加号附近；激活主要集中在公式符号与变量。

patterns.name: 代码注释与配置词
patterns.context: 代码注释中的参数说明、类型描述及引号括起的状态值；另见 Go 导入列表中的引号。

patterns.name: 歌曲标题及引号
patterns.context: 歌曲标题在链接文字和引号中的重复出现，标题词及引号均激活。

patterns.name: 引号内标题词
patterns.context: 引号开头的娱乐作品标题中，激活引号及标题开头词，后续内容未显示相同强度模式。

en.concept: Subwords/fragments of proper nouns in split words
en.description: Activations often fall on subwords of split proper nouns or long words: Louise in emails, as well as medical terms, rare proper nouns, titles, and occupational nouns; formatting may also contribute to triggering.

patterns.name: Tokenized name Louise
patterns.context: The personal name Louise is split into multiple subwords at the beginning of a word; it may appear in a salutation, list, or sentence.

patterns.name: In-word biologic/ologic substrings
patterns.context: In scientific terms, biologic/ologic letter sequences occur, with activations concentrated on internal subwords.

patterns.name: Internal subwords of rare proper nouns
patterns.context: Proper or specialized terms are split into subwords, with activation at the beginning or inside the word; contexts include repeated entries, research descriptions, and medical treatment.

patterns.name: Subwords in titles and work names
patterns.context: Work titles recur in quotation marks, or occupational nouns are split; activations fall on title words or internal subwords.

patterns.name: Tokenization in names and list contexts
patterns.context: Names appear in parallel or in email salutations after a colon and line break; beyond Louise, this may also reflect names and list formatting.

9_2480.concept: 拆分词中的子词/专名片段
9_2480.description: 激活常落在拆分后的专名或长词子词上：邮件中的 Louise，以及医学术语、罕见专名、标题和职业名词；格式也可能参与触发。

patterns.name: Louise 名字分词
patterns.context: 人名 Louise 在词首被拆成多个子词；可处于称呼、名单或句中。

patterns.name: 词内 biologic/ologic 子串
patterns.context: 科学术语中出现 biologic/ologic 字母序列，激活集中在词的内部子词。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研资助文本

patterns.name: 罕见专名的内部子词
patterns.context: 专名或专业词被拆分为子词，触发位置落在词首或词内部；上下文分别是重复词条、研究描述和医学治疗。

patterns.name: 标题与作品名子词
patterns.context: 作品标题重复出现并带引号，或职业名词被拆分；激活落在标题词或词内子词。

patterns.name: 姓名及列举语境中的分词
patterns.context: 人名并列或冒号后换行的邮件称呼；除 Louise 外，可能也反映姓名和名单格式。

en.description: Responds to symbolic algebra text in math exercises: function definitions and composition evaluation, polynomials and power coefficients, differentiation, expression simplification, equation solving, and numerical rounding. The main triggers are dense variable–operator–coefficient expressions and adjacent problem instructions.

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation instructions
patterns.context: Explicitly asks to differentiate a given function, with a polynomial or function expression nearby.

patterns.name: Define functions and evaluate compositions
patterns.context: Defines one or more functions, then asks for a function value or composition value; often adjacent to polynomial coefficients.

patterns.name: Polynomial coefficients and power expressions
patterns.context: Variables, multiplication signs, powers, and signed integer coefficients are written consecutively in a polynomial, often in differentiation or function-definition problems.

patterns.name: Algebraic expression rearrangement and coefficient matching
patterns.context: Asks to rewrite an expansion in a specified form or simplify an expression; involves terms arranged by powers.

patterns.name: Numerical calculation and rounding
patterns.context: First evaluates an expression numerically, then asks for rounding to a specified precision.

patterns.name: Solve an equation
patterns.context: Provides an equation containing an unknown and asks to solve for a specified variable.

patterns.name: Second-derivative-related wording
patterns.context: Natural-language description that a function is the second derivative of another expression; followed by power-function terms.

patterns.name: Isolated coefficient or arithmetic fragment
patterns.context: The fragment is incomplete, possibly clipped across problem sections; there is insufficient information to identify a definite operation or shared structure.

9_2480.concept: 符号化代数题目
9_2480.description: 响应数学练习中的符号化代数文本：函数定义与复合求值、多项式及幂次系数、求导、整理表达式、解方程和数值取整。主要触发因素是密集的变量—运算符—系数表达式及相邻的题目指令。

patterns.name: 多项式求导指令
patterns.context: 明确要求对给定函数求导，邻近内容含多项式或函数表达式。

patterns.name: 定义函数并求复合函数值
patterns.trigger: “Let g(f) = …”“Let j(b) = …”“What is y(j(w))?”“What is g(t)?”
patterns.context: 先定义一个或多个函数，再询问函数值或复合函数值；常与多项式系数相邻。

patterns.name: 多项式系数与幂次表达式
patterns.context: 连续书写变量、乘号、幂次和带符号整数系数的多项式，常出现在求导或定义函数的题目中。

patterns.name: 代数式整理与系数匹配
patterns.trigger: “in the form q*x + p + t*x**3 + z*x**2 and give t.”以及“Rearrange 58*w + 58*…”
patterns.context: 要求将展开式改写成指定形式或整理表达式；涉及按幂次排列的项。

patterns.name: 数值计算与四舍五入
patterns.context: 先由表达式求出数值，再要求按指定精度取整。

patterns.name: 解方程
patterns.context: 给出含未知数的等式并要求解指定变量。

patterns.name: 二阶导数相关表述
patterns.context: 用自然语言描述某函数是另一表达式的二阶导数；后接幂函数项。

patterns.name: 孤立的系数或算式片段
patterns.trigger: “*l - 10 for l.”、“Suppose 3*q - 6”以及负数和系数片段
patterns.context: 片段残缺，可能是题目跨段截取；没有足够信息判定明确操作或共同结构。

en.description: Activations occur across domains, often on token fragments, punctuation, and structural boundaries; in code they favor control flow and callbacks, in math they favor problem prompts, line breaks, and expressions, and in biomedicine they favor internal parts of terms. No unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Token fragments and in-word boundaries
patterns.context: Activations often fall on fragments of split words or in-word hyphens, including English natural language and code/math expressions; surrounding context varies widely
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; biomedicine, tech news, math, code

patterns.name: Branch and callback code structures
patterns.context: Occurs in JSX/JavaScript or shell code, especially near control flow, callbacks, component properties, and method chains

patterns.name: Questions and line breaks in math problems
patterns.context: Near questions, problem prompts, and line breaks/answer regions in math problems or derivations; some strong activations also fall on mathematical symbols and numbers

patterns.name: Polynomial derivative expressions
patterns.context: Immediately adjacent to algebraic expressions comprising variables and powers; the specific problem is incomplete

patterns.name: Possible proper nouns or tokenization noise
patterns.context: Occurs in byline/link text fragments following news headlines, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition

patterns.name: Biomedical term fragments
patterns.context: In specialized terms in abstracts about immunology, liposomes, or infection research; activations fall within terms and near hyphens

patterns.name: Neuroscience terms and gene names
patterns.context: Near proper nouns, abbreviations, and specialized terms in descriptions of transcriptional regulation and nematode motor neurons

patterns.name: Number and operator strings
patterns.context: In polynomial coefficients, variables, operators, and answer-number strings in algebra problems; activations are not limited to one operation

9_2480.concept: 文本结构与分词边界
9_2480.description: 激活分布于多领域文本，常落在分词片段、标点和结构边界；代码中偏向控制流与回调，数学中偏向题目提示、换行及表达式，生物医学中偏向术语内部。各处缺少统一语义触发。

patterns.name: 分词片段与词内边界
patterns.trigger: «bum»、«lip»、«ocyte»、«transistor»中的词内片段；以及 «-»、«.»、«/» 等邻接标点
patterns.context: 激活常落在被拆分词的片段或词内连接符上，包含英语自然语言和代码/数学表达；片段前后文差异很大
patterns.domain: 跨领域；生物医学、科技新闻、数学、代码

patterns.name: 分支与回调代码结构
patterns.context: 出现在 JSX/JavaScript 或 shell 代码中，尤其是控制流、回调、组件属性和方法链附近

patterns.name: 数学题中的问句及换行
patterns.context: 数学题目或推导文本中，问句、题目提示与换行/答案区域附近；部分强激活也落在数学符号和数字上

patterns.name: 多项式导数表达式
patterns.context: 紧邻变量与幂次构成的代数表达式，具体题意不完整

patterns.name: 疑似专名或切分噪声
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题后的署名/链接文本片段中，未见稳定语义或句法条件

patterns.name: 生物医学术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在免疫学、脂质体或感染研究摘要的专业术语中；激活落于术语内部及连字符附近

patterns.name: 神经科学术语与基因名
patterns.context: 转录调控及线虫运动神经元描述中，专名、缩写和专业术语附近

patterns.name: 数字与运算符串
patterns.context: 代数题的多项式系数、变量、运算符及答案数字串中，激活并不局限于某一种运算

en.concept: Numbers and citations in structured text
en.description: Activations occur in three types of text: numbers and abbreviations in legal case citations and rules; numbers, punctuation, and operators in math problems; and literature citations and cell-related terms in patent backgrounds. Each type includes numbers or citation formats, but no single trigger word accounts for all examples.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal text contains federal case citations (F.3d, U.S. v.) or circuit court rule notices; activations occur near numbers, abbreviations, and punctuation.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in math problems
patterns.context: In math exercises or problems, activations occur near values, plus/minus signs, decimal points, arithmetic operators, and number sequences; some examples include questions or rounding instructions.

patterns.name: References and cell terms in patent documents
patterns.context: In patent background sections, cites research reports or papers bibliographically and discusses cellulase, tissue, stem cells, or cell lines.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds and biomedical/biotechnology literature

9_2480.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与引用
9_2480.description: 激活分布于三类文本：法律判例与规则引文中的编号缩写；数学题中的数字、标点及运算符；专利背景中的文献引文和细胞相关术语。各类内部均有数字或引用格式，但没有一个具体触发词能解释全部样例。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的编号与标点
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现联邦判例引文（F.3d、U.S. v.）或巡回法院规则通知；数字、缩写和标点附近激活。

patterns.name: 数学题中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 数学练习或题目中，数值、正负号、小数点、加减运算符及数字序列附近激活；有些样例包含提问或四舍五入指令。

patterns.name: 专利文献中的参考文献与细胞术语
patterns.trigger: «ul»1«ase»4…«Sh»iz«u»«oka»…«Text»ile« Industrial»…«Report»…«1986»；«“»«Human»« Ad»«ip»«ose»« Tissue»…«St»«em» Cells»…«Vol»…«2002»；并出现 «cell»9«ul»…«fungi»、«mouse»« cell»9
patterns.context: 专利背景技术中，引用研究报告或论文的书目信息，并讨论纤维素酶、组织、干细胞或细胞株。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与生物医学/生物技术文献

en.description: Primarily sensitive to the split-out sub string and its occurrences in code, typesetting commands, and ordinary words; also responds to cell and cell-research phrases. Other local patterns include address codes and subscript symbols.

patterns.name: sub string
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of words or near markers and commands; sometimes following characters are split into tokens, as in “substance,” “subdivision,” “subsequently,” “subsection,” or “sub{sub}.”
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, law, medicine, code, and typesetting

patterns.name: cell string
patterns.context: Appears in cell-related terms or phrases, especially cell line, cell surface, and cell model; some texts split it into subwords.

patterns.name: CSS vertical alignment and subscripts
patterns.context: Co-occurs with CSS properties, values, and brace rules, describing line height, vertical alignment, and subscript/superscript positioning.

patterns.name: Register/address abbreviations in code
patterns.context: Located in tab-indented assembly-like code, near registers, commas, and address-operation comments.

patterns.name: LaTeX heading-spacing commands
patterns.context: Appears in repeated \titlespacing commands and section/subsection level parameters; the command is split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: sub prefix in legal text
patterns.context: An ordinary English word in the body of a legal document after a page break or line break, not a code command.

patterns.name: Land subdivision terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts of land surveying and subdivision, including plat, lots, and streets.

patterns.name: Word-initial portion of subsequently
patterns.context: In a narrative sentence describing a defendant manager who subsequently proposed selling a car.

patterns.name: Subscripts in technical notation
patterns.context: sub is used as a variable subscript marker, embedded in fault symbols and a list of mathematical expressions.

9_2480.concept: sub 前缀与 cell 术语
9_2480.description: 主要对被切分出的 sub 字符串及其在代码、排版命令和普通单词中的出现敏感；另有对 cell 及细胞研究短语的响应。也覆盖地址代码、上下标符号等局部模式。

patterns.name: sub 字符串
patterns.context: 在单词开头或标记、命令附近出现；有时后续字符被拆成 token，如「substance」「subdivision」「subsequently」「subsection」或「sub{sub}」。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本、法律、医学、代码及排版

patterns.name: cell 字符串
patterns.context: 出现在细胞相关术语或短语中，尤其是 cell line、cell surface、cell model；部分文本中切分为子词。

patterns.name: CSS 垂直对齐与上下标
patterns.context: 与 CSS 属性、值和花括号规则同现，描述行高、垂直对齐及上下标位置。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 CSS 代码

patterns.name: 代码中的寄存器/地址缩写
patterns.context: 位于制表符缩进的类汇编代码中，周围有寄存器、逗号及地址操作注释。

patterns.name: LaTeX 标题间距命令
patterns.context: 出现在重复的 \titlespacing 命令及 section/subsection 层级参数中；命令被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 排版问答中的 LaTeX

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 sub 前缀
patterns.context: 分页或换行后接法律文书正文中的普通英文单词，并非代码命令。

patterns.name: 地块细分术语
patterns.context: 出现在 plat、lots、streets 等地块测绘和土地划分语境中。

patterns.name: subsequently 的词首
patterns.context: 描述被告经理之后提出售车的叙述句中。

patterns.name: 技术符号中的下标
patterns.context: sub 用作变量下标标记，嵌在故障符号及数学式列举中。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的技术论述

tokens:
line
height

vertical
align
 baseline



sub

bottom
em

top
em



a

en.description: Activations are scattered across code, URLs, medicine, geology, genes, bibliography, physics, and SQL, falling on diverse in-word fragments, proper nouns, terms, and number formats; there is no stable shared semantic or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Android XML/Java package names and component fragments
patterns.context: Attribute values, reverse-domain package names, and component class names in Android layout XML

patterns.name: Word fragments in automotive safety URLs
patterns.context: Government URL following vehicle safety information

patterns.name: Meat terms and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Descriptions of beef cuts, tenderization, and aging

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in geology terms
patterns.context: Geology passage describing sediments and their weathering sources

patterns.name: In-word fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Discussion of chemical hepatectomy and bile duct-related effects

patterns.name: sub and method calls in code
patterns.context: JavaScript code replacing match results and calling methods

patterns.name: Word fragments related to voles and microsatellites
patterns.context: Compares gene regions and mating systems in species such as prairie voles

patterns.name: Volume counts and price formats in bibliography
patterns.context: Lists volumes and net prices in a book catalog or publication list

patterns.name: Wilson ratio terminology
patterns.context: Discusses temperature-dependent Wilson ratio and related physical results

patterns.name: SQL subqueries and field names
patterns.context: Explains how to deduplicate by field and select the minimum rid in a query

9_2480.concept: none
9_2480.description: 激活分散在代码、网址、医学、地质、基因、书目、物理和 SQL 等语境，落在多种词内片段、专名、术语及数字格式上；没有稳定共享的语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: Android XML／Java 包名与组件词片段
patterns.context: Android 布局 XML 中的属性值、反向域名包名及组件类名

patterns.name: 汽车安全网址中的词片段
patterns.context: 车辆安全说明后出现的政府网址

patterns.name: 肉类术语及词内片段
patterns.context: 牛肉部位、嫩化及成熟过程的描述

patterns.name: 地质词的词尾片段
patterns.context: 描述沉积物及其风化来源的地质段落

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 讨论化学性肝切除及胆管相关效应

patterns.name: 代码中的 sub 与方法调用
patterns.context: JavaScript 代码中对匹配结果进行替换并调用方法

patterns.name: 田鼠与微卫星相关词片段
patterns.context: 比较草原田鼠等物种的基因区域及配偶制度

patterns.name: 书目中的卷数、价格格式
patterns.context: 书籍目录或出版物清单中列卷数与净价

patterns.name: Wilson ratio 术语
patterns.context: 讨论温度依赖的 Wilson ratio 及相关物理结果

patterns.name: SQL 子查询及字段名
patterns.context: 解释如何按字段去重并选取最小 rid 的查询

en.description: Responds to structured strings joined by delimiters such as periods, slashes, and @, especially URL domains and email addresses; also appears in dotted package names in code and hexadecimal strings in signature fields.

patterns.name: Domains and paths in URLs
patterns.context: In URLs, link previews, or software source addresses, especially when domain names are split into multiple tokens
patterns.domain: Web links, software configuration, forum text, email advertisements

patterns.name: Email addresses and contact lists
patterns.context: Email addresses appear in contact/recipient lists, signatures, or address-book-style text

patterns.name: Code package names and namespaces
patterns.context: In Java import statements, package names or class paths comprise multiple identifiers joined by periods

patterns.name: Hexadecimal strings in hashes or signatures
patterns.context: Long hexadecimal strings appear as signature values in JSON-style data

9_2480.concept: 分隔符连接的机器可读标识符
9_2480.description: 响应由句点、斜杠、@等分隔符连接的结构化字符串，尤其是网址域名、邮箱地址；也见于代码点分包名和签名字段中的十六进制串。

patterns.name: 网址中的域名与路径
patterns.trigger: «http»、«www»、«.»、域名片段及后续路径，如«rig»«zone»«.»«com»；也包括以«.»开头的域名文本
patterns.context: URL、链接预览或软件源地址中，尤其是域名被切分成多个 token 的场景
patterns.domain: 网页链接、软件配置、论坛文本、邮件广告

patterns.name: 邮箱地址及联系人列表
patterns.trigger: 邮箱中的«@»、«.»和地址片段，如«@»«hotmail»«.»，或成串的姓名与邮箱
patterns.context: 邮件地址出现在联系人/收件人列表、签名或通讯录样式文本中

patterns.name: 代码包名与命名空间
patterns.context: Java import 语句中，包名或类路径由多个标识符和句点组成

patterns.name: 散列或签名中的十六进制串
patterns.trigger: «11»«ef»«1»…等十六进制字符片段，以及«signature»字段和值
patterns.context: JSON 样式数据中长十六进制字符串作为签名值出现

en.description: Activations often occur in structured string fragments, especially email addresses and URLs/domains; also covers LaTeX commands, shell paths, JSON fields, and source-code comments, licenses, and documentation declarations. The commonality is identifiers or configuration text delimited by special punctuation, but trigger forms differ across domains.

patterns.name: Email addresses and contact lists
patterns.context: Multiple email addresses appear consecutively, often alongside names, usernames, or email-header fields; activations particularly fall on email domains and their local characters

patterns.name: URLs and domains
patterns.context: URLs occur in links, website information, or standalone Web link lists; domains are usually adjacent to paths, punctuation, or line breaks
patterns.domain: Forum text, web directories, code comments, and license text

patterns.name: LaTeX configuration commands and parameters
patterns.context: Commands and brace-delimited parameters occur consecutively in LaTeX/Beamer source code

patterns.name: Command-line paths and hyphenated segments
patterns.context: IRC conversations show shell prompts, paths, or grep commands; path components consist of slashes, hyphens, and letters

patterns.name: JSON fields and object data
patterns.context: Quoted field names, colons, numbers, or arrays are arranged in JSON style within brace-delimited objects

patterns.name: Personal contact information in code comments
patterns.context: Comment lines introduce project metadata such as email addresses and URLs with labels like Contact or Website

patterns.name: License and software-name links
patterns.context: Software names are adjacent to official links in license terms or derivative-work licensing statements

patterns.name: Code docstrings and initialization declarations
patterns.context: Docstrings follow field declarations in Lisp-like structure/class definitions

patterns.name: Tourism domains in URL lists
patterns.context: Multiple .com domains formed from a place name plus expo are listed consecutively after a “Web” heading
patterns.domain: Web directory or tourism promotional text

9_2480.concept: 标点界定的结构化标识符
9_2480.description: 激活常出现在结构化字符串片段中，尤其是邮箱地址和网址/域名；也覆盖 LaTeX 命令、shell 路径、JSON 字段及源码注释、许可证和文档声明。共同点是特殊标点界定的标识符或配置文本，但各领域触发形式不同。

patterns.name: 邮箱地址与联系人列表
patterns.trigger: 如“@hotmail.com”“@eng.auburn.edu”“@webtv.net”，以及邮箱前后的逗号分隔项
patterns.context: 多条邮箱地址连续排列，常伴随姓名、用户名或邮件头字段；激活尤其落在邮箱域名及其局部字符上

patterns.name: 网址与域名
patterns.trigger: 如“http://”“www.”、“stellar…org”“mexicoexpo.com”“…toolbox.com”及 URL 中的域名部分
patterns.context: 网址出现在链接、网站信息或独立的 Web 链接列表中；域名通常与路径、标点或换行相邻
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、网页目录、代码注释与许可证文本

patterns.name: LaTeX 配置命令与参数
patterns.context: LaTeX/Beamer 源码中，命令及花括号参数连续出现

patterns.name: 命令行路径与连字符分段
patterns.context: IRC 对话中展示 shell 提示符、路径或 grep 命令；路径组件由斜杠、连字符和字母构成

patterns.name: JSON 字段与对象数据
patterns.context: 花括号对象中的引号字段名、冒号、数值或数组按 JSON 风格排列

patterns.name: 代码注释中的个人联系信息
patterns.context: 注释行以 Contact 或 Website 标签引出邮箱、网址等项目元数据

patterns.name: 许可证与软件专名链接
patterns.context: 许可证条款或衍生作品许可说明中，软件名称与官方链接相邻

patterns.name: 代码文档字符串与初始化声明
patterns.context: 类似 Lisp 的结构/类定义中，字段声明后附文档字符串

patterns.name: 网址列表中的旅游域名
patterns.context: “Web”标题后连续列出多个以地点名加 expo 构成的 .com 域名
patterns.domain: 网页目录或旅游推广文本

en.description: Activations occur in fragments of split domains, email addresses, paths, and identifiers; the clearest repeated pattern is hotmail in email addresses. Code identifiers, number formats, and other link fragments lack stable shared trigger conditions.

patterns.name: hotmail email suffix in a domain
patterns.context: hotmail appears in email addresses, usually after @ and before .com.

patterns.name: Specific domain fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Domains in ordinary text or links are split into subwords; activations fall on internal domain fragments, but different domains show no evident shared suffix.

patterns.name: Long path or identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in code paths, Java package names, or configuration identifiers joined by slashes, underscores, hyphens, or word boundaries; specific high-activation positions vary.
patterns.domain: Code, build configurations, and technical identifiers

patterns.name: Fragmented subwords in technical identifiers
patterns.context: Variables, member accesses, or underscore-joined code identifiers are split into multiple tokens; there is no stable semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Fragments in email addresses and names
patterns.context: Parts of names, usernames, or email addresses in email headers are split into tokens; unlike the hotmail hit in section 10, no consistent address substring is apparent.

patterns.name: Number and financial-format fragments
patterns.context: Scattered weak activations occur in formats such as numbers, prices, gains, and dates, without a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Unclear webpage or code boundary fragments
patterns.context: There are local activations but no shared, confirmable trigger form; they may be incidental responses to tokenization boundaries or long identifiers.

9_2480.concept: 碎片化字符串片段
9_2480.description: 激活分布在被拆分的域名、邮件地址、路径及标识符等字符串片段中；最明确的重复是邮件地址里的 hotmail。代码标识符、数字格式及其他链接片段则缺乏稳定的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 域名中的 hotmail 邮箱后缀
patterns.context: hotmail 出现在电子邮件地址中，通常是 @ 后、.com 前。

patterns.name: URL 中的特定域名片段
patterns.context: 普通文本或链接中的域名被拆成子词；激活落在域名内部片段，但不同域名之间没有明显共同后缀。
patterns.domain: 网页链接及投资相关邮件

patterns.name: 较长的路径或标识符片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在由斜杠、下划线、连字符或词边界连接的代码路径、Java 包名或配置标识符中；具体高激活位置各异。
patterns.domain: 代码、构建配置与技术标识符

patterns.name: 技术标识符中的碎片化子词
patterns.context: 变量、成员访问或下划线连接的代码标识符被拆分为多个 token；没有稳定的语义触发词。

patterns.name: 邮件地址及姓名中的片段
patterns.context: 邮件头中的姓名、用户名或邮箱地址局部被拆分标记；与第10段的 hotmail 命中不同，未见统一的地址子串。

patterns.name: 数字及金融格式片段
patterns.context: 数字、价格、涨幅和日期等格式中出现零散弱激活，未形成一致模式。

patterns.name: 不明确的网页或代码边界片段
patterns.context: 虽有局部激活，但没有共同且可确认的触发形式；可能是分词边界或长标识符带来的偶然响应。
patterns.domain: 混合：网页、代码、技术文本

en.description: Primarily activates on protocols, domains, periods, and path segments in URLs and their Markdown link structure; also activates on include directives and file paths in code, as well as Java dot-separated package names and class identifiers.

patterns.name: URL or link format
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on URL protocols, hostnames, paths, and link markers; links often appear in Hacker News comments or article excerpts, typically following explanatory text.
patterns.domain: Web links, Hacker News posts and comments

patterns.name: Domains and path segments in URLs
patterns.context: URLs contain multi-level domains, compound-word paths, or date and number paths; tokenized text within URLs is more prominent than in ordinary prose.
patterns.domain: Web URLs; links about news, government statistics, finance, travel, blogs, and more

patterns.name: C/C++ include paths
patterns.context: Appears in consecutive preprocessor include directives at the start of code files; trigger points include directive symbols and directory/file names.

patterns.name: Identifiers in Java package and class names
patterns.context: These dot-separated package and class names recur in declarations and import statements and include compound identifiers.
patterns.domain: Java code on GitHub, related to electronic signatures and certificate reports

9_2480.concept: 结构化路径与标识符
9_2480.description: 主要对 URL 及其 Markdown 链接结构中的协议、域名、点号和路径片段激活；另对代码里的 include 指令、文件路径，以及 Java 点分包名和类标识符激活。

patterns.name: 网址或链接格式
patterns.trigger: «http»、«://»、«www»、域名片段以及 Markdown 链接的 «](»
patterns.context: 激活主要集中在 URL 的协议、主机名、路径和链接标记中；链接常出现在 Hacker News 评论或文章摘录里，通常紧随说明性文字。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、Hacker News 帖子及评论

patterns.name: URL 中的域名及路径片段
patterns.trigger: «.»、域名字符片段以及斜杠分隔的 URL 路径，如 «productivity»、«eurostat»、«capitalism»、«financement»
patterns.context: 网址本身含多级域名、复合词路径或日期与数字路径；相较常规正文，URL 内部的分词式文本更突出。
patterns.domain: 网页 URL；包含新闻、政府统计、金融、旅行、博客等链接

patterns.name: C/C++ include 路径
patterns.context: 出现在代码文件开头的连续预处理器 include 指令中，触发点包括指令符号及目录/文件名。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 C/C++ 源代码

patterns.name: Java 包名与类名中的标识符
patterns.context: 这些点分包名和类名在声明与 import 语句中重复出现，且含复合标识符。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Java 代码，电子签名与证书报告相关

en.description: Activations primarily fall on subword fragments in URLs, domains, paths, and adjacent punctuation; they also occur in code import paths, class names, and email addresses. Specific fragments vary with link topic and include EU certificates, software, energy, news, and institutional information.

patterns.name: Character-level decomposition of URL domains and paths
patterns.context: Primarily activates on URLs themselves and adjacent punctuation and path components; URLs often appear in Markdown links, citations, or webpage text.
patterns.domain: Web links, news discussions, email, code repositories, and job postings

patterns.name: EU certificate-related code and URLs
patterns.context: The SimpleCertificateReport class from EU eSignature DSS appears in a Java import statement; «ificate» in the certificate class name has the strongest activation. Similar fragments occur in EU/Europa domain URLs.
patterns.domain: GitHub Java code; EU statistics URLs

patterns.name: Package paths and identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears consecutively as code lexical fragments in Java import statements and near enum constants.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in energy company contact information
patterns.context: Appears in a subscription promotion in Enron email, adjacent to an email address, forming the Energy InfoSource contact address.

patterns.name: Air quality and cycling fragments in links
patterns.context: Appears in a discussion about London's car-free zones and related news links.
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions and news URLs

patterns.name: Product name fragments in links
patterns.context: Appears in the product path of a Chrome Web Store extension link.

patterns.name: Site name fragments in links
patterns.context: Appears in a link attached to a post about revisiting an old project; activation is concentrated on the domain and filename.
patterns.domain: Hacker News technical discussions and personal project links

patterns.name: Site fragments in energy news links
patterns.context: Appears in news about the South Pars gas field and its Rigzone link.

patterns.name: News site and article path fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the headline of legislative news forwarded in email and in a National Journal URL.

patterns.name: Recruitment agency URL fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the About Us section at the end of a job posting and in the Worcester Food & Active Living Policy Council URL.

9_2480.concept: 网址与技术字符串片段
9_2480.description: 激活主要落在网址、域名、路径及其邻近标点的子词片段上，也见于代码导入路径、类名和邮箱地址；具体片段随链接主题而异，涵盖欧盟证书、软件、能源、新闻及机构信息。

patterns.name: 网址域名及路径的字符级展开
patterns.trigger: «http»、«://»、«.»、域名片段（如 «e»«urop»«a»、«cycl»«ing»«indust»«ry»、«wor»«cester»）以及路径中的词和斜杠
patterns.context: 主要在网址本身及其邻近标点、路径成分中激活；网址常出现在 Markdown 链接、引用或网页文本中。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、新闻讨论、邮件、代码仓库和招聘信息

patterns.name: 欧盟证书相关代码与网址
patterns.context: Java 导入语句中出现 EU eSignature DSS 的 SimpleCertificateReport 类，证书类名中的 «ificate» 激活最强；同类 EU/Europa 域名网址也出现相近片段。
patterns.domain: GitHub Java 代码；欧盟统计网址

patterns.name: 代码中的包路径与标识符片段
patterns.context: 在 Java 导入语句和枚举常量附近，按代码词法片段连续出现。

patterns.name: 能源公司联系信息中的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Enron 邮件的订阅宣传语中，紧邻邮箱地址，构成 Energy InfoSource 的联系地址。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、能源行业宣传

patterns.name: 链接中的空气质量与骑行词片段
patterns.context: 出现在一条关于伦敦无车区域的讨论及相关新闻链接中。

patterns.name: 链接中的产品名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Chrome 网上应用店扩展程序链接的产品路径中。

patterns.name: 链接中的站点名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在关于回顾旧项目的帖子所附链接中，激活集中于域名和文件名。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论及个人项目链接

patterns.name: 能源新闻链接中的站点片段
patterns.context: 出现在南帕尔斯气田新闻及其 Rigzone 链接中。

patterns.name: 新闻站点与文章路径片段
patterns.context: 出现在邮件转发的立法新闻标题及 National Journal 网址中。

patterns.name: 招聘机构网址片段
patterns.context: 出现在招聘信息末尾的 About Us 段落及 Worcester Food & Active Living Policy Council 网址中。

en.description: Activations occur across many kinds of split long strings, especially URLs, domains, code paths, and identifiers; they also appear in equations, academic citations, and email addresses. The examples do not share a stable thematic meaning.

patterns.name: European domains and URLs
patterns.context: European domains, EU institution domains, and their hierarchical substrings in URLs or paths; often accompanied by split domain tokens.

patterns.name: Split substrings in code paths and identifiers
patterns.context: Paths, filenames, namespaces, and identifiers are split into multiple tokens in code or structured data; activation falls on the fragments, with no unified semantic requirement.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, Julia error output, configuration data

patterns.name: road/chose/me fragments in links
patterns.context: A URL follows the body text, and its domain or path contains these letter strings; activation is distributed across link tokens.

patterns.name: London Marathon news links
patterns.context: A link to a London Marathon story on a UK news site follows a mention of a route or year in the text.

patterns.name: β_M superscript in mathematical equations
patterns.context: Paper equations and nearby text about scattering physics; activation is concentrated on split LaTeX/mathematical tokens.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, Compton scattering and spin polarization

patterns.name: Author names and years in citations
patterns.context: Bracketed citations in ArXiv paper text, containing split author surnames, years, or reference numbers.

patterns.name: Energy email in customer contact information
patterns.context: Promotional or customer service notes end with an email address and phone number; activation is concentrated on fragments of the email domain.
patterns.domain: Business email, customer service contact information

9_2480.concept: 长字符串中的切分子串
9_2480.description: 激活出现在多种被切分的长字符串中，尤其 URL、域名、代码路径与标识符；另见公式、学术引用及邮箱。各例没有稳定共享的主题语义。

patterns.name: 欧洲相关域名与 URL
patterns.context: URL 或路径中的欧洲域名、欧盟机构域名及其层级子串；常伴随被切分的域名 token。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、Eurostat 数据文档

patterns.name: 代码路径与标识符中的切分子串
patterns.context: 代码或结构化数据中，路径、文件名、命名空间及标识符被拆成多个 token；激活落在片段上，未见统一语义要求。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码、Julia 错误输出、配置数据

patterns.name: 链接中的 road/chose/me 片段
patterns.context: 正文后附 URL，URL 的域名或路径包含这些字母串；激活分布在链接 token 上。

patterns.name: 伦敦马拉松新闻链接
patterns.context: 正文提及路线或年份后，附带英国新闻网站的伦敦马拉松链接。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 帖文、新闻链接

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 β_M 上标
patterns.context: 论文公式及其附近的散射物理文字；激活集中在被拆分的 LaTeX/数学 token。

patterns.name: 文献引用中的作者名与年份
patterns.context: ArXiv 论文正文中的方括号引用，含拆分的作者姓氏、年份或文献编号。

patterns.name: 客服联系方式中的能源邮箱
patterns.context: 促销或客服说明末尾提供电子邮件地址与电话；激活集中在邮箱域名片段。
patterns.domain: 商业邮件、客服联系信息

en.description: Activations occur in citations, terminology, and equations in physics papers, as well as Java imports, URLs, email links, institutional promotions, and wording in hiring forms; no clear common feature is apparent.

patterns.name: LaTeX citations and reference markers
patterns.context: Activates when academic text cites references, lists bibliography entries, or transitions to a summary; trigger points often neighbor citation markers and punctuation.

patterns.name: Technical terminology and equation symbols
patterns.context: Specialized terms, equations, or theory names in physics discussion; often co-occurs with citations but is not limited to them.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics and particle physics papers

patterns.name: Java package names and import statements
patterns.context: Consecutive dot-separated lowercase package paths and class names in code import statements.

patterns.name: URLs and URL paths
patterns.context: URLs consisting of domains, paths, or filenames; some appear in forwarded email content or institutional introductions.
patterns.domain: Email, institutional webpage text, and code-related text

patterns.name: Web links and email newsletter text
patterns.context: Web links and newsletter headlines in email; links are near dates and news site paths.
patterns.domain: Enron email and forwarded webpage content

patterns.name: Institutional promotions and contact information
patterns.context: Wording that introduces an organization, provides more information, or directs readers to a website or to send inquiries.
patterns.domain: Institutional webpage copy, email marketing, or contact information

patterns.name: Energy industry markets and consulting contacts
patterns.context: Introduces energy and industrial market trends and construction activity, and provides a consulting email or website.

patterns.name: Hiring form instructions
patterns.context: Brief instructions in a form or hiring process about completing it once a candidate is selected and about the start date.

9_2480.concept: none
9_2480.description: 激活分布于物理论文中的引文、术语与公式，也见 Java 导入、网址、邮件链接、机构宣传及招聘表格措辞；共同特征不明确。

patterns.name: LaTeX 引文与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 学术正文中引用文献、列举参考文献或转入总结时激活；触发点常邻接引文标记和标点。

patterns.name: 技术术语及公式符号
patterns.context: 物理学论述中的专门术语、公式或理论名称；多与文献引用同现，但触发并不局限于引文。
patterns.domain: 理论物理与粒子物理论文

patterns.name: Java 包名与导入语句
patterns.context: 连续的点分隔小写包路径和类名，出现在代码导入语句中。

patterns.name: 网址及 URL 路径
patterns.context: 网址由域名、路径或文件名构成；部分出现在邮件转发内容或机构介绍中。
patterns.domain: 邮件、机构网页文本及代码相关文本

patterns.name: 网页链接与邮件简报文本
patterns.context: 邮件中的网页链接和新闻简报标题，链接附近包含日期及新闻站点路径。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及转发网页内容

patterns.name: 机构宣传及联系信息
patterns.context: 介绍机构、提供更多信息或引导访问网站、发送咨询的措辞。
patterns.domain: 机构网页文案、邮件营销或联系信息

patterns.name: 能源产业市场与咨询联系
patterns.context: 介绍能源和工业市场趋势、建设活动，并提供咨询邮箱或网站。

patterns.name: 招聘表格指示语
patterns.context: 表格或职位流程中关于候选人确定后填写、起始日期的简短说明。

en.description: Primarily responds to characters and word fragments in URLs, domains, and paths; it also responds to code identifiers, punctuation, and command-style text. A few activations fall on garbled parameters and symbols in academic text. A possible common feature is that the strings are structured rather than ordinary prose, but evidence across examples is limited.

patterns.name: Domain and path fragments in URLs
patterns.context: Appears in links, link previews, or cited URLs; activation falls on URL components such as protocols, domains, paths, numbers, and extensions, without requiring a particular domain
patterns.domain: Web text, forum posts, job postings, email unsubscribe links, search result lists

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax delimiters
patterns.context: In code or code-like identifiers and file paths, package names, namespaces, commands, and delimiters are activated; examples include Java declarations/imports and DLL print commands
patterns.domain: Source code, commands, or filename dumps

patterns.name: Local fragments in special symbols and noisy text
patterns.context: Text interspersed with symbols, mixed-case letters, and seemingly encoded or garbled text; no stable natural-language semantic trigger is evident
patterns.domain: Link parameters or encoded text in email

patterns.name: Symbols and terminology in mathematical/physics papers
patterns.context: Appears in paper sentences about the chiral limit and polarizability, and in their citation markers; there is insufficient evidence that these words alone constitute a primary pattern

9_2480.concept: 结构化字符串片段
9_2480.description: 主要响应网址及其域名、路径中的字符和词片段，也响应代码标识符、标点和命令样式文本；少量激活落在乱码参数及学术文本符号中。共同点可能是结构化、非普通散文的字符串，但跨样例证据有限。

patterns.name: 网址中的域名与路径片段
patterns.trigger: 网址部分的字符或子词，如 «http», «://», «www», «.»、«/»，以及域名/路径词片段
patterns.context: 出现在链接、链接预览或引用网址中；激活落在协议、域名、路径、数字和扩展名等网址组成部分，不要求某个固定域名
patterns.domain: 网页文本、论坛帖子、招聘信息、邮件退订链接、搜索结果列表

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法分隔符
patterns.context: 代码或类似代码的标识符、文件路径中，包名、命名空间、命令及分隔符被激活；样例包括 Java 声明/导入和 DLL 打印命令
patterns.domain: 源代码、命令或文件名转储

patterns.name: 特殊符号和噪声文本中的局部片段
patterns.context: 夹杂符号、大小写混合字母与看似编码或乱码的文本；未见稳定的自然语言语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 邮件中的链接参数或编码文本

patterns.name: 数学/物理论文中的符号与术语
patterns.context: 出现在关于手征极限、极化率的论文句子及其引文标记中；没有足够证据说明这些词单独构成主模式

en.concept: Punctuation and delimiters in structured strings
en.description: Activations most often occur on punctuation and delimiter structures in URLs, paths, code identifiers, and Markdown image markers; academic citations also appear frequently. Other sporadic activations occur in ordinary phrases, job descriptions, and mathematical symbols, which cannot be fully explained by a single text feature.

patterns.name: Punctuation boundaries in URLs or paths
patterns.context: Activations often fall in URLs, file paths, or consecutive strings separated by punctuation; text before and after punctuation may both be marked, so this cannot be reduced to one punctuation mark or word.
patterns.domain: Web links, code, file paths, and document markup

patterns.name: ArXiv citations and citation markers
patterns.context: Bracketed or author-year citations in academic text; activation is distributed across multiple components of the citation string.

patterns.name: Markdown image and anchor markers
patterns.context: Image links and the following numbered anchors form a repeated sequence of Markdown captions/image markers.
patterns.domain: Markdown-converted content from PubMed Central medical literature

patterns.name: Fields and identifiers in embedded code
patterns.context: Struct initialization in C code; activation covers field names, underscores, and hyphen-separated identifiers.

patterns.name: Web addresses containing numbers
patterns.context: A link appears in a HackerNews post, with activation on the URL protocol, domain, path, and numbers; it resembles code paths and other formats, but is recorded separately here as a specific trigger form.

patterns.name: Hyphenated filesystem paths
patterns.context: A macOS/Xcode deletion path provided in a StackExchange answer; activation covers directory separators and path components.

patterns.name: Standalone form/job description fragments
patterns.context: These words and phrases are activated, but the available context does not show a clear relation to citations, code, or link formats.

patterns.name: Standalone ordinary text fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary phrases in HackerNews text are marked; although adjacent to a link, it is unclear whether activation is caused by the phrases themselves or nearby URLs/punctuation.

patterns.name: Standalone mathematical symbol
patterns.context: A LaTeX mathematical expression in academic text; the activation marker falls on the exponent `2`, and its relation to other patterns is unclear.

9_2480.concept: 结构化字符串中的标点与分隔符
9_2480.description: 激活最常见于 URL、路径、代码标识符和 Markdown 图像标记中的标点及分隔结构；学术引文也频繁出现。另有普通短语、职位描述和数学符号等零散激活，不能由单一文本特征充分解释。

patterns.name: URL或路径中的标点边界
patterns.context: 激活常落在 URL、文件路径或由标点分隔的连续字符串中；标点前后的文本可能同时被标记，不能归结为某一种标点或词。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、代码、文件路径及文档标记

patterns.name: ArXiv 引用与引文标记
patterns.context: 学术正文中的方括号引用或作者—年份引文，激活分布在引文字符串的多个组成部分。

patterns.name: Markdown 图片与锚点标记
patterns.context: 图像链接及其后续编号锚点连成重复的 Markdown 图注/图像标记序列。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 医学文献的 Markdown 化内容

patterns.name: 嵌入代码的字段与标识符
patterns.context: C 代码中的结构体初始化，激活覆盖字段名、下划线和连字符分隔的标识符。

patterns.name: 带数字的网页地址
patterns.context: 链接出现在 HackerNews 帖文中，URL 的协议、域名、路径和数字均有激活；与代码路径等格式相似，但此处单独记录其具体触发形式。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 中引用的网页链接

patterns.name: 带连字符的文件系统路径
patterns.context: StackExchange 回答中给出的 macOS/Xcode 删除路径；激活覆盖目录分隔符和路径组件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答与文件系统路径

patterns.name: 独立的表格/职位描述片段
patterns.trigger: `be filled when appropriate candidate is identified`、`Start date is ASAP`
patterns.context: 这些词句被激活，但现有上下文没有显示它们与引文、代码或链接格式有明确关系。

patterns.name: 独立的普通文本片段
patterns.context: HackerNews 文字中的普通短语被标记，虽紧邻链接，但无法确定激活由短语本身还是邻近 URL/标点造成。

patterns.name: 独立的数学符号
patterns.context: 学术正文中的 LaTeX 数学表达式；激活标记落在指数 `2`，其与其他模式的联系不明确。

en.description: Activations appear in paper equations and citations, web links, and kernel IRQ identifiers; sporadic academic word fragments and forum comments also trigger. The text forms have no clear shared semantic content.

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and equation symbols in papers
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX math environments or near equations, including variables, superscripts/subscripts, function notation, and mathematical typesetting commands.

patterns.name: Paper citations and author-year markers
patterns.context: References appear as inline bracketed citations, @author:year, and reference identifiers.

patterns.name: URLs and link text
patterns.context: Full URLs, Markdown links, or URLs in JSON fields; activation is distributed across fragments such as protocols, domains, paths, and delimiters.
patterns.domain: Web discussions, code repository configurations, and Q&A pages

patterns.name: Linux kernel IRQ code identifiers
patterns.context: Underscore-separated device/interrupt handler identifiers and struct member access in C code.

patterns.name: Specific word fragments in academic narrative
patterns.context: Appears in sentences introducing ellipsoidally symmetric solutions and their references; these words do not recur in other paragraphs, so broader triggering conditions are unclear.

patterns.name: Phrases and usernames in web discussions
patterns.context: A short comment follows a short username in a comment-style post, followed by an external link; these triggers do not appear to be URL components.

9_2480.concept: none
9_2480.description: 激活出现在论文公式与引文、网页链接、内核 IRQ 标识符等处；另有零散学术词片段及论坛评论触发。各类文本形态并无明确共同语义。

patterns.name: 论文中的数学排版与公式符号
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学环境或公式附近，包含变量、上标/下标、函数记号及数学排版命令。

patterns.name: 论文引文与作者年份标记
patterns.context: 参考文献以内联方括号、@作者:年份及文献标识符形式出现。

patterns.name: 网址及链接文本
patterns.context: 出现完整 URL、Markdown 链接或 JSON 字段中的网址；激活分布在协议、域名、路径和分隔符等片段。
patterns.domain: 网页讨论、代码仓库配置及问答页面

patterns.name: Linux 内核 IRQ 代码标识符
patterns.context: C 代码中由下划线连接的设备/中断处理标识符及结构体成员访问。

patterns.name: 学术叙述中的特定词片段
patterns.context: 出现在介绍椭球对称解及其文献出处的句子中；这组词在其他段落未见，是否有更广泛的触发条件不明。

patterns.name: 网页讨论中的短语及用户名
patterns.context: 评论式帖子中，短用户名后接简短评论，随后出现外链；这些触发未显示为 URL 的组成部分。

en.concept: Proper names and identifiers in technical text
en.description: Activations are scattered across academic citation keys, URLs/email addresses, Maven configuration versions and dependency paths, and jQuery submenu identifiers. Energy industry contact information or the string continental appears in several segments, but there is no unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: continental in a domain
patterns.context: “continental” is split into subword fragments in the URL http://continentalairlines.rsc01.net; activation is strongest on “ental”.
patterns.domain: Privacy policy or webpage link in Enron email

patterns.name: Academic citation numbers and adjacent letters
patterns.context: In physics paper citations, citation-key letters or characters following four-digit years are also often marked; the discussions concern dark matter, the matter power spectrum, Faddeev-AGS equations, or the Higgs boson.
patterns.domain: ArXiv academic papers and their citations

patterns.name: continental in a domain or URL
patterns.context: “ental” in the split “intercontinental” is marked within “intercontinental ballistic missiles”; a Wikipedia link also appears in the same paragraph, but the link itself is not marked.

patterns.name: Versions and paths in Maven dependency configuration
patterns.context: Spring Cloud Maven repository paths and version strings in XML configuration are marked in segments; configuration tags and the jar:// prefix are also marked.

patterns.name: Contact address in unsubscribe email
patterns.context: In a newsletter email's unsubscribe instructions and brand URL, the email address and the text worldenergyonline in the URL are marked.
patterns.domain: Energy industry newsletter in Enron email

patterns.name: jQuery submenu code
patterns.context: In JavaScript/jQuery code, submenu variables, CSS selectors, and navigation menu identifiers are marked.

patterns.name: Energy industry contact address
patterns.context: Promotional text about the electricity, energy, and industrial markets ends with a contact email; all parts of the email are prominently marked.
patterns.domain: Energy industry promotional content in Enron email

9_2480.concept: 技术文本中的专名与标识符
9_2480.description: 激活分散于学术引用键、网址/邮箱、Maven 配置版本与依赖路径、jQuery 子菜单标识符；多段出现能源行业联系信息或 continental 字样，但缺少统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 域名中的 continental
patterns.context: “continental”被拆成子词片段，出现在网址 http://continentalairlines.rsc01.net 中；强激活集中于“ental”。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的隐私政策或网页链接

patterns.name: 学术引用编号及相邻字母
patterns.context: 物理学论文的文献引用中，四位年份后的引用键字母或字符也常被标记；具体论述涉及暗物质、物质功率谱、Faddeev-AGS 方程或希格斯玻色子。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及其文献引用

patterns.name: 域名或网址中的 continental
patterns.context: “intercontinental”拆分处的“ental”被标记，位于“intercontinental ballistic missiles”中；同段还出现维基百科链接，但链接本身未标记。

patterns.name: Maven 依赖配置中的版本与路径
patterns.context: XML 配置中的 Spring Cloud Maven 仓库路径及版本字符串被分段标记；同时标记了配置标签和 jar:// 前缀。

patterns.name: 退订邮件中的联系地址
patterns.context: 邮件简报的退订说明及品牌网址中，邮箱地址和网址里的 worldenergyonline 字样被标记。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源行业简报

patterns.name: jQuery 子菜单代码
patterns.context: JavaScript/jQuery 代码中，子菜单变量、CSS 选择器及导航菜单相关标识符被标记。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页开发问答代码

patterns.name: 能源行业联系地址
patterns.context: 介绍电力、能源和工业市场的宣传文字，以联系邮箱为结尾；邮箱各部分显著标记。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的能源行业宣传内容

en.concept: Structured strings in code and URLs
en.description: Primarily responds to protocols, punctuation, and string fragments in URLs and domains; it also activates near XML tag indentation, error records with hexadecimal addresses, and underscore-separated C identifiers.

patterns.name: Punctuation and strings in URLs and domains
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across URL protocols, hostnames, domains, and paths; sometimes the same link appears both in the body text and in a parenthetical link.
patterns.domain: Links in webpages, email, forums, and documents

patterns.name: HTML/XML tags and indentation adjacent to URLs
patterns.context: Appears near XML tags, attributes, or code indentation in dependency declarations; activation is not limited to URLs.

patterns.name: Address numbers in compressed-file error stacks
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears in the ZipFile.ZipInfo object address `0x1004ca`, near Bad password error text.

patterns.name: IRQ/power-related C identifiers
patterns.context: Identifiers are split into multiple tokens within underscore-separated kernel-style function and parameter names.

patterns.name: Resource statistics identifiers in C code
patterns.context: Appears in the function declaration `spx_resource_stats_cpu_time`, surrounded by C code and preprocessor directives.

9_2480.concept: 代码与网址中的结构化字符串
9_2480.description: 主要响应网址及域名的协议、标点和字符串片段；另在 XML 标签缩进、带十六进制地址的错误记录，以及下划线分隔的 C 标识符中激活。

patterns.name: 网址与域名中的标点和字符串
patterns.context: 激活分布在网址的协议、主机名、域名和路径中；有时同一链接在正文和括号链接中重复出现。
patterns.domain: 网页、邮件、论坛与文档中的链接

patterns.name: URL 邻接的 HTML/XML 标记与缩进
patterns.context: 出现在依赖声明的 XML 标签、属性或代码缩进附近，激活并非只限于网址。

patterns.name: 压缩文件错误栈中的地址数字
patterns.context: 重复出现在 ZipFile.ZipInfo 对象地址 `0x1004ca` 中，邻近 Bad password 错误文本。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 错误输出/调试记录

patterns.name: IRQ/电源相关 C 标识符
patterns.context: 在下划线分隔的内核风格函数名和参数名内部，标识符被切分为多个 token。
patterns.domain: Github C 代码/驱动程序

patterns.name: C 代码中的资源统计标识符
patterns.context: 出现在函数声明 `spx_resource_stats_cpu_time` 中，周围是 C 代码和预处理指令。

en.concept: Boundaries and identifiers in structured technical text
en.description: High activations primarily occur in structured technical text such as code, configuration, markup, and URLs, especially delimiters, tag/attribute boundaries, and identifiers composed of multiple word fragments. Specific domains and terms vary; occasional webpage copy and email links also appear.

patterns.name: Delimiters and markup in structured technical text
patterns.context: These symbols appear in consecutive technical strings, separating URLs, code identifiers, XML attributes, or style declarations; they usually neighbor longer word fragments, numbers, or keywords. The specific highly activated symbols differ by segment, with no single fixed symbol consistently prominent across all segments.
patterns.domain: Software code, configuration files, HTML/XML/CSS, URLs, and links in email

patterns.name: Compound identifiers in code and configuration
patterns.context: Technical names joined by capitalization, underscores, or hyphens; activation may fall on multiple word fragments and joining characters in an identifier.

patterns.name: URL and domain paths
patterns.context: When domain components, periods, slashes, and paths occur consecutively in a URL; domain word fragments in segment 1 are especially strongly activated.
patterns.domain: Web links, news links in email

patterns.name: XML/HTML tag and attribute structure
patterns.context: Markup syntax consisting of angle brackets, tag names, attribute names, quotation marks, and attribute values; comments and tag/attribute boundaries also trigger responses.
patterns.domain: XML, HTML, and similar markup languages

patterns.name: Object-oriented and package name paths
patterns.context: Dot-separated package names or qualified names followed by class/repository names; appears in Java imports and dependency configuration.

patterns.name: CSS variables and declaration syntax
patterns.context: Variables beginning with `@`, hyphenated compound names, and colon-separated properties and values, with style declarations ending in semicolons.

patterns.name: Specific technical word fragments
patterns.context: Field names, component names, and domain identifiers in code or configuration; these terms occur in different project contexts and do not form a single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Food policy domain in business webpage copy
patterns.context: Appears as the website address in institutional introductions and contact information for a local food and active living policy council.

patterns.name: Media names in email news links
patterns.context: A news recommendation headline and URL at the end of an email, with the media domain adjacent to the link path.

patterns.name: Hardware interrupts and probe flow in code
patterns.context: Identifiers, struct members, and jump labels for a GPIO power interrupt chip and probe flow in kernel driver code.

patterns.name: Android state color resources
patterns.context: An Android XML selector specifies drawable or color resources by control state.

patterns.name: Time picker plugin references
patterns.context: A Bootstrap time picker plugin is mentioned in an HTML comment and script `src` path.

patterns.name: Legacy border attributes in table styles
patterns.context: Inline styles on HTML table cells, including Word-related `mso-` attributes and length units.

patterns.name: Functional code and jump syntax
patterns.context: Struct member access, bitwise operations, and label jumps in C code; symbols and identifiers are interspersed.

patterns.name: Weak word items explained only by structured code/markup context
patterns.context: Appear respectively as XML attribute values, CSS keywords, or filename fragments near markup/links; they do not form a unified semantic trigger by themselves.

9_2480.concept: 结构化技术文本的边界与标识符
9_2480.description: 高激活主要出现在代码、配置、标记语言和网址等结构化技术文本中，尤其是分隔符、标签/属性边界及由多词片段组成的标识符；具体领域和词项多样，偶见网页文案与邮件链接。

patterns.name: 结构化技术文本中的分隔符与标记
patterns.context: 这些符号出现在连续的技术字符串中，用来分隔网址、代码标识符、XML属性或样式声明；通常邻接较长的词片段、数字或关键字。各段中具体高激活符号不同，未见单一固定符号在所有段一致突出。
patterns.domain: 软件代码、配置文件、HTML/XML/CSS、网址及邮件中的链接

patterns.name: 代码与配置中的复合标识符
patterns.context: 大小写、下划线或连字符连接的技术名称；激活可落在标识符的多个组成词片段及连接符上。

patterns.name: 网址与域名路径
patterns.context: URL 中域名各组成部分、句点、斜线及路径连续出现时；第1段域名词片段激活尤其强。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、邮件中的新闻链接

patterns.name: XML/HTML标签与属性结构
patterns.context: 尖括号、标签名、属性名、引号和属性值构成的标记语法中；注释及标签/属性边界也有响应。

patterns.name: 面向对象及包名路径
patterns.context: 由点号连接的包名或限定名，后接类名/仓库名；Java代码导入语句及依赖配置中出现。

patterns.name: CSS变量与声明语法
patterns.context: 以 `@` 开头的变量、连字符复合名，以及冒号分隔的属性和值、分号结尾的样式声明。

patterns.name: 特定技术词片段
patterns.context: 代码或配置中的字段名、组件名和领域标识符；这些词分别出现于不同项目上下文，未形成单一稳定词义模式。

patterns.name: 业务网页文案中的食品政策域名
patterns.context: 机构介绍及联系信息中，作为地方食品与积极生活政策委员会的网站地址。

patterns.name: 邮件新闻链接中的媒体名称
patterns.context: 邮件末尾的新闻推荐标题及网址中，媒体域名与链接路径相邻。

patterns.name: 代码中的硬件中断与探测流程
patterns.context: 内核驱动代码中，GPIO电源中断芯片及探测流程的标识符、结构体成员和跳转标签。

patterns.name: Android状态颜色资源
patterns.context: Android XML选择器中，按控件状态指定 drawable 或颜色资源。

patterns.name: 时间选择器插件引用
patterns.context: HTML注释及脚本 `src` 路径中提及 Bootstrap 时间选择器插件。

patterns.name: 表格样式中的旧式边框属性
patterns.context: HTML表格单元格的内联样式，含 Word 相关 `mso-` 属性及长度单位。

patterns.name: 函数式代码与跳转语法
patterns.context: C代码中的结构体成员访问、位运算及标签跳转；符号与标识符交错。

patterns.name: 仅由结构化代码/标记上下文解释的弱词项
patterns.context: 分别作为XML属性值、CSS关键字或文件名片段出现在标记/链接附近；本身并不构成统一语义触发。

en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on the literal fragment “Pad”: it commonly occurs in iPad names and also as a typographic fill character; it also appears as an incidental substring in foreign words or proper names, without a consistent meaning.

patterns.name: Substring within iPad
patterns.context: Appears in Apple iPad names or related models, filenames, and app names; sometimes preceded by a word boundary or with different capitalization.

patterns.name: Fill / placeholder token
