patterns.context: Appears as fill content or an alignment placeholder in tables or text, not necessarily referring to a device.

patterns.name: Pad substring in foreign words
patterns.context: May have no semantic relation to iPad; it may result from tokenization or text encoding.
patterns.domain: Latvian parliamentary text, Italian proper names

9_2521.description: 激活主要集中于字面片段“Pad”：常见于 iPad 名称，也出现为排版填充符；另有外语词或专名中的偶然子串，语义并不统一。

patterns.name: iPad 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现 Apple iPad 名称或相关型号、文件名、应用名；有时前面带有分词边界或大小写变化。

patterns.name: 填充/填充符 token
patterns.context: 作为表格或文本中的填充内容、对齐占位符出现，不一定指设备。

patterns.name: 外语词中的 Pad 子串
patterns.trigger: “Pad”出现在非英语词语或断裂的分词片段中，如“Padome”“Padova”
patterns.context: 未必与 iPad 有语义关联，可能是分词或文本编码造成的偶合。
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语议会文本、意大利语专名

en.description: Activation is scattered across medical, encyclopedic, news, and web text, often falling on subword boundaries within words or fragments of proper names. Other local patterns include CD identifiers, left-right comparisons, repeated table fields, headlines, and purpose statements.

patterns.name: Tokenization boundaries in words or headlines
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on internal subword fragments in English words or proper names, especially across tokenizer subword boundaries; some occur in headlines, links, or tables.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including medical papers, encyclopedia entries, news headlines, web links, and tables

patterns.name: CD in medical abbreviations
patterns.context: CD is followed by a numeric or alphanumeric identifier as part of a marker, molecule, or project name.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Left-right comparison
patterns.context: Explicitly compares differences between two groups, sites, or directions; one instance is in a headline, another in a left-right comparison in body text.

patterns.name: Repeated fields in structured tables
patterns.context: The same institution, location, and disease names recur across aligned table rows, with extensive whitespace.

patterns.name: News section headlines
patterns.context: Several section or category terms form a short headline, followed by a region and a colon.
patterns.domain: News digest headlines in Enron emails

patterns.name: Encyclopedia entry titles and definition openings
patterns.context: An entry title is a term or biological name; it may be followed by a blank line or the start of a defining sentence.

patterns.name: Product names and teardown links
patterns.context: A product name or teardown topic appears in a headline and URL path.

patterns.name: Research-purpose phrasing
patterns.context: A project description begins with a fixed administrative or academic phrase stating the research purpose.

9_2521.description: 激活分散于医学、百科、新闻和网页文本，常落在词内子词边界或专名片段；另见CD编号、差异比较、重复表格字段及标题、目的句式等局部模式。

patterns.name: 单词或标题中的分词边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在英语词语或专名的内部子词片段，尤其是跨 tokenizer 子词边界；部分出现在标题、链接或表格中。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括医学论文、百科条目、新闻标题、网页链接和表格

patterns.name: 医学缩写中的 CD
patterns.context: CD 后接数字或字母数字编号，作为标记、分子或项目名称的一部分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要和 NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 左侧与右侧对照
patterns.context: 明确比较两组、部位或方向的差异；一处为标题，一处为正文中的左右侧对比。

patterns.name: 结构化表格中的重复字段
patterns.context: 相同机构、地点和疾病名称在对齐的多行表格中重复出现，伴有大量空格。

patterns.name: 新闻栏目标题
patterns.context: 多个栏目或类别词连成简短标题，后接地区和冒号。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的新闻简报标题

patterns.name: 百科词条标题与释义开头
patterns.context: 以术语或生物学名称作词条标题；其后可接空行或定义句开头。

patterns.name: 产品名与拆解链接
patterns.context: 产品名或拆机主题出现在标题及 URL 路径中。

patterns.name: 研究目的句式
patterns.context: 项目描述以研究目的的固定行政/学术句式开头。

en.description: Activation is scattered across fragments within technical terms, reference markers, double spaces in emails, and several common words. “losing” appears in both a sports passage and an IRC passage, but in different meanings and contexts. Overall, there is no stable, unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Morpheme/tokenization boundaries within technical terms and rare proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within technical terms, abbreviations, or personal names; these fragments are often concatenated with adjacent unmarked morphemes.
patterns.domain: Technical texts, including patents, medicine, physics, and research abstracts

patterns.name: Spaces after numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: When two spaces separate sentences after a period in emails, the spaces themselves activate strongly; the following sentence-initial word also activates.

patterns.name: Losing-streak phrasing in sports news
patterns.context: In passage 4, “losing” occurs in a team defeat or losing-streak context; in passage 8, the same word form appears in the idiom “losing sleep,” with a different meaning.
patterns.domain: Sports news; fixed expression in IRC dialogue

patterns.name: Citation and reference markers
patterns.context: Activation occurs near years or citation markers; fragments within reference authors’ names also activate.

patterns.name: Frequent fragments in common words
patterns.context: “you” and “believe” activate in emails; “instrumental” activates in research descriptions, but no consistent local syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Sporadic positions that do not fit the above patterns
patterns.context: Some activations occur in common words, domain-specific terms, or narrative sentences, with no stable shared condition across passages.
patterns.domain: Patents, papers, sports reporting, emails, and IRC

9_2521.description: 激活分散于专业名词内部片段、参考文献标记、邮件双空格及若干普通词；体育段与IRC段均出现losing，但语义和语境不同。整体没有稳定统一的语义触发。

patterns.name: 专业词内部的词素/切分边界及生僻专名
patterns.context: 激活落在专业名词、缩写或人名的词内片段上；这些片段常与未标记的相邻词素连写。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、物理、科研摘要等技术文本

patterns.name: 数字与标点后的空格
patterns.context: 邮件句号后以两个空格分隔新句时，空格本身激活很强；后续句首词也有激活。

patterns.name: 体育新闻中的连败表述
patterns.context: 段4中“losing”处于球队输球、连败语境；段8同一词形用于习语“losing sleep”，语义不同。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻；IRC 对话中的固定表达

patterns.name: 引用与参考文献标记
patterns.context: 年份或文献引用标记附近出现激活；参考文献人名的内部片段也激活。

patterns.name: 一般词语中的高频片段
patterns.context: 在邮件中“you”及“believe”激活；科研描述中“instrumental”激活，但未见统一的局部句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 无法归入上述模式的零散位置
patterns.context: 若干激活出现在普通词、领域词或叙述性语句中，跨段难以找到稳定的共同条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、论文、体育报道、邮件及 IRC

en.concept: Fragments of technical terms and proper names
en.description: Activation is scattered across academic and legal genres, often falling on proper names, technical terms, abbreviations, or tokenization boundaries. Scientific names and terms related to disease and reproductive medicine are prominent; other examples include the endings of legal citations, possessive apostrophes, and fragments of institutional names.

patterns.name: Specific stems in scientific names
patterns.context: In species or biological names, especially scientific names split by tokenization; also appears in titles and at the beginning of abstracts.

patterns.name: Legal citations and the ends of statutory references
patterns.context: A legal opinion cites the full and abbreviated names of a statute, then ends the citation with a period and starts a new line introducing a subsequent case citation.

patterns.name: Possessive apostrophes
patterns.context: A plural noun uses an apostrophe to mark possession, followed by a noun phrase describing its stressors or behavior.

patterns.name: Author-name fragments in citation markers
patterns.context: A surname fragment appears after a journal identifier and number in a parenthetical citation.

patterns.name: Translational in a scientific institution name
patterns.context: A compound adjective related to scientific research is split by tokenization within an institution’s proper name, followed by the institute name.
patterns.domain: Profiles of U.S. medical research institutions

patterns.name: Disease term otitis
patterns.context: The disease name “otitis media” is split into subwords; it appears in both titles and body text.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts concerning otitis media and related medical history or animal models

patterns.name: LH in reproductive medicine terminology
patterns.context: A technical term or hormone abbreviation appears in discussions of follicles, luteinized cells, or prolactin-related mechanisms.

patterns.name: Affix fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: A longer technical term is split by tokenization in a discussion of age-related changes in neurological function; the specific activation position may also relate to sentence endings or phrase structure.

9_2521.description: 激活分散于多种学术及法律文体，常落在专名、专业术语、缩写或分词边界上：学名、疾病与生殖医学词汇较突出；另有法律引文结尾、所有格撇号及机构名称片段。

patterns.name: 学名中的特定词干
patterns.context: 物种名或生物名称中，尤其是词被分词拆开的学名；也出现在标题与摘要开头。
patterns.domain: 昆虫学、农业与生物医学文献

patterns.name: 法律引文与法条结尾
patterns.context: 判例论述中引用法律全称及其简称，随后以句点结束引文并换行引出后续判例引证。

patterns.name: 所有格撇号
patterns.context: 复数名词以撇号标记所有格，后接描述其压力源或行为的名词短语。

patterns.name: 文献引用标识中的作者名片段
patterns.context: 括号式文献引用中，期刊标识及编号后出现作者姓氏片段。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与文献引用

patterns.name: 科学机构名称中的 Translational
patterns.context: 机构专名中，科学研究相关的复合形容词被分词拆开，后接研究所名称。
patterns.domain: 美国医学研究机构简介

patterns.name: 疾病术语 otitis
patterns.context: “otitis media”这一疾病名称中，词被拆分成子词；在标题及正文叙述中均出现。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，涉及中耳炎及相关病史或动物模型

patterns.name: 生殖医学术语中的 LH
patterns.context: 讨论卵泡、黄体化细胞或催乳素相关机制时出现的专业术语或激素缩写。
patterns.domain: 生殖生物学与医学摘要

patterns.name: 专业词中的词缀片段
patterns.context: 神经功能随年龄变化的讨论中，较长专业词被分词拆开；具体触发位置还可能与句末或短语结构有关。

en.description: Activation is most prominent on the LH hormone abbreviation and its endocrine context. Other strong activations are scattered across subword fragments of personal names, scientific names, technical terms, and common words, along with a few words or numbers with no obvious commonality.

patterns.name: LH-related hormone token
patterns.context: In reproductive endocrine or pituitary-related text, LH is an abbreviation for luteinizing hormone; passage 1 also contains LHRH, and passage 5 lists serum LH levels.

patterns.name: LH-secreting adenomas
patterns.context: In a classification of pituitary adenomas, LH is listed alongside hormones such as ACTH and refers to LH-secreting adenomas.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments of the name Edwin Seaver
patterns.context: A proper name is split into multiple subwords and appears in a title or at the start of an entry, with line breaks and repetition of the name.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of citation author Dave
patterns.context: An author citation in an astrophysics paper, within “Somerville & Dave 2015”.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of a bacterial scientific name
patterns.context: The pathogen’s Latin scientific name Streptococcus pneumoniae is split into several subwords.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of a spelling-marked term
patterns.context: The word intermediate is split and placed in quotation marks as part of the term “intermediate flora”.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of the common word Labeling
patterns.context: In philosophical discussion, Labeling is split into subwords and occurs as a capitalized gerund at the beginning of a sentence.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragment of the name Chandrasekhar
patterns.context: In an astrophysics paper, the scholar’s name Chandrasekhar is split within an author citation.

patterns.name: Other activations that are difficult to group
patterns.context: In their respective contexts, these are a sentence-initial word, a comparative adjective, and part of a year range; no clear shared semantic or formal pattern is apparent.

9_2521.concept: 异质文本中的显著子词/缩写
9_2521.description: 激活最显著地落在 LH 激素缩写及其内分泌语境；其余强激活分散于人名、学名、术语和普通词的子词片段，以及少数无明显共同点的词或数字。

patterns.name: LH 相关激素 token
patterns.context: 生殖内分泌或垂体相关文本中，LH 作为促黄体生成素的缩写出现；第1段还出现 LHRH，第5段列举血清 LH 水平。

patterns.name: LH 分泌型腺瘤
patterns.context: 垂体腺瘤分类中，LH 与 ACTH 等激素并列，指 LH 分泌型腺瘤。

patterns.name: 人名 Edwin Seaver 的分词片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个子词，出现在标题或条目开头，并伴随换行及姓名重复。

patterns.name: 引用作者 Dave 的分词片段
patterns.context: 天体物理学论文中的作者引用，位于“Somerville & Dave 2015”内。

patterns.name: 细菌学名的分词片段
patterns.context: 病原体拉丁学名 Streptococcus pneumoniae 被拆分成若干子词。

patterns.name: 拼写标记的子词片段
patterns.context: 单词 intermediate 被拆分，并置于引号内作为“intermediate flora”术语的一部分。

patterns.name: 普通词 Labeling 的子词片段
patterns.context: 哲学论述中，Labeling 被拆分为子词，出现在句首大写动名词位置。

patterns.name: 人名 Chandrasekhar 的子词片段
patterns.context: 天体物理论文中，Chandrasekhar 这一学者姓名被拆分，处于引文作者名中。

patterns.name: 难以归并的其他激活
patterns.context: 在各自语境中分别是句首词、比较级形容词、年份范围的一部分；没有明显共同语义或形式模式。

en.description: Activation often occurs on “widely” and neighboring words. Other activations are scattered across numbers, statistics, clinical outcomes, imaging, and table data in medical papers, as well as materials, devices, and safety descriptions in patents; no single stable semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: widely as an adverb of degree
patterns.context: The word appears in a noun phrase or copular construction, indicating that something is widely used; activation is mainly on the word itself.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical papers, materials science

patterns.name: Numbers and statistics in medical text
patterns.context: Medical studies describe patient counts, groups, test results, operation times, complications, ages, or table data; activation is distributed across numbers and neighboring tokens.

patterns.name: Clinical complications and surgical outcomes
patterns.context: Reports outcomes such as operation duration, pain, death, or postoperative complications; activation includes outcome terms and adjacent words.

patterns.name: Material names and technical descriptions
patterns.context: Describes material composition, properties, preparation, or uses; this is not always triggered by the same conditions as “widely”.

patterns.name: Ladder safety and drawbacks
patterns.context: Describes how external ladders become difficult to climb and dangerous when wet or soiled with dirt or oil.

patterns.name: Imaging examinations and acquisition parameters
patterns.context: Describes medical imaging equipment, patient examination posture, or image acquisition planes.

patterns.name: Table headings and demographic categories
patterns.context: Tables list categories such as birth, gestational age, and sex, along with counts and percentages.

patterns.name: Ferritin groups
patterns.context: Patients are grouped by serum ferritin levels, and the study sample is reported.

patterns.name: Renal function or urea indicators and repair surgery
patterns.context: Reports patients’ serum urea, repair surgery, gastrostomy, and deaths.

patterns.name: Ladder-type cooling equipment
patterns.context: Describes equipment and processes for cooling cement clinker or other mineral materials after a furnace.

9_2521.description: 激活常见于“widely”及其邻近词；其余激活分散在医学论文的数字、统计量、临床结局、影像和表格数据，以及专利中的材料、设备和安全描述，未见单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: widely 作程度副词
patterns.context: 该词出现在名词短语或系表结构中，表示某物使用广泛；激活主要落在该词本身。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学论文、材料科学

patterns.name: 医学文本中的数字与统计量
patterns.context: 医学研究中描述患者人数、分组、检验结果、手术时间、并发症、年龄或表格数据；激活分布在数字及其邻近 token。

patterns.name: 临床并发症与手术结果
patterns.context: 报告手术时长、疼痛、死亡或术后并发症等结局；激活包含结局词及相邻词。

patterns.name: 材料名称与技术描述
patterns.context: 描述材料组成、性质、制备或用途；与“widely”并非总是同一触发条件。

patterns.name: 梯子安全与缺点描述
patterns.context: 描述外置梯子遇水、污垢或油后难以攀爬且有危险。

patterns.name: 影像检查与采集参数
patterns.trigger: “magnetic resonance images”“imaged the brains”“Two-dimensional images were acquired”
patterns.context: 说明医学影像设备、患者检查姿势或图像采集平面。

patterns.name: 表格标题与人口统计分类
patterns.context: 表格中列出出生、孕龄、性别等分类及人数百分比。

patterns.name: 铁蛋白分组
patterns.context: 按血清铁蛋白水平对患者分组并报告研究样本。

patterns.name: 肾功能或尿素指标及修复手术
patterns.context: 报告患者血清尿素、修复手术、胃造口及死亡情况。

patterns.name: 梯式冷却设备
patterns.context: 描述炉后冷却水泥熟料或其他矿物材料的设备与工艺。

en.description: Activation samples span biomedical, physics, linguistics, patent, and legal texts. Shared cues include formatting/marker fragments and dense technical exposition, but the specific terminology and topics vary substantially across passages, with no single semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Special symbols, equations, and marker boundaries
patterns.context: Near mathematical formulas, citation markers, numbering, or line breaks; activation may favor special tokens, fragmented text, or marker boundaries rather than domain-specific word meanings.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, legal opinions, and text with formatting markers

patterns.name: Technical terms and descriptions
patterns.context: Terms occur in technical discussions of gene primer sequences, cosmological data, legal disputes, linguistic arguments, optical systems, material measurements, or tire structures; these terms have no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and opinion phrasing
patterns.context: Procedural actions and party information appear in descriptions of court orders, appeals, or judgments.

patterns.name: Devices and structural relationships in patent background
patterns.context: Describes the construction, position, and function of optical lens assemblies or tire components.

patterns.name: Classification or relational phrasing in academic arguments
patterns.context: Introduces linguistic concepts and their theoretical relationships, or describes scientific measurements, model quantities, and modality.

patterns.name: Gene primer sequence fragments
patterns.context: Forward and reverse primers and nucleotide sequences are listed after a gene name.

patterns.name: Physical parameters and experimental figure descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses material resistivity and scattering factors around plots, equations, or values calculated from references.

9_2521.concept: 专业文本中的结构化片段
9_2521.description: 激活样本横跨生物医学、物理、语言学、专利和法律文本；可见共同线索是格式/标记碎片及密集专业叙述，但各段的具体术语和主题差异很大，尚无单一语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 特殊符号、公式与标记边界
patterns.context: 数学公式、引文标记、编号或换行附近；激活可能偏向特殊 token、碎片化文本或标记边界，而非领域词义。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律判决及带格式标记的文本

patterns.name: 专业名词与技术描述
patterns.context: 术语处于基因引物序列、宇宙学数据、法律争议、语言学论证、光学系统、材料测量或轮胎结构等专业叙述中；这些词彼此并无明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 法律程序与判决措辞
patterns.context: 法院命令、上诉或判决叙述中出现程序性动作与当事人信息。

patterns.name: 专利背景中的装置及结构关系
patterns.trigger: «lens system»、«prism»、«groups of lenses»；«small block»、«tread side»、«side open sipes»
patterns.context: 描述光学镜头组件或轮胎部件的构造、位置与功能。

patterns.name: 学术论证中的分类或关系表述
patterns.context: 介绍语言学概念及其理论关系，或描述科学测量、模型量与模态。

patterns.name: 基因引物序列片段
patterns.context: 基因名称后列出正向与反向引物及核苷酸序列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法或实验材料

patterns.name: 物性参数与实验图表说明
patterns.context: 图线、方程或文献计算值周围讨论材料电阻率及散射因素。

en.concept: Entities and functions in explanatory text
en.description: Activation is broadly scattered: it commonly occurs in technical text introducing systems, devices, and materials and their uses or advantages; it also appears in textbook and biographical lists of categories, and in first-person arguments in exhortative prose.

patterns.name: Systems and components
patterns.context: In technical sentences describing systems, materials, or devices and their functions, components, performance, or relationships; no fixed collocation is required.

patterns.name: Devices and manufacturing in patents
patterns.context: Patent background text describing manufacturing processes, product defects, materials, or proposed improvements.

patterns.name: Technical capabilities and application value
patterns.context: Explains what a technology or component can do, where it can be used, or what advantages it provides.

patterns.name: Listing categories or identity information
patterns.context: Uses enumeration to introduce fields of study, book chapter contents, or a person’s profession and identity.

patterns.name: Generic pronouns in moral arguments
patterns.context: Uses judgments about people in general or concern for others to support exhortative or argumentative statements.

9_2521.concept: 说明性文本中的实体与功能
9_2521.description: 激活分布较散：常见于介绍系统、器件、材料及其用途或优点的技术文本，也出现在教材、传记的分类列举和劝诫散文的人称论述中。

patterns.name: 系统与组成部分
patterns.context: 在描述系统、材料或器件及其功能、组成、性能或相互关系的技术性句子中；无需固定搭配。

patterns.name: 专利中的器件与制造
patterns.context: 描述制造过程、产品缺陷、材料或改进方案的专利背景文字。

patterns.name: 技术能力与应用价值
patterns.context: 说明某种技术或部件能做什么、适用于何处，或带来的优点。

patterns.name: 列举类别或身份信息
patterns.context: 以枚举方式介绍领域组成、书籍章节内容，或人物职业与身份。

patterns.name: 道德论证中的一般人称
patterns.context: 以一般人的判断或对他人的关怀支撑劝诫性、论辩性陈述。
patterns.domain: 十九世纪散文或道德论述

en.description: Activation occurs in discussions of imaging availability, legal documents, steroid specificity, exhortative prose, mechanical patents, and clinical statistics. Apart from two instances of “readily available”, the triggering words and domains differ substantially across passages.

patterns.name: “readily available” imaging resources
patterns.context: Describes whether imaging examinations or diagnostic methods are easily available locally; both instances contain “readily available”.

patterns.name: Defenses and statements in legal proceedings
patterns.context: Legal text discusses litigation, affidavits, court rulings, or contract clauses; the trigger words are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Steroid structure and binding specificity
patterns.context: Discusses the steroid backbone, binding sites, and factors determining specificity.

patterns.name: Pronoun relationships in exhortative moral writing
patterns.context: Uses rhetorical questions and moral admonition to discuss whether smoking can be justified as a luxurious habit.

patterns.name: Gear transmission description
patterns.context: Explains how a dual clutch shifts between two sets of gears.

patterns.name: Coupler usability statement
patterns.context: A patent lists the invention’s objectives and describes the coupler as easy to use and unlock.

patterns.name: Numerical statistical results
patterns.context: Statistical data such as perioperative times, significance values, and patient complication rates.

9_2521.description: 激活分布在影像可及性、法律文书、类固醇特异性、劝诫散文、机械专利及临床统计中；除两处“readily available”外，各段触发词与领域差异明显。

patterns.name: “readily available”影像资源
patterns.context: 描述影像检查或诊断手段在当地是否容易获得；两处均出现“readily available”

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的抗辩与陈述
patterns.context: 法律文本中讨论诉讼、宣誓书、法院裁定或合同条款；触发词并不完全一致

patterns.name: 类固醇结构与结合特异性
patterns.context: 讨论类固醇骨架、结合位点及决定特异性的因素

patterns.name: 劝诫性道德文字中的人称关系
patterns.context: 以反问和道德劝诫讨论抽烟作为奢侈习惯是否可辩护

patterns.name: 齿轮传动描述
patterns.context: 说明双离合器在两组齿轮之间换挡
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，机械工程

patterns.name: 联轴器易用性陈述
patterns.context: 专利文本列举发明目的，并描述联轴器易于使用及解锁

patterns.name: 数值统计结果
patterns.context: 围手术期时间、显著性数值及患者并发症比例等统计数据
patterns.domain: 医学摘要，临床研究结果

en.description: Activation falls on several seemingly unrelated local fragments: an internal fragment of the Bulgarian word “увеличава”, “who” in literature, S/Inc. in legal names and citations, and statistical, instrument-related, and molecular-framework phrasing in academic texts.

patterns.name: Fragment of Bulgarian “увеличава” within a word
patterns.context: In Bulgarian text, the forms “увеличаване” or “увеличава” occur in sentences describing an increase in quantity, degree, or risk; the prominent feature is scattered subword elements within the word, not the complete word.

patterns.name: who and descriptions of speech/characters in English narrative
patterns.context: In English literary narration, who introduces a clause describing a character’s traits or behavior; the passage also contains descriptions of a character’s temperament and a question.

patterns.name: Letter C in names, citations, and legal references
patterns.context: In the names of parties or case citations in legal documents, activation falls on the uppercase S; the surrounding text often includes names, abbreviations, punctuation, and volume/page details.

patterns.name: Corporate abbreviation Inc.
patterns.context: The corporate-entity abbreviation Inc. appears in case names, next to company names and citation formats such as v.

patterns.name: Statements about model selection and generalization performance
patterns.context: Discusses differences between training and test performance, cross-validation error, and model selection; activation is concentrated on that after “cross-validation error”.

patterns.name: instrument(s) and availability
patterns.context: Mentions instrument parts, availability, and use by young players; both singular and plural forms activate.
patterns.domain: USPTO background technology, instrument-related patent text

patterns.name: Molecular-framework phrasing in a scientific plan
patterns.context: A research plan describes characterizing protein-subunit phosphorylation and its functional consequences, and proposes a new molecular framework for understanding regulation.

9_2521.description: 激活落在多种互不明显相关的局部片段：保加利亚语「увеличава」词内片段、文学中的 who、法律姓名与引证中的 S/Inc.，以及学术文本中的统计、乐器和分子框架措辞。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词内的「увеличава」片段
patterns.context: 保加利亚语正文中，词形「увеличаване」或「увеличава」出现于描述数量、程度或风险上升的句子；突出的是词内分散的子词元件，而非完整词。

patterns.name: 英语叙述中的 who 与话语／人物描写
patterns.trigger: «who»5 …«thus»3…«dare»2…«differ»…「one who had a right to be heard」中 «who»8
patterns.context: 英语文学叙述里，who 引出人物特征或行为的从句；本段同时出现人物气质描写及问句。

patterns.name: 姓名、引文与法律引证中的字母 C
patterns.context: 法律文书的当事人姓名或判例引证中，激活落在大写 S；周围常有姓名、缩写、标点及卷页信息。

patterns.name: Inc. 中的公司名称缩写
patterns.context: 判例名称中的公司实体缩写 Inc.；紧邻公司名及 v. 等引证格式。

patterns.name: 模型选择与泛化性能表述
patterns.context: 讨论训练样本与测试样本表现差异、交叉验证误差及模型选择；激活集中在 cross-validation error 之后的 that。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central，学术方法论／统计讨论

patterns.name: instrument(s) 及其可用性
patterns.context: 谈及乐器的零件、可用性及年轻演奏者使用乐器；两个单复数形式均有激活。
patterns.domain: USPTO 背景技术，乐器相关专利文本

patterns.name: 科学计划中的分子框架措辞
patterns.context: 研究计划描述表征蛋白亚基磷酸化及其功能后果，并提出理解调控的新分子框架。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划／生物医学

en.description: Activation is distributed across subword fragments within words and function words, appearing in medical research, legal litigation, fabric treatment, mathematical proofs, and older admonitory prose; there is no stable cross-domain semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Fragmented within-word activation in medical and research texts
patterns.context: Activation often falls on subword fragments within words near medical, experimental, equipment, or measurement terms; however, not all examples belong to the same specialized field.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, clinical records, medical imaging, research methods

patterns.name: Fragments of people or legal terms in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in judgments or litigation narratives involving parties, juries, company names, testimony, or property status.

patterns.name: Fabric care and surface treatment
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of surfactant ingredients depositing on fabric during rinsing or similar baths.
patterns.domain: Patent background, detergents and textile treatment

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and reasoning texts
patterns.context: A mathematical expression is followed by discussion of whether an inequality assumption or derivation is valid.

patterns.name: Pronouns and word fragments in older moral admonitions
patterns.context: Discusses the use of luxury goods and their effects on others in admonitory prose; some activation falls within words.

9_2521.description: 激活分散在词内子词及功能词上，出现在医学科研、法律诉讼、织物处理、数学论证和旧式劝诫文中；没有跨领域稳定的语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 医学及科研文本中的碎片化词内激活
patterns.context: 激活常落在词内部的子词片段，邻近医学、实验、设备或测量术语；但不是所有例子都属同一专门领域。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、临床记录、医学影像、科研方法

patterns.name: 法律文本中的人或法律术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在判决或诉讼叙述中，涉及当事人、陪审团、公司名称、证词或财产状况。

patterns.name: 织物护理与表面处理
patterns.context: 讨论表面活性剂成分在漂洗或类似浴液中沉积到织物上的效果。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术、洗涤剂与纺织处理

patterns.name: 数学符号及推理文本
patterns.context: 数学表达式后接对不等式假设或推导是否成立的讨论。

patterns.name: 旧式道德劝诫中的人称与词语碎片
patterns.context: 在劝诫文中讨论奢侈品使用及其对他人的影响；激活部分落在词内。

en.concept: Multiple local morphological and formatting features
en.description: Activation is distributed across conjunctions, numbers and measurement units, event names, Android XML tags, imaging terminology, and descriptions of unmarked topic shifts; no single semantic pattern accounts for all passages.

patterns.name: Specific conjunctions and clause structures
patterns.context: Trigger words occur in formal explanatory sentences describing steps, purposes, or properties; that-introduced relative clauses are especially strong. This pattern does not explain the other passages.

patterns.name: Numbers and units/measurement expressions
patterns.context: Numbers are embedded in experimental conditions, scales, dimensions, measurement units, or test descriptions; values often co-occur with units and range expressions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, medical imaging methods, experimental materials and test reports

patterns.name: Sport event names and titles
patterns.context: Event titles and introductory text contain track-and-field events, categories, and distance names.

patterns.name: Android XML layout tags
patterns.context: Android namespace URIs and LinearLayout layout elements appear in code or XML.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, Android configuration code

patterns.name: Markers and sample dimensions in imaging
patterns.context: Discusses super-resolution imaging, marker/dye properties, and imaging difficulties with thicker or three-dimensional samples.
patterns.domain: Imaging research abstracts or grant text

patterns.name: Unmarked content and topic shifts
patterns.context: Explains how a table of contents indicates topic changes or structure in the main text that are not explicitly marked.
patterns.domain: Book table-of-contents notes, editorial explanatory prose

9_2521.concept: 多种局部词形与格式特征
9_2521.description: 激活分散于连接词、数字及测量单位、赛事名称、Android XML标记、成像术语和关于未标记主题转换的表述；没有单一语义模式覆盖全部语段。

patterns.name: 特定连接词与从句结构
patterns.context: 触发词出现在描述步骤、目的或属性的正式说明句中；尤以 that 引导的定语从句最强。该模式未能解释其他语段。

patterns.name: 数字与单位/测量表达
patterns.context: 数字嵌在实验条件、量表、尺寸、计量单位或测试描述中；数值及其单位、范围表达常共同出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、医学影像方法、实验材料与测试报告

patterns.name: 运动项目名称与赛事标题
patterns.context: 赛事标题和正文介绍中出现田径项目、组别及距离名称。

patterns.name: Android XML布局标记
patterns.context: 代码或 XML 中出现 Android 命名空间 URI 与 LinearLayout 布局元素。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Android 配置代码

patterns.name: 成像中的标记物与样本维度
patterns.context: 讨论超分辨成像、标记物/染料特性，以及较厚或三维样本的成像难点。
patterns.domain: 成像研究摘要或资助项目文本

patterns.name: 未标记内容与主题转换
patterns.context: 说明目录如何指向正文中没有显式标出的主题变化或结构。
patterns.domain: 书籍目录说明、编辑性说明文

en.description: Activation is distributed across the number 3 and numeric formats, three-dimensional terminology, cell expressions, rating scales, for loops in code, and several within-word subword fragments; many instances occur near numbers, hyphens, or token boundaries, with no unified semantic explanation yet.

patterns.name: Number 3 and nearby formatting
patterns.context: The number 3 appears in expressions for experimental replicates, grouping schemes, dates, or near mathematical expressions.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, event entries, math problems

patterns.name: Three-dimensional terminology
patterns.context: Describes three-dimensional imaging or motion analysis; activation falls on tokenized numeric/unit morphological fragments such as “three”, “-”, and “dimensional”.

patterns.name: Cell-related expressions
patterns.context: Cells and cellular processes in a cell-biology context; strong activation is concentrated on “cell” and repeated hyphenated expressions.

patterns.name: Item-by-item scoring and scales
patterns.context: Numbers are linked to scale units in questionnaire or statement-rating methods.

patterns.name: for in Go code
patterns.context: In code control flow, a for loop introduces a statement that iterates over page items.

patterns.name: Specific term fragments and their boundaries
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on tokenized within-word fragments, not obviously explained by complete word meanings or nearby medical semantics.

patterns.name: Numeric/hyphenated expressions for animal age
patterns.context: Compound numeric expressions indicate animal age in animal experiments; activation falls near numbers, hyphens, and age units.

patterns.name: Unclear mathematical sequence fragments
patterns.context: Appears in sequence/math-problem text, but the available fragments are insufficient to determine the trigger condition; it is unclear whether they match the numeric pattern.

9_2521.description: 激活分散于数字3及数字格式、三维术语、cell表达、评分量表、代码for循环和若干词内分词片段；不少位置紧邻数字、连字符或分词边界，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 数字3及其邻近格式
patterns.trigger: “3”及其附近的数字、标点或单位，如“3 times”“three-to-a-cycle”“3 March”；另有数学式中的“3”
patterns.context: 数字3出现在实验重复次数、分组方案、日期等数字表达中，或数学表达式附近。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、赛事条目、数学题

patterns.name: 三维及其相关术语
patterns.context: 描述三维成像或运动分析；激活落在分词后的数字/单位构词片段，如“three”“-”“dimensional”。
patterns.domain: 生物成像、医学运动分析

patterns.name: cell 相关表达
patterns.context: 细胞生物学语境中的细胞、细胞层面的过程；强激活集中在“cell”及连字符构成的重复表达。

patterns.name: 逐项计分与量表
patterns.context: 问卷或陈述评分方法中，数字与量表单位相连。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的 for
patterns.context: 代码控制流中，for 循环引出遍历页面项目的语句。

patterns.name: 特定术语片段及其边界
patterns.context: 激活集中于被切分的词内片段，并非显然由完整词义或邻近医学语义解释。

patterns.name: 动物年龄中的数字/连字符表达
patterns.context: 动物实验中表示动物年龄的复合数字表达，激活落在数字、连字符及年龄单位附近。

patterns.name: 不明数学序列片段
patterns.context: 数列/数学题文本中出现，但现有片段不足以确定触发条件；不能确认是否与数字模式一致。

en.concept: Local patterns involving “third”, plus isolated triggers
en.description: Primarily responds to fixed phrasings in math problems asking for the “third largest/smallest,” with particular emphasis on the ordinal “third”; it also activates at “if” in Go code and “overfit” in a statistics paper, neither of which has an evident semantic connection to the math-problem pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinal “third” in math problems
patterns.context: After defining several variables or equations, asks for the third largest or third smallest among candidate values; the ordering may be by biggest or smallest
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics; English arithmetic and algebra problems

patterns.name: Conditional branch in Go code
patterns.context: A conditional statement inside a Go function checks whether an optional timeout configuration is present

patterns.name: Overfitting in predictive models
patterns.context: Discusses cross-validation error, training and test samples, and notes that model selection may lead to overfitting on training data
patterns.domain: PubMed Central; statistics or predictive modeling papers

9_2521.concept: 含“third”的局部模式，另有孤立触发
9_2521.description: 主要响应数学题中要求找“第三大/第三小”的固定问法，尤其突出序数词“third”；另在Go代码的“if”及统计论文的“overfit”处激活，二者与数学题模式无明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 数学题中的序位词“third”
patterns.trigger: “Which is the third biggest value?” / “Which is the third smallest value?”，其中 “third” 激活最强
patterns.context: 先给出若干变量定义或方程，再要求从候选值中找第三大或第三小；排序方向可为 biggest 或 smallest
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics；英文算术与代数题

patterns.name: Go 代码中的条件分支
patterns.context: Go 函数体内、检查可选的超时配置是否存在的条件语句

patterns.name: 预测模型的过拟合
patterns.context: 讨论交叉验证误差、训练样本与测试样本，并指出模型选择可能导致在训练数据上过拟合
patterns.domain: PubMed Central；统计学或预测建模论文

en.concept: Ranking questions and local text patterns
en.description: Primarily responds to math questions asking for the nth smallest or largest value among candidates, especially a recurring third-place ranking template; it also responds to table labels and variable definitions in math problems. There is also a statement in a legal text inferring consciousness of guilt from fleeing the scene, with no evident relation to the math pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinals and quantifiers in math ranking problems
patterns.context: Asks for the nth smallest, largest, or nth largest value in a given set of numbers; often preceded or followed by variable definitions, a list of values, or table rows.

patterns.name: Recurring third-place ranking template in math problems
patterns.context: Finds the third smallest or third largest value in a set of candidates; the problem first defines variables, then lists variables alongside numerical values.

patterns.name: Fifth-place ranking template in math problems
patterns.context: Asks for the fifth smallest or fifth largest; may be adjacent to variable definitions and lists of candidate values.

patterns.name: Structural markers in tables and math problems
patterns.context: After table labels and line breaks, introduces variable definitions, calculations, and ranking questions; activation is distributed across labels, Let, What, ordinals, and ranking words, rather than limited to a single trigger word.

patterns.name: “flight” and inference of guilt in legal texts
patterns.context: Treats a defendant’s departure from the crime scene, when unexplained, as evidence of consciousness of guilt; includes case citations.

9_2521.concept: 排序问答及局部文本模式
9_2521.description: 主要响应数学问答中对候选数值求第几小或第几大，尤其反复出现的第三名排序模板；也响应数学题的表格标签和变量定义。另有一次法律文本中以逃离现场推断有罪意识的表述，和数学模式无明显关系。

patterns.name: 数学排序题中的序数与数量词
patterns.trigger: “What is the [third/fifth] smallest/biggest value”及“Which is the biggest value?”
patterns.context: 在数学题中询问给定数值集合的第几小、最大或第几大；其前后常有变量定义、数值列表或表格行。

patterns.name: 数学题中反复出现的第三名排序模板
patterns.context: 围绕一组候选值求第三小或第三大；题目先定义变量，再把变量与数值并列列出。

patterns.name: 数学题中的第五名排序模板
patterns.context: 询问第五小或第五大；可与变量定义、候选值列表相邻。

patterns.name: 表格与数学题的结构标记
patterns.context: 表格标签和换行之后引入变量定义、计算式及排序问题；激活分布在标签、Let、What、序数和排序词上，而非只限于单个触发词。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的“flight”与罪责推断
patterns.trigger: “alleged flight from the scene”“Flight, when unexplained, tends to prove a consciousness of guilt.”
patterns.context: 将被告离开案发现场、且无法解释的行为作为有罪意识的证据；包含判例引证。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several types of specialized text: patent device structures, biomedical cell research, legal judgments, mathematical sequences and differentiation problems, and crop breeding. Recognizable features are domain terminology or task expressions in individual passages, with no clear shared trigger across all passages.

patterns.name: Equipment/structure descriptions in patent texts
patterns.context: Introduces devices, components, functions, and structural relationships in patent background or technical descriptions

patterns.name: Cell and biomedical terminology
patterns.context: Research accounts concerning cell surfaces, apoptosis, vulnerability, and molecular or anatomical features

patterns.name: Legal case law and litigation language
patterns.context: Discusses legal relationships, interests, fraud, or litigation rules, and includes court or case citations

patterns.name: Sequence continuation prompts
patterns.context: Asks a question requiring inference of the next item in a numerical sequence, with several groups of numbers in the prompt

patterns.name: Differentiation problems
patterns.context: Asks for the derivative or higher-order derivatives of a given algebraic expression

patterns.name: Crop breeding trials and cultivar selection
patterns.context: Describes multi-year testing of breeding material in representative environments and selection of commercial cultivar candidates

9_2521.concept: 专业文本中的领域术语
9_2521.description: 激活分布于多类专业文本：专利装置结构、生物医学细胞研究、法律判决、数学数列与微分题、作物育种。可辨认的是各片段中的领域术语或任务表达，没有贯穿所有段的明确共同触发词。

patterns.name: 专利文本的设备/结构描述
patterns.context: 专利背景或技术描述中，介绍装置、部件、功能和结构关系

patterns.name: 细胞与生物医学术语
patterns.context: 围绕细胞表面、凋亡、易损性及分子或解剖特征的研究叙述
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 法律判例与诉讼措辞
patterns.context: 讨论法律关系、利益、欺诈或诉讼规则，并包含法院或案件引用

patterns.name: 数列续写提示
patterns.context: 以问句要求推断数字序列的下一项，题面夹杂多组数字

patterns.name: 微分运算题
patterns.context: 要求对给定代数表达式求导或求高阶导数

patterns.name: 作物育种试验与品种筛选
patterns.context: 描述育种材料在代表性环境中多年测试，并筛选商业品种候选
patterns.domain: 农业/植物育种专利背景

en.description: Activation primarily corresponds to summaries of prior art in patent backgrounds and the “What is” question template in math problems; it also activates at “Co.” and “Inc.” in legal case citations.

patterns.name: Prior-art statements in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: The background section of a patent specification summarizes existing systems, patents, or prior art and their shortcomings; activation falls on words such as “These”, “patents”, “systems”, or “prior art”.

patterns.name: Question template in math problems
patterns.context: A short question in a math or arithmetic problem asks for a variable, expression, or digit; activation is concentrated on “What” and “is”.

patterns.name: Company names in legal case citations
patterns.context: Case names and corporate entity names appear in legal discussion; activation is concentrated near abbreviations in company names.

9_2521.concept: 语境相关的常见短语/缩写
9_2521.description: 激活主要对应专利背景中的既有技术总结，以及数学题“What is”提问模板；另在法律判例引文的“Co.”、“Inc.”处激活。

patterns.name: 专利前案背景陈述
patterns.trigger: “These patents all show” “Prior systems” “old in the art” “prior art”
patterns.context: 专利说明书背景部分，概述既有系统、专利或先前技术及其不足；激活落在“These”“patents”“systems”或“prior art”等词上。

patterns.name: 数学题的提问模板
patterns.context: 数学题或算术题中，提出求某变量、表达式或数位的简短问题；激活集中在“What”“is”。

patterns.name: 法律判例引用中的公司名
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现判例名称及公司实体名称；激活集中于公司名称缩写附近。

en.description: Most passages concern comparisons between plans or states, differences in degree, and technical effects, often using comparatives, than/over, more/less, or descriptions of avoiding defects; there are also local patterns involving child vocabulary, statistical follow-up, stress hypotheses, and forum anecdotes that cannot all be unified.

patterns.name: Comparatives and relative merits
patterns.context: Compares one approach with another in terms of size, performance, cost, or suitability, often using comparatives, than, over, or greater/less contrasts.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, technical descriptions; also forum comments and research hypotheses

patterns.name: Technical effects of negating or avoiding problems
patterns.context: Identifies shortcomings or infeasibility of existing approaches, or problems avoided by a new approach; typically an effect statement in technical background text.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, engineering or medical technology descriptions

patterns.name: Changes, measurements, or differences in degree and quantity
patterns.context: States differences in degree, changes, or results that vary by condition; sometimes appears as a measurement, statistical analysis, or hypothesis.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, clinical studies, and research hypotheses

patterns.name: Vocabulary expressions about child language development
patterns.context: Discusses children’s brain development, language abilities after starting school or reading, and receptive/expressive vocabulary.

patterns.name: Dimensions and structural relationships in patent texts
patterns.context: Describes component dimensions, arrangement, overlap, or flow relationships, usually with technical structural details.

patterns.name: Time points and statistical tests in research design
patterns.context: Gives the time points for repeated follow-up and the statistical tests used for analysis.

patterns.name: Research hypothesis on “stress” and time to relapse
patterns.context: Compares patient relapse speed by reported stress level and states numbered hypotheses.

patterns.name: Personal opinions and anecdotes in informal forums
patterns.context: A commenter expresses surprise and uses a relative’s experience to evaluate a product or approach.

patterns.name: Incidental morphological cues in terms or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on local subwords or word fragments within various specialized terms; these terms span domains and lack evidence of shared semantics.

9_2521.description: 多数段落涉及方案或状态的比较、程度差异及技术效果，常用比较级、than/over、more/less 或避免缺陷的表述；另有儿童词汇、统计随访、压力假设和论坛轶事等局部模式，无法全部归一。

patterns.name: 比较级与优劣比较
patterns.trigger: “shorter and … wider”“lighter and smaller”“more active … greater conversion … less active”“preferred over”“lighter … higher density and lower cost”“simpler and likely cheaper”
patterns.context: 描述某方案相对另一方案在尺寸、性能、成本或适用性方面的比较，常见比较级、than、over 或 greater/less 对照。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、技术说明，也见论坛评论和研究假设

patterns.name: 否定或避免问题的技术效果
patterns.trigger: “To avoid the problem of wear”“avoids the exertion of excessive tension”“has not proved feasible”
patterns.context: 指出现有方案的缺陷、不可行之处，或新方案避免的问题；通常是技术背景中的效果说明。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、工程或医学技术描述

patterns.name: 程度与数量的变化、测量或差异
patterns.trigger: “more … than”“less …”“greater conversion”“variations”“more stress … relapse sooner … less stress”
patterns.context: 陈述程度差异、变化或随条件而变的结果；有时以测量、统计分析或假设形式出现。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、临床研究与研究假设

patterns.name: 儿童语言发展词汇相关表述
patterns.trigger: “child’s language ability and vocabulary”“words known (receptive vocabulary)”“words the child uses in speech (expressive…)”
patterns.context: 谈儿童脑部发育、入学或阅读后语言能力及接受性／表达性词汇。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的儿童发展说明

patterns.name: 专利文本中的尺寸与结构关系
patterns.trigger: “adjacent rows”“moved and non-moved grate plates overlap”“shorter and … wider”
patterns.context: 描述部件尺寸、排列、重叠或流动关系，通常伴随技术结构细节。

patterns.name: 研究设计中的时间点与统计检验
patterns.trigger: “pre-, 1 month, 6 months, and final follow-up”“Wilcoxon signed-rank test”
patterns.context: 交代重复随访的时间点及用于分析的统计检验。

patterns.name: “stress”与复发时间的研究假设
patterns.context: 按报告的压力程度比较患者复发速度，并以编号假设陈述。
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划或研究假设

patterns.name: 口语论坛中的个人评价与轶事
patterns.trigger: “quite surprised”“My late father recently developed”“simpler and likely cheaper”
patterns.context: 评论者表达惊讶，并用亲属经历评价某产品或方案。

patterns.name: 术语或专名的偶然词形线索
patterns.context: 激活落在不同专业术语的局部子词或词片段；这些词本身跨领域，缺少共同语义证据。
patterns.domain: 催化、眼科、外科、电子技术

en.concept: Technical solutions and their functional descriptions
en.description: Activation occurs mainly in technical patents: statements of prior art, needs, or invention goals, and functional clauses describing a solution’s purpose, capabilities, and performance; it also appears in comparisons between approaches and in a medical abstract describing identification of treatment responders.

patterns.name: Conventional problem statements in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Describes shortcomings in existing technology, a need, or an invention goal, then proposes a desired product/device and its function; no specific technical field is required.

patterns.name: Functional and performance limitations in patents
patterns.context: Describes the use, structural properties, or expected performance of a device, system, or product, often using functional clauses linked by can, which, to, and similar terms.

patterns.name: Review of prior art in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Cites existing approaches, patents, or conventions and describes their methods, shortcomings, or relevant precedents.

patterns.name: Comparison, differences, and effects of technical solutions
patterns.context: Uses negative contrasts and differences in materials or dimensions to describe solution categories and their effects.
patterns.domain: Patent specifications; technologies such as golf equipment or chromatography

patterns.name: Identification of study results and beneficiary populations
patterns.context: Reports how detection or intervention timing identifies patients or responders likely to benefit.

9_2521.concept: 技术方案及其功能描述
9_2521.description: 激活主要出现在技术专利中：陈述现有技术、需求或发明目标，并用功能从句描述方案的用途、能力和性能；另见方案对比，以及一段医学摘要中识别治疗响应者的表述。

patterns.name: 专利背景的惯用问题陈述
patterns.trigger: “The need to…”, “it would be desirable to provide…”, “An object of the present invention is to solve…”；常接 “which can…”
patterns.context: 描述现有技术的不足、需求或发明目标，再提出期望的产品/装置及其功能；不要求特定技术领域。

patterns.name: 专利中的功能与性能限定
patterns.trigger: “which can…”, “can be…”, “to accommodate…”, “to meet the performance requirements…”
patterns.context: 对装置、系统或产品说明用途、结构属性或预期性能，常出现 can、which、to 等连接的功能性从句。

patterns.name: 专利背景的现有技术评述
patterns.trigger: “Prior systems…”, “systems… suffer from a common shortfall”, “conventionally…”, “U.S. Pat. No.”
patterns.context: 引用既有方案、专利或惯例，说明其做法、缺陷或相关先例。

patterns.name: 技术方案的对比、差异与效果
patterns.trigger: “completely different solution”, “not putters”, “softer and more flexible feel”, “shorter and wider”
patterns.context: 通过否定对照、材料或尺寸差异说明方案类别及其效果。
patterns.domain: 专利说明；高尔夫器材或色谱等技术

patterns.name: 研究结果与受益人群识别
patterns.trigger: “identify early responders”, “identify patients who may benefit more”
patterns.context: 报告检测或干预时序如何识别可能获益的患者或响应者。

en.description: Activation is distributed across texts from multiple domains, often appearing in comparisons of properties or solutions, statements of capability and feasibility, and patent-style statements of purpose and advantages; it also involves material safety, group/species comparisons, parameters, and conjunctions, with no single theme covering all examples.

patterns.name: Comparative degree and difference expressions
patterns.context: Describes contrasts between two objects, approaches, or properties, often with comparatives, degree adverbs, or “rather than / different”

patterns.name: Capability, feasibility, and ease of use
patterns.context: States whether a device or approach can be implemented, used, or operated, and what performance it is expected to achieve

patterns.name: Patent-style invention purpose and solution statements
patterns.context: Organizes sentences around the purpose of an invention, provision of a device, or advantages over existing practices

patterns.name: Material, structural, and safety properties
patterns.context: Describes physical properties, safety, or biomedical effects of materials or devices

patterns.name: Outcome or category comparisons outside technical domains
patterns.context: Uses control groups or similar species for comparison and reports behavioral outcomes or distinguishing features

patterns.name: Numerical values, units, and technical parameters
patterns.context: Measurement values, units, or equipment parameters occur near one another in technical descriptions; evidence is sporadic, with no stable shared semantics

patterns.name: Formatting and conjunction triggers
patterns.context: Sentence-initial transitions, contrast markers, or patent-clause positions may trigger activation locally through grammar or formatting rather than a domain concept

9_2521.description: 激活分布在多领域文本中，常见于性质或方案的比较、能力与可行性陈述，以及专利式目的和优点表达；也涉及材料安全、群体/物种对照、参数和连接词，未见单一主题覆盖全部例子。

patterns.name: 比较程度与差异表达
patterns.trigger: “shorter and … wider”“completely different”“much lower”“rather than”“lighter and smaller”“more flexible”“smaller and having a flatter”
patterns.context: 描述两个对象、方案或性质之间的对比，常伴随比较级、程度副词或“rather than / different”
patterns.domain: 专利、科研摘要、百科说明

patterns.name: 能力、可行性与易操作性
patterns.trigger: “can be readily connected”“can be easily operated”“can be varied easily”“has not proved feasible”“desirable to realize”
patterns.context: 说明装置或方案能否实现、使用或操作，以及期望实现的性能

patterns.name: 专利式发明目的和方案陈述
patterns.trigger: “An object of the present invention is to solve”“by providing”“is preferred over”
patterns.context: 以发明目的、提供某装置或相较既有做法的优点组织句子

patterns.name: 材料、结构及安全性质
patterns.trigger: “softer and more flexible feel”“lower vapor pressure”“solid”“safer”“hernia patch”“excessive tension”
patterns.context: 阐述材料或器件的物理性质、安全性或生物医学作用
patterns.domain: 专利与 NIH 科研文本

patterns.name: 非技术领域的结果或类别对照
patterns.trigger: “relative to non-users”“regular cannabis users”“distinguished from Andean duck”
patterns.context: 用对照群体或相似物种作比较，报告行为结果或辨别特征

patterns.name: 数值、单位及技术参数
patterns.context: 技术描述中邻接测量值、单位或设备参数；证据零散，未见稳定共同语义
patterns.domain: 专利、工程或发动机说明

patterns.name: 格式性和连接词触发
patterns.context: 句首承接、转折或专利从句位置，可能是局部语法/格式相关触发，而非领域概念

en.concept: Morgan proper name and local terms
en.description: Responds strongly mainly to the proper name Morgan (a person, organization, or place) across a range of genres; other local activations include stock-rating to/from formats, Hoosiers, HIV-1/seropositive terminology, and a few directory, date, legal, and to-plus-place constructions.

patterns.name: Morgan proper name
patterns.context: Morgan as a person’s, company’s, or place’s name; appears in financial news, people lists, musician discographies, company lists, encyclopedia prose, legal citations, and forum Q&A.

patterns.name: Stock-rating change format
patterns.context: A fixed phrase in securities analyst headlines indicating a change from one rating to another; J.P. Morgan also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Indiana Hoosiers team name
patterns.context: The name Indiana Hoosiers is repeated in a headline and at the beginning of an encyclopedia sports entry.

patterns.name: HIV-2 testing terminology
patterns.context: Wording in a medical abstract about HIV-1 RNA testing and seropositive individuals; strong activation is concentrated at positions such as the split word seropositive.

patterns.name: Directory title or song-title terms
patterns.context: Album or song titles listed in a discography, along with adjacent punctuation; the passage also mentions musician Frank Morgan.

patterns.name: Year and date terms
patterns.context: Months and years appearing in a historical account; the same passage also contains the name Morgan.

patterns.name: Legal procedure terminology
patterns.context: The word examinations appears in a legal case citation discussing competency; the same passage also contains the Morgan case name.

patterns.name: Prepositional construction referring to a place
patterns.context: A forum answer suggests moving to Morgan Hill or Gilroy; “to” also appears elsewhere in the same passage.

9_2636.description: 主要对专名 Morgan（人名、机构名或地名）强烈响应，横跨多种文体；另有股票评级的 to/from 格式、Hoosiers、HIV-1/seropositive 术语及少量目录、日期、法律词项和 to 地名结构等局部激活。

patterns.name: Morgan 专名
patterns.trigger: «Morgan»（包括拆分或与后续词组成的专名，如 «J»2.«P»2.« Morgan»10、«Morgan» Jones、«Morgan» Hill）
patterns.context: 人名、公司名或地名中的 Morgan；可见于金融新闻、人物列表、音乐家唱片目录、公司名单、百科正文、法律引文及论坛问答。

patterns.name: 股票评级变动格式
patterns.trigger: « to»5« S»3ell «from»1« Hold»1；« to»5 Lt Buy «from»1
patterns.context: 证券分析师评级标题中表示由某评级调至另一评级的固定搭配；同段也出现 J.P. Morgan。

patterns.name: Indiana Hoosiers 队名
patterns.context: Indiana Hoosiers 的名称在标题及百科体育条目开头重复出现。

patterns.name: HIV-2 检测术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中关于 HIV-1 RNA 检测及血清阳性个体的表述；高激活集中在拆分的 seropositive 一词等位置。

patterns.name: 目录标题或曲名词项
patterns.context: 唱片目录中列出的专辑或曲名及相邻标点；此段同时出现音乐家 Frank Morgan。

patterns.name: 年份日期词项
patterns.context: 叙述历史事件时出现的月份与年份；同段另有 Morgan 姓名。

patterns.name: 法律程序术语
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中讨论 competency 时出现的 examinations 一词；同段另有 Morgan 判例名。

patterns.name: 到某地的介词结构
patterns.context: 论坛问答中建议搬往 Morgan Hill 或 Gilroy；«to»也在同段其他位置出现。

en.description: Trigger positions are scattered across the samples: Mult-/Complex word beginnings are common in research titles, alongside intraword title fragments, a team-name fragment, and common words in email; there is no unified semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: Compound words/initial fragments in titles
patterns.context: Appears in titles or at sentence beginnings, followed by a longer term or noun phrase; examples include Multicenter, Multiresidue, Multivalent, Multilayer, and Complex.
patterns.domain: Research project titles, PubMed paper titles

patterns.name: Intraword suffix fragments
patterns.context: In uppercase titles, activation falls on initial or intraword fragments of PLANNING and EVALUATION, rather than consistent positions across the whole words.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in a team name
patterns.context: In the name Indiana Hoosiers, activation falls at the beginning of Indiana and within Hoosiers; the latter also activates when repeated.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragments in taxonomic terminology
patterns.context: Several intraword fragments in the insect genus name Hymenolepis and the preceding word Survey are activated.

patterns.name: Function words in common phrases
patterns.context: In a common expression at the beginning of an email, activation is scattered across multiple common words; the following content discusses recent efforts.

9_2636.description: 覆盖样本的触发位置分散：科研标题中常见 Mult-/Complex 词首，另有标题词内片段、球队名片段及邮件常见词；缺乏统一的语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 标题中的复合词/词首片段
patterns.context: 出现在标题或句首，后接较长的术语或名词短语；包括 Multicenter、Multiresidue、Multivalent、Multilayer 和 Complex。
patterns.domain: 科研项目标题、PubMed论文标题

patterns.name: 词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 大写标题中，激活落在 PLANNING 和 EVALUATION 的词首或词内片段，而非整词一致位置。

patterns.name: 球队名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: Indiana Hoosiers 名称中，激活分别落在 Indiana 的开头和 Hoosiers 的词内；后者在重复出现时也激活。

patterns.name: 分类学术语中的词首片段
patterns.context: 昆虫属名 Hymenolepis 及其前置词 Survey 的多个词内片段被激活。

patterns.name: 常见短语中的功能词
patterns.context: 邮件正文句首的常见表达中，激活分散在多个常见词上，后续内容谈及近期努力。

en.description: The most consistent visible cue is the digit string “20” in mathematical expressions; “We” also appears in abstracts or explanatory text. Other highlights are scattered among mathematical symbols and a few domain-specific terms, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Number 20
patterns.context: The digit string 20 appears in mathematical expressions, coefficients, or integers; local markings sometimes cover a space and part of the following number.

patterns.name: English we
patterns.context: Capitalized We appears at the beginning or within a sentence, followed by research plans, researchers’ current work, or a description; in [3], We follows a verbal explanation of a formula.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts and mathematical problem text

patterns.name: Deltran product numerical specification
patterns.context: The number 20 appears in the power specification “20 amp” in a product description.

patterns.name: Other mathematical tokens
patterns.context: Appears around algebraic expressions, variable functions, line breaks, or operators; the specific tokens vary between passages and are difficult to group under one trigger apart from the shared number 20.

patterns.name: Biomedical terms
patterns.context: Terms for research subjects, experimental materials, or research progress appear in NIH abstracts; apart from overlap with “ We,” the terms vary.

9_2636.description: 最稳定的可见线索是数学式中的数字串“20”，另有摘要或文字说明中的“We”；其余高亮分散于数学符号和少数领域词项，未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字 20
patterns.context: 数字串 20 出现在数学表达式、系数或整数中；局部标记有时覆盖空格及后续数字的一部分。

patterns.name: 英文 we
patterns.context: 句首或句中出现大写 We，后接研究计划、研究人员当前工作或描述；[3] 中 We 位于公式文字说明之后。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要及数学题文字

patterns.name: Deltran 产品数字规格
patterns.context: 数字 20 出现在功率规格“20 amp”中，并处于产品介绍语境。

patterns.name: 其他数学 token
patterns.context: 出现在代数式、变量函数、换行或运算符周围；不同段落中的具体 token 并不一致，除共享数字 20 外难以归为同一触发项。

patterns.name: 生物医学领域词项
patterns.context: NIH 摘要中出现研究对象、实验材料或研究进展词语；除与“ We”重合外，各词项不一致。

en.description: The main triggers are the complete words let or such: let can introduce causatives, infinitives, or suggestions; such is often used to give examples or refer back with a qualifier. Other surface patterns include for example, lytic, and a word-initial substring of letrozole.

patterns.name: Example-introducing markers such as
patterns.context: Such is followed by examples or specifics; in passage 10, “let us simply assume that” introduces an example.

patterns.name: Expressions or actions introduced by let
patterns.context: Let is followed by an infinitive or a pronoun plus verb: let respondents express, let yourself be, let their child die, let us assume.
patterns.domain: Interview methods, advice, clinical ethics discussions, academic writing

patterns.name: Special subword in a term or process
patterns.context: Embedded in lytic infection in a research description of viral RNA metabolism; the word itself has no clear relation to the other main triggers.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment related to letrozole
patterns.context: Only a word-initial substring of letrozole, in the context of tumor resistance and aromatase inhibitors; it is not syntactic let.

patterns.name: Example-giving use of the function word such
patterns.context: Passage 1 uses such as to introduce footwear examples, and passage 3 uses such as to introduce rubber products; this is not the same grammatical usage as such strategies in passage 9.

patterns.name: Such modifying strategies
patterns.context: Such refers back to HIV prevention options mentioned earlier and modifies strategies; it is not a such as example construction.

9_2636.description: 主要触发是完整词 let 或 such：let 可引出使役、不定式或建议；such 常用于举例或回指限定。另有 for example、lytic，以及 letrozole 词首子串，表面模式各异。

patterns.name: suggest例示标记
patterns.context: such 后接举例或具体化内容；段10出现 let us simply assume that 后引出 example。
patterns.domain: 专利、医学/生物医学摘要与论文

patterns.name: let引导的表达/行动
patterns.context: let 后接不定式或代词加动词：let respondents express、let yourself be、let their child die、let us assume。
patterns.domain: 访谈方法、劝告文字、临床伦理讨论、学术论述

patterns.name: 术语或过程片段的特殊子词
patterns.context: 嵌在 lytic infection 中，处于病毒 RNA 代谢的科研描述里；该词本身与其他主要触发词关系不明。

patterns.name: letrozole相关药名片段
patterns.context: 只是 letrozole 词首子串，处于肿瘤耐药和芳香化酶抑制剂语境；并非句法上的 let。

patterns.name: 虚词such的例示用法
patterns.context: 段1为 such as 引出鞋类举例，段3为 such as 引出橡胶制品举例；与段9的 such strategies 不是同一语法用法。

patterns.name: such限定策略
patterns.context: such 回指前文提到的 HIV prevention options，并修饰 strategies；不是 such as 例示结构。

en.description: Activation is scattered across numbers and statistics, parenthetical additions, split proper names/abbreviations, and specialized entities from different fields; there are also sporadic instances of coordination, identity descriptions, code, and legal language. No single meaning covers all the fragments.

patterns.name: Numbers, percentages, and ranges
patterns.context: Numbers give quantitative information such as distance, dates, statistical proportions, age, population counts, or ordinals; not all numbers strongly activate.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narrative, academic, legal, and patent-background texts

patterns.name: Local fragments of proper names or abbreviations
patterns.context: When proper names, technical abbreviations, or code identifiers are split into multiple tokens, local fragments can strongly activate; the instances differ in meaning.
patterns.domain: Science, law, sports narratives, and code

patterns.name: Parenthetical supplementary information
patterns.context: When parentheses add quantities, identities, or abbreviation explanations, the parentheses and their contents activate; the parentheses themselves are usually weaker.

patterns.name: Coordination or contrast
patterns.context: Two options, groups, directions, or properties are coordinated, contrasted, or juxtaposed; activation is scattered, with no stable fixed trigger word.

patterns.name: Enumerated identity and group labels
patterns.context: Political, religious, class, or group identities are listed using coordinated nouns or adjectives; these markers appear only in this passage.

patterns.name: Medical terminology and biological processes
patterns.context: Specialized entities, mechanisms, or process terms in scientific passages activate in a scattered manner, rather than as a single terminology category.

patterns.name: Code comments and locale configuration
patterns.context: Comment-style configuration notes in a JavaScript file, followed by a locale configuration fragment.

patterns.name: Pronouns and judgments in dialogue
patterns.context: An email uses a personal pronoun to refer to someone, followed by a brief evaluation or cost judgment.

patterns.name: Uncertain identity and historical office narrative
patterns.context: The text first states that a person’s identity or name cannot be confirmed, then describes their parliamentary office; activation is distributed across ordinary narrative words and abbreviations.

patterns.name: Legal case facts and geographic location
patterns.context: Describes a defendant, a crime, temporal relations, and distance to a location, with quantitative information embedded in a statement of legal facts.

patterns.name: Sample demographics and age statistics
patterns.context: Reports participant counts, gender, and age range or mean in statistical form.

patterns.name: Symptom proportions and conditional statements in patents
patterns.context: Lists conditions or outcomes in sequence and uses percentages to describe incidence in a female population.

9_2636.concept: 结构化文本中的信息标记
9_2636.description: 激活分散于数字与统计量、括号补充、拆分的专名/缩写及各领域专门实体；另有零散并列、身份叙述、代码和法律表达。没有单一词义能覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 数字、百分比与数量区间
patterns.context: 数字用于距离、年代、统计比例、年龄、人数或序数等定量信息；并非所有数字都会强激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的叙述、学术文本、法律文本及专利背景

patterns.name: 专名或缩写的局部拆分
patterns.context: 专名、技术缩写或代码标识符被分成多个 token 时，局部片段可强激活；不同实例语义不一。
patterns.domain: 科学、法律、体育叙述及代码

patterns.name: 括号内补充信息
patterns.context: 括号中补充数量、身份或缩写解释时，括号及其内部内容出现激活；括号本身通常较弱。
patterns.domain: 学术、百科及说明性叙述

patterns.name: 并列或对照表达
patterns.trigger: « but»1« too»6« expensive»3« (»6«or»5…；« and»；« vice»2« versa»2
patterns.context: 对两个选项、群体、方向或性质作并列、转折或对照；激活较零散，未见稳定的固定触发词。

patterns.name: 枚举式身份与群体标签
patterns.context: 以并列名词或形容词列举政治、宗教、阶级或群体身份；这些标记仅在该段出现。

patterns.name: 医学术语与生物过程
patterns.context: 科学段落中的专业实体、机制或过程词出现分散激活，并非单一术语类别。

patterns.name: 代码注释和区域设置配置
patterns.context: JavaScript 文件中的注释式配置说明，随后出现 locale 配置片段。

patterns.name: 对话中的人称与判断
patterns.trigger: « him»1« He»2 is« OK»3« but»1« too»6« expensive»3
patterns.context: 邮件中以人称代词指称某人，并给出简短评价或成本判断。

patterns.name: 身份不明及历史职务叙述
patterns.context: 先说明人物身份或姓名无法确认，随后叙述其议会职务；激活点分布在普通叙述词与缩写。

patterns.name: 法律案件事实与地理位置
patterns.trigger: « 1»4« day»3« before»3 the« burglary»；« 70»10 miles；« important»6« issue»
patterns.context: 描述被告、犯罪事件、时间关系及地点距离，法律事实陈述中夹有数量信息。

patterns.name: 样本人口统计与年龄统计
patterns.context: 研究对象的人数构成、性别与年龄范围或均值，以统计格式报告。

patterns.name: 专利中的症状比例与条件句
patterns.trigger: « 90»5%« of» women、« 70»10%« of» women；« Second»、« Third»
patterns.context: 按序列举条件或结果，并用百分比描述女性群体中的发生比例。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的医学说明

en.concept: Expressions highlighting specific objects or examples
en.description: Activation falls mainly on “in particular,” used to highlight a specific object in academic text, and “such as,” used to introduce examples; it also responds strongly to a few place names and “learning” in migration and development contexts.

patterns.name: Highlighting a subgroup or example after “in particular”
patterns.context: A general situation, impact, or significance is stated first, followed by “in particular” to highlight a specific group, country, place, or object; there are also cases where “such as” introduces examples.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, medical and social science abstracts

patterns.name: Such as in classification examples
patterns.context: Introduces specific examples after a general statement; the examples may be diseases or scientific tools.

patterns.name: Place names followed by numbers
patterns.context: Place names appear in location comparisons, sample composition, or descriptions of specific locations; strong activation falls on the place name or related names.

patterns.name: Learning-related word
patterns.context: Describes developmental opportunities arising from children’s migration, followed by content such as learning a new language.
patterns.domain: Social science text on migration and child development

9_2636.concept: 突出具体对象或例子的表达
9_2636.description: 激活主要落在学术文本中用于突出特定对象的“in particular”和引出例子的“such as”；另对少数地点名及迁移发展语境中的“learning”有强响应。

patterns.name: 强调“特别是”后的子群或例子
patterns.context: 前文先陈述一般情况、影响或重要性，随后用“in particular”突出特定人群、国家、地点或对象；也有以“such as”引出例子的情况。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学与社会科学摘要

patterns.name: 分类举例中的 such as
patterns.context: 在概括性陈述之后引入具体实例；所引出的内容可能是疾病或科学工具。

patterns.name: 地点名及其后接数字
patterns.context: 地名出现在地点比较、样本构成或具体地点说明中；强激活落在地点名或相关地名上。
patterns.domain: 跨地区研究或旅行／文化类叙述

patterns.name: 学习相关词
patterns.context: 描述儿童迁移带来的发展机会，后接学习新语言等内容。
patterns.domain: 移民与儿童发展的社会科学文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across several text types: question words How/What introduce inquiries; other passages concern skilled workers and migration, psychiatry, literary anonymity, climate policy, ethnic groups and evolution, and early childhood intervention. The passages lack a consistent semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: How questions and information requests
patterns.context: How/What appears at the beginning of a question or direct quotation, asking about change, properties, or opinions; in passage 7, What’s appears in a quotation.
patterns.domain: Academic research, philosophical writing, forum quotations

patterns.name: Skilled-worker outflow and development impacts
patterns.context: Discusses skilled-worker supply and demand in the Gulf region or the losses and potential gains from professional migration; triggers are scattered across regional, skills, and example-giving contexts.

patterns.name: Psychiatry and language of radical reform
patterns.context: The word “psychiatry” is split across marked tokens, in a description of radical child psychiatry and a discussion of the term’s true radical implications.
patterns.domain: Medicine, history of psychiatry, or professional discourse

patterns.name: Abstract condition or anonymous identity term
patterns.context: A novel synopsis describes an African American narrator growing up in the South, attending college, and then living anonymously in Harlem.

patterns.name: Climate change policy terms
patterns.context: Climate change is described as not yet having become an issue in a discussion of whether Congress authorized the EPA to regulate greenhouse gases under the Clean Air Act.

patterns.name: Group noun and source of a quoted viewpoint
patterns.context: In a review of a philosophical book, Ashkenazi Jews appear as an example in an argument; Wade is the source of the quoted viewpoint. There is no clear common trigger condition around them.
patterns.domain: Book review concerning human evolution and group differences

patterns.name: Importance of early intervention
patterns.context: Reports a view emphasizing allocating resources to children from birth and the importance of the early home environment for development.
patterns.domain: Child development and public policy news

9_2636.description: 激活分散于多类文本：疑问词 How/What 引出询问；另涉及专业人才与移民、精神科、文学匿名身份、气候政策、族群与演化论述、儿童早期干预。各段缺乏一致的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: How 疑问句及信息询问
patterns.context: How/What 出现在问句或直接引语开头，引出对变化、性质或看法的询问；段7的 What’s 位于引语中。
patterns.domain: 学术研究、哲学论述、论坛引语

patterns.name: 专业人才外流与发展影响
patterns.context: 讨论海湾地区专业人才供需，或专业人士移民的损失与潜在收益；触发点分散在地域、技能和举例语境中。
patterns.domain: 劳动力、移民与发展研究

patterns.name: 精神科及激进改革措辞
patterns.context: 词语“psychiatry”被拆分标记，处于对激进儿童精神科的描述及其真正激进主义含义的讨论中。
patterns.domain: 医学、精神科史或专业论述

patterns.name: 抽象状态或匿名身份词
patterns.context: 小说简介叙述非裔美国叙述者在南方成长、上大学后，在哈莱姆过匿名生活。

patterns.name: 气候变化议题词
patterns.context: 讨论国会是否授权 EPA 依据《清洁空气法》监管温室气体时，提到气候变化当时尚未成为议题。

patterns.name: 群体名词与引文中的观点人物
patterns.context: 哲学著作评论中，Ashkenazi Jews 作为论证例证出现；Wade 是所引观点的来源。二者周边没有明显统一的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 人类演化、群体差异相关书评

patterns.name: 早期干预重要性
patterns.context: 转述报告观点，强调从出生起为儿童配置资源、早期家庭环境对发展的重要性。
patterns.domain: 儿童发展、公共政策新闻

en.description: Activation falls on word endings of keywords or proper names across several fields: research, biomedicine, intelligence, legal safety, philosophical terminology, poetic forms, and espionage. Apart from some recurrence in research contexts, the triggers and meanings are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Proper-name endings in biomedical and research contexts
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of research institutions, clinical collaborations, or research fields; strong activation is concentrated on the final “T” of an abbreviation.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of fictional proper name Walensor
patterns.context: The same fictional place name is repeated, with activation on its latter part; the narrative concerns deities, princes, and political conflict.
patterns.domain: Fantasy novel review or plot synopsis

patterns.name: Safety in a legal phrase
patterns.context: In a legal dispute about expert qualifications, oral testimony, and pool safety, activation falls on “safety.”

patterns.name: IQ and intelligence discussion
patterns.context: When discussing IQ, genetic and environmental contributions, and the scope of intelligence measurement, activation falls on “intelligence.”

patterns.name: Translational medicine and neural engineering
patterns.context: Discusses redirecting academic science toward clinically relevant problems, translational research, or biomedical engineering; activation is distributed across field-specific keywords.
patterns.domain: NIH research projects and biomedical research

patterns.name: Research on disease mechanisms
patterns.context: “Despite decades of research” introduces basic disease mechanisms; activation falls on a general research word.

patterns.name: Duhem terminology in intellectual history
patterns.context: Discusses physics, methodological judgments, and Duhemian thought; activation falls on the ending of a proper-name derivative.

patterns.name: Ending of the proper name Haiku
patterns.context: Discusses Russian poets and the loss of elements of the haiku form in an adaptation; activation falls on the end of the poetic form’s name.

patterns.name: Contemporary biology and graduate training
patterns.context: Describes a graduate core course covering contemporary biology and its techniques; activation falls on the discipline name.

patterns.name: Ending of espionage
patterns.context: After listing Silicon Valley industries, the text discusses espionage targeting the region; activation falls on the latter part of “espionage.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry, industry, and security issues

9_2636.description: 激活落在多种领域关键词或专名的词尾：科研、生物医学、智力、法律安全、哲学术语、诗体及间谍活动。除科研语境稍有重复外，触发词和语义并不一致。

patterns.name: 生物医学与研究语境中的专名词尾
patterns.context: 出现在研究机构、临床合作或科研领域介绍中；强激活集中在缩写末尾的 “T”。
patterns.domain: NIH 机构介绍、科研宣传

patterns.name: 虚构专名 Walensor 的内部片段
patterns.context: 同一虚构地名重复出现，激活落在其后半部分；叙述围绕神祇、王子及政治冲突。
patterns.domain: 幻想小说评论或剧情介绍

patterns.name: 法律短语中的 safety
patterns.context: 专家资格、口头证词及泳池安全问题的法律争议中，激活落在 “safety”。

patterns.name: IQ 与 intelligence 讨论
patterns.context: 谈论 IQ、遗传与环境贡献及智力衡量范围时，激活落在 “intelligence”。

patterns.name: 转化医学与神经工程
patterns.context: 讨论把学术科学转向临床相关问题、转化研究或生物医学工程；激活分布在领域关键词上。
patterns.domain: NIH 科研项目与生物医学研究

patterns.name: 病理机制研究
patterns.context: “Despite decades of research”后引出基本发病机制；激活落在一般科研词上。

patterns.name: Duhem 思想史术语
patterns.context: 讨论物理学、方法论判断及 Duhemian 思想；激活落在专名派生词的词尾部分。

patterns.name: Haiku 专名词尾
patterns.context: 谈论俄国诗人与俳句形式在改编中元素的损失；激活落在诗体名称末尾。

patterns.name: 当代生物学与研究生培养
patterns.context: 描述研究生核心课程覆盖当代生物学及其技术；激活落在学科名。

patterns.name: 间谍活动词尾
patterns.context: 列举硅谷产业后谈到针对该地区的间谍活动；激活落在 “espionage” 的后半部分。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、产业与安全议题

en.description: Activation is distributed across abstract discourse terms, discipline and field names, components of proper titles, fixed expressions, and drug names; semantic and syntactic functions vary considerably, with no consistent trigger condition.

patterns.name: Cross-domain abstract nouns
patterns.context: Abstract or generalizing words appear in prominent positions when describing ideas, viewpoints, research subjects, or topics; their specific meanings and syntactic positions vary.
patterns.domain: Academic discourse, philosophical texts, interview narratives

patterns.name: Professional fields and discipline names
patterns.context: Field names or their key components activate when research fields, technology industries, or sociocultural topics are mentioned; they do not always appear as complete terms.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, neural engineering, technology, African studies

patterns.name: Words within proper names or titles
patterns.context: In the names of a comic work and its characters, the common word “Man” appears as part of a proper name; nearby text concerns Marvel works and sequels.

patterns.name: Prominent noun in a fixed expression
patterns.context: In the proper-name-like fixed expression “Chesterton’s Fence,” the noun “Fence” is split into marked tokens and strongly activates.
patterns.domain: Aphoristic discourse, political or social commentary

patterns.name: Drug and drug-culture discussion
patterns.context: MDMA appears as a drug name in a discussion of drug-use patterns, cultural acceptance, and future media coverage.

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: These words are locally strong in the passages, but the available excerpts do not reliably group them under the patterns above or support a unified trigger condition.

9_2636.description: 激活分布在抽象论述词、学科与领域名称、作品专名组成词、固定表达及药物名称上；语义和句法功能差异明显，尚无一致触发条件。

patterns.name: 跨领域抽象名词
patterns.context: 描述思想、观点、研究对象或话题时，抽象概括性词语处于句中突出位置；具体语义和句法位置不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、哲学文本、访谈叙述

patterns.name: 专业领域与学科名称
patterns.context: 提及研究领域、技术行业或社会文化研究主题时，领域名称或其关键组成词激活；未必都以完整术语形式出现。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、神经工程、科技、非洲研究

patterns.name: 专名或作品名称中的组成词
patterns.context: 漫画作品及其角色的名称中，普通词“Man”作为专名组成部分出现；邻近文本涉及漫威作品与续作。

patterns.name: 固定术语中的显著名词
patterns.context: 在“Chesterton’s Fence”这一专名式固定表达中，名词“Fence”被拆分标记并强烈激活。
patterns.domain: 格言式论述、政治或社会评论

patterns.name: 药物及药物文化讨论
patterns.context: 讨论药物使用模式、文化接受度及未来媒体报道时，MDMA作为药物名称出现。
patterns.domain: 药物使用、社会文化评论

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: 各段中可见这些词局部较强，但现有片段无法将其稳定归为前述模式，也不足以推出统一触发条件。

en.description: Activation is distributed across art, photography, and music, as well as health, medicine, and healthcare policy contexts; data-entry work and the visibility of Asian men in the technology industry also appear. Triggers are mostly field-specific terms, with no single clear shared lexical item.

patterns.name: Art, images, and photography
patterns.context: Discusses the status of photographs/images, artistic identity, or music as an art form; also includes art criticism and accounts of photography history.
patterns.domain: Philosophy of art, photography, music criticism, and interviews

patterns.name: Health and medical fields
patterns.context: Medical, public health, health advocacy, or healthcare policy contexts; trigger words sometimes occur within longer technical terms or institution names.
patterns.domain: Public health, genomics, healthcare policy, and treatment

patterns.name: Data entry and data-related work
patterns.context: Mentions data-entry work, workload, or data-related activities.
patterns.domain: Work experiences, technology, and internet discussions

patterns.name: Asian men in the technology industry
patterns.context: Compares the visibility of Asian men at universities and in technology startups.

9_2636.description: 激活分布在艺术、摄影与音乐，以及健康、医学和医疗政策语境；另见数据录入工作和科技行业中亚裔男性可见度。触发多为领域词，尚无单一明确共同词项。

patterns.name: 艺术、图像与摄影
patterns.context: 讨论照片/图像的地位、艺术身份或音乐作为艺术形式；也包括艺术评论与摄影史叙述。
patterns.domain: 艺术哲学、摄影、音乐评论与人物访谈

patterns.name: 健康与医学领域
patterns.context: 医学、公共卫生、健康倡议或医疗政策语境；触发词有时处于较长专业词或机构名称中。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、基因组学、医疗政策与治疗

patterns.name: 数据录入及数据相关工作
patterns.context: 谈及数据录入工作、任务负担或数据相关活动。
patterns.domain: 职场经历、科技与互联网讨论

patterns.name: 科技行业中的亚洲男性
patterns.context: 对比亚裔男性在大学与科技创业公司中的可见度。

en.description: Core terms and their explanations, evaluations, or debate contexts are activated across multiple academic, technical, and cultural topics. There is no shared fixed word form; cross-domain consistency lies mainly in discussion centered on a topic.

patterns.name: Health and life sciences
patterns.context: Activates near field names or core terms when introducing disciplinary composition, describing experimental results, or discussing archaeological evidence.

patterns.name: Music and literary criticism
patterns.context: Book reviews or critiques evaluate music and its significance as an art form and way of life.
patterns.domain: Music, book reviews, and cultural criticism

patterns.name: Sports recruitment and rules discussion
patterns.context: Activates when asking how sports recruitment works and comparing rules for different athletes visiting schools.

patterns.name: Big data and statistical sampling
patterns.context: Explains the meaning of big data and discusses why sampling and data security need not cover every record.

patterns.name: Software development and spelling correction
patterns.context: Discusses how hacker communities should focus on writing software and criticizes an entity for being unable even to spell correctly.

patterns.name: Comedy and joke evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses whether mocking hypocrisy or absurdity counts as a joke and evaluates its comedic effect.

patterns.name: Diversity and identity issues in technology
patterns.context: Discusses the representation of Asian women in engineering and the relationship among identity, diversity, and advocacy.

patterns.name: Quantum mechanics terminology Q&A
